location.name: Four separate underground pits: Ardougne, Varrock, Keldagrim, Port Sarim (each entered from its own street-level trapdoor/entrance)

notes: 2-player-only PvP gambling minigame explicitly flagged by the wiki as one of the least popular/most dead pieces of content in the game -- finding a second live player is the main practical obstacle, not any skill/level barrier. Ironmen are hard-locked out entirely. Each of the 4 pits accepts only one specific cat growth stage (kitten/cat/overgrown cat/wily cat respectively), unlocked individually as you progress through Ratcatchers rather than needing the full quest. Both players stake an equal coin bet (100-20k), then optionally use a catspeak amulet (or Dragon Slayer II's innate catspeak) to pick one of 4 tactical dialogue options trading Attack/Strength for Defence/Hitpoints (and whether the cat flees at low health vs fights to the death) before the cats duke it out against rats until one owner's cat dies/flees (loss) or both simultaneously tire out (draw, bets refunded). Reward is purely the opponent's coin stake plus a modest cat-growth-timer boost at the Ardougne/Varrock pits only (~15 min win / ~7.5 min loss) -- no xp, no unlocks, no gear. Given the dead-content status and pure coinflip-adjacent nature, this is a low-priority novelty stop in any progression route, useful only as a cat-growth accelerant if a partner happens to be present.

items: None required to enter -- weapons are auto-unequipped into inventory on entry; low-Hitpoints players are advised to bring food since tackles deal chip damage

xp.Agility: 4-7 xp per goal scored, plus a flat 25 xp bonus for winning (first to 5 goals)
xp.Ranged: 4-7 xp per goal scored, plus a flat 25 xp bonus for winning

items: One gnomeball (tradeable, GE-priced) awarded on winning a game -- capped at one per game, and players who brought their own gnomeball onto the pitch don't get a second one from winning

location.name: North-western Tree Gnome Stronghold (dedicated pitch)

notes: Free-for-all sports minigame: get a gnomeball from the referee on entry, then Pass (to teammates or the two green gnome wingers, who pass it back after a delay), Tackle (opposing gnomes/players -- success chance scaled by Agility, and being tackled while holding the ball transfers it to the tackler plus 1-2 damage), or Shoot (success scaled by Ranged level and proximity to goal) to score. First to 5 points wins and their score resets. Any number of players can join simultaneously (no team-size requirement). Xp gain is small and per-goal (not per-attempt), so this is a low-intensity Ranged/Agility trickle rather than a training method, with scoring one goal being an Easy Western Provinces Diary requirement -- best framed as a quick diary-task stop rather than a repeatable grind target.

skills.Hunter: 17 minimum to enter the maze and catch the lowest impling tier (baby impling), 27 to catch it net-and-jar-free (barehanded threshold in parens is +10 over the netted minimum for every tier); higher tiers need progressively higher Hunter up to 89/99 for lucky implings

quests: Lost City needed only for the permanent Zanaris crop-circle portal shortcut -- no quest is required to reach Puro-Puro via the migratory surface crop circles
Fairytale II - Cure a Queen partial completion recommended for fairy-ring access as a travel aid, not a hard gate
items: A butterfly net and 7 starter impling jars (given free by the Elnock Inquisitor on first entry, along with an impling scroll that tracks catches per type)
Magic butterfly net (higher catch chance, purchasable from Elnock once unlocked) recommended over the base net
Weight-reducing clothing, magic armour pieces (boosts entangle/dark lure success), ring of endurance or stamina potions all recommended but optional

rewards.xp: Hunter, scaled to impling tier caught (baby lowest through lucky highest)
items: Jarred implings themselves, each openable for a loot table of trinkets/treasures scaled to tier -- GE-priced jars exist for most tiers (baby through dragon); lucky implings are untradeable
Crystal impling is the sole impling type NOT available in Puro-Puro (Prifddinas only)
unlocks: Elnock's Exchange barter shop: 3 baby+2 young+1 gourmet jars -> Imp repellent; 3 gourmet+2 earth+1 essence jars -> Magic butterfly net; 3 essence+2 eclectic+1 nature jars -> Jar generator; 1 jar of any type -> 3 empty impling jars (a jar-replenishment loop)

location.name: Puro-Puro, reached via the permanent Zanaris crop circle (Lost City) or a migratory surface crop circle found by talking to the wandering impling in Zanaris' wheat field

notes: Solo Hunter minigame: a maze of magical wheat rows (pushable through with high Strength) inside which implings of many tiers spawn and must be net-caught then jarred (or, at higher Hunter, caught barehanded for an on-the-spot catch without needing a jar at all -- though jars are still needed to carry a barehanded catch out, per the wiki's own catch-mechanics caveat). This is functionally the concentrated version of impling hunting that's otherwise done ambiently across the overworld -- nearly every impling type in the game (baby through lucky) spawns here, the sole exception being the crystal impling which is Prifddinas-only. Elnock Inquisitor at the entrance both onboards new players (free net + 7 jars + tracking scroll) and runs a barter exchange converting caught jars into catching aids (repellent, magic net, jar generator) rather than gp, plus a daily gold-coin jar purchase cap of 10. Reward value is almost entirely in what's inside the jars (trinkets/treasures/gp scaling with tier) plus the Hunter xp for the catch itself -- there's no separate minigame-specific gear/unlock track beyond the catching-aid exchange.

skills.Thieving: None to enter the central garden/Winter garden; 25 for Spring, 45 for Autumn, 65 for Summer (each seasonal garden's sq'irk tree and herb patch require matching or exceeding that garden's Thieving level to enter -- boosts, including from the sq'irkjuice reward itself, count)

quests: Prince Ali Rescue (talk to Osman) -- Beneath Cursed Sands additionally unlocks Selim as an alternate quest-giver for the same minigame
items: Pestle and mortar (to crush picked sq'irk fruit into an empty beer glass for juice)
Empty beer glasses (free from searching shelves in the Sorceress's house, or Crafting-made)

xp.Farming: Flat 50 xp per herb pick (25 xp/herb, always yields 2 clean herbs regardless of which seasonal garden), independent of season
xp.Cooking: Flat 5 xp per sq'irk crushed into juice, independent of season
xp.Thieving: From Osman/Selim redeeming sq'irkjuice: 350 (Winter) / 1350 (Spring) / 2350 (Autumn) / 3000 (Summer) xp per juice

items: Sq'irk fruit (Winter/Spring/Autumn/Summer tier, crushable into matching sq'irkjuice) -- exactly one fruit OR 2 herbs pickable per garden entry, then auto-teleported out

Random clean herbs per garden tier: Winter (guam/marrentill/tarromin/harralander only), Spring adds irit+avantoe, Autumn adds ranarr+kwuarm+cadantine, Summer adds lantadyme+dwarf weed -- higher seasons strictly superset lower ones on the herb table
unlocks: Sq'irkjuice can alternatively be drunk instead of turned in, for a temporary Thieving boost (0/+1/+2/+3 by season) plus run-energy restore (5%/10%/15%/20% by season) -- a self-contained utility loop as well as an xp-turn-in item

location.name: Sorceress's house near Shantay Pass, Al Kharid (garden itself is a separate instanced area entered via the apprentice)

notes: Solo (or crowded-mass-world) Thieving/Farming/Cooking minigame: sneak past guardian elementals in one of four seasonal instanced gardens (each gated by a Thieving level) to steal either one sq'irk fruit from that season's tree or 2 random herbs, then you're auto-teleported back out to the central fountain-garden hub -- so each 'run' is a single fast in-and-out. Getting spotted by an elemental (which can only detect/teleport you within 2 tiles) ejects you empty-handed. The wiki documents two efficiency strategies: solo speed-running with run energy maximized via low weight/Agility/stamina potions, or a now largely-dead 'mass worlds' method (historically World 471) where enough simultaneous thieves diffuse elemental attention so almost everyone reaches the tree unclicked-at, though the wiki notes this is rarely populated enough to work anymore except at peak times for the Summer garden. Reward loop is dual-purpose: crushed sq'irkjuice turned in to Osman/Selim gives large flat Thieving xp chunks scaled steeply by season (350 up to 3000 per juice), or can instead be drunk on the spot for a temporary Thieving level boost + run energy refill, letting higher-tier gardens bootstrap access to themselves. Herb picks are a flat, season-independent 50 Farming xp with the herb pool simply widening at higher seasons. No combat, no gp cost, purely a stealth-timing minigame best suited to short repeated bursts for Thieving xp injections or bulk herb collection.

items: skilling tools (pickaxe/axe/harpoon/herblore secondaries) to gather in-raid resources for points

rewards.xp: no lump completion xp -- Combat, Mining, Woodcutting, Herblore, Farming, Hunter, Cooking, Fishing, Thieving, Firemaking and Agility xp all accrue naturally from the resource-gathering and combat actions performed inside the raid to build points
rewards.items: Ancient Chest unique table (weighted, 1% chance per 8,676 team points, capped 65.7% per roll, up to 6 rolls/raid): Twisted bow (2/69), Kodai insignia (2/69), Elder maul (2/69), Dragon claws (3/69), Ancestral hat/robe top/robe bottom (3/69 each), Dinh's bulwark (3/69), Dragon hunter crossbow (4/69), Twisted buckler (4/69), Dexterous/Arcane prayer scroll (20/69 each); dark journal and metamorphic dust/twisted ancestral colour kit (challenge mode) can drop alongside any roll; 7 lootable books drop from named bosses/the chest
rewards.unlocks: Xerician cape accolades from Captain Rimor at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Challenge Mode completions (Xeric's guard/warrior/sentinel/general/champion); an ancient tablet reward unlocks a direct Xeric's talisman teleport to the mountain

location.name: Cave system beneath Mount Quidamortem, Kebos Lowlands (Great Kourend) -- reachable via Lovakengj Minecart Network, fairy ring code BLS, or on foot from the Shayziens' Wall

notes: OSRS's first raid (Raids 1) -- a scaling 1-100 player PvM+skilling raid with no hard entry gate (no required quest or skill level), procedurally laid out from a pool of resource/puzzle/boss rooms culminating in the Great Olm. Reward quality is driven entirely by team points banked during the run (combat kills + skilling actions), not by a fixed completion bonus, so higher-level accounts and more thorough resource-gathering both push loot chances up. Challenge Mode (a harder fixed-layout variant) is the only route to the cosmetic ancestral colour kit and counts separately toward the Xerician cape ladder.

quests: Priest in Peril (only hard requirement -- unlocks Morytania access)

rewards.xp: no direct completion xp beyond normal combat xp from killing the room bosses
rewards.items: Monumental Chest common table (3 rolls if no unique) plus a unique-roll chance per player per completion: Avernic defender hilt, Justiciar faceguard/chestguard/legguards, Ghrazi rapier, Sanguinesti staff, Scythe of vitur, plus Vials of blood as a common uniques-adjacent drop (charges Scythe of Vitur, makes bastion/battlemage potions); 6 lootable books drop from the named room bosses and the treasure vault bookshelves
rewards.unlocks: Sinhaza shroud tiers 1-5 from the Mysterious Stranger at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Normal/Hard Mode completions

location.name: Beneath the castle of Ver Sinhaza, Morytania -- reachable via Drakan's medallion (post-A Taste of Hope), paying Andras 10,000 coins near the Ectofuntus in Port Phasmatys, Ectophial, or the Burgh de Rott boat after starting Darkness of Hallowvale

notes: Raids 2 -- a fixed 1-5 player raid (unlike CoX's scaling layout) with genuinely the lowest entry bar of the three raids: no combat/skill level is enforced, only Priest in Peril for Morytania access. Loot is per-player (up to 5 large chests spawn, one per party member) rather than team-pooled like CoX, and a unique roll glows the chest purple the same way CoX's beam does. Hard Mode is a separate, harder scaled variant of the same room sequence rather than a distinct raid.

quests: Beneath Cursed Sands (hard requirement to enter)

rewards.xp: no direct completion xp beyond normal combat xp from the four path bosses and the Wardens
rewards.items: Sarcophagus unique roll (one unique max per raid, else 3 common-table rolls): Masori mask/body/chaps, Lightbearer, Osmumten's fang, Elidinis' ward, Tumeken's shadow; independent tertiary rolls for Thread of elidinis (divine rune pouch component), keris partisan jewels (Breach of the scarab, Eye of the corruptor, Jewel of the sun, Jewel of amascut) and the Tumeken's guardian pet; under 1,500 points yields fossilised dung instead; 6 lootable books drop from the path bosses/Wardens/burial-chamber bags
rewards.unlocks: Icthlarin's shroud tiers 1-5 (tier 5 also grants Icthlarin's hood) from a lobby chest at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Normal/Expert Mode completions

location.name: Jaltevas Pyramid necropolis, Kharidian Desert -- reachable via Pharaoh's sceptre (post-obelisk activation), fairy ring code AKP (needs Agility 62), or the Shantay Pass/Pollnivneach/Sophanem magic carpet chain

notes: Raids 3 -- unique among the three raids for its Invocation system: players tune raid difficulty/length pre-entry by toggling modifier tiers, which scales both danger and the raid-level number used for loot-table weighting, so 'the raid' isn't a single fixed difficulty like CoX/ToB but a player-selected point on a difficulty curve. Up to 8 players per party (largest of the three raids). A post-raid Raid Summary interface hands out flavour titles (The Leech/The Carry/etc.) based on performance stats, purely cosmetic bragging-rights info with no mechanical reward attached.

items: combat gear/prayer for level-360 Ket-Zek and level-702 TzTok-Jad

rewards.xp: no bonus xp beyond normal combat xp from the 63 waves
rewards.items: 8,032 Tokkul on defeating TzTok-Jad plus 2 additional Tokkul per wave cleared (running total N*(N+1) for N waves) with a further 4,000 Tokkul bonus for the Jad kill itself; 1/200 chance of the TzRek-jad pet on the Jad kill (1/100 on a Slayer task), plus a second independent 1/200 roll if a spare fire cape is exchanged with TzHaar-Mej-Jal afterward
rewards.unlocks: fire cape (untradeable) on defeating TzTok-Jad -- this is the sole entry ticket into the Inferno; Elite Karamja Diary doubles Tokkul earned here and grants one free resurrection per day inside the Fight Caves

location.name: Mor Ul Rek, Karamja volcano -- reachable via the 'TzHaar Fight Pit' Minigame Teleport or fairy ring code BLP then running north

notes: Solo 63-wave combat gauntlet with zero entry requirements (no quest, no level, open from level 1) -- the classic early-to-mid-game major challenge. Because there's no restocking and only one life (barring the diary's free resurrection), the run is entirely about surviving the escalating waves up to TzTok-Jad, the level-702 final boss. It exists in the same TzHaar volcano complex as the harder Inferno, which explicitly requires sacrificing a fire cape earned here to even attempt.

items: fire cape (one-time entry fee, consumed by TzHaar-Ket-Keh)
top-tier combat gear/prayer for the 69-wave gauntlet and the level-1400 TzKal-Zuk

rewards.xp: no bonus xp beyond normal combat xp from the 69 waves
rewards.items: Tokkul scaled to the wave reached, 16,440 max (doubled with the elite Karamja Diary); 1/100 chance of the Jal-nib-rek pet on defeating TzKal-Zuk (1/75 on a Slayer task), plus a second independent 1/100 roll by exchanging a spare infernal cape with TzHaar-Ket-Keh afterward
rewards.unlocks: infernal cape (untradeable, the strict best melee cape in the game per the wiki's own Fight Caves comparison) on defeating TzKal-Zuk; a defeated TzKal-Zuk can later be assigned as a Slayer task, applying to all Inferno monsters on that task

location.name: Mor Ul Rek, Karamja volcano (same complex as the Fight Caves) -- entered by handing a fire cape to TzHaar-Ket-Keh

notes: The successor solo challenge to the Fight Caves and, per the wiki's own cited Jagex quote, 'the greatest solo PvM challenge ever' at release -- explicitly no requirement beyond sacrificing a fire cape. A death sends the player all the way back to wave 1 (no checkpoint/restock), and the run can only be paused (not saved) by logging out between waves; purple sweets are disabled inside. Restricted to unrestricted worlds only since 2018 to stop free unlimited practice, later loosened again from 2021.

quests: Children of the Sun (required for all of Varlamore, including the Colosseum)
items: combat gear/prayer for the 12 waves and final boss Sol Heredit
food + potions (all accumulated wave loot is lost on death/teleport/logout mid-run)

rewards.xp: no bonus xp beyond normal combat xp from the 12 waves
rewards.items: Rewards Chest loot banked wave-by-wave (bankable any time by ending the run, or lost entirely on death/logout); unique rolls open from wave 4 onward with rising odds: Sunfire fanatic helm/cuirass/chausses, Tonalztics of ralos (wave 7+ only), Echo crystal (combines with guardian boots into echo boots), plus Sunfire splinters as a common uniques-adjacent drop (charges Dizana's quiver/Tonalztics, crafts sunfire runes/searing pages/sunfire wine)
rewards.unlocks: Dizana's quiver + Smol heredit pet guaranteed on beating Sol Heredit in wave 12; Glory-tier citizen perks at 2,000/5,000/8,000/12,000/16,000/20,000 personal-best Glory: Colosseum bank chest access, Civitas illa Fortis as respawn point, Oriana buying valuables at 65gp each, ring of dueling teleport to the Colosseum, disease-free Outer Fortis herb patch, and the Fortis Salute emote

location.name: Cliffs east of Civitas illa Fortis, Varlamore -- reachable via ring of dueling teleport (12,000 Glory), Quetzal transport, Civitas illa Fortis Teleport (Magic 54 + Twilight's Promise), or chartered ship

notes: Solo 12-wave combat gauntlet (2024, Varlamore: Part One) structurally like the Fight Caves/Inferno but with a bank-or-push-your-luck loot mechanic instead of a single end-of-run roll -- players choose each wave whether to bank current+next-wave loot or press on for better odds, and any death/teleport/logout forfeits everything unbanked. Glory (the performance score from clearing waves) is a personal-best ladder, not an accumulating currency, and unlocks account-wide QoL perks separate from the item rewards.

quests: Song of the Elves (required for Prifddinas access)

rewards.xp: no direct completion xp bonus; all skilling done while gathering supplies (Mining/Woodcutting/Fishing/Herblore/Smithing/Cooking-style crafting of gear) grants its normal skill xp during the run
rewards.items: two rolls on the Reward Chest common table plus several crystal shards and a unique roll every completion: crystal armour seed (1/120, -> crystal armour), crystal weapon seed (1/120), enhanced crystal weapon seed (1/2000, -> Blade of Saeldor/Bow of Faerdhinen), Youngllef pet (1/2000); a smaller consolation reward drops on failure/early exit but with no unique chance
rewards.unlocks: unlocked after completing The Gauntlet once, players may attempt the harder Corrupted Gauntlet variant (see minigamedb:corrupted-gauntlet)

location.name: Gauntlet Portal, north-western Prifddinas

notes: Solo procedurally-generated dungeon: players enter with zero items (everything is auto-banked on entry, boosts stripped) and must gather resource nodes/herbs/fish within the dungeon to craft their own weapons, armour, food and potions before a timed fight against the Crystalline Hunllef in the boss room. It's a dangerous minigame -- hardcore ironmen lose HC status and ultimate ironmen can lose instanced-bank items on death here. Built as the Amlodd Clan's warrior-training ground per its own in-game lore.

reqs.notes: must complete the regular Gauntlet at least once before the Corrupted variant becomes accessible (progression gate, not a quest/skill/item)

rewards.xp: no direct completion xp bonus; skilling actions during preparation grant normal skill xp same as the regular Gauntlet
rewards.items: three rolls on an upgraded Reward Chest table plus 7-12 crystal shards and a higher-odds unique roll every completion: crystal armour seed (1/50), crystal weapon seed (1/50), enhanced crystal weapon seed (1/400), Youngllef pet (1/800); Gauntlet cape is a guaranteed drop every completion
rewards.unlocks: Gauntlet cape guaranteed on every completion (cosmetic accolade cape)

location.name: Gauntlet Portal, north-western Prifddinas (same entrance as the regular Gauntlet, offered as a harder mode after first clear)

notes: Harder mode of The Gauntlet: same procedurally-generated dungeon shell but only 7:30 to prepare (vs 10:00 normal), all monsters/items are Corrupted-tier with increased stats, and the inner 3x3 ring around the boss room drops its usual resource-randomness mitigation (except one room guaranteed 3 fishing spots). The boss room's Corrupted Hunllef has 1000 HP with a max-hit table that scales down by the summed armour tier worn (0/3/6/9) while running the correct protection prayer -- gearing up through crafted Corrupted armour tiers materially changes survivability, not just cosmetic.

quests: Song of the Elves (Prifddinas access, prerequisite to the level gate)
items: graceful outfit and Varrock armour recommended for movement/pickpocket-style resource speed

rewards.xp: Mining xp OR item drops, player's choice (ask Rhiannon to switch) -- xp scales with contribution points (~points_main + points_tertiary*5) and is boosted by the Prospector kit; the unique/pet roll always happens regardless of which mode is chosen
rewards.items: main + tertiary drop tables scale with points (damage-to-health + 2x damage-to-shield, capped 400/300 respectively for tertiary); guaranteed 1-3 crystal shards + infernal ashes (MVP-only ashes) every eligible kill; runes (blood/cosmic/death/law/soul/nature) and noted ore/bar/gem materials (silver/coal/mithril/adamantite/runite/gold, steel/mithril/adamantite/runite bars, uncut diamond/dragonstone, onyx bolt tips, pure essence) on the main table; tertiary-only 1/200 roll for the crystal tool seed table (39/8000 seed, 1/8000 uncut onyx), Zalcano shard (1/750-1/1500 by contribution), Smolcano pet (flat 1/2250)

location.name: Volcanic caverns beneath Prifddinas, Trahaearn district -- via the teleport platform west of the south-eastern bank, or teleport crystal/eternal teleport crystal, spirit tree, or POH teleport with a Prifddinas house

notes: Not a conventional combat boss: Zalcano is immune to normal damage, so the fight is a skilling encounter -- players mine ore, smith it, and runecraft it into imbued tephra to strip her stone armour, then finish her off by mining her directly with a pickaxe (all her own attacks are typeless, so prayer can't reduce them). Must do at least 5 damage to her shield to be loot-eligible at all, and 31 combined damage to be eligible for uniques/pet; the MVP (top damage) gets a bonus 10% of their own non-unique loot on top. A group activity in practice even though it's fought solo-eligible, since ironmen need to join others' instances to get rewards.

items: metal bars, or metal equipment worth at least 2 bars, to feed each commission
a bucket (obtainable on-site) or Ice gloves to lift moulded weapons

rewards.xp: Smithing xp per sword forged, scaled by final quality (metal score + mould score, minus 5 per mistake)
rewards.items: a gold payout per sword equal to double the Smithing xp reward (bars/mould choices, e.g. steel or a 14/14 steel-mithril blend, can make forging net-profitable at high quality); Foundry Reputation earned 1:1 with final quality, spendable on extra moulds per preform section or in the Reward Shop for Double ammo mould (2,000 rep, needs Dwarf Cannon quest), Kovac's grog (300), Smithing catalyst (15), Ore pack (200), Smiths tunic/trousers (4,000 each), Smiths boots/gloves (3,500 each, gloves combine with ice gloves into smiths gloves (i)), Colossal blade (5,000)

location.name: Cave beneath the Giants' Plateau, Kharidian Desert edge -- reachable via Minigame Teleport, amulet of glory to Al Kharid Palace, ring of dueling to Emir's Arena, gnome glider to Kar-Hewo, or the Al Kharid toll gate from Lumbridge

notes: A Smithing minigame, not a combat one: players fulfil giant-sized weapon commissions for Kovac by choosing a metal blend and preform mould combination, then working a heat/hammer minigame ('sweet spot' timing during Refinement) to maximise sword quality before handing it in. No Smithing level is directly enforced by the activity itself, but Sleeping Giants (the entry quest) has its own Smithing requirement, so in practice it's gated by that quest's prerequisites rather than a level check at the door.

items: a telescope in a POH study room to locate the next star (oak=24min window, teak=9min, mahogany=2min) -- optional, not required to mine a star once found

rewards.xp: Mining xp while mining the crashed star, idle-friendly (only needs input roughly every 7 minutes); F2P players get half xp and no shop access; ~30,000 xp/hour achievable at 90+ Mining with a dragon pickaxe
rewards.items: stardust, spent at Dusuri's Star Shop by the Mining Guild entrance in Falador on: celestial ring (uncharged, 1600 to buy/2000 to sell), star fragment (2400/3000), bag full of gems -stardust variant- (240/300), soft clay pack -stardust variant- (120/150)

location.name: Global -- a star crashes roughly every 90 minutes (+/- 15) per server at a random spot from a fixed landing-site pool spanning nearly every major region (Asgarnia, Crandor/Karamja, Feldip Hills/Isle of Souls, Fossil Island/Mos Le'Harmless, Fremennik Lands/Lunar Isle, Great Kourend, Kandarin, Kebos Lowlands, Kharidian Desert, Misthalin, Morytania, Piscatoris/Gnome Stronghold, Tirannwn, Varlamore, Wilderness)

notes: A free-to-play-eligible Distraction and Diversion, not a members-only minigame -- F2P players can mine stars but can't spend stardust at the shop (half xp too). Locating a star well requires a player-owned house telescope (better wood tier = tighter time window) and the in-game Shooting Stars grouping chat to crowdsource sightings; without one, discovery is essentially luck-of-passing-by. The activity is notable in the guide-burndown model as a near-zero-babysitting Mining xp source once a star is found, unlike most other Mining training methods.

items: 32+ quest points (to be eligible to receive champion's scrolls from monster drops at all)
combat gear appropriate to the champion being fought, respecting that champion's specific rule restrictions (e.g. melee-only, no prayer, no armour)

rewards.xp: Hitpoints and Slayer xp per champion defeated (160 Imp up to 592 Lesser Demon, 492 for Leon d'Cour); a Champion's lamp claimable after each win grants 10x that xp again on top; 40,348 combined Hitpoints+Slayer xp total from all 11 champions + all 11 lamps
rewards.items: no tradeable item drops -- purely an xp + cosmetic activity
rewards.unlocks: a banner per defeated champion hung on the Champions' Guild basement wall; the cosmetic (no stat bonus) champion's cape from Leon d'Cour after all 11 champions are defeated

location.name: Basement of the Champions' Guild, Misthalin -- entered via a trapdoor; players cannot teleport out of the basement, only exit through the portcullis then up the ladder

notes: A Distraction and Diversion built around an extremely rare (1/5,000) champion's scroll drop from that race's regular monsters -- e.g. an Imp champion scroll can drop from any imp, a Skeleton champion scroll from Calvar'ion/Vet'ion/skeleton hellhounds/etc. Only 1 of the 6 'Champions of Champions' seated in the arena (the human, Leon d'Cour) is actually fightable; the other 5 (Dwarf/TzHaar/Werewolf/Elf/Gnome) are lore-only NPCs. Scrolls survive death (recoverable from the player's gravestone) but are lost once the corresponding champion is beaten. Each champion enforces its own combat-style/gear restriction, so full completion effectively requires 11 different loadouts across melee/range/magic/no-armour/no-prayer builds.

skills.Slayer: 85 to damage abyssal demons, its main drop source (no active-task requirement stated on the demon's own page)

grants.effect: One-handed slash melee weapon at the fast 2.4s/hit speed of daggers and scimitars; a long-standing default Slayer/training weapon until upgrades like the ghrazi rapier or blade of saeldor are reached. Attaching a kraken tentacle (itself a Kraken-boss drop) upgrades it into an abyssal tentacle (75 Attack, +8 slash/+4 Strength bonus), consuming the whip.

notes: Gather, not buy: kill abyssal demons (Slayer Tower, Catacombs of Kourend, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave, 85 Slayer) for a direct whip drop, or farm the Abyssal Sire boss (87 Slayer) for unsired drops and sacrifice one for a chance at a whip among several possible melee items. Abyssal demons can teleport themselves or the player mid-fight (breaks safespotting, up to 20 tiles), so Auto Retaliate or a teleport anchoring scroll helps maintain uptime.

grants.effect: Strongest scimitar in the game; fast 4-tick slash weapon and one of the definitive early-mid melee power spikes, widely used for Slayer and general training. As dragon equipment it cannot be smithed.

notes: Earn, not GE: after Monkey Madness I, buy directly from Daga on Ape Atoll for 100,000 coins gathered/earned through play (must be in monkey form via greegree unless Monkey Madness II is also done, or King Awowogei was freed via Recipe for Disaster to reach Marim by boat). Alternatively obtained as a rare drop from the Wilderness boss Scorpia or the Zombie Pirate's Locker, bypassing the quest/purchase route entirely. The Arkan blade (The Final Dawn quest reward) is a near-identical free alternative.

grants.effect: One-handed crossbow firing up to runite bolts; pairs with a shield or god book for extra defensive bonuses, a common Slayer/TzHaar Fight Cave choice for players who want a shield slot rather than a two-handed bow.

notes: Fletch from gathered materials: cut a yew log into a yew stock (50 Fletching xp), attach runite limbs with a hammer (100 xp) for an unstrung crossbow, then string it with a crossbow string (50 xp), 200 xp total -- or skip the level requirement entirely as an ironman by farming the crazy archaeologist, who reliably drops a finished rune crossbow. Crafting the whole chain within Witchaven/Yanille counts toward the elite Ardougne Diary.

grants.effect: Fast one-handed shortbow firing up to amethyst arrows with its own special attack; the strongest ranged weapon commonly available to mid-level players, a Slayer-task staple, and popular in PvP for stacking a knockout hit alongside melee. Imbuing it (magic shortbow scroll) raises ranged attack bonus to +75 and halves the special-attack energy cost.

notes: Fletch from gathered magic logs (75 Woodcutting to cut) into a magic shortbow (u) at 80 Fletching, then string with a bow string spun from flax via Crafting -- or pick one up as a rare drop from spiritual rangers or from hard clue scroll caskets.

skills.Slayer: 87 to fight cave krakens/the Kraken boss (task-only; also needs 50 Magic since melee/Ranged only deal 1/7 damage to it)

items: 1 death rune, 1 chaos rune, 5 fire runes, 10 coins per charge, up to 2,500 charges

grants.effect: One-handed powered staff with a built-in attack spell usable regardless of the equipped spellbook, freeing the spellbook for teleports/utility during Magic combat; a core mid-tier Magic weapon before the sanguinesti staff or harmonised nightmare staff.

notes: Task-only drop: cave krakens (87 Slayer, must be an active assigned task) drop the uncharged trident, and the Kraken boss variant can drop it fully charged already. Charge it with gathered death/chaos/fire runes (Runecrafting or monster-drop sourced, not a GE purchase) plus coins; uncharging recovers the runes but any coins spent are permanently lost.

skills.Slayer: 93 to damage smoke devils, and requires an active Slayer task on them

items: slayer helmet, slayer helmet (i), or facemask (needed to safely fight smoke devils)

grants.effect: The only neck-slot item that grants +5% Magic damage, stacking with sources like the staff of the dead or an imbued slayer helmet; standard choice for most Magic combat setups below the 3rd age amulet.

notes: Drop-only from smoke devils or the thermonuclear smoke devil boss in the Smoke Devil Dungeon, and only obtainable while on an assigned Slayer task at 93 Slayer -- cannot be off-task farmed. No purchase route exists.

grants.effect: One of the few rings that gives a Strength bonus rather than pure accuracy, raising max hit; a staple melee-DPS ring choice. Imbuing it (berserker ring (i), via Nightmare Zone points, Combat Achievements, Soul Wars Zeal Tokens, or an Emir's Arena scroll of imbuing) doubles its bonuses.

notes: Drop-only from Dagannoth Rex, one of the three Dagannoth Kings deep in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon (boat from Rellekka, then descend the dungeon's sublevels to the boss room); the dungeon's own page states no formal quest gate. Group Ironmen without individual prestige need at least one personal Rex kill before the ring can be worn. Exact sublevel routing/travel time is left "??" here, belonging to a travel: row.

grants.effect: Melee boots with the third-highest Strength bonus of any boots plus strong defensive bonuses; affordable relative to other dragon-tier gear, so they typically remain the feet-slot pick even after other dragon armour is replaced with higher tiers.

notes: Drop-only, and like all dragon equipment cannot be smithed from raw materials. The item page's own Item sources section transcludes a dynamic drop-table template that does not render through wikitext fetch (a recurring pattern this pass, logged as a gotcha) and its lead text names no specific source monster -- checked King black dragon, Mithril dragon, Brutal black dragon, and the general Rare drop table's own weapons/armour drop lists directly and none of them list dragon boots, so the exact monster(s) are left "??" rather than guessed.

grants.effect: Part of the Bandos armour set; +4 Strength bonus with better defensive bonuses than the fighter torso or inquisitor's hauberk, and never degrades, making it a popular pick for prolonged melee training/Slayer despite lower stab/slash defence than barrows platebodies or the justiciar chestguard. Doesn't interfere with Ava's devices despite its metal appearance.

notes: Drop-only from General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon (Troll Country). The dungeon's own page states Death Plateau is only required for Slayer-task assignments there, not for direct farming, so no quest gates entry; reaching Graardor's inner chamber past the outer guards is a mechanical kill-count gate rather than a skill/quest/item one, left "??" pending a travel:/minigame-style row for that mechanic specifically.

grants.effect: Ranged weapon firing up to dragon bolts with an 8-tile attack range (10 with longrange); counts as an Armadyl item in the God Wars Dungeon. Can later be upgraded (with a nihil horn and 250 nihil shards) into the Zaryte crossbow.

notes: Drop-only, and only from Commander Zilyana in the God Wars Dungeon -- a single-boss gate with no crafting/purchase alternative. Same GWD entry caveat as unlockdb:bandos-chestplate: no quest needed to enter the dungeon itself, but reaching Zilyana's chamber past guards is a kill-count mechanic, "??" here.

skills.Fletching: 78 to craft from a tanzanite fang (boostable)

quests: Regicide (required for every fast-travel route to Zulrah's Shrine)
items: Zulrah's scales (Zulrah drop, used to charge it)

grants.effect: Ranged weapon with a 5-tile attack range (7 with longrange), 3-tick attack speed vs monsters, and a 25% chance to venom on hit (100% vs NPCs when paired with a serpentine helm); charges and darts both survive death if the blowpipe is protected, making it a strong Wilderness/Revenant Caves ranged option. Effectively self-sustaining once a player farms their own Zulrah kills for scales.

notes: Both raw materials -- the tanzanite fang used to fletch the empty blowpipe (chisel + 78 Fletching), and the Zulrah's scales used to charge it (up to 16,383 per charge) -- come only from killing Zulrah. Zulrah's Shrine is reachable by charter ship to Port Tyras, fairy ring code BJS plus a 76-Agility stepping-stone crossing, or a Zul-andra teleport scroll, but the page states all three routes require completing Regicide first.

grants.effect: Ranged bow firing any arrow up to dragon arrows with a fixed 10-tile attack range; its accuracy and damage scale up sharply against targets with high Magic level/accuracy, making it uniquely dominant against Magic-heavy bosses like Commander Zilyana and TzKal-Zuk.

notes: Rare unique reward from the Chambers of Xeric raid's Ancient Chest, weighted by raid points rather than gated by any single skill/quest requirement -- points accrue from combat plus a wide skilling spread performed during the raid itself (Mining, Woodcutting, Herblore, Farming, Hunter, Cooking, Fishing, Thieving, Firemaking, Agility), so a higher-skilled/larger point total raises the unique-roll odds rather than unlocking eligibility outright.

quests: Priest in Peril (the raid's only hard requirement, for Morytania access)
items: vial of blood + 200 blood runes per 100 charges (up to 20,000 charges), added at a vyre well in Ver Sinhaza/Darkmeyer

grants.effect: Two-handed slash weapon that hits all targets in a line, extremely powerful against large/multi-target monsters; charging it (+20 stab/crush, +50 slash attack, +4 slash/+10 crush defence, +25 Strength bonus) is what makes it viable -- uncharged it is drastically weaker.

notes: Rare unique drop from Verzik Vitur's treasure vault at the end of the Theatre of Blood raid (drops uncharged). Charging uses vials of blood and blood runes gathered/farmed rather than bought outright per this KB's no-GE convention, deposited at the vyre well next to the bank in Ver Sinhaza (or, after Sins of the Father, the one in Darkmeyer); uncharging at a well returns the runes/vials, but an unprotected PvP death loses all charges with no refund.

skills.Magic: 50 minimum to cast any Ancient Magicks spell (Desert Treasure I's own req plus prerequisite-quest xp)

quests: Desert Treasure I -- see questdb:desert-treasure-i in this KB for its own flattened chain (The Dig Site, Temple of Ikov, The Tourist Trap, Troll Stronghold, Death Plateau, Priest in Peril, Waterfall Quest)

grants.effect: Combat-heavy alternate spellbook (16 combat spells, 9 teleports) using expensive runes like death and blood; includes some of the strongest combat spells in the game and is especially popular in PvP. Swapped in at the pyramid's altar after finishing the quest; the pyramid's back-door shortcut also unlocks after the first run.

notes: Desert Treasure I is a master-tier quest chain, already fully detailed under questdb:desert-treasure-i in this KB; this row documents the spellbook-specific payoff. The same quest also grants the ring of visibility, the ability to buy an ancient staff from Eblis for 80,000 coins, and access to the Smoke Dungeon.

quests: Lunar Diplomacy -- see questdb:lunar-diplomacy in this KB for its full prerequisite chain and walkthrough

grants.effect: Utility/combat-support spellbook (uses every rune type except wrath) focused on reducing or removing the need for certain items/equipment for various tasks -- teleports, item-creation spells (e.g. Superglass Make, Tan Leather), and stat-restore/boost spells. A larger spell set unlocks after Dream Mentor, plus two more spells from the Hard Fremennik Diary.

notes: Lunar Diplomacy is already fully detailed under questdb:lunar-diplomacy; this row documents the spellbook payoff specifically. Note the page's own caveat: if the quest was auto-completed via a Fremennik quest lamp, or Magic/Defence xp was lost on death in old Deadman Mode seasons, the 65 Magic/40 Defence stat floor can end up unmet even with the quest already done, blocking spellcasting until levels catch up.

grants.effect: Combat/utility spellbook (a mix, like the standard spellbook) focused on necromancy, prayer support, demon-slaying, and combat augmentation; heavy use of blood/nature/soul runes, notable for reanimation and offering spells used in Prayer training and a wide net of teleports to death-associated locations (graveyards, undead dungeons). A Kingdom Divided (already detailed under questdb:a-kingdom-divided) unlocks 24 further combat/utility spells beyond the base set.

notes: Unlike the other two spellbooks, base Arceuus access has zero skill/quest/item gate: simply speak to Tyss near the Dark Altar north of Arceuus (reachable via fairy ring code CIS, games necklace to Wintertodt Camp then travel, or an Arceuus Library Teleport POH portal) to swap in immediately, per the page's own text. 80 Construction lets a player build a dark altar in their POH Achievement Gallery to swap spellbooks without traveling at all. The expanded 24-spell version is gated behind A Kingdom Divided, already captured separately under questdb:a-kingdom-divided.

facts.value: Novice puzzle quest; only 10 Construction required.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Given by the Effigy at the Tower of Life, just east of the Ardougne Monastery.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Climb the tower fixing three broken machines with scavenged parts: a pressure valve-and-lever pipe puzzle, a simpler pipe-fitting puzzle, and a cage-building puzzle.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The cage-building puzzle needs specific horizontal and vertical piece sizes placed in order on each of its 4 sides.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Finish by answering the Homunculus's back-and-forth dialogue quiz, picking consistently either all 'Logic' or all 'Magic' answers.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Creature Creation minigame and the Builder's costume.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: A raw chicken and raw swordfish let you optionally kill a 'swordchick' afterward for a Medium Ardougne diary task, but this is not required to finish the quest.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 1,000 Construction xp, 500 Crafting xp, and 500 Thieving xp.

req_items.name: Regular beer
req_items.note: other beer types do not work

summary: Track a stolen tribal totem through Lord Handelmort's hideout and return it to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Very short quest; only 21 Thieving (boostable) required, no items needed.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Given by Kangai Mau at the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant, Brimhaven.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Track a totem stolen from the Rantuki tribe through a shipping company's Ardougne depot by relabelling a crate to redirect it.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Get teleported by Wizard Cromperty into collector Lord Handelmort's hideout, crack a spoken door password ('KURT', said slowly or it fails), then thieve open a locked staircase and search a chest for the totem.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 1,775 Thieving xp and 5 Swordfish.

summary: Build a sled for the troll Ug, race down Trollweiss Mountain, then fight the level 113 troll Arrg.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Short quest.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Given by Ug on the middle level, south-west corner, of Troll Stronghold.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must be able to defeat the level 113 troll Arrg.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Build a sled with blacksmith Dunstan in Burthorpe from an iron bar and wax, then sled down a mountain course north-west of Trollheim while dodging ice trolls.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Stop mid-run to collect rare Trollweiss flowers before returning to Ug.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Arrg opens with an immediate melee-and-ranged combo hitting in the 30s and can despawn if not killed fast enough, so gear up before talking to him.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 1 uncut diamond, 2 uncut rubies, 4 uncut emeralds, a sled (needed for a hard and two elite clue-scroll steps), a sledding shortcut down Trollweiss Mountain, and adds Arrg to Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 8,000 Agility xp and 4,000 Strength xp.

req_items.name: Wax
req_items.note: swamp tar used on a bucket of wax, made ahead with a cake tin

summary: Recruit for the Temple Knights by chasing fugitive Solus Dellagar across the map and killing him in the rune essence mine.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Medium-length quest; first Temple Knight recruitment quest, needs 32 quest points.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Given by Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must be able to defeat a level 32 Black Knight.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Get a Commorb device from Tiffy or Sir Amik, meet informant Lord Daquarius in the Black Knights' Base inside Taverley Dungeon after killing a Black Knight, then hand 20 essence to the Mage of Zamorak at the Chaos Altar.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Use the Commorb to 'scan' and chase fugitive Solus Dellagar across roughly 7 wiki-listed locations in sequence (the exact set and order varies), then finish with an instanced kill of Solus in the rune essence mine.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The Solus-chasing leg alone can take 20-30+ minutes with no way to skip Savant's cutscene dialogue.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the White Knights' armoury (White equipment).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 5,000 Slayer xp.

req_items.name: Coins, or a law rune + enchanted gem + molten glass
req_items.note: 10,000 coins to buy a Commorb, or the raw materials (1 law rune, enchanted gem, molten glass) to make one

req_items.name: Unnoted rune essence or pure essence
req_items.note: same essence type, delivered all at once

req_items.name: Light source
req_items.note: a tinderbox is recommended; candles/torches/oil lamps can trigger swamp gas explosions off-route

summary: Easy tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary: 11 low-level tasks around Gnome Stronghold, Piscatoris, and chompy hunting.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Easy tier of the Western Provinces diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 11 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Region-wide diary tier with no single quest-giver; the claim NPC is not captured in held text (??).

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks span catching a Copper Longtail, a novice Pest Control game, mining iron near Piscatoris, a Gnome Stronghold agility lap, a Gnomeball goal, fletching an oak shortbow, and killing a Terrorbird in the Gnome Stronghold enclosure.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Claiming a chompy bird hat from Rantz requires 30 chompy or jubbly kills; the Brimstail teleport-to-Essence-Mine task requires Rune Mysteries to be complete.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: No item requirements beyond per-task tools: a bird snare, a pickaxe, and an oak shortbow (u) with bowstring.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Western banner 1 (a chompy-bird crush weapon with no combat bonus), an antique lamp, a 25% chance of two chompy/jubbly birds spawning at once, and 25 free ogre arrows daily from Rantz.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 2,500 xp in any skill 30 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Elite tier of the Western Provinces diary: 7 tasks gated by Regicide/Mourning's End Part I progress and 1,000+ chompy kills.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Elite tier of the Western Provinces diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 7 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Claimed from the Elder Gnome child just south of the Grand Tree, Tree Gnome Stronghold; prior tiers must be claimed first.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Prior Western Provinces diary tiers (easy/medium/hard) must be claimed before this tier can be claimed.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks: fletch a magic longbow in Tirannwn, kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil without needing a prior slayer task, protect the magic tree with Prissy Scilla, take the Elven overpass advanced cliffside shortcut, wear a full void set, claim a chompy hat at 1,000+ kills, and pickpocket an Elf.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fletching the magic longbow needs Regicide started; the Elven overpass shortcut needs Underground Pass; pickpocketing an Elf needs Mourning's End Part I started; the tier overall also gates on 1,000+ chompy/jubbly kills and Big Chompy Bird Hunting completed.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Western banner 4 (unlimited teleport to Piscatoris Fishing Colony), 2 chompy birds spawning at once when hunting, a 1/500 chance of a chompy chick, 150 free ogre arrows daily from Rantz, Duradel/Kuradal-tier slayer reward points from Nieve/Steve, and a once-daily full-health resurrect against Zulrah (safe death for HCIM).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward antique lamp grants 50,000 xp in any skill 70 or above.

summary: Hard tier of the Western Provinces diary: 13 tasks across Ape Atoll, Tirannwn, and chompy hunting up to 300 kills.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Hard tier of the Western Provinces diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 13 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Claimed from the Elder Gnome child just south of the Grand Tree, Tree Gnome Stronghold.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks include killing an elf with a crystal bow, catching and cooking a monkfish in Piscatoris, completing a veteran Pest Control game, catching a dashing kebbit, lapping the Ape Atoll agility course, and chopping and burning mahogany on Ape Atoll.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Mining adamantite in Tirannwn needs Regicide started; checking a Lletya palm tree needs Mourning's End Part I started; killing Zulrah for this task also needs Regicide started; teleporting to Ape Atoll needs the Freeing King Awowogei RFD subquest.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: claim a chompy hat at 300 kills, build an Isafdar painting in your POH quest hall, and pickpocket a gnome.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Western banner 3 (a daily teleport to Piscatoris Fishing Colony), an antique lamp, 100 free ogre arrows daily from Rantz, a teleport crystal charge cap raised to 5, elite void top/robe upgrades for 200 commendation points each, access to the ancient gorilla greegree room in the Temple of Marimbo Dungeon, and access to the Hunting expert's private red chinchompa ground.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Islwyn begins selling crystal halberds (750,000 coins, 70 Attack/35 Strength) and unlocks crafting them (78 Crafting/78 Smithing).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 15,000 xp in any skill 50 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Medium tier of the Western Provinces diary: 13 tasks around Gnome Stronghold, Feldip Hills, and Ape Atoll.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Medium tier of the Western Provinces diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 13 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Claimed from the Elder Gnome child just south of the Grand Tree, Tree Gnome Stronghold.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks include the Grand Tree-to-Otto's-Grotto agility shortcut, spirit-tree travel to the Gnome Stronghold, trapping a spined larupia in the Feldip Hunter area, and fishing bass plus chopping and burning teak logs on Ape Atoll.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Ape Atoll fishing/woodcutting task needs Monkey Madness I partially completed; the glider and eagle-transport tasks link Feldip Hills to Eagles' Peak.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: complete an intermediate Pest Control game, claim a chompy hat at 125 kills, make a chocolate bomb and complete a Gnome Restaurant delivery at the Grand Tree, singing-bowl a crystal saw seed into a crystal saw, and mine gold ore under the Grand Tree.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Western banner 2, an antique lamp, a 50% chance of two chompy birds appearing at once when hunting, 50 free ogre arrows daily from Rantz, and a crystal saw charge cap raised to 56 from 28.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 7,500 xp in any skill 40 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Recover a trader's stolen documents, infuse a wand at the Chaos Altar, then fight an instanced King Roald.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Short quest.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Given by Rat Burgiss, south of Varrock.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Recover a stranded trader's documents stolen by outlaws west of the Grand Exchange, pulling you into a Zamorak-monk conspiracy.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Infuse a wand at the Chaos Altar, deliver findings to Surok Magis in Varrock Palace's library, then fight an instanced King Roald.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Bring King Roald to 2hp or less and operate the Beacon ring when the chatbox prompts to summon an ally and finish him off.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: 5 Battlestaves become stocked at Zaff's Superior Staffs as soon as King Roald is defeated -- the quest itself need not be finished for that unlock.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the Beacon ring, a shortcut to the Chaos Altar, and adds King Roald to Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 8,000 Runecraft xp and 2,000 Defence xp; grabbing the Dagon'hai history book from a nearby bookshelf before leaving adds 5 bonus Kudos.

req_items.name: Access to the Chaos Altar
req_items.note: via chaos and catalytic talismans/tiaras, the Abyss, or the Temple of the Eye

summary: Easy tier of the Wilderness achievement diary: 12 low-level tasks around Edgeville and the Wilderness Chaos Altar.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Easy tier of the Wilderness diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 12 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Region-wide diary tier with no single quest-giver; the claim NPC is not captured in held text (??).

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks include Low Alching at the Fountain of Rune, entering the Wilderness via the Ardougne or Edgeville lever, praying at the Western Wilderness Chaos Altar, and entering the Chaos Runecrafting temple by a route other than the Tunnel of Chaos or Guardians of the Rift.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Kill a Mammoth south-east of Ferox Enclave and an Earth Warrior beneath Edgeville.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: restore prayer at the demonic ruins, enter the King Black Dragon's lair beneath the Lava Maze, collect 5 red spiders' eggs in the Edgeville Dungeon, mine iron ore in the Wilderness, and equip a team cape in the Wilderness.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Mage of Zamorak teleport-to-Abyss task requires Enter the Abyss to be complete.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Wilderness sword 1 (always slashes webs, otherwise identical stats to an iron sword), an antique lamp, an Edgeville teleport option added to the Wilderness lever, and 40 free random runes daily from Lundail.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 2,500 xp in any skill 30 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Elite tier of the Wilderness diary: 7 tasks including the Wilderness bosses and Resource Area crafting under prior-tier gates.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Elite tier of the Wilderness diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 7 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Claimed from the Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse, near the bridge outside the Wilderness; prior tiers must be claimed first.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Prior Wilderness diary tiers (easy/medium/hard) must be claimed before this tier can be claimed.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Kill Callisto, Venenatis, and Vet'ion, or their lesser forms Artio, Spindel, and Calvar'ion, which need the medium and hard Wilderness diaries claimed respectively.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Teleporting to Ghorrock needs Desert Treasure I and Ancient Magicks; smithing a rune scimitar from scratch in the Resource Area means mining, smelting, and smithing runite entirely inside the Resource Area.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: fish and cook a Dark Crab in the Resource Area, steal from the Rogues' Chest, slay a Spiritual mage in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, and cut and burn magic logs in the Resource Area.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Wilderness sword 4 (adamant-sword stats, negligible weight, unlimited teleport to the Fountain of Rune), free Resource Area access (previously 3,750gp), 200 free random runes daily from Lundail, auto-noted Wilderness dragon bones (excludes King Black Dragon), and a 112.5% higher dark crab catch rate.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward antique lamp grants 50,000 xp in any skill 70 or above.

req_items.name: Lobster pot
req_items.note: plus dark fishing bait, for catching a dark crab

req_items.name: Pickaxe, hammer, and coal
req_items.note: any pickaxe and hammer, plus 16 coal, to smith a rune scimitar from scratch

req_items.name: Axe and tinderbox
req_items.note: any axe, for cutting and burning magic logs

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: 3,750 to 7,500 coins for Resource Area entry, charged per task; the fee scales down with diary progress

summary: Hard tier of the Wilderness diary: 10 tasks including single-combat-area bosses and Resource Area smithing.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Hard tier of the Wilderness diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 10 tasks.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Claimed from the Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse, near the bridge outside the Wilderness.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Hit another player with a god spell in the Wilderness (needs Mage Arena I), kill a lava dragon on Lava Dragon Isle, and kill the Chaos Elemental.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Kill the Crazy Archaeologist, Chaos Fanatic, and Scorpia in any order, but with no other diary task attempted in between the three kills.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: charge an air orb, catch a black salamander, smith an adamant scimitar in the Resource Area, take the Trollheim-into-Wilderness agility shortcut, kill a spiritual warrior in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, and fish a raw lava eel in the Wilderness.

facts.value: Grants Wilderness sword 3, an antique lamp, a lowered Resource Area entrance fee (3,750 from 6,000), a raised Ecumenical key cap (5 from 4, sellable to the Lesser Fanatic for 61,500 coins each), 120 free random runes daily from Lundail, 50% more lava shards from lava scale grinding, 67% more Rogues' Castle chest loot (from 33%), chosen (not random) Wilderness obelisk destinations, and access to Spindel, Artio, and Calvar'ion.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Removes the 3-tick teleport delay in the Revenant Caves and Wilderness boss caves, and makes wine of zamorak from the Chaos Temple (hut) or Deep Wilderness Dungeon noted.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 15,000 xp in any skill 50 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Medium tier of the Wilderness diary: 11 tasks around the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, Resource Area, and lava maze.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Medium tier of the Wilderness diary.

facts.label: length
facts.value: 11 tasks.

facts.value: Claimed from the Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse, near the bridge outside the Wilderness.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Kill a green dragon, an ankou, and a bloodveld in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon (needs 60 Agility/Strength plus 50 Slayer for the bloodveld).

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Other tasks: mine mithril ore in the Wilderness, chop yew logs from a fallen ent, enter the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, lap the Wilderness agility course, charge an earth orb, talk to the Edgeville Emblem Trader, and open the Muddy Chest in the lava maze.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Smithing a golden helmet in the Resource Area needs Between a Rock... partially completed.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Wilderness sword 2, an antique lamp, a lowered Resource Area entrance fee (6,000 from 7,500), a raised Ecumenical key cap (4 from 3), 80 free random runes daily from Lundail, the Deep Wilderness Dungeon crevice shortcut (46 Agility), access to Callisto/Venenatis/Vet'ion, 15% more drops from cutting fallen ents, loot access to Rogues' Castle chests, and a 50% zombie pirate bonus drop chance (up from 15%).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Antique lamp is worth 7,500 xp in any skill 40 or above; total tier XP reward not otherwise stated in held source (??).

summary: Investigate Sophia Hughes' disappearance across Kourend, defeat the Judge of Yama and Xamphur, and win the support of all five Great Kourend Houses.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate Councillor Sophia Hughes' disappearance for Commander Fullore and Martin Holt, tracing her trail through Kourend to a final confrontation and gaining favour with all five Houses.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fights the level-168 demon Judge of Yama mid-quest (dodge fire waves like Galvek, melee him in the gaps; he keeps an overhead prayer up the whole fight).

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fights the spirit boss Xamphur (level 239): Protect from Magic, kill summoned hands, dodge a falling-hand mechanic similar to Vorkath.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Also requires defeating a level-91 Barbarian Warlord and a level-132 assassin during the quest.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Includes multiple puzzle sequences: a stone-pile numeric code, a statue-panel matching puzzle, and brewing a shielding potion from a sulphur potion + volcanic sulphur for the Doors of Dinh.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the book of the dead, respawn-point relocation to Kourend Castle (via Asteros Arceuus), 24 new Arceuus spellbook spells (nearly all combat and utility spells), and access to fight the boss Yama.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards two antique lamps of 10,000xp each (any skill level 40+) — only one lamp if the Architectural Alliance miniquest's own lamp was already claimed before its removal on 10 Jan 2024.

summary: Gather two vampyre trophies and complete a Theatre of Blood raid to help the Mysterious Stranger humiliate Lady Verzik Vitur.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help the Mysterious Stranger humiliate Lady Verzik Vitur by gathering two vampyre trophies and completing a Theatre of Blood raid.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The egg-sac cave north of Darkmeyer is guarded by venomous spiders — bring anti-venom or antipoison; the spiders don't need to be killed, only doused with sulphuric acid.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Kill the level-302 hespori (grown from planted strange spider eggs) and chop it for hespori bark, one of the two required trophies.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Completing one Theatre of Blood raid (any mode, entry mode recommended) is a required quest step, skippable only if a prior ToB completion already exists.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards four antique lamps worth 20,000xp each in Attack/Strength/Defence/Ranged/Magic/Hitpoints (level 50+) — only two lamps if the quest was completed before 28 July 2021 and the original two lamps were already spent.

summary: Track a crop-raiding beast to its underground lair near Draynor Manor and defeat the level-37 Sourhog responsible.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Track down a crop-raiding beast for farmer Sarah near Falador, following a stolen-vegetable trail to an underground lair and defeating the Sourhog responsible.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Requires defeating the level-37 Sourhog at the end of the underground trail.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 5,000 coins, 30 Slayer reward points, access to Sourhog Cave with sourhog Slayer tasks assigned by Spria, and reinforced goggles added to existing Slayer helmets.

req_items.note: not whip/tentacle/halberd/claws; obtainable during the quest

summary: Descend an instanced rift near the Digsite, fight through four combat-training rooms, then defeat the three heads of the demon Tolna.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Descend an instanced rift near the Digsite and battle through four themed combat rooms before facing the three heads of the demon Tolna.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Effectively requires the ability to defeat level 45+ enemies; there is no formal skill or quest level gate stated.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Room 3 requires telling 6 real confusion beasts apart from decoys that vanish after 8 hits (giving free combat xp); progress resets if you log out mid-room.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final fight is against all three heads of Tolna together.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 500 coins and repeatable post-quest access to Tolna's rift for combat training (re-entering also completes a Varrock Medium diary task).

summary: Track down the missing cat Bob across Gielinor with an enchanted catspeak amulet, then cure his mysterious sickness via a Varrock disguise sequence.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sequel to Gertrude's Cat: track down the missing cat Bob across Gielinor using an enchanted catspeak amulet, then cure his mysterious "sickness" via a disguise sequence in Varrock.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Locating Bob requires world-hopping between a list of possible spawn spots with the catspeak amulet equipped; the western Varrock anvil and Draynor Manor garden are the fastest camp spots.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a swappable Doctor's or Nurse's hat, a mouse toy (cat plaything / Emir's Arena joke weapon), and 5 Kudos at the Varrock Museum via Historian Minas.

summary: Infiltrate Ver Sinhaza, forge the Ivandis flail, and defeat the vampyre lord Ranis Drakan as the fourth Myreque chain quest.

facts.value: Fourth Myreque chain quest: infiltrate Ver Sinhaza, forge the Ivandis flail, and defeat vampyre lord Ranis Drakan.

req_items.name: cosmic rune
req_items.note: paired with the air runes above for Lvl-1 Enchant

req_items.name: weapons and armour
req_items.note: for the Ranis Drakan boss fight

summary: Visit ten named pubs across Gielinor and report back to the Barbarian Guard at the Outpost gate to complete this pub-crawl miniquest.

facts.value: Visit ten named pubs across Gielinor in any order, picking the barcrawl dialogue option at each, then report back to the Barbarian Guard at the Outpost gate.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the Barbarian Outpost Agility course, required later for Scorpion Catcher and Horror from the Deep.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Barbarian Guard teaches auto-smashing empty potion vials on their last dose.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for the Kandarin Medium Achievement Diary.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Reward xp is unknown/unrecorded in held text ("??") — this miniquest has no combat and needs no items beyond travel means.

summary: Complete a four-stage fetch quest for Ava to build her Ranged-ammo-collecting device across three item-gathering stages.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Four-stage fetch quest for Ava: gather ingredients across three item-gathering stages (amulet/chickens, magnet, undead-tree twigs) to build her ranged-ammo-collecting device.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Ava's attractor (below 50 Ranged) or accumulator (50+ Ranged), which auto-collects fired ranged ammo, plus the ability to trade Ava for further devices later.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The Ballistic attractor schematic variant is only available if Pandemonium has also been completed.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Stage 3 requires solving an orb puzzle (toggle off all but the 2nd/5th/9th orbs left-to-right) before combining the solved notes with a button and leather.

summary: Excavate artefacts for Tegdak, fight through a goblin ambush and Sigmund, and rescue Zanik from the H.A.M. plot.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Archaeology-themed goblin quest: excavate artefacts for Tegdak, uncover a H.A.M. plot, and fight through an ambush and Sigmund to rescue Zanik.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: The goblin-village ambush pits you against a level-30 H.A.M. Mage and level-30 H.A.M. Archer that can only be damaged with Ranged or Magic — melee doesn't work on them.

summary: Reunite archaeologist Willow's old crew through three recruitment side-tasks, then defeat the level-25 Ancient Guardian at Camdozaal.

summary: Investigate Menaphos's lockdown for spy Maisa through the Ruins of Ullek and the necropolis, defeating the Champion of Scabaras and the Menaphite Akh.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate Menaphos's lockdown for spy Maisa, working through the Ruins of Ullek and the necropolis to defeat the Champion of Scabaras and the Menaphite Akh.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fights the level-174 Head Menaphite Guard at the Jaltevas Pyramid entrance — it deals 1/3 max HP through Protect from Melee, so that prayer doesn't fully block it.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fights the level-379 Champion of Scabaras (alternates magic/melee) — stay at range, destroy its 20hp Shadow Rift quickly, kill its poison-swarm summon fast, and avoid its 4-tile Shadow Burst attack.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final fight is the level-351 Menaphite Akh (melee) — dodge her lightning-bolt twitch attack by standing behind or beside her, and kill her summoned Menaphite Shadow quickly or it can swap places with her.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Ruins of Ullek section includes a passcode-locked chest (1118513), a scarab-emblem pillar placement puzzle, timed lever traps in a maze, and an urn-matching Riddle of the Tomb keyed to each player's own emblem clues.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the Tombs of Amascut raid, a free Keris partisan (from Selim, if inventory was full when offered), a free Circlet of water waterskin-helm (from the Sophanem High Priest, if inventory was full), fairy ring code AKP, and a Jaltevas teleport option on the Pharaoh's sceptre.

facts.value: Grants the Rune pickaxe, the Gold helmet, access to the Arzinian Mine (dwarf banks a 20%/10%-with-Charos cut of gold ore mined there), and a ring of wealth teleport to Dondakan's rock.

summary: Grandmaster sequel to Dragon Slayer I: gather 4 dragon key pieces then fight the Assault and a 4-phase Galvek.

facts.value: Very Long

facts.value: Grandmaster

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final boss Galvek is a 4-phase fight requiring full dragonfire protection and phase-specific dodges (fire traps, stat-drain beam, wave-gaps, earth-bind projectiles).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Assault stage is a checkpointed defence against escalating dragon waves (green/blue, then black/steel/brutal red, then mithril/adamant/rune, the last two needing antidote++ and insulated boots), preceded by rallying Varrock/Falador/Ardougne or Kandarin rulers in 'A World United'.

summary: Carry the Mage of Zamorak's scrying orb to 3 of 5 rune essence mine entry points to open the Abyss.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: The Mage of Zamorak hands over a scrying orb; visit 3 of 5 possible rune essence mine entry points so it records readings, then return to open the Abyss as an essence-mining and teleport hub.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak, who roams level 4-7 Wilderness along the River Lum near Edgeville; the second conversation happens at the Zamorak chaos temple hut in Varrock, south-east of Aubury's.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Any Saradomin or Guthix items must be unequipped (inventory is fine) before talking to the Mage of Zamorak or he refuses to speak.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Feeds into Enter the Abyss's own required-for list: Devious Minds, Temple of the Eye, partial Wanted!, and the Wilderness Easy Diary.

req_items.name: optional travel items: Varrock/Ardougne teleport runes, an Edgeville teleport (e.g. amulet of glory), necklace of passage for Wizards' Tower
req_items.note: none of these are required, they only speed travel between the 3 essence-mine entry points visited

summary: Explore Draynor Manor for clues to turn Veronica's fiance Ernest back from Professor Oddenstein's chicken.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Explore spooky Draynor Manor to gather clues and turn Veronica's fiance Ernest back into a human from Professor Oddenstein's chicken transformation.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Veronica south of Draynor Manor by the gate.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires only the ability to survive a level 22 skeleton guarding one of the manor rooms.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Solve a lever/door puzzle in the basement for an oil can, dig up a key from the compost heap outside, retrieve a pressure gauge from a poisoned fountain, and grab a rubber tube from the skeleton-guarded room before delivering all parts to Professor Oddenstein.

summary: Investigate a Fortis museum theft, following witnesses to Varrock Museum to expose curator Haig Halen.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate a theft from the Fortis Grand Museum, following a trail of witnesses and evidence to Varrock Museum's storeroom to expose curator Haig Halen.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Inspect the empty display case in the Grand Museum, Civitas illa Fortis.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Follow a witness chain (Regulus Cento, a Trader Crewmember after a sail-repair favour for Artima, Trader Stan's crew, Betty at the Port Sarim rune shop) to Varrock Museum, pickpocket curator Haig Halen for the storeroom key, search the NE storeroom crates, then confront him with the correct dialogue picks.

summary: Gather 3 randomly-assigned items via a skull-trading NPC and defeat the Tanglefoot to earn magic secateurs.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate Martin the Master Gardener's failing crops, gather 3 randomly-assigned items via a skull-trading NPC, and defeat the Tanglefoot to earn magic secateurs and end the queen's poisoning.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener by the pig pen in Draynor Village.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final fight is a level 111 Tanglefoot in Zanaris, beatable with limited weaponry using Protect from Melee or by flinching around mushrooms; must be defeated with the Magic secateurs equipped.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Nature Spirit's own Priest in Peril / Restless Ghost requirements are inherited/flattened into this quest's own reqs.quests rather than listed as a separate Nature Spirit sub-chain.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Confirm membership with 5 of the Group of Advanced Gardeners at farming patches (any except Ayesha in Al Kharid or the Kourend ones), then give Malignius Mortifer a Draynor skull (dug from a Draynor Manor grave) for a list of 3 randomly-assigned items to collect, bringing a filled druid pouch to protect perishables from ghasts.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Do not pickpocket Martin the Master Gardener when first talking to him, or he locks you out for 10 game-minutes.

req_items.name: secateurs
req_items.note: buyable at Sarah's Farming shop near quest start, 5gp

req_items.name: 3 randomly-assigned items
req_items.note: rolled during the quest, contents vary per playthrough

summary: Decode Fairy Nuff's certificate and brew a magic essence potion from a star flower and gorak claw powder.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Decode Fairy Nuff's ransacked-grotto certificate, learn the fairy ring network, then brew a magic essence potion from a star flower and gorak claw powder to revive the poisoned Fairy Queen.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener at the pig pen in Draynor Village/Market.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Decipher Nuff's certificate via the Cosmic Altar's rune temple sign in Zanaris, then use a 4-code fairy ring sequence (AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS) with the certificate in inventory to reach the Fairy Queen's hideout.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather (Thieving 40, no boost) for the Queen's secateurs, then brew a magic essence potion from a star flower (grown on the CKP cosmic plane, Farming 49) and gorak claw powder (from level 145 Goraks on the DIR gorak plane, Herblore 57 to combine).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Access to the fairy ring network opens partway through the quest, before full completion; required for the Hopespear's Will miniquest and 6 Medium diary tasks needing fairy ring travel (Kandarin ALS; Ardougne AIR/BIS; Fremennik CIP; Lumbridge & Draynor DIS; Kourend & Kebos CIR).

summary: Reforge the family crest via Dimintheis's 3 sons, then defeat level 170 Chronozon to finish.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Track down Dimintheis's 3 estranged sons to reforge the family crest, each rewarding a set of steel gauntlets, then defeat level 170 Chronozon to complete the crest.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Dimintheis in south-eastern Varrock.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Experienced

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Chronozon is a level 170 demon fought in the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon, safespottable, defeated by landing all 4 elemental Blast spells before finishing him off.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Caleb (Catherby) wants 5 cooked fish types for the cooking gauntlets; Avan (near Al Kharid's Gem Trader) needs 2 'perfect' gold ore mined from the hellhound room in Witchaven Dungeon via a lever-sequence puzzle, then smithed/crafted into a ruby ring and necklace, for the goldsmith gauntlets; Johnathon (Jolly Boar Inn) needs a poison cure for the crest piece's location.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Family Pest, Defender of Varrock, Legends' Quest, Recipe for Disaster (Freeing Sir Amik Varze), and the Elite Kandarin Diary.

req_items.name: 5 cooked fish types (shrimps, salmon, tuna, bass, swordfish)
adamant or rune pickaxe
req_items.note: recommended for mining the perfect gold ore

summary: Pay Dimintheis 500,000 coins after his 3 sons decline a favour, unlocking unlimited free gauntlet replacements.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Visit Dimintheis's three sons, who each turn down a favour, then pay Dimintheis 500,000 coins so he'll hand out unlimited free replacement gauntlets.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Dimintheis in the south-east Varrock closed-off area.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The row's own notes call this a 'pure dialogue miniquest' rather than a quest; card_kind is recorded as quest here only because the enum has no separate miniquest value -- treat as a miniquest downstream.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Visit Avan (Al Kharid mine), Caleb (Catherby), and Johnathon (Jolly Boar Inn) in any order, each of whom declines to help with a comic non-problem, before returning to Dimintheis for the real ask.
