summary: Infiltrate General Khazard's prison in Khazard armour and fight through a scripted arena sequence to free Lady Servil's family.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Free Lady Servil's kidnapped family from General Khazard's arena by infiltrating the prison in Khazard armour and fighting through a scripted enemy sequence.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Talk to Lady Servil, west of Ardougne Monastery at the north-east corner of the Gnome Maze.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Take Khazard armour from a chest south of Ardougne Monastery to enter the prison, buy Khali brew from the Khazard barman to get the Head Guard drunk, then steal his cell keys to free Sammy Servil.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Scripted arena fight sequence: level 63 Khazard ogre, level 44 Khazard scorpion, then level 137 Bouncer (hellhound) -- all safespottable behind a skeleton, or beatable with Protect from Melee. The optional level 142 General Khazard fight can be skipped via the door's quick-escape.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for The General's Shadow and While Guthix Sleeps.

summary: Sabotage a rival pirate ship in Bill Teach's crew and win a naval battle to unlock Mos Le'Harmless.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Board Bill Teach's ship and fight a scripted sea battle against a rival pirate vessel.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Cut the enemy ship's sail rigging, blow up its powder barrel, and patch your own ship's leaks during the battle.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Plunder the enemy ship's cargo for loot, then repair and fire your own cannon to finish the fight.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fire canister rounds first to kill 3 pirates, then cannonballs to hole the enemy ship 3 times to win.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for The Great Brain Robbery.

req_items.name: 3500 coins
req_items.note: for the boat to Mos Le'Harmless, only needed if Ghosts Ahoy is not completed

req_items.name: 2 ecto-tokens
req_items.note: alternative to 3500 coins for the boat, only needed if Ghosts Ahoy is not completed

summary: Investigate a Varlamore delegation in Varrock by tailing a suspicious guard and unmasking four disguised bandits.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Varlamore's opening quest: investigate a Varlamore delegation that has arrived in Varrock.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Covertly tail a suspicious guard through Varrock without being spotted, using nearby buildings for cover.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Identify and mark four bandits disguised as guards around Varrock Square by their appearance, weapons, or stance.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No combat or skill requirements.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for the rest of the Varlamore quest line.

summary: Deliver Veos's enchanted scroll to a store owner in each of Great Kourend's five districts, then activate a mysterious orb.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Deliver messages to store owners across Great Kourend's five districts on behalf of Veos.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Visit each of the 5 Great Kourend districts and speak with a named store owner about their district (e.g. Jennifer in Shayzien, Munty in Lovakengj).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Use a feather on the enchanted scroll from Veos to make an enchanted quill.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Travel near the Dark Altar and activate the mysterious orb before returning to Veos to finish.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Two antique lamps grant 500xp each in any skill upon completion.

req_items.name: feather
req_items.note: stripy or coloured feather works; magic gold feather does not

summary: Fit four coloured cogs into their matching spindles in the dungeon beneath the Clock Tower to restart it.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No skill or quest requirements; the wiki's own 'requirements' line is a survivability note about running past level 53 ogres, not a level gate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Find 4 coloured cogs in the dungeon beneath the tower and fit each into its matching spindle one at a time (can't carry more than one cog at once).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The black cog must be cooled with a bucket of water or ice gloves before it can be picked up.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The red cog is guarded by ogres; the white cog requires poisoning dungeon rats with rat poison and a food trough to unhinge a gate.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No xp is granted; the only reward is a flat 500 coins.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Fills out the Ardougne Diary prerequisite set alongside Plague City and Sheep Shearer.

req_items.name: Bucket of water
req_items.note: alternatives: Ice gloves, Jug of water, or Smith's gloves (i)

summary: Infiltrate the penguins' Iceberg outpost as Zookeeper Larry's spy to uncover their escape plan.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Only quest in the Penguin series -- Zookeeper Larry suspects the zoo's penguins are planning an escape and enlists you to investigate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Watch a cutscene of a unique 3-emote penguin greeting sequence and memorize it -- it's needed again later (guessable if forgotten, max 24 tries).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Craft a Clockwork penguin suit at a crafting table 3, then test the memorized greeting on zoo penguins to learn of their escape plan.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Trade a raw cod or wear a ring of charos with penguins disguised as sheep to learn the secret phrase 'do not trust the walrus'.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Trade swamp tar and 5 feathers to black-marketeer Noodle for a fake KGP ID, then infiltrate the Iceberg outpost using the password 'cabbage'.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Escape an Icelord cage by defeating 1-3 level 51 Icelords, each granting 40 Attack xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Making Friends with My Arm.

req_items.name: Clockwork
req_items.note: or a steel bar to craft one

summary: Sneak through the Sophanem dungeon labyrinth and defeat the Giant Scarab to open a secret route into Menaphos.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sequel to Icthlarin's Little Helper: sneak into Menaphos through the Sophanem dungeon labyrinth.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Navigate floor/wall traps, crusher blocks, sand pits, and scarab pit-traps using a tile-marker path (green=direction, yellow=step carefully, red=warning); one trap drops you into a multi-combat area.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Kill the level-191 Giant Scarab boss, which can spawn mages/riders and extinguishes bullseye lanterns.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Shuttle between Maisa and Osman to arrange a second, secret entrance into Menaphos.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Optionally grab the Keris dagger for the Desert hard diary by killing a locust rider with it before teleporting out.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Two bankable lamps grant 7,000xp each, chosen from Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints, Ranged, or Magic.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Beneath Cursed Sands and the Desert hard diary.

req_items.name: Light source
req_items.note: Kandarin headgear, Firemaking cape, Abyssal lantern, or bruma torch recommended so traps can't extinguish it; otherwise buy an unlit torch for 200gp

req_items.name: Tinderbox
req_items.note: not needed if using a non-extinguishable light source; otherwise buy for 50gp

summary: Gather an egg, a bucket of milk, and a pot of flour for the Cook to bake the Duke's birthday cake.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Novice tutorial-tier quest: gather 3 ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake, all obtainable for free during the quest.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Get a bucket from the castle cellar and milk a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field; get an egg from the chicken farm north-west of the cow field; get an empty pot from the Cook and mill flour at Mill Lane Mill.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Recipe for Disaster; also counts as an Easy Lumbridge & Draynor Diary task (bake bread on the Lumbridge castle kitchen range).

summary: Gather body parts and repair a lightning conductor to help Dr Fenkenstrain reanimate his monster.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Dr Fenkenstrain build a monster by gathering body parts and reanimating them with a repaired lightning conductor.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must be able to defeat a level 51 Experiment and run past level 72 monsters.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Read two books for a memorial-opening amulet, then dig up a head in the vampyre-infested Haunted Woods.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Sew the gathered parts together, get a shed key from the Gardener Ghost, and smelt a silver bar into a conductor to repair the castle's lightning conductor.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Pickpocket Fenkenstrain for the ring of charos once the monster is animated.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Garden of Tranquillity and The Great Brain Robbery.

req_items.name: 50 coins
req_items.note: or 1 law rune + 1 air rune, for Telekinetic Grab

summary: Help Arhein get Catherby's by-laws changed so a duck can be used to chart ocean currents.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Third Sailing-skill quest: help Arhein test whether a duck can track ocean currents, blocked by Catherby bureaucracy.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fill in form cr-4p for Councillor Catherine using charcoal; the quiz answers are arbitrary but must be repeated consistently later.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Buy a mayoral fishbowl and tiny net from Harry, fish a new Mayor of Catherby from an aquarium, and get it a mayoral chain from Arhein.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Sign form 7r4-5h with the new mayor to change the by-law, then track an ocean current near the Obelisk of Water with the current duck.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Needs a boat docked at Catherby to complete the final leg.

summary: Follow one of three randomized ghost sequences across Gielinor to earn the full ghostly robes set.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: After talking to Valdez, the game randomly assigns one of 3 fixed ghost sequences (hinted via a location clue); you must follow that sequence's 5 ghosts at that sequence's specific locations only.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Several sequence stops are in deep, dangerous Wilderness (up to level 56), such as Rogues' Castle or Edgeville Dungeon.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Ghostly robe pieces are individually reclaimable for free afterward by revisiting your assigned sequence's ghosts.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: A 10,000xp lamp (any skill level 50+) plus 10 kudos are awarded from Historian Minas in Varrock Museum upon completion.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates The General's Shadow.

req_items.name: Ghostspeak amulet
req_items.note: Morytania legs 2+ can substitute except where noted

summary: Build furniture for Marlo to earn a free player-owned house in Rimmington.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Straightforward first-Construction-unlock miniquest with no combat, primarily useful for its free player-owned house grant.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The waxwood bed needs 3 waxwood planks specifically -- search kitchen crates for waxwood logs and take them to the Varrock sawmill operator, who mills them free for this quest.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Novice difficulty, no combat.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The 944 Construction xp splits as 400 flat quest reward plus 544 earned in-quest from building the 6 furniture pieces.

req_items.name: planks
req_items.note: regular planks only; oak/teak/mahogany will not work

req_items.name: nails
req_items.note: any type; 100 recommended since nails can bend while building, more obtainable from the Sawmill during the quest

summary: Cross into Meiyerditch and steal an alchemy tome from Vanstrom Klause's castle for the Myreque.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Myreque chain quest 3: cross into Meiyerditch via boat and infiltrate Vanstrom Klause's castle to steal an alchemy tome.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Run the sickle-logo agility maze to reach Vertida's hideout, then complete a fetch-quest loop back to Burgh de Rott and Paterdomus/Varrock.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Vanstrom Klause attacks you 5 times during the sneak-in cutscenes; praying melee avoids the damage.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Use Telekinetic Grab to retrieve the alchemy tome from the secret lab.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No combat kills required -- just surviving Vanstrom's scripted hits.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The Tome of experience grants 2000xp split across any 3 skills at level 30+.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for A Taste of Hope and Burgh de Rott Ramble (Temple Trekking).

summary: Investigate a murder at Villa Lucens on Aldarin by gathering clues and accusing a suspect.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Murder-mystery quest on the island of Aldarin: investigate the death of Livius at Villa Lucens.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Steal a servant uniform to infiltrate Villa Lucens through the Head Butler, then question the four nobles and search the wine cellar for clues.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Pickpocket all six suspects and inspect the physical evidence before accusing a suspect.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Accuse and fight Adala (level 49, innocent), then later accuse and fight Naiatli on stage to close the case.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Post-quest: claim masks/tray from the Head Butler and a needle from the Costumer; search the SW fountain for an icon to use on the NE Aldarin statue for a bonus reward.

summary: Help Denulth find a hidden route up Death Plateau to investigate troll raids on Burthorpe.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Novice quest that opens the troll questline: help Denulth investigate troll raids on Burthorpe.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Give Harold an Asgarnian ale for an IOU note with a combination (a Blurberry special auto-wins the dice bet, otherwise gamble repeatedly over 60gp until he goes bankrupt).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Exchange a certificate, climbing boots, and iron bar for spiked boots, then trade 10 unnoted bread + 10 unnoted trout + the spiked boots to Tenzing for a map.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Walk the back route around the mountain to reach Denulth and finish, ignoring the Death Plateau warning message on the main path.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Troll Stronghold.

req_items.name: coins
req_items.note: bring 1000 to skip the dice-gamble grind

summary: Help Zanik infiltrate the H.A.M. Hideout, revive her with tears of Guthix, and defeat Sigmund.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Follow Kazgar through a hole under Lumbridge kitchen to Mistag, then help Zanik infiltrate the H.A.M. Hideout.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must defeat level-50 Sigmund with melee or magic.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Position Zanik out of guard sightlines and lure each of 4 guards into her line of fire one at a time to sneak into the Hideout.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Travel to Juna in the Chasm of Tears and collect 20 tears to revive Zanik after she is killed.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight and kill 3 Senior Guards (safespottable via Zanik), then Sigmund (level 50, uses protect-missiles in phase 2, safespottable behind boxes).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Ironmen should pickpocket H.A.M. members instead of gathering robe sets -- better odds during the quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Directly extends the H.A.M. Hideout thieving spot with post-quest loot-chest access.

req_items.name: H.A.M. robes
req_items.note: 2 full sets, 7 pieces each; drop chance is boosted during the quest

req_items.name: Pickaxe
req_items.note: not needed if using a games necklace, post-Tears of Guthix

summary: Investigate an undead uprising in Varrock and confront the Fitzharmon descendant behind it.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Long-chain endgame Varrock quest: investigate an undead uprising and confront a hidden threat to Varrock led by Dimintheis.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Follow a forest trail of clues to a dungeon, kill armoured zombies and bottle their red mist to investigate the uprising.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Get a chaos core from Chaos Golems at Ruins of Camdozaal and combine it with a mined barronite deposit at the Sacred Forge to imbue a barronite ore.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Dig through Reldo's scrolls/records to identify the Fitzharmon descendant among six named Varrock NPCs before confronting Dimintheis.

req_items.name: Barronite deposit
req_items.note: or a pickaxe to mine one

summary: Collect three keys to Silverlight and banish the demon Delrith from Varrock.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No skill or quest requirements; must be able to defeat a level 27 demon (Delrith), aided by dark wizards, using Silverlight in melee.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight through dark wizards at Varrock's south entrance, then banish Delrith using Silverlight and a randomized incantation given earlier (re-askable from Aris if forgotten).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Collect three keys to Silverlight from three Varrock Palace NPCs: Captain Rovin, a rusty key found via a bucket-of-water-on-drain manhole dungeon crawl, and Wizard Traiborn in exchange for 25 unnoted bones.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Silverlight is retrievable from Sir Prysin for 500gp if lost.

summary: Collect four elemental diamonds from separate dungeons and place them in the pyramid to reach Azzanadra.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Master-tier quest: collect four diamonds (Smoke, Shadow, Ice, Blood) from separate mini-dungeons, then place them in the pyramid's obelisks to reach Azzanadra.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Smoke diamond: light 4 torches in the Smoke Dungeon before they burn out, then kill Fareed (ice gloves or water spells needed to damage him).

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Shadow diamond: kill Damis in both forms underground (safespottable, drains prayer fast).

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Ice diamond: kill 5 ice trolls then Kamil using only fire spells.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Blood diamond: kill Dessous by pouring blessed blood on his tomb in the Morytania Graveyard.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The final pyramid run races through 4 trapped floors to reach Azzanadra.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Recipe for Disaster (Culinaromancer), Curse of the Empty Lord (partial completion), Hopespear's Will, The Frozen Door, hard tiers of Desert/Varrock/Morytania diaries, elite tiers of Ardougne/Wilderness/Lumbridge/Desert diaries, and Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.

req_items.name: Shantay pass
req_items.note: 10+ recommended; or another way into the Kharidian Desert

req_items.name: spice
req_items.note: gnome spice and Evil Dave's spices do not count

req_items.name: climbing boots
req_items.note: only needed if you lack Trollheim Teleport

req_items.name: facemask, slayer helmet, or gas mask

summary: Defeat the four Forgotten Four bosses to loot their medallions and confront the Empty Lord's legacy at the Ancient Vault.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Grandmaster capstone: defeat the four 'Forgotten Four' bosses to loot medallions and place them in the Ancient Vault's statues before the finale.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Vardorvis: defend Kasonde from stranglers for 3 minutes, brew a strangler serum, then kill Vardorvis and Kasonde himself.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Perseriya: solve 3 randomized puzzle rooms to burn 3 ships, then fight the Leviathan with Ranged and Shadow spells.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Duke Sucellus: solve gate-code puzzles while dodging Jhallan, then defeat the sleeping Duke via a mushroom-poison mechanic.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: The Whisperer: navigate the Shadow Realm managing a sanity meter, then fight a magic-weak boss with frequent prayer switches.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Finale: fight a Mysterious Figure, then Sliske's four wights one after another (Forsaken Assassin, Ketla the Unworthy, Kasonde the Craven, Persten the Deceitful), each with distinct dodge mechanics, before a final cutscene with Azzanadra.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Three 100,000xp lamps are awarded, each spendable on Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints, Ranged, Magic, or Prayer at level 60+.

req_items.name: Runes for Blood/Ice/Smoke/Shadow Burst
req_items.note: 8 death, 16 chaos, 2 fire, 3 air, 4 water, 2 soul, 2 blood runes

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

summary: Forge a bow-sword and smuggle an orb through the Wilderness Abyss to trigger a prisoner swap.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Heavy prerequisite-chain quest: forge a bow-sword and smuggle an orb through the Wilderness Abyss to trigger a prisoner swap.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: At Doric's house, forge a bow-sword from a mithril 2h sword and a bow string, then give it to the monk outside Paterdomus.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Put the monk's orb into a large or colossal pouch and run it through the Wilderness Abyss to the Law Altar, then on to the Entrana church to trigger a swap cutscene.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Search the resulting dead monk back at Paterdomus, return to Entrana's high priest, then finish at Falador Park with Sir Tiffy Cashien.

req_items.name: Large or colossal pouch
req_items.note: non-degraded; all 3 pouch types are consumed unless a colossal pouch is used

summary: Win a fishing contest for two dwarves to unlock a shortcut through White Wolf Mountain.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Novice quest unlocking a shortcut through White Wolf Mountain by winning a fishing contest for two dwarves.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to either dwarf (Austri or Vestri) guarding the mountain's tunnel entrances; starting from the west side is faster on foot.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: 3 red vine worms must be dug from the vine west of fairy ring ALS at McGrubor's Wood.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Garlic is found in a house south-west of the Seers' Village bank.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Garlic must be placed in the north pipes and dialogue finished before paying Bonzo 5 coins to start fishing once the Sinister Stranger clears the pipes.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Recipe for Disaster (Freeing the Mountain Dwarf), Forgettable Tale, Between a Rock, and Land of the Goblins.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to catching minnows in the Fishing Guild once Fishing 82 and full Angler's outfit are also met.

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: 10 if buying a rod from Jack

req_items.name: Fishing rod or pearl fishing rod
req_items.note: oily fishing rod does not work

summary: Investigate the Red Axe by befriending a drunk dwarf, brewing kelda ale, and exploring a minecart tunnel with puzzles.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Part 2 of the Rise of the Red Axe series; investigate the Red Axe organisation through an extremely drunk, kebab-obsessed dwarf informant.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Commander Veldaban at the Dwarven Black Guard headquarters in Keldagrim.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires growing kelda seeds in the Kelda Hops Patch (15-20 minutes) then brewing them into kelda ale at the East Keldagrim pub vat (another 15-20 minutes).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Involves exploring a closed-off minecart tunnel through 6 rooms, including 3 sliding-block cart-track puzzles and a room requiring 3 Red Axe documents to be read.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: A dwarven stout must be delivered to Khorvak as part of the investigation.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 2 Dwarven stout (m).

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: approximate total coin cost across the quest

req_items.name: Random item from an NPC-specified list

summary: Trade grown crops with 5 NPCs for rare seeds, move two garden statues, then present the finished garden to Ellamaria and King Roald.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Long farming-focused quest to earn seed upgrades from 5 NPCs and beautify the garden east of Varrock Palace for Ellamaria.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Ellamaria, then pass a quiz from the Wise Old Man in Draynor while wearing the ring of charos.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Grow seeds for 5 NPCs to trade up to rarer seeds: onions for Lyra (orchid seeds), cabbages for Kragen (snowdrop seeds), marigolds for Elstan (delphinium seeds), a White Tree cutting for Dantaera, and a rune-dust plant cure for Brother Althric and Bernald (rose and vine seeds).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires moving two statues by trolley: the Lumbridge king statue east across the bridge, and the Falador Saradomin statue north through a gated cutscene.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The ring of charos(a) must be thrown down the Edgeville monastery well then retrieved with a fishing rod for Brother Althric's task.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants an activated ring of charos(a) for cheaper NPC services and extra dialogue, plus an apple tree seed, acorn, 5 guam seeds, and a 4-dose compost potion.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The white tree grown in the player's personal garden yields fruit that restores about 8% run energy and regrows over time.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long because most steps are gated by farming grow-timers of roughly 10-15 minutes once seeds are finally planted.

req_items.name: Full leprechaun tool set
req_items.note: rake, seed dibber, spade, secateurs, watering can, gardening trowel

req_items.name: Rune dust
req_items.note: hammer/chisel rune essence, or pestle+mortar rune shards

summary: Find Gertrude's lost cat, reunite it with its kitten, and return it to earn a starter kitten.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: No-requirement novice quest to find Gertrude's lost cat and reunite it with its kitten.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Gertrude at her house just west of Varrock.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The lost cat is found up a ladder at the Lumber Yard north-east of Varrock; feed it a seasoned sardine and milk, then search crates below for Fluffs' kitten.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Chopping the dying tree at the Lumber Yard while there also ticks an easy Varrock Achievement Diary task.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a starter kitten, plus a chocolate cake (kept for A Tail of Two Cats) and a stew (kept for The Queen of Thieves).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Feeds into Ratcatchers and other cat-line quests; Gertrude sells further kittens for 100gp each after completion.

req_items.name: Seasoned sardine
req_items.note: or raw sardine + doogle leaves obtained in-quest

summary: Track down missing livestock, kill the Headless Beast, and craft a fake head to fool Gordon and Mary.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Kourend/Kebos Lowlands quest to track down Gordon and Mary's missing livestock and craft a decoy head to fool them.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Gordon at his farm south of the Farming Guild.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Use a pot of flour on the southern gate to lay a scent trail south past the bridge and west into the Kebos Lowlands mine cave.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: The trail leads to a level-82 Headless Beast in the mine cave.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Craft a fake head from soft clay (knifed into a clay head), fur (with needle and thread into a fur head), and red dye (for a bloody head), then mount it with two planks and six nails.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 3,000 coins, Tannery access in Kebos Lowlands via Mary, and makes the Headless Beast accessible in Nightmare Zone.

summary: Chase down wedding items for a runaway ghost bride and pass on a wandering ghost's soul in Port Phasmatys.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Medium quest to chase down items for a runaway ghost bride's wedding plans in Port Phasmatys.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Velorina in a house just east of the Port Phasmatys gates.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Brew nettle tea for an old crone, repair a toy ship, and dye its flag to solve a mast puzzle for a hidden treasure map.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Dig up the Book of Haricanto after fighting a level-32 giant lobster.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Win a coin-flip game (Rune-Draw) for a translation manual, then collect 10 ghost signatures on a petition before performing a passing-on ceremony for Necrovarus.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants free passage into Port Phasmatys and the Ectophial, a direct teleport to the Ectofuntus that refills there.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Dragon Slayer II and the Morytania medium Achievement Diary.

req_items.name: Ecto-tokens
req_items.note: approximate; or bone/pot/bucket to earn them at the Ectofuntus

req_items.name: Nettle tea ingredients
req_items.note: tinderbox, log, closed-finger gloves, bowl of water

summary: Dye goblin mail to help two goblin generals settle on a new armour colour.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: No-requirement, no-combat quest to help two goblin generals settle a dispute over a new armour colour.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to General Bentnoze or General Wartface in Goblin Village.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Collect 3 sets of goblin mail from crates around Goblin Village or goblin drops, dye one orange (from red+yellow dye) and one blue (from woad leaves via Wyson the gardener and Aggie in Draynor), leaving the third plain.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The generals reject the orange mail and the blue mail before settling on the original plain brown.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: This quest is the actual completion gate on the Recipe for Disaster 'Freeing the Goblin generals' subquest.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a gold bar.

summary: Collect a griffin feather and a dwarf's helmet for magic beans, then climb a beanstalk to fight the cloud giant Glod.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Master-tier quest, no series, to help collector Sylas obtain two rare items for magic beans, then defeat cloud giant Glod.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Sylas in Taverley, south of the player-owned house portal.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Get a griffin feather from Grimgnash on White Wolf Mountain by telling an escalating violent bedtime story, or take 20% current HP damage instead.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Climb a crumbling tower's east wall (Thieving 58) to reach imprisoned dwarf Rupert, then climb his lowered beard (Agility 59) to talk to him.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Retrieve Princess Miazrqa's pendant, stolen by a mouse and hidden in the Witch's House basement behind an electric-shocking gate and a piano puzzle (notes EFEDCAEGA).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Drink a Herblore-brewed shrinking potion (Herblore 52) to enter the mouse hole and navigate nail-wall ladders past level-95 mice to the pendant.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Climb the fast-growing beanstalk (Agility 59, no followers) to fight Glod, a level 118-to-138 cloud giant weak to Magic.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Glod quakes to drain Prayer and heals himself during the fight.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a Dwarven helmet (equip in the Dwarven Mines for a Hard Falador Diary task) and makes Glod accessible in Nightmare Zone; required for the Hard tier of the Falador Diary.

req_items.name: Leather gloves
req_items.note: obtainable during quest; skipping costs 17 damage

req_items.name: High-healing food and good armour/weapon
req_items.note: needed to defeat the level 138 Glod

summary: Retrieve a glowing fungus from the Abandoned Mine and defeat Treus Dayth to access Tarn's Lair.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Short quest to descend through the Abandoned Mine in south-western Morytania and defeat Treus Dayth.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to the Zealot in the Abandoned Mine.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Pickpocket the Zealot's key, solve a lever/points puzzle to route a minecart carrying a light-giving glowing fungus, then open a water valve to access a lift.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight Treus Dayth, level 95 but notably harder than the level suggests.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The fight against Treus Dayth is not a safe death fight, since the glowing fungus is lost on death; ranged or magic with Protect from Missiles is effective.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the ability to make the Salve amulet, a shortcut to the crystal outcrops, and access to Tarn's Lair; makes Treus Dayth accessible in Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Lair of Tarn Razorlor, the Morytania medium/hard Achievement Diary, and the Ardougne elite Achievement Diary.

summary: Choose a side in a dispute between Ceril Carnillean and the Mahjarrat Hazeel over stolen family armour.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Second Mahjarrat-series quest, novice tier, with a good/evil branch similar in structure to Temple of Ikov.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Ceril Carnillean in his south-western house in East Ardougne.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Head to the cave south-east of the Ardougne clock tower and talk to Clivet to learn about the Mahjarrat Hazeel, then choose to side with Ceril or Hazeel.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Siding with Ceril requires turning 5 sewer valves in specific directions to reach the hideout raft and killing the level 13 Alomone for Carnillean armour.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Siding with Hazeel requires poisoning Ceril's cooking range (which instead kills the dog Scruffy), then helping Butler Jones steal a restoration scroll from a locked chest in Ceril's house.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 2,000 coins, plus 5 extra and Carnillean armour if siding with Ceril, or Hazeel's mark cosmetic if siding with Hazeel; also 5 Kudos claimable from Historian Minas.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Secrets of the North; the side chosen also has a minor effect on that quest.

req_items.name: Weapon, armour, and food
req_items.note: only needed if siding with Ceril, to kill the level 13 Alomone

summary: Complete 3 cooperative fetch chains with a second-player partner to earn Heroes' Guild access for Achietties.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Medium quest requiring a second player as a cooperative partner to complete 3 independent fetch chains for Achietties at the Heroes' Guild.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Achietties at the entrance to the Heroes' Guild, between Taverley and Burthorpe.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Cannot be soloed; requires a partner from the opposite Shield of Arrav gang for a cooperative candlestick-theft sequence in Brimhaven.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Lava eel chain: mix blamish snail slime with harralander(unf) for blamish oil, oil a fishing rod, then fish and cook a lava eel near the blue dragons in Taverley Dungeon.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Master thieves' armband chain: the Black Arm partner and Phoenix partner each navigate Brimhaven password puzzles to trap Grip, loot 2 candlesticks, and trade one to their gang leader for the armband.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fire feather chain: kill the level-111 Ice Queen inside White Wolf Mountain for Ice Gloves, then kill the Firebird near the Law Altar on Entrana for its feather.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Heroes' Guild access, the ability to purchase and wield the dragon battleaxe and dragon mace, and use of the Fountain of Heroes to recharge amulets of glory.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Hard-gates Legends' Quest.

req_items.name: Second player partner from the opposite Shield of Arrav gang
req_items.note: Black Arm or Phoenix, whichever the player is not

req_items.name: Dusty key
req_items.note: or 70 Agility, or 60 Sailing route instead

req_items.name: Black full armour
req_items.note: only needed if a Black Arm Gang member, non-trimmed

summary: Defeat all six Barrows Brothers to retrieve a strange icon for the Strange Old Man.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Short experienced-tier miniquest to retrieve a strange icon guarded by the six Barrows Brothers for the Strange Old Man.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to the Strange Old Man, who wanders the Barrows east of Mort'ton.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Requires defeating all six Barrows Brothers.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Loot the icon from the Barrows reward chest after all six brothers are defeated; at least 6 free inventory slots are needed or all six brothers must be redone to retrieve it.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a dusty lamp for 20,000 Prayer experience, and a Crypt map that permanently reveals the Barrows crypt minimap once studied, then is destroyed.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The wiki lists it as 'Required for completing: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire', though this is a Twisted Tale lore cross-reference rather than a normal prerequisite chain.

req_items.name: Combat equipment
req_items.note: needed to defeat the six Barrows Brothers

summary: Defeat the Black Knight Titan and find the Fisher King's missing son to retrieve the Holy Grail for King Arthur.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Second Camelot-series quest to find the Holy Grail for King Arthur and help the ailing Fisher King.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to King Arthur in Camelot.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Visit Entrana (weapons and armour must be deposited for the monks), get a holy table napkin from Galahad, and grab two magic whistles from a room in Draynor Manor.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Blow a whistle at the guard tower north of the Brimhaven goldmine to enter the Fisher King's Realm.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight the Black Knight Titan, a level 120 monster with +1000 magic and ranged defence that is flinchable; the killing blow must be dealt with Excalibur or he heals to full.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Get a magic gold feather from King Arthur and follow it to Goblin Village to find Percival hiding in sacks in the east house, then give him a magic whistle.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Return to the Fisher Realm, now also reachable via fairy ring code BJR, to find Percival has become king, then take the Holy Grail and return it to King Arthur.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the Fisher Realm, a King Arthur picture for Construction wall decoration, and makes the Black Knight Titan accessible in Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for King's Ransom.

summary: Rekill 5 unequipped goblin high priests and bury their bones at Yu'biusk to free their souls for Hopespear.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Short sequel quest to Land of the Goblins, freeing 5 goblin high priests' souls for the ghost prophet Hopespear.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Hopespear's ghost in the crypt of the Goblin Temple, reached via Goblin Cave east of the Fishing Guild.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Drink the goblin potion to enter the temple disguised, then equip the ghostspeak amulet and ring of visibility only after entering the crypt, or risk being expelled.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Rekill each of the 5 goblin high priests completely unequipped (no weapons, spells, or armour, though jewellery is fine) and collect their bones before summoning the next, since old bones despawn.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Priests fought: Snothead (level 32), Snailfeet (56), Mosschin (88), Redeyes (121, stat-draining), and Strongbones (184, hardest, summons skoblins, drains stats, and hits up to 18).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Players can restock and bank between fights; the goblin potion must be re-drunk to re-enter, but the ghostspeak amulet does not need to be reapplied.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Finish by using fairy ring code BLQ to reach Yu'biusk and burying the collected bones, which can be done in batches.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Prayer xp is granted per priest bone (1,250/2,500/5,000/10,000/20,000) and cannot be pyre-boosted or converted via the Sinister Offering.

req_items.name: Ring of visibility or ring of shadows
Dramen or lunar staff
req_items.note: not needed if the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary is fully complete

req_items.name: Food and potions
req_items.note: needed to defeat 5 enemies while unequipped (no armour, weapons, or magic)

summary: Fix the lighthouse and defeat the shapeshifting Dagannoth Mother to rescue keeper Jossik.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Short quest to fix the lighthouse's light mechanism and rescue the missing keeper Jossik from its basement.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Larrissa outside the Lighthouse, north of Barbarian Outpost.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fix the light mechanism with swamp tar, tinderbox, and molten glass, then break into the basement past a rune-and-weapon-sacrifice wall puzzle.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Kill a level-100 Dagannoth (safespottable), then the level-100 Dagannoth Mother.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Dagannoth Mother cycles her damage-type weakness roughly every 18 seconds through all 4 elemental spell schools plus ranged and melee.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a damaged prayer book of choice (fills into the Holy/Unholy book or Book of Balance), access to the Lighthouse general store and Dagannoth caves, and makes the Dagannoth Mother accessible in Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Recipe for Disaster: Defeating the Culinaromancer and Rag and Bone Man II.

req_items.name: Fire, air, water, and earth runes
All 4 elemental attack styles
req_items.note: recommended for the Dagannoth Mother fight

summary: Help the Wanderer investigate a haunted pyramid with your cat to earn access to the city of Sophanem.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Medium quest requiring a cat to help the Wanderer investigate a pyramid and open access to Sophanem.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to the Wanderer at the camp west of the Agility Pyramid.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires defeating a level-91 Possessed Priest plus one randomly-assigned level 75-81 elemental guardian, determined by which canopic jar the player is given.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Once inside the pyramid there is no teleporting out; it contains aggressive level-84 mummies and poison scarabs, and a pit must be jumped at 20%+ run energy.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Solve a golden-bird door puzzle to trigger the first flashback; dropping the cat is required to answer the Sphinx's riddle or the cat is lost.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The quest runs through 4 flashback sequences: retrieving the correct canopic jar and killing its guardian, preparing embalming materials and a holy symbol, then using the holy symbol on a sarcophagus and defeating the Possessed Priest.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the Catspeak amulet, access to the city of Sophanem, and magic carpet rides between Pollnivneach, Sophanem, and Menaphos.

req_items.name: Cat (or overgrown cat, hellcat, or kitten)
Bag of salt
req_items.note: or an empty bucket to make one in Sophanem

summary: Collect 4 coloured beads and deliver them to Wizard Mizgog for the amulet of accuracy.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: No-requirement quest to collect 4 coloured beads for Wizard Mizgog atop the Wizards' Tower.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Wizard Mizgog on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Beads can be obtained by killing imps: F2P spawns are near Falador's south entrance and the Karamja volcano top; members spawns are near Ardougne Monastery, Chasm of Fire, and the Charcoal furnace.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the amulet of accuracy and the ability to buy further amulets from Wizard Mizgog with a full bead set.

summary: Rebuild Burgh de Rott and craft the Rod of Ivandis to fight back against vampyre juvinates.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Medium quest, Myreque chain part 2, to rebuild the ruined town of Burgh de Rott and craft the Rod of Ivandis.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Veliaf Hurtz at the Myreque Hideout below the Canifis pub.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Repair Burgh de Rott's pub basement, general store, bank, and furnace to unlock the town's bank.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Kill Gadderanks and the juvinates guarding the town, then escort Ivan Strom through a Temple-Trekking-style route while fighting vampyre juvinates.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Craft the Rod of Ivandis from a silver bar, mithril bar, sapphire, and soft clay mould, enchanted with Lvl-1 Enchant, then deliver it to Veliaf.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to Burgh de Rott, the Temple Trekking minigame, and the ability to make the Rod of Ivandis; also unlocks the Gadderhammer from killing Gadderanks.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Oarswoman Olga as a hireable crewmate at 65 Sailing and 5 Kudos at the Varrock Museum.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Darkness of Hallowvale and the Morytania medium Achievement Diary.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

summary: Farm Forthos Dungeon monsters for tattered pages to fill 3 tomes for Brother Aimeri and Logosia.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Medium quest with no hard skill or quest gate, requiring high combat only as a recommendation, to fill 3 tomes with pages found in Forthos Dungeon.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to the injured Brother Aimeri at the south-east end of Forthos Dungeon, outside Sarachnis's lair.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Kill Forthos Dungeon monsters (Sarachnis, red dragon, undead druid, baby red dragon, temple spider) for a drop table of tattered sun/moon/temple pages; 4 of each are needed to fill 3 tomes found in the dungeon's Temple Library.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Hand the filled tomes to Logosia in the Arceuus Library to finish.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a Lamp of Knowledge for 10,000xp in any skill at least level 40; extra pages found after completion sell to Logosia for 1,000gp each.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: A parenthetical claim of a 'prayer-book unlock' reward for this quest circulating in an earlier queue payload is not substantiated anywhere on the quest's own wiki page (Details/Walkthrough/Reward/Trivia); the only reward is the one-time 10k xp lamp.

summary: Deliver steel weapons to the Myreque resistance and defeat a Skeleton Hellhound in Canifis.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Short quest, Myreque chain part 1, delivering steel weapons to the resistance hideout in Canifis.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Vanstrom Klause at the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Deliver steel weapons from Cyreg Paddlehorn's boat at Mort'ton to the Myreque hideout, then answer a spelling-checked lore quiz to get in.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Safespot-kill a level-97 Skeleton Hellhound before talking your way out.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the Hollows and fairy ring code dls; makes the Skeleton Hellhound spawn in Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for In Aid of the Myreque.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Vanstrom Klause, met at the tavern, is later revealed as the villain of the Myreque chain; this is his first appearance.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

summary: Gather five jungle herbs around Tai Bwo Wannai and Karamja for Trufitus, showing each herb to him before hunting the next.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Trufitus at his house north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short quest.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Show Trufitus each new herb before searching for the next: snake weed, ardrigal, sito foil, volencia moss, and rogue's purse.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Herb spots: snake weed in marshy vines SW of the village, ardrigal from palm trees NE near Harpie Bug Swarms, sito foil on scorched earth south of the village, volencia moss at rock veins SE, rogue's purse searched from cave walls NW (not a Jogre drop).

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Harpie Bug Swarms (level 46) and Jogres (level 53) are encountered while gathering herbs.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 775 Herblore xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Shilo Village, My Arm's Big Adventure's Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup portion, Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, Zogre Flesh Eaters, and several Karamja Diary tasks.

req_items.name: ability to defend against level 53 Jogres and level 46 Harpie Bug Swarms

summary: Clear Anna of murder charges, free Merlin from Camelot's dungeon, and free King Arthur from a statue at Black Knights' Fortress.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Gossip outside Sinclair Mansion.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium-length quest with three linked storylines.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Break into Sinclair Mansion for evidence, then clear Anna of murder at the Seers' Village courthouse by presenting three witness testimonies to the Judge.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Freeing Merlin requires solving a 4-tumbler lock puzzle in his cell (raise each tumbler until it shows green).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Entering Black Knights' Fortress requires full black armour and an Animate rock scroll (bought from Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne) to animate King Arthur's statue with granite.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Deep prerequisite chain that effectively also requires Merlin's Crystal, Murder Mystery, Rune Mysteries, and the Druidic Ritual line to be completed first.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Knight Waves training ground, which leads to the Chivalry and Piety prayers.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 33,000 Defence xp and 5,000 Magic xp.

summary: Fight through 8 increasingly tough knights in a melee-only training ground unlocked by King's Ransom.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to the Squire on the top floor of Camelot Castle, reached via the south-western tower ladder.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Fight 8 knights (level 110-127) in sequence inside a melee-only room; each hit drains a specific combat stat.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Progress saves on death or teleport, resuming at the knight that killed you; leaving via the door resets progress to wave 1.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: No Prayer, Ranged, or Magic is allowed in the fight room.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 20,000 xp each to Attack, Strength, Defence, and Hitpoints.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Chivalry prayer (needs 60 Prayer and 65 Defence) and the Piety prayer (needs 70 Prayer and 70 Defence), plus setting your respawn point to Camelot.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Listed on the Miniquests page's 'one-off content without miniquest designation' table rather than the main miniquest list, and gated by a quest (King's Ransom) rather than being a miniquest itself.

summary: Fight through a trap-filled dungeon to reach and defeat Tarn, the sequel dungeon to Haunted Mine.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Enter directly at the Haunted Mine area, west of Burgh de Rott and south of the Zealot.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Navigate floor, wall, and log traps plus receding-wall pits by searching to disarm them (log traps re-arm if you fall) to reach Tarn's chamber.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: A Slayer ring teleport goes straight to Tarn's Lair, skipping the trap gauntlet entirely.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Tarn transforms into a level-69 mutant with two level-110 terror dogs and nearby level-53 animated armour; only Tarn needs to be killed, and he continuously drains prayer.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: After the mutant form dies, Tarn becomes an easier level-69 ghost; poison carries over between his forms.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 5,000 Slayer xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks Tarn's diary, which can be combined with a salve amulet to make a salve amulet (e) (20% Attack and Strength bonus vs undead), and counts toward a Medium Morytania Diary task (killing a terror dog here).

req_items.name: coins
req_items.note: per use of the lair's banker Odovacar

summary: Infiltrate the Goblin Temple disguised as a goblin, steal six coloured keys, and defeat goblin bosses to learn the location of Yu'biusk.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Grubfoot in the Dorgesh-Kaan mine.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Disguise as a goblin with a Makeover Mage transformation and a brewed goblin potion to infiltrate the Goblin Temple, free Zanik from her cell, and pass High Priest Bighead's lore quiz.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Steal 6 coloured keys from priests by repeatedly re-dyeing a goblin mail and pickpocketing; the white key needs a side trip to Hemenster's Fishing Contest area to catch a whitefish for Aggie.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Unlock the crypt with all 6 keys and defeat 4 named goblin-ancestor bosses (Snothead, Snailfeet, Mosschin, Redeyes), then the level-184 Strongbones (skoblins present; use Protect from Magic).

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Finish by returning to Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan's South Dungeon, dialling combination 9-4-1, and opening the strange box in Yu'biusk.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 8,000 xp each to Agility, Fishing, Thieving, and Herblore.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Goblin Temple prayer-recharge altar, fairy ring access to Yu'biusk (code BLQ), purchasable plain-of-mud spheres (teleport to Goblin Cave), and the ability to make goblin potions.

req_items.name: Black dye
req_items.note: or black mushroom + empty vial + pestle and mortar

summary: Complete Tutorial Island's eight instructor stations to reach the mainland; the universal starting quest for every new account.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to the Quest Guide on Tutorial Island.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Walk through 8 instructor buildings in order: Gielinor Guide, Survival Expert, Master Chef, Quest Guide, Mining Instructor, Combat Instructor, Account Guide, Brother Brace, Magic Instructor.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: The Combat Instructor stop includes killing 2 level-3 giant rats.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Character customization happens first; Ironman Mode restrictions (if applicable) are chosen with the Ironman tutor near the end, before boarding the boat to the mainland.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to the mainland, the Lumbridge Home Teleport spell, and a starting gear bundle (bronze axe/pickaxe, tinderbox, small fishing net, bronze dagger/sword, wooden shield, shortbow with 25 bronze arrows, runes, bucket, pot, bread, 25 coins).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: This page IS Tutorial Island itself; no separate Quick guide subpage exists -- both titles resolve to the same page/section map.

summary: Master-tier capstone quest through Kharazi Jungle, ending in defeating the level-187 demon Nezikchened for a choice of skill xp.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to the Legends' Guards just outside the Legends' Guild.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Master-difficulty; one of the deepest prerequisite chains in the game.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Must be able to defeat the level-187 demon Nezikchened, fought up to 3 times across the quest; he has high magic resistance and drains prayer to 1/10 at the start of the fight.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Map Kharazi Jungle for Radimus, summon Gujuo, then progress through cave puzzles: enchant a golden bowl, place gems by colour on carved rocks, and douse and bind Ungadulu before fighting Nezikchened.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Grow a Yommi tree from seeds, brew a bravery potion, then choose a short 'evil' path (kill Viyeldi) or long 'good' path (cast Holy Force on Zekin) through a second cave, fighting 3 named skeletons for crystal pieces on either path.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Carving and using the Yommi totem triggers up to 4 unavoidable melee hits (up to 72 damage total) while Nezikchened respawns after each of the 3 skeleton fights; pray Protect from Melee.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward is a choice of 30,000 xp, 4 times, in any of Attack/Defence/Strength/Hitpoints/Prayer/Magic/Woodcutting/Crafting/Smithing/Herblore/Agility/Thieving (repeats allowed).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Deep prerequisite chain requiring Family Crest, Heroes' Quest (incl. Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal, Dragon Slayer I), Shilo Village line, Jungle Potion/Druidic Ritual line, Underground Pass, Biohazard, Plague City, Waterfall Quest, and 107 quest points.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks Legends' Guild access, the dragon square shield, chargeable skills necklace/combat bracelet, Kharazi Jungle's 79 Agility vine shortcut, and adds Nezikchened to the Nightmare Zone.

req_items.name: Cut gems up to diamond
req_items.note: one each of sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond, opal, jade, red topaz

summary: Kill a level-101 Dramen Tree Spirit on Entrana (no armour allowed) to make a dramen staff and reach Zanaris.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to the warrior camped in north-western Lumbridge Swamp.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Chop (not chop-down) the tree near the warrior to summon Shamus, then bank your axe and all armour/weapons before sailing to Entrana with a Monk of Entrana (jewellery may be kept).

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight through 2 Greater Demons in the Entrana cave, then kill the level-101 Dramen Tree Spirit, which is safespottable behind the southern fungus.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Kill zombies in the cave for a bronze axe drop, then chop the Dramen tree and use a knife on a branch to make a dramen staff; cutting extra branches now saves later trips for Freeing Sir Amik Varze and The Fremennik Trials.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Reward xp is not itemized in the held data.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Fairytale I - Growing Pains, Heroes' Quest, Lunar Diplomacy, Freeing Sir Amik Varze (Recipe for Disaster subquest), Lumbridge & Draynor Medium/Hard Diary, and Slayer Master Chaeldar.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to Zanaris, the ability to buy/wield dragon longswords and daggers (60 Attack), cosmic rune crafting, a permanent Puro-Puro portal in Zanaris' wheat field, and the Tree spirit as a Nightmare Zone boss.

req_items.name: Woodcutting axe
req_items.note: must be un-blessed and banked before entering Entrana

summary: Resolve a miscommunication between Fabia and Xilo about where they were meant to meet in the Tlati Rainforest.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to either Fabia or Xilo in the Tlati Rainforest, Varlamore (Fabia by the southern magic trees west of Kastori; Xilo by the river bank west of the Crypt of Tonali lift).

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Each NPC describes the same rendezvous tree differently and is confused why the other never showed; talk to whichever one you did NOT speak to first.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Talking to the second NPC makes her leave to join the other, resolving the miscommunication and completing the miniquest.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: No skills, quests, or items are required; reward xp is not stated in the held data.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: No unlock -- lore-only, per the Miniquests page's own table.

summary: Multi-stage Lunar Isle quest crafting lunar equipment and clearing the Dream World to unlock the Lunar spellbook.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Lokar Searunner at Rellekka's westernmost dock.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sail to Lunar Isle with Captain Bentley by talking to 5 crew NPCs in a strict order and finding 5 hidden symbols with a lit lantern around the ship.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: On Lunar Isle: kill Suqah for a tooth, brew a waking-sleep potion, charge a Dramen staff at all 4 elemental altars in order to make a Lunar staff, then craft full lunar gear (helm, torso, trousers, gloves, boots, ring) from mined lunar ore and Suqah hides.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Enter the Dream World and defeat Me (level 79, safespottable); no gear switching is allowed once inside and you cannot teleport out.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Before the Me fight, complete 6 mini-puzzles at coloured platforms: dice-sum guessing, number-sequence pattern, a 20-log chopping race, a memorize-and-cross stepping-stone maze, a hurdle race, and copy-the-emote.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 5,000 xp each to Magic and Runecraft.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Lunar spellbook, Lunar Isle and its equipment shop, the Astral Altar, a seal of passage, 50 astral runes, and adds Me as a Nightmare Zone boss.

req_items.name: Elemental talismans or tiaras
req_items.note: all 4 elements, or Abyss access instead

summary: Defeat Kolodion through five shifting forms in the Wilderness to choose a god cape and staff.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by reaching Kolodion at the Mage Arena bank in level-53 Wilderness, via the Edgeville or West Ardougne wilderness lever to the Deserted Keep, then north and west while cutting two webs.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Kolodion shifts through 5 forms (himself, ogre, frost spider, ghost, level-112 black demon); all forms after the first take magic-only damage, so Protect from Magic tanks the fight.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Roughly 50-100 spell casts (fewer with Iban Blast) clear all 5 forms at 60+ Magic.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The arena is deep Wilderness (level 53-56), carrying PKer risk; enabling PK Skull Prevention and the hidden attack option is recommended before entering.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Choosing a god cape (Saradomin, Zamorak, or Guthix) with matching staff after defeating Kolodion; each god spell (Claws of Guthix, Flames of Zamorak, Saradomin Strike) is separately unlocked for outside use by casting it 100 times inside the arena, with the other two staves buyable from the Chamber guardian for 80,000gp each.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The 100-cast god-spell unlock grind is the larger time cost, not the Kolodion boss fight itself.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates Mage Arena II and the Wilderness Hard Diary.

req_items.name: Knife, slash weapon, or Wilderness sword

summary: Track and kill three wandering Wilderness followers to imbue a god cape at Kolodion.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by returning to Kolodion at the Mage Arena bank in level-53 Wilderness.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: An enchanted symbol works like a Hot/Cold clue to locate one of three wandering deep-Wilderness followers (Porazdir, Justiciar Zachariah, Derwen) at a time; each can only be damaged by its own matching god spell.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: The followers hit hard (up to 43) with both magic and melee, and despawn if not killed fast enough.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Recommended loop: locate a follower with the symbol, bank/gear up at Ferox Enclave, kill it and grab the remains, hand the remains to Kolodion, then repeat for the other two.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Deep Wilderness carries high PKer risk; dying to a player loses your cape and awards the killer 60,000gp.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Follower spawn locations rotate roughly every 45 minutes of Wilderness time, per player.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Imbues a god cape into its (i) variant using the matching follower's remains (Justiciar's hand for Saradomin, demon's heart for Zamorak, ent's roots for Guthix); extra imbued capes can be made later by re-killing a follower for another remains, or buying a base cape from the Lost Property shop first.

req_items.name: Knife, slash weapon, or Wilderness sword

summary: Escort My Arm to Weiss to court Snowflake, sneaking into the walled troll town and fighting Mother to secure fire-making secrets.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Burntmeat in the Troll Stronghold kitchen.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Travel by boat to the hidden troll town of Weiss, then sneak, mine, and climb past hostile trolls through a stealth section with a checkpoint and a stepping-stone dodge puzzle.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fake the Wise Old Man's death with a built coffin to fool Mother.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight through Don't Know What (level 163) and Mother (level 198); Mother must be doused with a water bucket to make her vulnerable via the Fire of Domination.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 10,000 Construction xp, 40,000 Firemaking xp, 50,000 Mining xp, and 50,000 Agility xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Deep prerequisite chain (My Arm's Big Adventure, Eadgar's Ruse, Druidic Ritual, Troll Stronghold, Death Plateau, The Feud, Jungle Potion, Swan Song, One Small Favour, Rune Mysteries, Shilo Village, Garden of Tranquillity, Creature of Fenkenstrain, Priest in Peril, The Restless Ghost, Cold War, Romeo & Juliet); is itself required for Secrets of the North.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to the Salt Mines, the ability to build fire pits, a disease-free herb patch in Weiss, and a teleport-room portal to Troll Stronghold via salt.

req_items.name: Climbing boots
req_items.note: only needed if not using Trollheim teleports

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

summary: Research three historical leads around Gielinor for outpost curator Jorral, then report back to him and King Lathas.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Jorral at the outpost north-west of West Ardougne.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Research three independent leads in any order: dig up a buried chest near Castle Wars with a silver merchant's key, trade a ghost in Port Phasmatys a sapphire amulet for a scroll, and pass a trivia quiz with the warrior Dron in Rellekka.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Report all 3 findings back to Jorral, then relay them to King Lathas to finish.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 1,000 Crafting xp and 1,000 Prayer xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 750 coins, an enchanted key for repeatable solo treasure digs until it disappears, access to the outpost museum, master clue hot/cold treasure trails, and 5 Kudos plus a 1,000xp antique lamp from Historian Minas.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Song of the Elves and The Enchanted Key miniquest.

req_items.name: Way to enter Port Phasmatys
req_items.note: Ghosts Ahoy completed, or 2 ecto-tokens, or charter ship gold

summary: Investigate a missing spice delivery for Emelio and prepare a test kebab, fighting a Dire Wolf Alpha and the Colosseum Minotaur.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Emelio at his home in Outer Fortis.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Talk to the Spice Merchant in the Bazaar about a missing delivery and open a mystery box with code 2546, then visit Alba north of Ortus Farm.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight the level-113 Dire Wolf Alpha in the wolf den west of the farm; it is multicombat, attacking with melee and ranged simultaneously, so bring food.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight the level-193 Minotaur in Fortis Colosseum for Lelia, switching Protect from Melee/Magic on 'Moo!'/'Moooo!' voice cues (a double-moo signals a faster attack).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Deliver a specific mix of meat, salad, spice, and sauce portions to make a test kebab before the Minotaur fight.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 8,000 Cooking xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to Emelio's Kebab Shop.

summary: Free Merlin from Morgan Le Faye's castle by sparing Sir Mordred and gathering the items to summon and defeat Thrantax the Mighty.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to King Arthur in Camelot.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Ask King Arthur, then Sir Gawain and Sir Lancelot, for leads, then sneak into Keep Le Faye by hiding in crates near the Catherby docks.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fight Sir Mordred (level 39) on the top floor but do not kill him or interrupt the cutscene when Morgan Le Faye begs for his life -- sparing him gives the recipe for freeing Merlin.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Gather bat bones from giant bats, make a black candle (bucket of wax plus the candle maker in Catherby), and pass the Lady of the Lake's bread-to-a-beggar test at the Port Sarim jeweller's to get Excalibur; read the chaos altar inscription in Varrock's Zamorakian chapel for the magic words.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Light the candle and drop (not bury) the bat bones on the garden symbol at Camelot to summon Thrantax the Mighty (level 92); getting the incantation wrong causes him to attack.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward includes 6 quest points and a 1,000xp lamp in any skill 20 or higher via Historian Minas kudos, but does not directly grant Prayer or Defence xp (those come from Holy Grail).

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks Excalibur, required for Holy Grail, the Honorary Knight of the Round Table title, and 5 claimable Kudos; gates into Heroes' Quest and Holy Grail.

summary: Solve a whodunit inside a manor south of Lumbridge Swamp by collecting three coloured gem keys and unmasking the killer.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Abigale or Hewey at the SE corner of Lumbridge Swamp, near the fishing spots.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Reach the manor by boat, empty a rainwater barrel for the manor key, then solve three room puzzles for coloured gem keys: slash a painting for the ruby key, play D-E-A-D on a piano for the emerald key, and enter a gem sequence (Sapphire-Diamond-Zenyte-Emerald-Onyx-Ruby) in a fireplace for the sapphire key.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Use all three keys on the final blue door, then dodge the hidden killer's knife throws by aiming a mirror at their wardrobe.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight and unmask Abigale as the killer to finish.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 600 Crafting xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks an uncut ruby, uncut emerald, and uncut sapphire.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: No requirements to start.

summary: Infiltrate Ape Atoll to craft an m'speak amulet and monkey greegree, then defeat the level-195 Jungle Demon.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Glider to Gandius for monkey bones, deliver the royal seal to G.L.O. Caranock, talk to Daero, then solve a sliding puzzle (or pay Glough roughly 200k coins to skip it) before sailing to Ape Atoll via Crash Island.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: On Ape Atoll, sneak past guards (escape jail if caught), find Garkor, gather monkey dentures and an m'amulet mould, then trade them plus a gold bar to Zooknock for an enchanted bar, and combine it with a wall-of-flames and ball of wool into an m'speak amulet.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Trade 5 bananas for a monkey talisman, return to Zooknock with the talisman and monkey bones for a greegree, then use a Karamjan greegree at Ardougne Zoo to smuggle a monkey to Awowogei's audience chamber via Kruk and the Elder Guard, retrieving the 10th squad sigil from Garkor.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Must be able to defeat a level-195 Jungle Demon (Protect from Magic recommended) to finish.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward xp is a player choice of 35,000 or 20,000 in each of Attack, Defence, Strength, and Hitpoints, told to Daero.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 10,000 coins, 3 diamonds, the ability to buy/wield the Dragon scimitar, full Ape Atoll access except bank/javelin store, permanent monkey greegree use at Ape Atoll and Ardougne Zoo, and adds the Jungle Demon to the Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Not found in the held steps_quests.jsonl index; steps_quests_id is null.

summary: Grandmaster five-chapter quest infiltrating Glough's dungeon and Ape Atoll to fight Kruk, Kob, Keef, and Glough.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Long.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Grandmaster-tier, 5-chapter quest.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Chapter II: infiltrate Glough's dungeon via the Agility Route or the web-slashing Tanking Route to reach and kill Kruk (level 207).

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Chapter III: defeat Kob (level 185) and Keef (level 178), sneak into Ape Atoll disguised as Assistant Le Smith, and play the Monkey Gear Solid stealth minigame back to Kruk's dungeon.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Chapter V: a 3-phase final battle against Glough (level 431) using combat-style-dependent tanking or safespotting per phase.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 80,000 Slayer xp, 60,000 Agility xp, 50,000 Thieving xp, and 50,000 Hunter xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 2 Duke training tokens worth 50,000xp each, the royal seed pod (unlimited Grand Tree teleports up to level 30 Wilderness), Crash Site Cavern (demonic gorillas) access, Ape Atoll bank and Javelin Store access, a new glider spot direct to Ape Atoll, the heavy ballista, and dragon javelin tip drops from dragons.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Deep prerequisite chain (Enlightened Journey with the balloon route to Gnome Stronghold, The Eyes of Glouphrie, Recipe for Disaster's Freeing King Awowogei subquest, Monkey Madness I, The Grand Tree, Tree Gnome Village, Troll Stronghold, Death Plateau, Watchtower).

summary: Recover a stolen blanket from thieves and help Brother Cedric prepare a birthday party for Brother Omad.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Brother Omad at Ardougne Monastery, south of East Ardougne.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Run past thieves (two level-14, one level-26) in a stone-circle den west of the monastery to recover a stolen child's blanket.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Brother Cedric prepare a birthday party by giving him a jug of water and some logs or a plank, then return to Brother Omad.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Grants 2,000 Woodcutting xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 8 law runes and repeatable parties from Brother Omad when spoken to.

req_items.name: Regular logs or a regular plank

summary: Find Hamal's missing daughter, cross a wilderness route, and kill The Kendal to recover her remains for burial.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Recover the chieftain's daughter's remains from Mountain Camp and give her a proper burial.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Hamal the Chieftain at Mountain Camp, east of Rellekka.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: The Kendal (level 70, melee-only, safespottable) guards the daughter's remains in a cave.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires pole-vaulting and mud-climbing a wilderness route to reach a talking magic pool.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Broker peace between Mountain Camp and Rellekka by mining an ancient rock sample and securing safe passage.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks passage into Mountain Camp over the rockslide and access to the Bearhead.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for The Fremennik Exiles.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 2,000 Prayer xp and 1,000 Attack xp.

summary: Infiltrate Mourner HQ in stolen gear, poison West Ardougne's food stores, and free the caged gnome to unlock Lletya.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sneak into West Ardougne Mourner HQ disguised as a Mourner to sabotage the city's food supply and open elf relations.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must defeat a level 11 Mourner at the Arandar gate to loot mourner gear; its attacks reduce all stats including HP to 20.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Combat stat drain from the Mourner fight is severe -- a ring of dueling trip to the Ferox pool of refreshment is recommended afterward.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Clean the bloody mourner top with Tegid's stolen soap and mend the trousers with silk and bear fur via Oronwen.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Re-dye 4 sheep herds using the fixed device's Aim-and-Fire mode, then poison 2 of West Ardougne's food stores with a barrel of toxic powder.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks Mourner HQ basement, the village of Lletya, an elf teleport crystal, and full mourner clothing.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Sets up Mourning's End Part II and its Death Altar unlock chain.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 40,000 Thieving xp and 25,000 Hitpoints xp.

req_items.name: Rotten apple
req_items.note: obtained in-quest, must be the specific one N of Mourner HQ

req_items.name: Toad crunchies or premade t'd crunch

summary: Solve the Temple of Light's mirror puzzle and charge an enchanted crystal at the Death Altar to finish Mourning's End.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Chip and enchant a black crystal, then solve the Temple of Light's mirror puzzle to reach and charge the Death Altar.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No hard skill requirement, but 65+ combat, 75-91 Agility, and 43+ Prayer are strongly recommended for the shadow-infested temple.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: A 3-floor light/mirror puzzle across 5 numbered treasure chests repositions hand mirrors and coloured crystals to route a light beam.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Ironmen without a death talisman must instead collect 50 junk items to open the Death Altar route.

facts.label: unlock
