facts.value: Unlocks the Death Altar, Death talismans/runes via Guardians of the Rift, Dark Beasts access, and a Slayer ring teleport to Dark Beasts.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 60,000 Agility xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Direct sequel to Mourning's End Part I; grants a crystal trinket for re-entering the Temple of Light afterward.

req_items.name: Death talisman/tiara, catalytic talisman/tiara, Runecraft cape, OR 50 junk items
req_items.note: any one of these satisfies the requirement; 50 junk items substitutes for ironmen without talismans

summary: Investigate old man Sinclair's death: match fingerprints, question suspects, and identify the poisoner to report to a guard.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate Sinclair Mansion's murder by dusting fingerprints and questioning suspects to identify the poisoner.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to any guard around Sinclair Mansion, north of Seers' Village and Camelot.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: No requirements; a short Kandarin-region quest.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Dust silver items in two thread-colour-matched suspects' bedrooms with flour and flypaper to match a fingerprint to the dagger.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Ask Gossip and the Seers' Village pub poison salesman who bought poison, then confront and confirm the matched suspect's motive.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 1,406 Crafting xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Rewards 2,000 coins.

summary: Teach the troll My Arm to farm goutweed, defending the crop from a Baby Roc and a Giant Roc.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Prep a goutweed patch atop Troll Stronghold and defend the growing crop from roc attacks.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Baby Roc (level 75) and Giant Roc (level 172) attack the growing goutweed crop and must be killed.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fetch a goutweedy lump from Death Plateau, then sail with My Arm to Tai Bwo Wannai for hardy gout tubers (needs 60%+ Cleanup favour).

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Requires 60%+ Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup favour before starting.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks a disease-free herb patch (goutweed only) atop Troll Stronghold and a rocks agility shortcut outside it.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Making Friends with My Arm.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 10,000 Herblore xp and 5,000 Farming xp.

req_items.name: spade, rake, seed dibber, plant cure

summary: Answer 3 questions correctly at each of 14 Varrock Museum creature displays to earn Hunter and Slayer xp.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Answer multiple-choice questions at 14 Varrock Museum creature displays to earn xp from Orlando Smith.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Orlando Smith in the basement of the Varrock Museum.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Each display needs 3 correct multiple-choice answers sourced from that display's lecture or wiki text; only 3-of-several need to be right, so guessing is viable.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 1,000 Hunter xp and 1,000 Slayer xp.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: If this is the player's first-ever Slayer xp, the free enchanted gem is lost on the first Slayer assignment and must instead be paid for at 1gp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 28 unique Varrock Museum kudos (2 per display across 14 displays).

summary: Retrieve a mirror and journal for the ghost Filliman, then give the nature spirit a sickle to fight ghasts in Mort Myre Swamp.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help the ghost Filliman recover his memory, then receive a druid pouch from the nature spirit to fight ghasts.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Drezel in the basement of the Paterdomus Temple by the River Salve.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Find a mirror under a bench's washing bowl for Filliman, then search the grotto tree for his journal.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Solve a 3-stone puzzle: mushroom on the light-brown stone, used spell card on the grey stone, stand on the orange stone.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Use the sickle's Bloom ability on swamp plants to fill a druid pouch, then use the filled pouch to make ghasts attackable and kill three of them.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks Mort Myre Swamp, the Nature Spirit altar (prayer restore plus temporary +2 boost), and the ability to fight ghasts.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Fairytale I - Growing Pains, In Search of the Myreque, Recipe for Disaster, While Guthix Sleeps, and Easy Morytania Diary.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 3,000 Crafting xp, 2,000 Defence xp, and 2,000 Hitpoints xp.

summary: Deliver 3 building materials to the Observatory professor and retrieve a stolen lens mould to view the rebuilt telescope.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Supply materials to rebuild the Observatory telescope and retrieve a stolen lens mould from the dungeon below.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to the Observatory professor in the Observatory Reception Room, north of Castle Wars.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Hand in 3 planks, a bronze bar, and molten glass as 3 separate deliveries, each fully finished before the next can begin.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The Observatory Dungeon has goblins guarding a kitchen key chest and a sleeping guard to bypass or kill.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Viewing the rebuilt telescope grants a fixed, account-locked constellation reward chosen once per account by RNG.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The exact constellation reward (combat xp, runes, an amulet of defence, a black 2h sword, a maple longbow, weapon poison, or a super strength(1)) is assigned per-account and cannot be chosen.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Building the permanent Observatory dungeon shortcut afterward needs Agility 23, Ranged 24, Strength 28 (all boostable), a crossbow, and a mith grapple -- not needed to complete the quest itself.

summary: Recruit Olaf's relatives, solve a symbol combination lock in a dungeon, and defeat Ulfric to restore family honour.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help a shipwrecked Fremennik reclaim his family honour by exploring a dungeon under a windswept tree.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Olaf Hradson, east of Rellekka, south of the Hunter area.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Ulfric (level 100, melee, safespottable) is fought in an old ship at the end of the dungeon.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The dungeon has a symbol-picture-wall combination lock and a rope-repaired rotten walkway; skeleton fremennik (level 40) drop keys.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 20,000 coins, 4 cut rubies, access to the brine rat cave, and a parchment leading into The Graveyard.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for The Graveyard and counts toward partial completion of the Fremennik medium diary.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 12,000 Defence xp.

summary: Complete a long chain of favours across the map, then fight Slagilith and a dwarf gang to finish Petra's storyline.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Chase down a long favour-for-favour chain of NPCs to repair a weather vane and reforge a sharpened axe for Yanni Salika.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Slagilith (level 92) reduces damage by 67% unless a pickaxe is equipped or magic is used; fought via an animate rock scroll on a sculpture.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: A group of dwarf gang members (levels 44/48/49) must be fought in a multicombat area.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Brew a Guthix rest tea for Sanfew and smith 3 weather vane parts on an anvil from bronze, iron, and steel bars.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks two 10,000xp experience lamps (skill must be level 30+), a steel key ring, pot lid crafting, Guthix rest tea, and a gnome glider route to Feldip Hills.

req_items.name: Guthix rest ingredients
req_items.note: 2 guam leaves, marrentill, harralander, cup of hot water

req_items.name: cut opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire
req_items.note: 2 each, or a chisel to cut uncut ones given in-quest

summary: Salvage a shipwreck, build a raft cargo hold, and deliver cargo to Port Sarim to unlock the Sailing skill.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Salvage a shipwreck and deliver raft cargo between Port Sarim and The Pandemonium to unlock Sailing.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Will and Anne at the south docks of Port Sarim.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Helm a ship south through the Bay of Sarim, trimming sails on wind gusts, then deploy a salvaging hook east of the Karamja Shipyard.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Build a cargo hold on a raft with the hammer and saw, then load cargo from the ledger table with empty hands and no weapons equipped.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Sailing skill, access to The Pandemonium ship, a raft, a 25 sawmill coupon, 2 repair kits, and a spyglass.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 400 Sailing xp.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

summary: Build 3 dungeon camps, locate a hidden NPC by dowsing, and defeat all 3 Moons of Peril in Neypotzli.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate the stirred ancient bosses beneath Cam Torum and defeat all 3 Moons of Peril.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Blue Moon (crush-weak; weapon-freeze and brazier-relight specials), Blood Moon (slash-weak; raining-blood pools and blood-jaguar specials), and Eclipse Moon (stab-weak; rotating shield and clone-facing specials) are each fought in their own chamber.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Build 3 camps in the dungeon's corner areas using building supplies, then dowse hot/cold with infused water and earth talismans to locate the hidden NPC Eyatlalli (location varies per player).

facts.label: combat
facts.value: A Sulphur Nagua guards the entrance and must be killed to enter the city.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Stand in a rotating safe-damage circle throughout each Moon fight; damage taken during their specials still counts.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to Neypotzli and the Moons of Peril, and a Lesser nagua Slayer task assignment.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Completion counts as a kill of the Moons of Peril, allowing Lunar Chest loot.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 40,000 Slayer xp, 5,000 Runecraft xp, 5,000 Hunter xp, and 5,000 Fishing xp.

summary: Smuggle rum for Luthas, retrieve a key from Wydin, and dig up One-Eyed Hector's treasure in Falador Park.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Smuggle rum through Karamja and trade it for a key to unlock a pirate treasure buried in Falador Park.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Redbeard Frank at the northernmost dock at Port Sarim, outside The Rusty Anchor.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: A level-4 Gardener guards the dig site in Falador Park and must be defeated or evaded.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fill the OUTSIDE banana crate (not the bedroom one) to smuggle Karamjan rum, then trade it to Redbeard Frank for a key that opens a chest in Varrock's Blue Moon Inn.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No xp reward.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks access to One-Eyed Hector's Treasure Chest (gold ring, emerald, 450 coins).

summary: Sneak into plague-locked West Ardougne, cure Bravek's hangover, and free Elena from the barred plague house.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Rescue Edmond's daughter Elena from a barred plague house in West Ardougne.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Edmond in the NW house of East Ardougne.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Soften the mud behind Edmond's house with buckets of water, dig under the wall, then use rope on the blocked pipe grill to enter West Ardougne.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Cure Bravek's hangover with chocolate dust, bucket of milk, and snape grass to get a warrant past the Mourners guarding the plague house.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks an Ardougne teleport scroll, which reading grants the Ardougne Teleport spell (51 Magic) and use of Ardougne teletabs.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: One of the Ardougne-diary prerequisite quests alongside Sheep Shearer and Clock Tower.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 2,425 Mining xp.

req_items.name: Hangover cure
req_items.note: or chocolate dust + bucket of milk + snape grass to make one

summary: Free the imprisoned monk Drezel by killing a Temple Guardian dog and a Monk of Zamorak to open the route to Morytania.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate a temple losing contact with Varrock Palace and free the imprisoned monk Drezel.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to King Roald at Varrock Palace.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Kill the Temple Guardian dog in the basement (safespottable, immune to Magic) and a Monk of Zamorak on the 1st floor for a golden key.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fill a bucket from the temple well, get it blessed by Drezel, then pour it on the coffin to free him.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Wolfbane dagger (stops Canifis citizens transforming into werewolves when attacked), the route to Canifis and Morytania, and 5 Kudos from Historian Minas.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for Animal Magnetism, Creature of Fenkenstrain, Desert Treasure I, Ghosts Ahoy, Haunted Mine, His Faithful Servants, Making History, Nature Spirit, Rum Deal, Shades of Mort'ton, and Wanted!.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 1,406 Prayer xp.

req_items.name: unnoted rune essence or pure essence
req_items.note: minable via Aubury in Varrock after Rune Mysteries

req_items.name: Bucket
req_items.note: buyable during quest from Varrock general store for 2gp

summary: Craft a disguise and a bronze key to break Prince Ali out of Lady Keli's jail in Draynor.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Break Prince Ali out of a jailhouse using a crafted disguise and a smelted bronze key.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Chancellor Hassan in Al Kharid palace.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Combine a disguise wig, skin paste (ashes, flour, water, redberries), and yellow dye into a disguise.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Take a key impression from Lady Keli, smelt a matching bronze key with a bronze bar, then use the rope on Lady Keli to bypass her.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Level-26 jail guards must be talked past using 3 beers for Joe rather than fought.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks 700 coins, free passage through the Lumbridge-Al Kharid toll gate forever, the Sorceress's Garden Thieving minigame (members), and an Al Kharid Palace rear window shortcut (70 Agility, members).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No xp reward.

req_items.name: Yellow dye
req_items.note: or 2 onions + 5 coins to make it

summary: Deliver cargo to The Pandemonium, forge a crowbar with Thurgo, and pry open a sealed crate at sea.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Deliver ledger cargo to The Pandemonium and forge a crowbar to pry open a sealed crate offshore.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie at The Pandemonium pub.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Fetch a crate of pirate looty from the Port Sarim ledger table and deliver it via the cargo hold.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Bring a steel bar, hammer, and redberry pie to Thurgo, who forges a crowbar to pry open a sealed crate found by sailing to the north-west island off The Pandemonium.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Drinking the recovered fish bladder stout can spawn an optional level 14 drink troll, skippable by returning to the buoys first or disembarking.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the ability to chart forgotten drinks, a 25 sawmill coupon (oak plank), and unlimited crowbars from the crate of crowbars.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 1,000 Smithing xp, 800 Sailing xp, and 1 Quest Point.

summary: Kill 8 low-level creatures for bones, soak them in vinegar, and boil each at the Odd Old Man's hut.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Collect bones from 8 low-level creatures and prepare each one for the Odd Old Man.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea, NE of Varrock by the Limestone Mine.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Kill a giant rat, unicorn, bear, ram, goblin, big frog, monkey, and giant bat for their bones -- all reachable on a walk from Varrock through Lumbridge Swamp to Karamja.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Buy vinegar from Fortunato in Draynor to soak each bone, then boil it in a pot over a fire at the Odd Old Man's hut.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Buying 27 extra vinegar jugs now (35 total) saves a trip if planning Rag and Bone Man II next.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Direct prerequisite for Rag and Bone Man II.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 500 Cooking xp and 500 Prayer xp.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

summary: Kill 27 varied monsters worldwide for bones, then repeat Rag and Bone Man I's vinegar-and-boil process 27 times.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Collect bones from 27 varied monsters across the world and repeat part I's preparation process for each.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea, NE of Varrock by the Limestone Mine.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires killing basilisks (needs mirror shield), and using ogre bow+brutal arrows or Crumble Undead against zogres among the 27 required monsters.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Gated behind 40 Slayer, 20 Defence, Rag and Bone Man I, Skippy and the Mogres (full), Horror from the Deep or partial Fremennik Trials, and partial Creature of Fenkenstrain and Waterfall Quest.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Ironmen/leaguers should avoid starting until ready, since quest-specific bones can litter drop tables across five regions while the quest is active.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Bonesack and the Ram skull helm.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 5,000 Prayer xp.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

req_items.name: Combat gear for zogres
req_items.note: ogre bow+brutal arrows or Crumble Undead

req_items.name: Ice coolers, fishing explosives, mirror shield/V's shield

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

summary: Guide a cat through five rat-catching vignettes across the map, then learn animal charming from Ali the Snake Charmer.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Use a cat to catch rats in five locations across the map, ending with an animal-charming note sequence.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Started by talking to Gertrude, west of Varrock.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Sneak the cat past guards in an Ardougne mansion, poison cheese to lure rats from a Varrock warehouse, and smoke a rat hole in Keldagrim with a lit weed pot.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Learn animal charming from Ali the Snake Charmer in Pollnivneach using an 8-note sequence: D G E F# B(+octave) C# A.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Rat pole, training overgrown cats into wily/lazy cats, naming your cat, and access to the Rat Pits with a minigame teleport.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 4,500 Thieving xp.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

req_items.name: Rat poison
req_items.note: or ingredients to make it: empty vial, cleaned kwuarm, red spiders' eggs

req_items.name: Snake charm
req_items.note: from The Feud or obtained in-quest

summary: Ten-chapter umbrella quest: unlock the feast, free 8 frozen council members in any order, then defeat the Culinaromancer for full Chest access.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Umbrella chain of 10 chapters: Another Cook's Quest opens the feast hub, 8 council-member chapters can be done in any order, then Defeating the Culinaromancer is the finale.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts with the Cook in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Long across the full 10-chapter chain.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Several chapters require defeating high-level bosses with Prayer disabled.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Full completion opens the Culinaromancer's Chest (kitchen weaponry, banking chest, food store, Barrows gloves), Mogre Camp, Evil Chicken's Lair, and the Ape Atoll Teleport spell.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The 20000 xp reward can be placed into any skill already above level 50.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The finale chapter needs 175 total Quest Points, combining RFD's own 9 subquest QP with the flattened prerequisite-quest list.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: No single combined gather list -- items are per-chapter; see each RFD subquest row for its own req_items.

summary: First RFD chapter: gather 4 ingredients for the Cook to unlock the feast and the rest of the quest chain.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Gather an eye of newt, greenman's ale, a rotten tomato, and a dirty blast (fruit blast mixed with ashes), then give them to the Cook and enter the dining room.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts with the Cook in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the feast invitation that opens the rest of Recipe for Disaster, plus Culinaromancer's Chest access after the feast cutscene.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates every other Recipe for Disaster chapter.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Fruit blast must be freshly made, not a premade one bought elsewhere.

req_items.name: Fruit blast
req_items.note: must be freshly mixed, not a premade fruit blast

req_items.name: Ashes
req_items.note: combined with fruit blast to make the dirty blast

summary: Finale chapter: after freeing all 8 council members, fight a 6-boss gauntlet with Prayer disabled to finish Recipe for Disaster.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Triggered automatically once all 8 council members are freed; a cutscene sends the player through a portal to face six bosses in sequence with no Prayer allowed.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Boss gauntlet order: Agrith-Na-Na, Flambeed (needs ice gloves), Karamel (weak to fire spells below max level), Dessourt (weak to stab/magic), Gelatinnoth Mother (colour-cycling elemental weakness), then the Culinaromancer himself.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: No Prayer allowed against any of the six bosses.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Player can leave and restock supplies between each boss fight without losing progress.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Triggers automatically in the Lumbridge Castle dining room after freeing all 8 council members; no NPC to talk to.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants full Culinaromancer's Chest access, including Barrows gloves.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The 20000 xp reward can be placed into any skill already above level 50.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Needs 175 total Quest Points before it can be attempted.

summary: Catch hellrats with a cat for spice colours, trial-and-error the correct dose per colour in stew, then deliver the perfectly-spiced stew to Evil Dave.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Talk to Doris (Dave's mother) in Edgeville, then Dave himself in the basement; hellrats stole his spices.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Use a cat to catch hellrats for each of 4 spice colours, then feed Dave test stews one dose at a time to work out the correct 1-3 dose amount per colour by trial and error before making the final stew.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting Evil Dave in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants a Hellcat from catching hellrats, the ability to fight Hell-Rat Behemoths with it, and coloured stat-boosting/draining spices for stews.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 7000 Cooking xp.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Cooking 25 is a wiki recommendation, not an enforced requirement to start or complete the chapter.

req_items.name: Cat
req_items.note: any cat except an overgrown cat

req_items.name: Bowls of stew
req_items.note: up to 9 needed for dose trial-and-error

summary: Travel to Ape Atoll, gather a stuffed-snake meal past the three wise monkeys, kill a level 84 Big Snake, cook it, and feed it to King Awowogei.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Get the gorilla/ninja/zombie greegrees from Zooknock if not already held, obtain a red banana and tchiki monkey nuts (gated behind the three wise monkeys in Awowogei's temple), kill a level 84 Big Snake for a corpse, stuff it with the banana and nuts, cook it over hot coals (zombie greegree needed to reach them), then feed it to Awowogei.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires defeating a level 84 Big Snake.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting Awowogei in the Lumbridge Castle dining room; the chapter itself plays out on Ape Atoll.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the Ape Atoll Teleport spell.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 10000 Cooking xp and 10000 Agility xp.

req_items.name: Karamjan monkey greegree
req_items.note: gorilla, ninja and zombie greegrees also needed, obtainable during the chapter

summary: Build a diving apparatus, dive for kelp and crab meat, kill 5 mudskippers for hides, then cook and deliver a fishcake to Pirate Pete.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Talk to the Cook, then have Murphy at Port Khazard build a diving apparatus (must weigh under 28kg). Dive to gather kelp and crab meat, kill 5 mudskippers for hides, trade the hides plus needle and bronze wire to Nung for crab pen access, grind the kelp and crab meat, cook a fishcake with the Cook, then feed it to Pete.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires killing 5 level 30/31 mudskippers.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting Pirate Pete in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the ability to dive for and fight crabs, cook crab meat (heals 10hp), and craft crab shells/claws into a helmet and gloves with a chisel.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 1000 xp each in Cooking, Crafting, Fishing and Smithing.

req_items.name: Needle
req_items.note: traded to Nung along with hides and bronze wire

summary: Make a creme brulee supreme, hunt the Evil Chicken and a level 227 black dragon in Zanaris for its ingredients, then flambe and deliver it to Sir Amik Varze.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Mix milk, cream and cornflour, add a vanilla pod picked in the Kharazi Jungle, track down the Evil Chicken via a Wise Old Man tip and a level 227 black dragon in Zanaris, add the chicken's egg and dramen-branch cinnamon, flambe using K'klik's dragon-token wish, then deliver it to Sir Amik.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Requires defeating a level 227 Black dragon in Zanaris.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting Sir Amik Varze in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Evil Chicken's Lair access (the black dragons) and adds the Evil Chicken plus all 5 chapter bosses to the Nightmare Zone.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 4000 Cooking xp and 4000 Hitpoints xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Needs 107 total Quest Points before it can be attempted.

req_items.name: Ice gloves
req_items.note: lets the brulee be flambeed without taking damage

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

summary: Help Rantz sail from Feldip Hills to Karamja, catch a Jubbly bird with a baited balloon toad, then cook and deliver the meat to Skrach Uglogwee.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Rantz build and sail a boat from Feldip Hills to Karamja, catch a Jubbly bird by baiting it with a balloon toad (bellows plus toad plus mined rock plus ball of wool), then cook the jubbly meat on Rantz's ogre spit and feed it to Skrach Uglogwee.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting Skrach Uglogwee in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants boat travel between Karamja and Feldip Hills for a fee of chompies or exotic herbs.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 1500 xp each in Woodcutting, Cooking, Crafting and Ranged.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Jubbly meat bought from the Grand Exchange does not work for this chapter -- it must be self-cooked.

summary: Make a dyed orange, spicy maggots, and soggy bread, then combine them into the 'Slop of compromise' to end the goblin generals' feud.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Give Mudknuckles the goblin cook some charcoal (triggers a comedic cauldron explosion), then make a dyed orange, spicy maggots and soggy bread and give all three to him for the 'Slop of compromise', fed to the two bickering goblin generals.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting the Goblin generals in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 1000 xp each in Cooking, Farming and Crafting.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Dye must not be red, yellow, orange or pink.

req_items.name: Dye
req_items.note: any colour except red, yellow, orange or pink

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

summary: Pass 3 trivia quizzes with Wizard Traiborn to enchant milk, egg and flour, then bake a cake for the frozen Lumbridge Guide.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Take milk, egg and flour to Wizard Traiborn in the Wizards' Tower and pass 3 short trivia quizzes (identify an NPC from a prior quest, answer a general knowledge question, pass an item memory test) to get each ingredient enchanted, then bake and give the cake to the frozen Lumbridge Guide.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting the Lumbridge Guide in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 2500 Cooking xp and 2500 Magic xp.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

summary: Get Rohak drunk on Asgoldian ale, hand him cake ingredients, then cool the resulting dwarven rock cake before delivering it to the frozen dwarf.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Learn the Asgoldian ale recipe from a Rising Sun Inn barmaid in Falador, get Rohak (the dwarf's father, under White Wolf Mountain) drunk on Asgoldian ales, hand him the ingredients for a dwarven rock cake, then cool the hot cake before delivering it to the frozen dwarf.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The hot dwarven rock cake can be cooled instantly with ice gloves, by killing an icefiend while carrying it, or by banking it and waiting.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: A level 13 Icefiend fight is only needed as a cooling method if ice gloves are not already held.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by inspecting the frozen dwarf in the Lumbridge Castle dining room.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 1000 Slayer xp and 1000 Cooking xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the ability to buy further dwarven rock cakes from Rohak for 100 coins or raw ingredients.

req_items.name: Gloves
req_items.note: ice gloves are the best cooling option, but any gloves work if using an alternate cooling method

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

summary: Clear 5 of 7 randomized puzzle rooms in a row (always including a Sir Leye fight) to become an Initiate of the Order of Temple Knights.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: After Sir Amik sends you to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park, clear 5 of 7 possible randomized puzzle rooms in a row, always including a Sir Leye fight; failing any room restarts the 5-room gauntlet from Falador.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Sir Leye fight is mandatory in every playthrough; use the warhammer or fight unarmed, since any bladed weapon on the killing blow fails the room.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Non-combat rooms are randomized logic/memory puzzles: river-crossing animals, a missing-statue memory test, a multi-step chemistry door puzzle, a riddle-based combination lock, multiple-choice riddles, and an 8-second stand-still test.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Sir Amik Varze on the 2nd floor of the western tower, White Knights' Castle, Falador.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short, but the randomized 5-room gauntlet must be cleared without a single failure.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants Initiate armour access (free sallet; cuisse, hauberk and full set purchasable from Sir Tiffy Cashien), the Gaze of Saradomin death-respawn toggle, and the Initiate title in the Order of Temple Knights.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates the Wanted! quest and the Medium Falador Diary.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Reward xp is 1000.5 in each of Prayer, Herblore and Agility, plus 3000 coins and 1 Quest Point, as held in source data.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The .5 xp fractions in the reward figures are as recorded in the held source row -- unverified against the wiki.

req_items.name: None
req_items.note: inventory must be completely empty and nothing equipped to enter the testing grounds

summary: Craft a barrel bomb through the Underground Pass and fire it from a catapult to destroy Lord Iorwerth's target for King Lathas.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Return through the Underground Pass to Iban's Temple exit, travel west through Isafdar meeting Idris then Lord Iorwerth at the Iorwerth Camp, track the Elf Tracker to find and kill a Tyras guard for a crystal pendant, gather coal-tar barrels, sulphur, quicklime and naphtha ingredients, distill naphtha at the Rimmington chemist's still, assemble a barrel bomb, carry it to the catapult north of Tyras Camp, bait the guard with cooked rabbit and fire the bomb, then return to King Lathas.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must defeat a safespottable level 110 Tyras guard.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Naphtha distillation at the Rimmington chemist's still is a careful tar/pressure/coal-feed minigame.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to King Lathas on the 1st floor of Ardougne Castle.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Long.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 15000 coins, access to the elven kingdom of Tirannwn and the Arandar overpass, the dragon halberd (60 Attack/30 Strength to wield), Port Tyras charter/docking at 66 Sailing, Iorwerth camp and Zul-Andra teleport scrolls, the BJS fairy ring code, and the Gwenith Glide (Barracuda Trial) attempt.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Direct prerequisite for Roving Elves and the rest of the Mourner/elf storyline.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Agility 56 avoids a slower alternate trap route but is not a hard start gate for the quest.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 13750 Agility xp.

req_items.name: Bow and arrows
req_items.note: no broad, ice or amethyst arrows

req_items.name: Limestone
req_items.note: or a pickaxe plus Mining 10 to mine it yourself

req_items.name: Strip of cloth
req_items.note: made from 4 wool on a loom

req_items.name: Cooked rabbit
req_items.note: obtained in-quest, or a roast rabbit

summary: Complete 3 independent errand branches for Ali Morrisane (runes, blackjacks, clothes) in any order to unlock his full Discount Wares stock.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Not an official miniquest -- the wiki classifies it as one-off training/trade-unlock content, not a Quest List entry. Three independent branches unlock separate parts of Ali's shop and can be done in any order: Runes (solve, force or pick two lockable rune caskets; the large casket only accepts the runedoku puzzle), Blackjacks (talk to the Blackjack seller in Pollnivneach and pick offensive or defensive style), and Clothes (give Siamun in Sophanem 3 matching dyes or pelts).

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short if fully prepared, Medium otherwise.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Runes branch opens Ali's rune stock; Blackjacks branch opens offensive or defensive blackjack stock (switchable later); Clothes branch opens Menaphite clothing or Desert outfit stock (switchable later, cosmetic-only); all three together give discounted magic carpet fares (100gp, or 75gp with ring of charos (a), down from 200gp/100gp).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Icthlarin's Little Helper only needs to be started, not completed, for the Sophanem access this quest needs.

req_items.name: Dyes of the same colour
req_items.note: OR 3 animal pelts of the same kind (cowhide, grey wolf fur, snakeskin, bear fur, or wool -- not balls of wool); either set unlocks Menaphite clothing or the Desert outfit

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: only needed to bribe the street urchin for the defensive blackjack option

summary: Relay a letter between Juliet and Romeo, then brew and deliver a sleeping potion so the two can meet in the crypt.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Relay a letter from Juliet (upper balcony of the mansion west of Varrock's west bank) to Romeo in the square, fetch cadava berries (growing west of the south-east Varrock mine) for the Apothecary to brew a sleeping potion, give the potion to Juliet, then tell Romeo to meet her in the crypt.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Romeo in Varrock Square.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: No requirements to start; reward is 5 Quest Points only, no xp or item rewards listed.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Prerequisite quest feeding into Defender of Varrock's requirement chain.

summary: Befriend Islwyn, plant a consecration seed grown from a Moss Guardian kill in the Waterfall Dungeon's final room, and choose a crystal weapon reward.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Track down and befriend Islwyn (world-hop if not present), bank combat gear, use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's tombstone north-west of the Fishing Guild, kill the Moss Guardian for a consecration seed, travel through the Waterfall Dungeon (raft, rope, rope, door) to plant the seed in the final room, then report back to Islwyn for the reward choice.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Level 84 Moss Guardian must be fought unarmed under heavy item restrictions (flinchable).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Agility 56 is waived entirely if travelling to the elven woods by charter ship instead of on foot.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Islwyn in the Elven woods of Isafdar.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Reward choice of a crystal shield or a crystal bow with 500 charges; also makes the Moss Guardian accessible in the Nightmare Zone and grants the Isafdar painting for the Quest hall (required for the hard Western Provinces Diary).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 10000 Strength xp.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Directly sets up Mourning's End Part I's teleport crystal once Eluned is then spoken to.

req_items.name: Glarial's pebble
req_items.note: obtained in-quest if not kept from Waterfall Quest

summary: Repair a broken lift, cross hazards to collect a burnt diary, then defeat the Giant Sea Snake to end the Miscellania-Etceteria conflict.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: As regent, investigate thefts threatening war between Miscellania and Etceteria; talk to citizens on both sides, get a signed scroll from King Vargas to access the dungeon under Miscellania Castle, talk to the dwarf Donal, then repair a broken lift using an engine, 5 coal, 3 beams, 3 pulley beams and 2 ropes assembled in a specific order.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Deeper in the dungeon: swing across water with a rope, cross slippery rocks with a plank while avoiding steam vents and falling rocks, and collect 5 pages of a burnt diary from fire remains, reading it before the final crevice.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Instanced fight against the Giant Sea Snake, level 149, 100 HP, poison hits up to 9 -- antipoison strongly recommended.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Advisor Ghrim in Miscellania Castle.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants 20000 coins, Bosun Zarah as a hireable crewmate at Sailing 80, enhanced Managing Miscellania rewards, and the ability to dock at Etceteria at Sailing 65.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 5000 Agility, 5000 Slayer, 5000 Hitpoints xp, plus 1 Quest Point, as held in source data.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Second quest in the Miscellania series; requires Throne of Miscellania, which itself flattens Heroes' Quest, Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal, Dragon Slayer I and The Fremennik Trials.

req_items.name: Coal
req_items.note: obtainable during the quest with a pickaxe

summary: Grow blindweed for the Braindeath Island brewery, then defeat an evil spirit and a fever spider to finish a batch of Unsanitary Swill.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Talk to Pirate Pete then Captain Braindeath (decline his money) to start; grab a blindweed seed, plant it in the south-eastern patch, feed the grown blindweed into the brewery hopper, fill a bucket with stagnant water and add it, fish 5 sluglings near the farm patch and add them, then pull the lever.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must kill a safespottable level 150 Evil spirit and a safespottable level 49 fever spider, adding the spider's corpse to the hopper.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Davey must bless the wrench (needs 47+ Prayer) before it can be used on the shaking brewing control.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Pirate Pete at the dock north of Port Phasmatys.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the holy wrench (extra prayer points from prayer potions while held) and access to Braindeath Island.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 7000 xp each in Fishing, Prayer and Farming.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Zogre Flesh Eaters' own Big Chompy Bird Hunting to Jungle Potion to Druidic Ritual chain is inherited and flattened into this quest's requirements.

req_items.name: Seed dibber
req_items.note: obtained in-quest, or via the partial Barbarian Training farming section

req_items.name: Prayer points
req_items.note: minimum needed for the evil spirit fight

summary: Deliver an air talisman between Sedridor and Aubury for Duke Horacio to unlock Runecraft and rune essence mining.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Duke Horacio gives an air talisman; take it to Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement, who sends it to Aubury in his Varrock rune shop as a research package, Aubury swaps it for notes to carry back to Sedridor, who explains Runecraft basics and returns the talisman.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Duke Horacio on the 1st floor of Lumbridge Castle.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short; no requirements or items needed.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Opens rune essence mining and Runecraft entirely; grants an air talisman, the ability to send lamps/books of knowledge from random events into Runecraft, and 5 Kudos claimable from Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The single most-required prerequisite quest on the wiki; directly gates Aubury's essence-mine teleport (Varrock Diary Easy task) and Sedridor's essence-mine teleport (Lumbridge & Draynor Diary Easy task).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Reward xp amount is unknown ('??' in held data) -- not stated in the source row.

summary: Offer draconic bones or dragonstones to Olbertus's cursed burner to raise its faith level and unlock a permanent Prayer xp boost.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Olbertus's burner/shrine sits under a curse; offer eligible draconic bones (babydragon, dragon, lava dragon, superior dragon) to raise its 'faith level' from 0 toward 200 points, or give 5 unnoted dragonstones up front to jump straight to the 100-point mark.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Faith thresholds give flavour messages at 0/50/100/150/200; the 'Check-Faith' option on the burner shows current progress at any time.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts by talking to Olbertus in Forthos Dungeon.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: At 100 faith the burner grants +300% Prayer xp on offered bones/ashes, permanently; at 200 faith a temple key appears that permanently unlocks the dungeon's remaining gates/shortcut.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The xp boost itself has no further threshold beyond the 100-point mark; not on the official quest list -- classified as a one-off restoration errand/miniquest.

req_items.name: Unnoted dragonstones
req_items.note: jumps faith straight to the 100-point mark instead of gradual bone offerings

req_items.name: Draconic bones (babydragon/dragon/lava dragon/superior dragon)
req_items.note: 100 bones for a half-restore or 200 for a full restore; lava dragon bones count double and superior dragon bones count triple toward the 200 total

summary: Catch Thormac's three escaped scorpions from Taverley Dungeon, Edgeville Monastery, and Barbarian Outpost, then return them.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Thormac's three rare Kharid Scorpions have escaped his tower; he provides a scorpion cage to recapture them.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Thormac on the top floor of Sorcerer's Tower (2701,3405, plane 3), south-east of the Ranging Guild.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Scorpion 1 is in a hidden room in Taverley Dungeon, unlocked by talking to a Seer in Seers' Village, reached past blue dragons and black demons/poison spiders using a dusty key from the jailer or a 70/80 Agility shortcut.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Scorpion 2 is upstairs in Edgeville Monastery, which requires Prayer 31 to enter (one-time).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Scorpion 3 is in the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course, accessible only after completing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 6,625 Strength xp and 1 quest point.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Thormac can enchant a battlestaff into a mystic staff for 40,000 coins after completion.

req_items.name: Dusty key
req_items.note: obtainable during the quest from the jailer; alternative: Agility 70 (boostable) bypasses the shortcut without needing the key

summary: Help Alan and three of King's men rebuild his egg-friend Humpy after repeated accidental drops, via fetch tasks and a puzzle.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Alan asks the player to mind his egg-friend Humpy while he cooks a feast, but gravity destroys it as soon as he leaves.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Recruit three of King's men from The King's Inn in Tal Teklan: Acatzin repairs a whetstone then an axe, Nezketi brews damiana tea, and Kauayotl repairs his cart.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: When the original egg can't be fixed, three replacement eggs are obtained by looting egg piles from a large chicken (level 16), a red dragon (level 106, safespottable), and a black jaguar (level 88).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: None of the painted replacement eggs survive judging, so the player and King's men solve a sliding/rotate puzzle to reassemble the original egg.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Wearing a bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace auto-buries Alan's bones for 1.5 Prayer xp instead of leaving them lootable as a keepsake.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Alan at the Temple of Tal Teok, just north of Tal Teklan (1247,3166).

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 5,000 xp each in Construction, Cooking, and Smithing.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants an egg pet (obtained by talking to the egg on the wall) that can be placed in a pet house.

summary: Fix Holgart's boat with swamp paste, rescue Kennith's father, then light a torch to save Kennith from platform machinery.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: First quest in the Sea Slug series and third in the Temple Knight series.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Give Holgart swamp paste to fix his boat and reach the Fishing Platform.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Find Bailey to learn sea slugs fear heat, then rescue Kennith's father Kent from a nearby island.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Light a torch, made from broken glass and damp sticks, and use it to save Kennith from the platform machinery (needs Firemaking 30, boostable, only at this step).

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Caroline on the coast just north of Witchaven, east of Ardougne (2716,3302).

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 7,175 Fishing xp and 1 quest point.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants access to the Fishing Platform and Oyster pearls.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates The Slug Menace, the sequel quest.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The quest's own Rewards section grants access to the Fishing Platform, not the Fishing Guild -- a different location; some secondary sources conflate the two.

req_items.name: Swamp paste
req_items.note: made by cooking flour and swamp tar on a fire, or buyable from a Trader crewmember (75gp), Rasolo west of the Fishing Guild (60gp), or Khazard General Store (42gp at full stock)

summary: Investigate Ceril's murder, track Evelot, infiltrate Weiss, and defeat the Strange Creature to unlock the Phantom Muspah.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Murder-mystery quest continuing the Hazeel Cult/General's Shadow storyline.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Desert Treasure I must be started (for the ring of visibility), though full completion is not required.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Investigate Ceril's murder at Carnillean Mansion (a broken window and a hidden room behind a false wall), then track and fight Evelot (level 148, drains prayer on her specials) near the Fight Arena bar.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Visit the Hazeel Cult hideout via an Ardougne sewers raft to enlist Hazeel's help, then lockpick a hidden chest behind the mansion's cooking shelves for a scroll (a Strange Old Lockpick does not work for this).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Travel to Weiss, question Big Fish and Snowflake, then fight a level-262 Assassin who lures with smoke bombs and throws poison vials.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Solve a multi-stage code-lock dungeon under Weiss (gate code, chest code, brazier-lighting order, arrow-direction gate code, combining two jewel shards) to reach the final boss, the Strange Creature.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final boss is the Strange Creature under Weiss; ranged/magic gear is recommended before the fight.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to the guard outside Carnillean Mansion, south-west East Ardougne (2570,3276).

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 60,000 Agility, 50,000 Thieving, and 40,000 Hunter xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks mining ancient essence crystals in the Ghorrock Dungeon and access to a stronger version of the Strange Creature, the Phantom Muspah.

req_items.name: Lockpick
req_items.note: the Strange Old Lockpick does not work for this quest

summary: Brew Serum 207, repair Mort'ton's ruined temple, then cure Razmire and Ulsquire with Serum 208.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Search a shelf in the ruined south-west house of Mort'ton and read the diary found there to start; this also unlocks making Serum 207.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Make 2 doses of Serum 207, use one to cure Razmire in the general store, kill 5 loar shades for their remains, and return the remains to Razmire.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Repair the temple north-east of Mort'ton to 100% with at least 20 sanctity (a minigame, safer with other players present), light the sacred altar, pour olive oil on the flame for sacred oil, and dip Serum 207 in the flame to make permanent-cure Serum 208.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Make a pyre log with the sacred oil and loar remains, light it at one of the stone funeral pyre groups west of the general store for 25 Prayer xp, then cure both Razmire and Ulsquire Shauncy with Serum 208 to finish.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: A regular hammer alone cannot finish the temple repair if the minigame world is empty; a Flamtaer hammer (buyable from Razmire for about 13,000 coins) is highly recommended.

facts.label: start
facts.value: No start NPC -- begin by searching the shelf in the ruined house, south-west Mort'ton (3481,3279).

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Rewards 2,000 Herblore and 2,000 Crafting xp; turning in the Diary of Herbi Flax to the Apothecary in Varrock grants an extra 335 Herblore xp, once only.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocks the Shades of Mort'ton minigame and its teleport.

req_items.name: Tarromin potion (unf)
req_items.note: or 2 vials of water + 2 grimy tarromin, both obtainable in-quest

req_items.name: Logs
req_items.note: or an axe to cut some

req_items.name: Hammer
req_items.note: a Flamtaer hammer (buyable from Razmire, ~13,000 coins) is highly recommended since a regular hammer alone can't finish the temple repair if the minigame world is empty

summary: Join Evil Dave's cult to gather demonic sigils, then defeat Agrith-Naar with Silverlight to upgrade it into Darklight.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sequel to The Golem and Demon Slayer; must be able to defeat a level 100 demon, Agrith-Naar.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Talk to Father Reen, travel to the Ruins of Uzer, talk to Father Badden with Silverlight in inventory, dye Silverlight black with a black mushroom/dye, grab a strange implement, then wear 3 black outfit items plus the dyed Silverlight to join the cult with Evil Dave.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Through the portal: get a demonic sigil mould from Jennifer, smelt a demonic sigil from a silver bar, find a book hidden in one of 4 kilns and deliver it to Matthew, get an incantation from Denath, complete and chant a ritual circle, retrieve Denath's dropped sigil, then take Tanya's sigil (4 sigils total).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Rally the troops by convincing Father Badden and Father Reen, then reprogram the golem with the strange implement and send it into the dungeon.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final fight: say the incantation backwards to Matthew, then kill Agrith-Naar (level 100, flinchable behind the north-west torch) with any weapon but land the final blow with Silverlight.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Do not flee mid-final-blow against Agrith-Naar or it heals.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Start by talking to Father Reen, south of Al Kharid bank.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Medium

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No flat xp reward; the player chooses 10,000 xp in any combat skill other than Prayer instead.

facts.label: unlock

facts.value: Being seen on the grass or by the Witch forces the break-in to restart, and getting caught mid-fight while carrying the ball can lower combat stats.
