facts.value: Completing the quest unlocks the Witch's experiment (all four forms) as a selectable Nightmare Zone boss.

summary: Gather four ingredients to help Hetty the witch brew a potion in Rimmington.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts with Hetty at her house in Rimmington, south of Falador and west of Port Sarim.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short quest length.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Requires collecting a rat's tail, an eye of newt, cooked rat meat, and an onion, then drinking a potion Hetty brews from them.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Eye of newt must be purchased from Betty (3gp); the raw rat meat must be burned on Hetty's fireplace before it can be used.

summary: A tutorial-tier treasure hunt: dig four marked spots and deliver the casket to Veos.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts with Veos at the Sheared Ram pub in Lumbridge; no requirements to begin.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Very Short quest length.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Dig at four marked spots around Lumbridge and Draynor Village, then use the resulting ancient casket on Veos at Port Sarim docks.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the quest raises the held cap on clue scrolls by one at every tier and unlocks the ability to receive scroll boxes, including a beginner scroll box if not already owned.

req_items.name: Spade
req_items.note: Eastfloor spade does not work for this quest

summary: Investigate zombified ogres for Grish, cure Sithik Ints of undeath, and defeat the boss Slash Bash.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Starts with Grish at Jiggig, south of Castle Wars and west of Gu'Tanoth.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Short quest length.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: In addition to the listed skill levels, requires the ability to defeat a level 111 enemy.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash (uses Ranged and Melee) in the ceremonial chamber; safespot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Zogre and skogre attacks in the cave below Jiggig can inflict disease if under 89 combat; carrying super restores is a precaution.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the quest unlocks the ability to make Relicym's balm.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the quest unlocks the ability to fletch composite ogre bows and brutal arrows.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the quest unlocks the ability to wear inoculation bracelets.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the quest unlocks access to Uglug's shop, entered by giving Uglug a dose of Relicym's balm.

summary: Help Bert recover his lost magical past by tracking down Sandy in Brimhaven and Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Bert recover a lost magical past by investigating his former colleague Sandy in Brimhaven and consulting wizard Zavistic Rarve.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires mixing bottled water with redberries then white berries, in that order, to brew pink dye for a rose-tinted lens used to make a truth serum.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Progressing at the Wizards' Guild requires ringing the entrance bell multiple times across the quest, each time triggering a new item or scene from Zavistic Rarve.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The final item, a wizard's head, comes from Mazion at the Entrana sandpit near the end of the quest.

req_items.name: Redberries
req_items.note: buyable in-quest from the Port Sarim food store

req_items.name: Bucket of sand
req_items.note: obtainable in-quest if you bring an empty bucket

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

summary: Investigate an attack on Prince Itzla at the Teomat through trials at the Tower of Ascension, then pursue Twilight Emissaries into an ice dungeon.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate an attack on Prince Itzla at the Teomat by completing trials at the Tower of Ascension, then pursue Twilight Emissaries into an ice dungeon beneath the ruins.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The First Trial requires pickpocketing a caged Emissary Ascended for a key, then solving a per-player word-decode puzzle from looted books to derive a passcode spoken to Forebearer Janus.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: The Second Trial is a wave-based combat encounter requiring the player to fight off melee and mage waves while healing Prince Itzla with bandages from medical boxes.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The Third Trial requires questioning every cultist and accusing whichever one mentions 'Mictl', a belief not part of standard Emissary teachings.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: The Final Trial is a fight against Prince Itzla himself, who is immune to special attacks; re-enable Protect from Melee immediately after his sword-swipe special and move behind him when he telegraphs an AOE special.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Statue Puzzle requires collecting 3 coloured icons from urns guarded by continuously-spawning level-104 Frost Nagua, then touching statues in a player-specific order derived from corner murals.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: The final boss is Amoxliatl (level 263), fought while praying magic, avoiding ice pools and spikes, and meleeing the healing ice blocks she summons.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The Ice Dungeon beneath the ruins requires pulling 4 levers while dodging Frost Nagua, frost crabs, and traps that each deal 10 damage.

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: pays for the pub basement room at Quetzacalli Gorge

req_items.name: Empty inventory slots
req_items.note: maximum needed, for carrying trial loot

summary: Help Cassius investigate the Groats' unusually productive cows on their farm near Lumbridge.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Cassius investigate why Seth and Gillie Groats' cows are unusually productive on their farm near Lumbridge.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Progress requires delivering milk samples in turn to Cassius, Duke Horacio, and Gillie Groats before being granted a permit to access the bull's pen.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Fight the pen's bull (recommended 15+ Combat) after obtaining a permit from Gillie Groats.

summary: Help the Squire recover the White Knights' lost ceremonial sword by finding smith Thurgo and mining replacement blurite ore.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help the Squire recover the White Knights' lost ceremonial sword by tracking down the Imcando smith Thurgo and mining replacement blurite ore.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires searching Sir Vyvin's bedroom cupboard for a portrait while he isn't watching, then giving it and iron bars to Thurgo so he agrees to reforge the sword.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Blurite ore is mined inside the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, reached via a trapdoor east of Thurgo.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Talking to Reldo about the Imcando dwarves can be skipped if Thurgo was already met through The Giant Dwarf.

req_items.name: Redberry pie
req_items.note: must be a whole pie, not half

req_items.name: Iron bars
req_items.note: base amount to forge the Squire's replacement sword

req_items.name: Iron bars (extra)
req_items.note: only needed if you want your own personal blurite sword (4 total)

req_items.name: Blurite ore
req_items.note: mined in-quest at the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon

req_items.name: Blurite ore (extra)
req_items.note: only needed for a spare sword and/or the Falador easy diary task

req_items.name: Pickaxe
req_items.note: a free pickaxe spawns in Rimmington

summary: Help Duke Horacio investigate goblin activity beneath Lumbridge Castle and reconnect with the goblin Mistag.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Duke Horacio investigate goblin activity in the cellar caves beneath Lumbridge Castle and reconnect with the goblin Mistag.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires searching the Varrock Palace library's northern bookcase for a goblin symbol book, then mediating between generals at Goblin Village to learn the Goblin Bow and Goblin Salute emotes.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Travel through the Lumbridge cellar caves toward Mistag can be auto-pathed by clicking the minimap.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Pickpocketing Sigmund and looting his chest yields HAM robes worth keeping for the separate quest Death to the Dorgeshuun.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Straying off-route near swamp gas underground can extinguish a light source and risks an explosion.

req_items.name: Light source
req_items.note: candle/torch/oil lamp; bring a tinderbox as backup

summary: Expose King Bolren's pet Dumpling as another evil creature and heal the corrupted spirit tree Incomitatus.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sequel to The Eyes of Glouphrie: expose King Bolren's pet 'Dumpling' as another evil creature and heal the corrupted spirit tree Incomitatus.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires solving a monolith-pushing puzzle in the Tree Gnome Village Dungeon and matching values on Yewnock's disc machine to progress Bolrie's diary cutscenes.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Must kill three aggressive Warped Terrorbirds while racing through the Warped Depths dungeon.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The Warped Depths dungeon ends in a tar-and-gas trap that Hazelmere teleports the player out of before it triggers.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Experienced-tier quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: While Guthix Sleeps.

req_items.name: Tree Gnome Village Dungeon key
req_items.note: not needed if Roving Elves has been started; otherwise obtainable in-quest

summary: Investigate the gang controlling Port Piscarilius and uncover the true identity of the Queen of Thieves.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Investigate the Saviours of Kourend, the gang uniting Port Piscarilius's criminal underworld, on behalf of an informant in The Warrens.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires bribing an informant with cooked stew to learn the gang's hideout, then faking a rival gang leader's death to prove loyalty before confronting the Queen of Thieves.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The Queen of Thieves is revealed to be Lady Shauna Piscarilius, who uses the gang to target the corrupt rather than terrorise the poor.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Intermediate quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: A Kingdom Divided, Kourend & Kebos Medium Diary.

req_items.name: Stew
req_items.note: ingredients purchasable in-quest for 6 coins, requires 25 Cooking to prepare

summary: Investigate the Red Reef Trading Company for navigator Floopa and uncover its coral-driven conflict with the tortugans.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Sequel to Troubled Tortugans: investigate the Red Reef Trading Company for injured navigator Floopa, uncovering a coral shortage driving its conflict with the tortugans.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight through six pirates and captain Black Eye Bethel, who has 3-stage weapon upgrades, at Last Light.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Requires sinking or crew-killing two pirate ships at sea, and fighting a safespottable giant lobster while repairing underwater coral dredgers.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Experienced-tier Sailing quest.

req_items.name: Magic or ranged gear
req_items.note: alternative option to skip ship combat

summary: Help Father Aereck put a haunted Lumbridge graveyard ghost to rest by finding its skull.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Father Aereck put a haunted Lumbridge graveyard ghost to rest by finding its missing skull.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: A level 13 skeleton spawns in the Wizards' Tower basement when searching the altar but does not need to be killed.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Novice quest; the only real gate is being able to kill or flee the level 13 skeleton.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: Animal Magnetism, Curse of the Empty Lord, Ghosts Ahoy, Making History, Nature Spirit, Creature of Fenkenstrain.

summary: Infiltrate the Desert Mining Camp in disguise for Irena to rescue the trapped worker Ana.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Infiltrate the Desert Mining Camp in disguise for Irena to rescue the trapped worker Ana.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires goading the Mercenary Captain into attacking for a gate key, then trading with a slave for disguise clothes to enter the mine undetected.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Entering without full waterskins risks heat damage or jail; equipping weapons/armour, removing the disguise, or leaving through the gate or mine door while still in disguise all risk being jailed.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Smithing a bronze dart tip and fletching it with 10 feathers produces a prototype dart traded to Al Shabim for the Tenti pineapple needed to bait a mine guard.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: If the mine cart cutscene doesn't trigger when searched, it must be redone; teleporting while carrying a captive in a barrel drops the barrel instead.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for starting Desert Treasure I.

req_items.name: Desert shirt, robe, and boots
req_items.note: non-black versions only; buyable from Shantay at Shantay Pass

req_items.name: Bronze bar
req_items.note: bring 2-3 as a buffer; 24-96% smith success chance depending on Smithing level

req_items.name: Feathers
req_items.note: 30-50+ recommended at low Fletching as a buffer

req_items.name: Desert entry method
req_items.note: any one of: Shantay Pass toll, desert amulet 2, teleport tablets/scrolls, fairy rings, or a pharaoh's sceptre

summary: Help King Bolren defend the Tree Gnome Village from the Khazard Stronghold and recover three orbs of protection.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help King Bolren defend the Tree Gnome Village from the Khazard Stronghold by disabling its ballista defences and recovering three orbs of protection.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires gathering a 4-digit ballista code from riddles told by 3 tracker gnomes around the Khazard Stronghold, then firing the south-west ballista with that code.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Level 48 Khazard commanders inside the stronghold can be ignored or killed while retrieving an orb of protection from an upstairs chest.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Defeat the level 112 Khazard warlord (safespottable near the West Ardougne wall) for the other two orbs.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Intermediate quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: Monkey Madness I, The Path of Glouphrie, Medium Western Provinces Diary, Medium Varrock Diary.

req_items.name: Normal logs
req_items.note: alternatively cut from goblin drops in the maze with an axe, or take from a stored canoe

summary: Help Denulth fight into the Troll Stronghold to rescue prisoners Twig and Berry from the trolls.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Denulth fight into the Troll Stronghold near Trollheim to rescue the imprisoned Twig and Berry.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight Dad in the arena (safespottable from the gate); the fight ends automatically before he dies.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Kill a Troll General inside the stronghold (safespottable) for a prison key.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Freeing prisoners Twig and Berry can be done by pickpocketing (30+ Thieving) or by killing them while they sleep.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Thrower trolls on the path must be passed by sprinting, using Protect from Missiles, or taking agility shortcuts.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Intermediate quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: Desert Treasure I, Devious Minds, Eadgar's Ruse, Monkey Madness II, Troll Romance.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: 15 Agility plus defeating Dad also gates access to the God Wars Dungeon (without Ghommal's hilt).

req_items.name: Climbing boots
req_items.note: or 12 coins to buy them from Tenzing along the route

summary: Rescue the tortugan Floopa, repair storm damage at the Great Conch, and hunt down a threatening gryphon.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Rescue and bandage the injured tortugan Floopa, then help the Great Conch's elders repair storm damage and investigate a gryphon threat.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Fight the level-235 Shellbane Gryphon at The Little Pearl using Protect from Melee/Ranged; its charge knockback (up to 65 damage) is blocked by standing near a tree or eggs, and whirlwinds require stepping off warned tiles.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Kill a level-95 gryphon found by tracking footprints from the market's central monument through a cave cleared of roots with an axe.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Repairing six structures around the Great Conch requires gathering a saw, hammer, 6 tortugan scutes, 10 jatoba logs chopped from jatoba trees, and 6 sea shells from the beach.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: A bandage for Floopa is made by combining seaweed with a palm leaf shaken from a palm tree.

summary: Help Prince Itzla round up six Knights of Varlamore to investigate a plot against his father Servius.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Prince Itzla round up six Knights of Varlamore scattered around Civitas illa Fortis to investigate a plot against his father Servius.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The six knights are found via a pickpocket hunt in the bazaar, a smuggling-crate search on the docks, a sparring fight against knight Mezan, and reuniting drunk Azali with her partner.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Fight off 8 cultists at the Teomat after a forged letter gets an innocent knight killed by Ennius Tullus.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Servius is mysteriously wounded during the cultist fight despite no cultist reaching him, foreshadowing the Twilight Emissaries' doomsday belief.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Intermediate quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: Perilous Moons, The Heart of Darkness.

req_items.name: Combat gear for two styles
req_items.note: or a single poisoned weapon, which is slower

summary: Cross a one-way dungeon west of Ardougne to destroy the demon Iban for King Lathas.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Cross a one-way dungeon west of Ardougne toward Tirannwn for King Lathas, destroying the demon Iban at his temple well.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Lighting an arrow with Koftik's cloth and tinderbox lets the player shoot a bridge guide-rope to cross the grid maze.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Collecting 4 light orbs to fuel a furnace requires avoiding wall traps and disarming a trap on the fourth orb.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Requires killing 3 paladins (safespottable) for badges, 3 demons for amulets, and Kalrag the spider (safespottable, ignores Protect from Melee) along the route.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Destroy Iban by repeatedly using the Doll of Iban on his temple well while enduring his unblockable spike attacks (~8 damage each).

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The dungeon is a one-way point of no return once entered, reversible only via a lever/rope pull; HP must stay above 15 while crossing the grid maze bridge.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Gates access to the Tirannwn/Elf lands questline infrastructure.

req_items.name: Non-poisoned metal-tipped arrows
req_items.note: 1-5 recommended; used to light and shoot the bridge guide-rope

summary: Help Ranulph and Isadora rebuild and decorate a totem damaged by local ents.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Ranulph and Isadora rebuild a totem damaged by local ents, then decorate it to unlock the Vale Totems Fletching minigame.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires laying a new totem base from chopped oak-or-better logs, then selecting carving options for a randomized set of spirit animals to decorate it.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Finishing the totem requires fletching 4 items, such as bows or shields, from the same wood type as the totem and using them on it.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: No combat is required.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Reward xp is not specified in the held source ("??").

req_items.name: Oak logs or better
req_items.note: obtainable during the quest by chopping nearby trees with an axe

req_items.name: Fletched items
req_items.note: same wood type as the logs, e.g. unstrung longbows or shields; obtainable during the quest

summary: Help Morgan defeat Count Draynor, the vampyre terrorising his family in Draynor Village.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help Morgan defeat Count Draynor, the vampyre terrorising his family in Draynor Village.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Beat the level-34 Count Draynor (safespottable, high healing); garlic weakens him and is strongly recommended.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The hammer and stake only need to be carried in the inventory, not actively used, during the fight.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Very short early quest.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Free-to-play quest with low requirements and no known deeper dependency chain.

req_items.name: Hammer
req_items.note: costs 1 coin at the general store north of the Blue Moon Inn

summary: Help the Watchtower Wizard investigate ogre unrest at Gu'Tanoth by gathering relics and elemental crystals.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Help the Watchtower Wizard investigate ogre unrest at Gu'Tanoth by gathering ogre relic pieces and elemental crystals.

facts.label: kills
facts.value: Kill the level-68 Gorad (safespottable) for a tooth needed to complete an ogre relic.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Must be able to run past level-111 blue dragons near the Ogre Enclave.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires solving a 4-cave skavid word-repeat puzzle using a skavid map obtained with a death rune, then using a gold bar to unlock the east gate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Brewing the magic ogre potion requires combining guam potion (unf), jangerberries, and ground bat bones, in that order.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The four elemental crystals must be returned to pillars matching their colours (NE magenta, SE grey, SW yellow, NW cyan) before pulling the final lever.

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: paid to guards to reach the Skavid caves

req_items.name: Pickaxe
req_items.note: used to mine the Rock of Dalgroth for a crystal

req_items.name: Dragon bones
req_items.note: given to Toban for a relic part

req_items.name: Guam potion (unf)
req_items.note: used in the magic ogre potion

req_items.name: Bat bones
req_items.note: ground for the magic ogre potion

req_items.name: Jangerberries
req_items.note: used in the magic ogre potion

req_items.name: Death rune
req_items.note: obtainable in-quest; used for the skavid map

summary: Retrieve Glarial's amulet and urn from her tomb for Almera to restore the Baxtorian Falls shrine.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Retrieve Glarial's amulet and urn from her tomb for Almera to restore the Baxtorian Falls shrine.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Glarial's Tomb bans all equipped gear; reaching it requires withstanding or evading level-86 Fire Giants and a level-84 Moss Guardian unarmed.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Requires banking everything except the pebble, food, and a teleport method before entering the tomb via Glarial's Tombstone.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Finishing requires placing one of each air/water/earth rune on 3 pillars, wearing the amulet at Glarial's statue to raise the ground, then pouring the urn into the chalice.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Glarial's pebble, obtained from Golrie in the Tree Gnome Village dungeon, is worth banking for the later quest Roving Elves.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Intermediate quest.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Required for: Desert Treasure I, Legends' Quest, Medium Kandarin Diary, Roving Elves, The Path of Glouphrie.

summary: Investigate Movario's schemes and infiltrate the Black Knights' Fortress while chasing the Stone of Jas.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Grandmaster Mahjarrat-storyline quest chasing the Stone of Jas: investigate Movario's schemes, rally old allies, and infiltrate the Black Knights' Fortress.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Infiltrating Movario's underground base requires solving a rune-symbol door puzzle, a bookcase-lever/wire maze, a trapped bed chest, and a weight/pressure-gauge puzzle.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Face Surok Magis (magic-only, 450hp, Vorkath-style attack rotation) atop the Black Knights' Fortress: bind/weaken his summoned warriors, telegrab-and-alch his explosive orbs, and counter his elemental surges with the opposite element.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Chasm of Tears requires collecting 4 elemental orbs from braziers, solving elemental-block puzzles in skull tunnels, and matching herblore-ingredient offerings (randomized per player) to 8 of 13 statues.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Final fight is the Balance Elemental (524hp, prayer-switches by attack style, drains stats every 3-4 hits, doubles up at 25% hp), followed by two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl can be cheesed by letting the Guardians finish them off from behind a pillar.

facts.label: difficulty
facts.value: Grandmaster-tier quest.

summary: The Achievement Diary spans 492 tasks across 12 regions x 4 tiers; each tier's rewards claim only after that tier and all preceding tiers are complete.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Tasks within a tier can be done out of order, but rewards claim from the region's own taskmaster only once every task in that tier and every preceding tier is complete.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Every tier claim always includes an antique lamp plus an equippable armour/cape piece, along with passive perks: xp-rate boosts, shop discounts, new teleport unlocks, and region access.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Completing every diary at every tier unlocks purchase of the achievement diary cape (99,000gp, Twiggy O'Korn, Draynor Village), which lets the quest point cape be trimmed cyan and is one of two requirements for the music cape's black trim.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The aggregate 'All requirements' tables list 'Acquire a prospector helmet from the Motherlode Mine' as an Additional-requirement checkbox for both the Hard tier and the Elite tier bundles, across every region -- only one prospector helmet piece is needed, not the full 4-piece set, but it is a literal cross-dependency on the Prospector kit unlock (unlockdb:prospector-kit).

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Other Hard/Elite aggregate gates include Warriors' Guild access (130 combined Attack+Strength or 99 in either), Wilderness God Wars Dungeon access, at least one god spell, and (Elite only) full completion of Chambers of Xeric, TzHaar Fight Cave, and all quests -- chaining the diary system to the raid/quest-cape burndown.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Travel-hub grant field is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: The Angler outfit (Fishing 34) comes from Fishing Trawler drops or Molch pearls; a hard requirement for a master clue, a combat achievement, minnow fishing.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Full set grants +2.5% Fishing xp on all Fishing activities except drift net fishing and deep sea trawling.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Hard functional requirement (not just an xp multiplier) for a master clue step, the 'Dress Like You Mean It' hard combat achievement, and access to minnow fishing.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Upgradeable to the spirit angler's outfit by trading each piece plus 1,200 spirit flakes (4,800 total) to Gita Prymes in the Ruins of Unkah, letting the outfit double as a tether rope when fighting Tempoross.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: The source page states the outfit is not worth farming purely for the xp bonus versus faster training methods (3-tick barbarian fishing at 65, 3-tick fly fishing/Tempoross-with-crystal-harpoon at 80); the break-even point is only worthwhile below roughly 66,129 xp/hour.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Marked hard specifically because of the minnow-fishing/clue-step/combat-achievement functional gates, which cannot be bypassed by training rate the way the xp bonus can.

req_items.name: outfit pieces (4x, via Fishing Trawler drop)
req_items.note: 1/12 chance per game of a not-yet-owned piece, requires contribution bar >=50 at game end; average ~48 games (~4h48m) for the full set

req_items.name: Molch pearls (alternate purchase path)
req_items.note: 100 per piece from Alry the Angler via aerial fishing; slower, not-recommended path, 20+ hours

summary: The Ardougne cloak (tier 1) is an unlimited teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, auto-granted on finishing the Easy Ardougne Diary.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Reward is claimed automatically on finishing the 10th (final) Easy Ardougne Diary task, with no separate NPC turn-in.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Higher Ardougne diary tiers (Medium/Hard/Elite) upgrade the same cloak to cloak 2/3/4, each adding further teleport destinations and passive perks; this row covers only the Easy-tier cloak 1 unlock.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Cited elsewhere in the KB as the closest teleport to the Ardougne herb patch (2667,3375), and as the cheapest, lowest-requirement route into the spirit-tree network via Ardougne Monastery -> Khazard Battlefield spirit tree, before 83 Farming makes the Farming Guild tree reachable.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Bundled with the rest of the Easy Ardougne Diary rewards (not cloak-specific): one antique lamp worth 2,500xp in any skill 30+, and double death runes plus auto-noted Jubster/Frogeel drops when trading cats to West Ardougne civilians.

summary: Barbarian Assault is a 5-player, 10-wave team minigame at the Barbarian Outpost with no skill or quest requirement beyond Captain Cain's tutorial.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: 5-player team minigame with attacker/defender/healer/collector roles across 10 waves; the whole team restarts a wave on any death or player leaving.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The Elite Kandarin Diary requires level-5 upgrades in all 4 roles, totalling 5,600 honour points (capped at 5,000 per role).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Honour points buy the Penance armour set (fighter hat/torso/skirt/gloves plus runner boots), each piece costing roughly 2,100 points across all 4 roles, plus 95,000gp and 7 Penance Queen kills for the granite body.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Points-gambling on honour points can yield a dragon chainbody or the Penance Queen pet at a 1/1000 chance on a high gamble.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The fighter torso is a cheap, no-stat-requirement Strength-bonus body slot upgrade, the minigame's headline item.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Reward xp is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: Blast Furnace at Keldagrim is the fastest bar-smelting method in the game, needing only started The Giant Dwarf; Smithing 60 waives the entry fee.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Entry costs 2,500 coins per 10 minutes, waived at Smithing 60, which also unlocks the nearby anvil.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: On a Blast Furnace themed world, dwarven workers auto-operate the furnace for 72,000 coins/hour paid into a shared coffer; non-themed worlds must be run manually and solo.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Keldagrim access requires only starting The Giant Dwarf, not completing it.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Steel bars smelt at 2,900-3,400 bars/hour (50,800-95,400 xp/hour with a coal bag); mithril bars reach up to 3,700 bars/hour (up to 111,000 xp/hour); rate scales by bar tier.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Its steel/mithril+ bar output feeds directly into cannonball and weapon/armour smithing chains elsewhere in progression.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Item and unlock rewards are unrecorded in the held text ('??').

req_items.name: ice gloves, smiths gloves (i), or a bucket of water

summary: The fairy ring network unlocks 55 of 64 A/B/C/D landing codes across most regions, requiring a 5-quest chain (plus a partial 6th) and an activator staff.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: The unlock is itself a multi-quest requisite chain (5 full quests plus Fairytale II partial completion, 'up to granted permission'), not a single flag.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Treated as the densest point-to-point travel web in the game and the default transport layer assumed by most other already-mined routes/guides (herb-patch runs, Chambers of Xeric access, Barrows, Mort Myre, penguin/Miscellania errands).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Hard dependency for a large share of downstream travel steps already contributed elsewhere in this KB (travel:ref-fairy-ring, bg:pps-03-withdraw-herb-run, travel:milestone-raids-cox).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Turns multi-region herb runs, raid access, and quest-hub travel from multi-minute walks/teleport-chains into a single 2-click ring dial.

req_items.name: Dramen staff or Lunar staff
req_items.note: waived if the player has completed the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary

summary: The Graceful outfit (260 marks of grace, bought piece by piece from Grace) grants -25kg weight and +30% run-energy restoration; no skill or quest hard-gate.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Marks of grace are earned by running rooftop Agility courses; best rate at Canifis (level 40, 16-18/hour, no level-over-20 penalty) or Ardougne (level 90, reaching 22/hour with the elite Ardougne diary).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Recolouring an already-owned full set costs only 90 marks total (15/piece) paid to Osten in Shayzien, distinct and cheaper than the 260-mark Grace purchase; do not conflate the two costs.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Sell-back refund on uncoloured pieces to Grace is 80% (208 marks).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Pure QoL multiplier; nothing else in the KB treats it as a hard prerequisite, but it compounds efficiency across later travel/training steps involving running.

summary: Guardians of the Rift at the Wizards' Tower requires Temple of the Eye and Runecraft 27, rewarding scaling RC xp plus talismans and Abyssal gear.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Primary high-level Runecraft trainer/gear source once Temple of the Eye is complete; the RC 27 entry gate is trivially met via the quest's own xp.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Runecraft xp equals Runecraft level times 45 per game on reaching 300+ combined elemental+catalytic energy gathered; up to 1,200 energy per game (1,320 with an abyssal lantern burning yew logs), capped at 1,000 per energy type.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Abyssal pearls buy Temple Supplies rewards including raiments of the eye (+60% runes, full set), ring of the elements, and the Blood talisman, which is exclusive to this minigame.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Abyssal needle merges essence pouches into a colossal pouch and needs Crafting 56 to use.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Grants the ring of the elements teleport network and the raiments of the eye passive Runecrafting rune-multiplier set.

summary: Hallowed Sepulchre in Darkmeyer is the premier late-game Agility trainer, gated Agility 52-92 by floor (unboostable), requiring Sins of the Father.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Unboostable per-floor Agility gates (52/62/72/82/92) mean it scales naturally alongside a player's Agility level rather than being a single unlock.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Coffin-looting is optional side content gated by its own skill checks: Thieving 66 (boostable), Construction 56 (boostable, for bridges), Prayer 54 (for braziers), Magic 7 (for portal frames), Ranged 62 (for pillars).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Recommended (not required): Hitpoints 70+ for survivability.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Hallowed marks from coffins buy Mysterious Hallowed Goods shop items: a lobby-teleport crystal shard, a token adding 1 minute per attempt, guaranteed obstacle-pass tools (grapple/focus/symbol/hammer for pillars/portals/braziers/bridges), a fail-safe teleport-back ring, Dark dye (recolours Graceful to Hallowed Graceful, 6 needed for a full set), and a bonus-loot-roll sack.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The only source of the Hallowed Graceful recolour, and grants a chance at the Giant squirrel Agility pet (improving from 1/35,000 on floor 1 up to 1/2,000 on floor 5).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Darkmeyer access requires Sins of the Father.

req_items.name: Saradomin-affiliated item
req_items.note: recommended, avoids run energy drain when using Magical Obelisks

summary: Kharedst's memoirs accrues Reminisce teleports to 5 Kourend cities as a side effect of 5 short quests, each page adding 20 stacking teleport charges.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: None of the 5 gating quests (Depths of Despair, Queen of Thieves, Tale of the Righteous, Forsaken Tower, Ascent of Arceuus) exist solely to earn a memoirs page -- all 5 are also direct requirements already contributed elsewhere for the Kourend & Kebos Medium diary and for A Kingdom Divided, so the teleport network accrues automatically without a dedicated grind/step needing scheduling.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Cannot teleport past level 20 Wilderness.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: After A Kingdom Divided the book auto-upgrades to the Book of the dead (reclaimed from Commander Fullore instead of Veos), which per an existing KB row also sets up a two-way transport to Shayziens' Wall from the Chambers of Xeric mountain via the Mountain Guide.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The book is a quest-item reward of Client of Kourend, reclaimable free from Veos (or Cabin Boy Herbert post-partial A Kingdom Divided) if lost, and retains charges through a destroy/reclaim cycle.

summary: Mahogany Homes is a repeatable Construction trainer (offices in Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne, Hosidius) gated by boostable Construction tiers up to 70.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Beginner tier needs only Construction 1; Novice 20, Adept 50, and Expert 70 unlock higher (boostable) contract tiers.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Construction xp per contract scales sharply by tier: Beginner 500 (512.5 with the carpenter's outfit), Novice 1,250, Adept 2,250, Expert 2,750 (2,818.7 with the outfit); experienced players complete roughly 50-60 contracts/hour with a plank sack plus efficient teleports/NPC Contact.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Carpenter points buy the Mahogany Homes Reward Shop: supply crates, Amy's saw, a 28-plank sack, Hosidius blueprints (unlocks the Hosidius Wall Kit), and the full Carpenter's outfit (further boosts contract xp).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The plank sack and Amy's saw are the priority early purchases since they most directly raise contracts/hour.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Full completion for the collection log requires 975 Expert contracts, a long-tail late-game grind.

req_items.name: regular/oak/teak/mahogany planks
req_items.note: depending on contract tier; nails not required

summary: Motherlode Mine in the Dwarven Mine is a low-intensity Mining 30 trainer and the only source of the coal bag, gem bag, and Prospector outfit.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: No quest requirement; upper floor access needs Mining 57 plus a one-time 100 golden nuggets.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: 60 Mining xp per ore vein (pay-dirt) mined, continuous low-intensity training; golden nuggets drop at 3.13% per pay-dirt cleaned (~1 every 32) regardless of Mining level.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Golden nuggets buy the Prospector outfit (helmet/jacket/legs/boots, each a small flat xp-boost %), the coal bag, the gem bag, upper floor access (100 nuggets, needs Mining 57), the Super Hopper (50 nuggets), and pay-dirt sack capacity 108->189 (200 nuggets).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The Prospector helmet is required for a hard Falador Diary task; the coal bag is a major Blast Furnace xp/gp multiplier, so this grind feeds directly into Blast Furnace efficiency.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Recommended purchase order is upper-floor and hopper unlocks first, then outfit pieces by xp-bonus-per-nugget, then sack capacity last.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: A full outfit plus upper level plus bag upgrades costs roughly 17,500 pay-dirt (Mining ~30 to ~68) to fund via nuggets alone.

summary: Nightmare Zone near Yanille is an AFK combat trainer needing any 5 completed quests from a long list, rewarding points for resources and exclusive potions.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Gate is shallow: any 5 completed quests from a long eligible list (e.g. The Grand Tree, Dragon Slayer I, Monkey Madness I, Desert Treasure I, Lost City, Tree Gnome Village, Vampyre Slayer, What Lies Below), not a fixed set, making it reachable early.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Historically the go-to AFK melee/ranged/magic combat trainer via a boss-rotation 'dream' using cannon and auto-retaliate.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: NMZ reward points buy Herblore-ingredient/rune resources (flax, sand, seaweed, runes, herb boxes capped at 15/day, scrolls of redirection), combat-stat upgrades, and minigame-exclusive potions (overload, absorption, super ranging/magic) drinkable from on-site barrels without delaying attacks.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Ironmen are restricted to scrolls-only on the resource tab of the reward shop.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The only source of Overload and Absorption potions, which are strong utility for other high-level PvM.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Raw combat xp/hr is unrecorded in the held text ('??'); the source page directs to its own Bosses/Playing sections for that number.

summary: Pest Control is a combat-level-gated (40/70/100) 5-25 player wave-defense minigame reached by boat from Port Sarim, rewarding Void Knight equipment and coin.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Entry gate is purely combat level (Novice 40 / Intermediate 70 / Veteran 100 lander); no skill or quest requirement.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Players must keep an 'activity bar' above 0% to earn points; points cannot be earned while a Dwarf multicannon or Alchemy spells are in use.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Commendation points (capped at 4,000 held) buy regular and elite Void Knight equipment, roughly 850-1,910 points per piece/set, plus coins per win equal to 10x current combat level.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Void Knight armour is a cheap, universal combat-bonus set with no stat requirements to wear, usable across melee/ranged/magic.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Commendation points can also be exchanged for Combat, Crafting, and Woodcutting xp.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Unlocks field is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: A player-owned house costs 1,000gp from an estate agent (or free via Daddy's Home); the focus of Construction and the game's best travel hub once built out.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Default location is Rimmington, relocatable to 8 cities for a fee at higher Construction.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: A fully-built portal chamber/nexus can hold teleports from every spellbook at once (no spellbook-switching needed); a fully-upgraded jewellery box gives unlimited ring of dueling/games necklace/skills necklace/combat bracelet/amulet of glory/ring of wealth teleports; the 75-Construction superior garden's spirit-tree-and-fairy-ring hotspot is the fastest single-tile access point to both transport networks at once.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Hard prerequisite for gaining Construction xp from three separate group minigames: repairing Wintertodt braziers, Tempoross totem poles and masts, and Vale Totem poles.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Also unlocks the ability to use experience lamps on Construction.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Later infrastructure (occult altar spellbook-swap, gilded altar prayer training at 3.5x with both incense burners lit, costume room bank-space relief, mounted glory in the quest hall) is gated behind first owning the house at all.

summary: The Prospector kit (180 golden nuggets, Motherlode Mine, Mining 30) grants +2.5% Mining xp full-set; a hidden Achievement Diary cross-dependency.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Prospector armour does not increase golden-nugget drop chance itself; buying the pricier pieces first is marginally more xp-efficient overall.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Per-piece Mining xp boost: helmet +0.4%, jacket +0.8%, legs +0.6%, boots +0.2%, plus a +0.5% set bonus for wearing all 4, totalling +2.5% on the full set.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The Achievement Diary system's aggregate 'All requirements' tables list 'Acquire a prospector helmet from the Motherlode Mine' as an Additional-requirement checkbox for both the Hard tier and Elite tier bundles across every region's diary -- only the helmet piece is needed, not the full 4-piece set, but it makes the kit a literal hard prerequisite baked into unlockdb:achievement-diary-system rather than a standalone cosmetic-xp buy.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Marked hard on the diary cross-dependency basis even though the xp-boost effect alone would only justify soft.

summary: Pyramid Plunder in Sophanem is a Thieving-only minigame (21 to start) scaling room access up to Thieving 91, rewarding the Pharaoh's sceptre.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Room tiers unlock via unboostable Thieving levels in +10 steps up to 91, scaling it as a Thieving-training destination through mid-to-late game rather than a one-time unlock.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: City access requires only starting Icthlarin's Little Helper, not completing it.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Artefacts (urns/chests/sarcophagi) sell for 50-1,250gp each or recharge a Pharaoh's sceptre.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Sceptre drop rate improves from 1/4,200 at Thieving 21-30 up to roughly 1/63.5 cumulative at Thieving 91+ per full run.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The Pharaoh's sceptre grants the Sophanem/Kalphite Cave/Menaphos/Nardah/Sophanem-Pyramid teleport network and can itself be used as a fast-entry item into this minigame once charged.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Raw xp/hr reward is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: Tempoross at the Ruins of Unkah has zero entry requirements and grants continuous Fishing xp plus a reward-pool shop scaled by Fishing level.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: No combat or skill level gates participation; base Fishing level only affects reward-pool loot quality at the time of searching (skill boosts don't count).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Fishing xp accrues continuously during the fight itself with no lump subdue bonus; the rate differs between the 'Not cooking' and 'Cooking' play styles.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Reward pool permits are earned at 1 per 2,000 points plus 1 per further 700 points, spent on spirit flakes, casket, soaked pages, fish barrel, tackle box, big harpoonfish, Tome of water, dragon harpoon, and the Tiny tempor pet.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The Tome of water (needs Magic 50 to wield, grants infinite water runes plus a spell damage/accuracy boost) and the fish barrel/tackle box storage items are exclusive to this reward pool.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Coordinates for the activity location and the unlocks field are unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: Volcanic Mine under the Fossil Island Volcano is a high-intensity Mining 50+ trainer where death or teleporting out forfeits the run's fragments and points.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: A riskier, more active alternative to AFK Mining spots; dying or teleporting out forfeits all fragments/points for that run.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Mining xp scales with level: roughly 40,000 xp/hour at Mining 50 (~7,200 points), rising to 85,000-95,000 xp/hour at Mining 99 (~15,400-17,200 points) with a good pickaxe and play, plus roughly 3.8 Mining xp granted per point at game end (3.895 with a prospector kit).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Ore fragments are kept even if not cashed for points; points are spent at Petrified Pete's Ore Shop, with runite ore fragments (unlocked at Mining 85) worth the most per point.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Also a source of numulite and Fossil Island fossils, useful for other Fossil Island unlocks (Fossil Storage, Ore Shop purchases).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Unlocks field is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

req_items.name: numulite
req_items.note: per entry; 3,000 one-time buys permanent access

summary: Wintertodt is an AFK-style Firemaking trainer at Doors of Dinh that also grants Woodcutting, Fletching, Construction, and Herblore xp as side effects.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: AFK-style Firemaking trainer with side xp in Woodcutting, Fletching, Construction, and Herblore during the same rotation.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Construction xp from fixing broken braziers requires the player to own a player-owned house (POH).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Reward Cart loot quality scales with the player's other skill levels (Herblore, Mining, Fishing, Crafting, Farming, Woodcutting); every 500 points guarantees one extra reward beyond the base two.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Firemaking xp on subdue equals character level times 100, requiring 500+ points; additional per-action xp accrues throughout the fight from lighting braziers, cutting/fletching bruma roots, feeding roots/kindling, and fixing braziers.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Unlocks reward is unrecorded in the held text ('??').

summary: Cape awarded for completing every released quest (miniquests excluded), bought for 99,000 coins from the Wise Old Man.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires completing all released quests (miniquests excluded) and paying 99,000 coins to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village, who also sells the matching quest point hood.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Grants unlimited teleport to the Legends' Guild gates, the second-closest teleport to a fairy ring after a player-owned house.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Players holding max quest points get every Nightmare Zone dream discounted 10,000 coins, independent of whether the cape is worn.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Performing the cape's emote is a required task for the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary and the Elite Falador Diary.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: A new quest release after obtaining the cape auto-unequips it; it cannot be re-equipped until the new quest is completed, is banked automatically if the inventory is full, and is lost (requiring re-purchase for 99,000 coins) if both inventory and bank are full at that moment.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The trimmed (cyan) version of the cape additionally requires the achievement diary cape (all diaries completed at all tiers).

req_items.name: Coins
req_items.note: paid to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village; also buys the matching quest point hood

summary: Outfit that doubles pickpocketing loot when worn, earned from Rogues' Den equipment crates.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Obtained from Rogue's equipment crates awarded for successfully opening wall safes at the end of the Rogues' Den minigame; pieces are untradeable, so wearing them effectively requires 50 Agility and 50 Thieving even though the minigame itself states no level gate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Each of the 5 pieces (mask, top, gloves, trousers, boots) adds a flat +15% chance to double an NPC's pickpocket loot, reaching 15/30/45/60% for 1-4 pieces; wearing all 5 jumps straight to a guaranteed 100% rather than a linear extrapolation.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Pieces are interchangeable -- any 5 of the 5 slots filled gives the same 100% bonus regardless of which pieces they are.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Does not affect chests, stalls, Pyramid Plunder, Hallowed Sepulchre, Underwater Agility and Thieving, or scroll-box drop rates; coin pouches and scroll boxes use a different doubling mechanic (chance at one extra pouch/coin value) instead of a flat double.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Since 1 June 2017 the crates let players choose which piece to receive, replacing a previously fixed acquisition order.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Storable in a player-owned house costume room armour case once owned.

req_items.name: Rogue's equipment crate
req_items.note: obtained from wall safes at the end of Rogues' Den; untradeable pieces effectively require 50 Agility and 50 Thieving to wear

summary: Teleport network unlocked after Tree Gnome Village, with permanent stops plus Farming-grown and POH tree access.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Unlocked by completing the Tree Gnome Village quest.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Provides 8 permanent stops: Tree Gnome Village, Tree Gnome Stronghold, Battlefield of Khazard, Grand Exchange, Feldip Hills, Poison Waste (partial, requires Path of Glouphrie), Prifddinas (requires Song of the Elves), and Laguna Aurorae (requires Pandemonium and 58 Sailing).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Also reachable via 5 Farming-grown spirit tree patches and a player-owned house superior garden tree at 75 Construction.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Tree Gnome Village is a single, cheap early quest compared to the fairy ring network's 5-quest chain, making the spirit tree network the first regional teleport web a fresh account can unlock.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Nothing else researched in this KB requires spirit-tree access, so it functions as a soft/optional accelerant rather than a hard dependency.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Fastest pre-83-Farming access methods per the source page: the Ardougne cloak to the Khazard Battlefield tree (zero cost, low requirements) or the Grand Exchange (via ring of wealth/teletab plus the medium Varrock Diary); the Achievement Diary Cape plus Elder Gnome child route is called faster than even the player-owned-house tree despite being farther on foot (no load screen).

summary: Amulet dropped by lizardmen that grants free teleports to four Kourend locations plus Chambers of Xeric after first use.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Obtained as a monster drop from lizardmen, lizardman brutes, or lizardman shamans at 1/250 (improved to 1/125 after the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary), or 1/300 stealing from stone chests in the Lizardman Temple beneath Molch; no quest or skill gate applies to the drop itself.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Grants 4 free teleports by default: Xeric's Lookout (southeast of Shayzien), Xeric's Glade (northeast of the Hosidius farm patch), Xeric's Inferno (at the Lovakengj lovakite furnace), and Xeric's Heart (Kourend Castle).

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: A 5th teleport, Xeric's Honour at the Chambers of Xeric summit on Mount Quidamortem, permanently unlocks only after using an Ancient tablet (a 1/10 drop from the post-raid Ancient chest) on the talisman.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Teleporting to Xeric's Heart via the talisman is a listed Hard-tier task of the Kourend & Kebos Diary.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Listed as one of three named routes into the Chambers of Xeric, alongside the Lovakengj Minecart and the fairy ring code BLS.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Nothing else researched in this KB requires possessing the talisman, since the Chambers of Xeric has alternate access routes.

req_items.name: Xeric's talisman (drop)
req_items.note: 1/250 from lizardmen/lizardman brutes/lizardman shamans (1/125 after the Kourend & Kebos easy diary), or 1/300 stealing stone chests in the Lizardman Temple beneath Molch

summary: Co-op minigame at Port Khazard where players defend a fishing trawler to earn fish, xp, and a chance at the Angler's outfit and Heron pet.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Co-op boat-defense minigame based at the Port Khazard docks (2669, 3161): players board Murphy's trawler and defend it for a 5-minute trawl (about 6.5 minutes total including docking and cutscenes).

facts.label: start
facts.value: Requires Fishing 15 only to catch fish and receive rewards; the minigame itself can be boarded and played at any Fishing level.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Players patch hull leaks with swamp paste, bail water with a bailing bucket, re-rope torn fishing nets, and fight off a kraken tentacle with an axe while a hammer repairs the rail damage it causes.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: The boat sinks if water gets too high before time runs out; forfeiting or sinking both eject the player onto the beach near fairy ring code DJP for 1-2 damage.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Reward is driven by a 0-255 contribution meter earned through 4 actions (bailing = 2 points, leak repair = 5 points, net repair = 7 points, kraken chop = 10 points, rail fix = 10 points); 50+ points are needed to search the post-voyage net for fish, xp, and an angler-piece roll, and the meter never depletes.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Fishing xp comes from the post-voyage net search, scaled by fish received; small Construction, Crafting, and Woodcutting xp (5xp per successful action) come from repairing leaks, nets, and kraken rail damage during the trip, with the Construction xp specifically requiring an owned player-owned house.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The Angler's outfit (hat, top, waders, boots) drops at 1/12 per unowned piece per successful trip once 50+ contribution is reached, the fastest known method to obtain it; the Heron pet drops at 1/5000 base, improving up to 1/2500 with a full 255-point contribution meter.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: A full 255-point contribution meter doubles fish yield and heron odds but does not increase angler-piece odds past the 50-point threshold.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Starting a voyage is an Ardougne Diary Easy task; catching and cooking a manta ray in Port Khazard is an Ardougne Diary Elite task.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Solo play yields more fish and xp per trip since server load is spread over fewer players, but official co-op worlds are the relaxed, faster route to the angler outfit.
