summary: Chambers of Xeric (Raids 1) is a 1-100 player scaling PvM+skilling raid beneath Mount Quidamortem with no hard entry gate, loot driven by team points banked.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: OSRS's first raid: a scaling 1-100 player PvM+skilling raid with no required quest or skill level, procedurally laid out from a pool of resource/puzzle/boss rooms culminating in the Great Olm.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Reward quality is driven entirely by team points banked during the run (combat kills + skilling actions), not by a fixed completion bonus.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No lump completion xp; Combat, Mining, Woodcutting, Herblore, Farming, Hunter, Cooking, Fishing, Thieving, Firemaking and Agility xp all accrue naturally from the resource-gathering and combat actions performed to build points.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Ancient Chest unique table rolls at 1% chance per 8,676 team points (capped 65.7% per roll, up to 6 rolls/raid): Twisted bow (2/69), Kodai insignia (2/69), Elder maul (2/69), Dragon claws (3/69), Ancestral hat/robe top/robe bottom (3/69 each), Dinh's bulwark (3/69), Dragon hunter crossbow (4/69), Twisted buckler (4/69), Dexterous/Arcane prayer scroll (20/69 each).

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Xerician cape accolades unlock from Captain Rimor at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Challenge Mode completions (Xeric's guard/warrior/sentinel/general/champion); an ancient tablet reward unlocks a direct Xeric's talisman teleport to the mountain.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Challenge Mode is a harder fixed-layout variant and the only route to the cosmetic ancestral colour kit; it counts separately toward the Xerician cape ladder.

summary: Theatre of Blood (Raids 2) is a fixed 1-5 player raid beneath Ver Sinhaza needing only Priest in Peril, with per-player loot from up to 5 chests.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: A fixed 1-5 player raid (unlike Chambers of Xeric's scaling layout), with the lowest entry bar of the three raids: no combat/skill level is enforced, only Priest in Peril for Morytania access.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Loot is per-player (up to 5 large chests spawn, one per party member) rather than team-pooled; a unique roll glows the chest purple, the same signal as Chambers of Xeric's beam.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No direct completion xp beyond normal combat xp from killing the room bosses.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Monumental Chest common table rolls 3 times if no unique, plus a unique-roll chance per player per completion: Avernic defender hilt, Justiciar faceguard/chestguard/legguards, Ghrazi rapier, Sanguinesti staff, Scythe of vitur, plus Vials of blood as a common uniques-adjacent drop (charges Scythe of Vitur, makes bastion/battlemage potions).

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Sinhaza shroud tiers 1-5 unlock from the Mysterious Stranger at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Normal/Hard Mode completions.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Hard Mode is a separate, harder scaled variant of the same room sequence rather than a distinct raid.

summary: Tombs of Amascut (Raids 3) is a scalable-difficulty 1-8 player raid in the Jaltevas Pyramid necropolis, requiring Beneath Cursed Sands.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Up to 8 players per party, the largest of the three raids, set in the Jaltevas Pyramid necropolis in the Kharidian Desert.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Beneath Cursed Sands is a hard requirement to enter.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Players tune raid difficulty/length pre-entry with an Invocation system that toggles modifier tiers, scaling both danger and the raid-level number used for loot-table weighting -- difficulty is a player-selected point on a curve rather than a single fixed tier like Chambers of Xeric/Theatre of Blood.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No direct completion xp beyond normal combat xp from the four path bosses and the Wardens.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Sarcophagus allows one unique roll max per raid (else 3 common-table rolls): Masori mask/body/chaps, Lightbearer, Osmumten's fang, Elidinis' ward, Tumeken's shadow; independent tertiary rolls for Thread of elidinis, keris partisan jewels (Breach of the scarab, Eye of the corruptor, Jewel of the sun, Jewel of amascut) and the Tumeken's guardian pet; under 1,500 points yields fossilised dung instead.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Icthlarin's shroud tiers 1-5 (tier 5 also grants Icthlarin's hood) unlock from a lobby chest at 100/500/1000/1500/2000 Normal/Expert Mode completions.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: A post-raid Raid Summary interface hands out flavour titles based on performance stats, purely cosmetic with no mechanical reward attached.

summary: Fight Caves is a solo 63-wave combat gauntlet in Mor Ul Rek with no entry requirement, ending in TzTok-Jad and rewarding the fire cape.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Solo 63-wave combat gauntlet with zero entry requirements (no quest, no level, open from level 1), culminating in the level-702 TzTok-Jad.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: No restocking mid-run and only one life, barring the Elite Karamja Diary's one free daily resurrection inside the Fight Caves.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: 8,032 Tokkul on defeating TzTok-Jad plus 2 additional Tokkul per wave cleared (running total N*(N+1) for N waves), with a further 4,000 Tokkul bonus for the Jad kill itself.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: 1/200 chance of the TzRek-jad pet on the Jad kill (1/100 on a Slayer task), plus a second independent 1/200 roll if a spare fire cape is exchanged with TzHaar-Mej-Jal afterward.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Fire cape (untradeable) drops on defeating TzTok-Jad -- the sole entry ticket into the Inferno.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: The Elite Karamja Diary doubles Tokkul earned here and grants one free resurrection per day inside the Fight Caves.

req_items.name: combat gear and prayer supplies (for level-360 Ket-Zek and level-702 TzTok-Jad)

summary: Inferno is a solo 69-wave gauntlet against TzKal-Zuk in Mor Ul Rek, entered by sacrificing a fire cape, rewarding the infernal cape.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Solo 69-wave gauntlet in the same TzHaar volcano complex as the Fight Caves, entered by handing a fire cape to TzHaar-Ket-Keh; no requirement beyond that sacrifice.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: A death sends the player all the way back to wave 1 with no checkpoint or restock; the run can only be paused, not saved, by logging out between waves; purple sweets are disabled inside.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Tokkul scales to the wave reached, 16,440 max, doubled with the Elite Karamja Diary.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: 1/100 chance of the Jal-nib-rek pet on defeating TzKal-Zuk (1/75 on a Slayer task), plus a second independent 1/100 roll by exchanging a spare infernal cape with TzHaar-Ket-Keh afterward.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Infernal cape (untradeable) drops on defeating TzKal-Zuk -- described by the wiki's cited Jagex quote as the strict best melee cape in the game.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: A defeated TzKal-Zuk can later be assigned as a Slayer task, applying to all Inferno monsters on that task.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Restricted to unrestricted worlds only since 2018 to stop free unlimited practice, later loosened again from 2021.

req_items.name: fire cape
req_items.note: one-time entry fee, consumed by TzHaar-Ket-Keh

req_items.name: top-tier combat gear and prayer supplies (for the 69-wave gauntlet and the level-1400 TzKal-Zuk)

summary: Fortis Colosseum is a solo 12-wave gauntlet east of Civitas illa Fortis with a bank-or-push-your-luck loot mechanic, requiring Children of the Sun.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Solo 12-wave combat gauntlet (2024, Varlamore: Part One), structurally like the Fight Caves/Inferno but with a bank-or-push-your-luck loot mechanic instead of a single end-of-run roll.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Children of the Sun is required for all of Varlamore, including the Colosseum.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Players choose each wave whether to bank current+next-wave loot or press on for better odds; any death, teleport, or logout forfeits everything unbanked.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: All accumulated wave loot is lost on death/teleport/logout mid-run.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Unique rolls open from wave 4 onward with rising odds: Sunfire fanatic helm/cuirass/chausses, Tonalztics of ralos (wave 7+ only), Echo crystal (combines with guardian boots into echo boots), plus Sunfire splinters as a common uniques-adjacent drop.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Dizana's quiver and the Smol heredit pet are guaranteed on beating Sol Heredit in wave 12.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Glory-tier citizen perks unlock at 2,000/5,000/8,000/12,000/16,000/20,000 personal-best Glory: Colosseum bank chest access, Civitas illa Fortis as respawn point, Oriana buying valuables at 65gp each, ring of dueling teleport to the Colosseum, disease-free Outer Fortis herb patch, and the Fortis Salute emote.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Glory (the performance score from clearing waves) is a personal-best ladder, not an accumulating currency.

req_items.name: combat gear and prayer supplies (for the 12 waves and final boss Sol Heredit)

summary: Utility/combat-support spellbook unlocked via Lunar Diplomacy (Magic 65, Defence 40 to cast), expanded after Dream Mentor and the Hard Fremennik Diary.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Lunar spellbook is a utility/combat-support spellbook that uses every rune type except wrath, offering teleports, item-creation spells (such as Superglass Make and Tan Leather), and stat-restore/boost spells.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing Dream Mentor unlocks a larger Lunar spell set, and the Hard Fremennik Diary unlocks two further Lunar spells.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The 65 Magic / 40 Defence casting requirement can remain unmet even after Lunar Diplomacy is completed, if the quest was finished via a Fremennik quest lamp or if Magic/Defence experience was lost on death in an old Deadman Mode season.

summary: Arceuus spellbook is a necromancy/prayer/demon-slaying combat-utility spellbook with no unlock requirement; A Kingdom Divided adds 24 more spells.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Arceuus spellbook is a combat/utility spellbook (a mix, like the standard spellbook) focused on necromancy, prayer support, demon-slaying, and combat augmentation, using mostly blood/nature/soul runes for reanimation, offering, and death-location teleport spells.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Base Arceuus spellbook access has no skill, quest, or item requirement -- speak to Tyss at the Dark Altar north of Arceuus (reachable via fairy ring code CIS, a games necklace to Wintertodt Camp then travel, or an Arceuus Library Teleport POH portal) to swap in immediately.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: 80 Construction lets a player build a dark altar in their POH Achievement Gallery, letting them swap spellbooks without traveling.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: A Kingdom Divided unlocks 24 further combat/utility spells beyond the base Arceuus spell set.

summary: D&D built on rare champion's scroll drops, redeemed to fight that race's champion in the Champions' Guild basement for xp and a cosmetic cape.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Distraction and Diversion built around an extremely rare (1/5,000) champion's scroll drop from a race's regular monsters, redeemable to fight that race's champion.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Entered via a trapdoor to the Champions' Guild basement in Misthalin; players cannot teleport out, only exit through the portcullis then up the ladder.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Only 1 of the 6 'Champions of Champions' seated in the arena (the human, Leon d'Cour) is actually fightable; the other 5 (Dwarf/TzHaar/Werewolf/Elf/Gnome) are lore-only NPCs.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Hitpoints and Slayer xp per champion defeated ranges from 160 (Imp) up to 592 (Lesser Demon) and 492 (Leon d'Cour); a Champion's lamp claimable after each win grants 10x that xp again; total is 40,348 combined Hitpoints+Slayer xp from all 11 champions plus all 11 lamps.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: No tradeable item drops -- purely an xp and cosmetic activity.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: A banner is hung on the Champions' Guild basement wall per defeated champion; the cosmetic (no stat bonus) champion's cape is granted from Leon d'Cour after all 11 champions are defeated.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Scrolls survive death (recoverable from the player's gravestone) but are lost once the corresponding champion is beaten; each champion enforces its own combat-style/gear restriction, so full completion requires 11 different loadouts across melee/range/magic/no-armour/no-prayer builds.

req_items.name: 32+ quest points
req_items.note: eligibility to receive champion's scrolls from monster drops at all

req_items.name: combat gear appropriate to the champion being fought
req_items.note: must respect that champion's rule restrictions (e.g. melee-only, no prayer, no armour)

summary: Harder Gauntlet mode: shorter prep, Corrupted-tier monsters/items, 1000 HP Hunllef, guaranteed Gauntlet cape.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Harder mode of the Gauntlet using the same procedurally-generated dungeon shell, with shorter prep time and Corrupted-tier monsters and items.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires completing the regular Gauntlet at least once as a progression gate before this variant becomes accessible.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Entered via the same Gauntlet Portal in north-western Prifddinas, offered as a harder mode after first clearing the regular Gauntlet; requires Song of the Elves for Prifddinas access.

facts.label: length
facts.value: Preparation time is 7:30, versus 10:00 for the regular Gauntlet.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Boss is the Corrupted Hunllef with 1000 HP.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The Corrupted Hunllef's max hit scales down by the summed armour tier worn (0/3/6/9) while the correct protection prayer is active, so crafted Corrupted armour materially affects survivability.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: The inner 3x3 ring around the boss room drops its usual resource-randomness mitigation, except one room with guaranteed 3 fishing spots.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No direct completion xp bonus; skilling actions during preparation grant normal skill xp, same as the regular Gauntlet.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Rewards: three upgraded Reward Chest rolls plus 7-12 crystal shards every completion, plus a higher-odds unique roll: crystal armour seed (1/50), crystal weapon seed (1/50), enhanced crystal weapon seed (1/400), or Youngllef pet (1/800); the Gauntlet cape is a guaranteed drop every completion.

summary: Solo procedural Prifddinas dungeon: gather resources to craft gear, then fight the Crystalline Hunllef for chest rolls and crystal seeds.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Solo procedurally-generated dungeon: players enter with no items and gather resource nodes to craft weapons, armour, food and potions before fighting a boss.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Boss is the Crystalline Hunllef, fought in a timed encounter after the preparation phase.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Entered via the Gauntlet Portal in north-western Prifddinas; requires Song of the Elves for Prifddinas access.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: All items are auto-banked and boosts stripped on entry; gear must be gathered and crafted inside the dungeon.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: No direct completion xp bonus; skilling actions during preparation (Mining/Woodcutting/Fishing/Herblore/Smithing/Cooking) grant normal skill xp.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Completing the Gauntlet once unlocks the ability to attempt the harder Corrupted Gauntlet variant.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Rewards: two Reward Chest common-table rolls plus crystal shards every completion, plus a unique roll: crystal armour seed (1/120), crystal weapon seed (1/120), enhanced crystal weapon seed (1/2000, upgrades to Blade of Saeldor/Bow of Faerdhinen), or the Youngllef pet (1/2000).

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Dangerous minigame: hardcore ironmen lose HC status and ultimate ironmen can lose instanced-bank items on death here.

summary: Smithing minigame: forge giant-sized commissions for Kovac via metal blend, mould choice, and a heat/hammer minigame for Smithing xp and rep.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Smithing minigame: players fulfil giant-sized weapon commissions for Kovac by choosing a metal blend and preform mould, then a heat/hammer minigame to maximise sword quality.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Located in a cave beneath the Giants' Plateau at the Kharidian Desert edge; requires the Sleeping Giants quest to participate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: No Smithing level is directly enforced by the activity itself, but the Sleeping Giants entry quest has its own Smithing requirement, so the activity is gated by that quest's prerequisites.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Smithing xp is granted per sword forged, scaled by final quality (metal score + mould score, minus 5 per mistake).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Gold payout per sword equals double the Smithing xp reward; certain bar choices can make forging net-profitable at high quality.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Foundry Reputation is earned 1:1 with final quality, spendable on extra moulds per preform section or in the Reward Shop for items like Double ammo mould (2,000 rep, needs Dwarf Cannon quest), Kovac's grog (300), Smithing catalyst (15), Ore pack (200), Smiths tunic/trousers (4,000 each), Smiths boots/gloves (3,500 each), or the Colossal blade (5,000).

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Unlocks beyond the Reward Shop list are unknown ("??") -- not stated in the held source text.

req_items.name: metal bars (or metal equipment worth at least 2 bars)
bucket
req_items.note: obtainable on-site, or use Ice gloves to lift moulded weapons

req_items.name: Ice gloves
req_items.note: alternative to bucket for lifting moulded weapons

summary: F2P-eligible D&D: a star crashes roughly every 90 minutes per server at a random site; mine it for idle-friendly Mining xp and stardust.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Free-to-play-eligible Distraction and Diversion: a star crashes roughly every 90 minutes (+/-15) per server at a random landing site, and players mine it for Mining xp and stardust.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Landing sites span nearly every major region (Asgarnia, Crandor/Karamja, Feldip Hills/Isle of Souls, Fossil Island/Mos Le'Harmless, Fremennik Lands/Lunar Isle, Great Kourend, Kandarin, Kebos Lowlands, Kharidian Desert, Misthalin, Morytania, Piscatoris/Gnome Stronghold, Tirannwn, Varlamore, Wilderness).

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: F2P players get half xp and no shop access; roughly 30,000 xp/hour achievable at 90+ Mining with a dragon pickaxe.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Stardust is spent at Dusuri's Star Shop by the Mining Guild entrance in Falador on: celestial ring uncharged (1600 buy/2000 sell), star fragment (2400/3000), bag full of gems -stardust variant- (240/300), soft clay pack -stardust variant- (120/150).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: A player-owned house telescope narrows the search window (better wood tier = tighter window), and the in-game Shooting Stars grouping chat crowdsources sightings; without one, discovery is essentially luck-of-passing-by.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Exact coordinates are unknown ("??") since landing sites are randomized across a fixed pool.

req_items.name: telescope (POH study room)
req_items.note: locates the next star; oak=24min window, teak=9min, mahogany=2min

summary: Skilling boss beneath Prifddinas: mine/smith/runecraft to strip Zalcano's armour, then finish her with a pickaxe for Mining xp or drops.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Skilling boss encounter: Zalcano is immune to normal damage, so players mine ore, smith it, and runecraft it into imbued tephra to strip her stone armour before finishing her with a pickaxe.

facts.label: boss
facts.value: Boss is Zalcano, located in volcanic caverns beneath Prifddinas.

facts.label: start
facts.value: Reached via the teleport platform west of the south-eastern Prifddinas bank, teleport crystal/eternal teleport crystal, spirit tree, or a POH teleport with a Prifddinas house; requires Song of the Elves for Prifddinas access plus 70 Mining and 70 Smithing.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: All of Zalcano's own attacks are typeless, so prayer cannot reduce them.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Must do at least 5 damage to her shield to be loot-eligible at all, and 31 combined damage to be eligible for uniques/pet; the MVP (top damage) gets a bonus 10% of their own non-unique loot.

facts.label: xp-note
facts.value: Players choose Mining xp or item drops (ask Rhiannon to switch); xp scales with contribution points and is boosted by the Prospector kit, while the unique/pet roll happens regardless of mode chosen.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Guaranteed 1-3 crystal shards plus infernal ashes (MVP-only) every eligible kill; main/tertiary drop tables include runes, noted ore/bar/gem materials, and a tertiary-only 1/200 roll for the crystal tool seed table, Zalcano shard (1/750-1/1500 by contribution), or the Smolcano pet (flat 1/2250).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Effectively a group activity even though solo-eligible, since ironmen need to join others' instances to receive rewards.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Unlocks from this activity are unknown ("??") -- not stated in the held source text.

summary: One-handed slash weapon at fast dagger/scimitar speed; requires 70 Attack, gathered from 85 Slayer abyssal demons or Abyssal Sire unsired drops.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: One-handed slash melee weapon at the fast 2.4s/hit speed of daggers and scimitars.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 70 Attack to wield.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Requires 85 Slayer to damage abyssal demons, its main drop source (no active-task requirement stated on the demon's own page).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Attaching a kraken tentacle (a Kraken-boss drop) upgrades it into an abyssal tentacle (75 Attack, +8 slash/+4 Strength bonus), consuming the whip.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Gather, not buy: dropped by abyssal demons (Slayer Tower, Catacombs of Kourend, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave, 85 Slayer), or via the Abyssal Sire boss (87 Slayer) unsired-drop sacrifice for a chance among several possible melee items.

facts.label: hazard
facts.value: Abyssal demons can teleport themselves or the player mid-fight (breaks safespotting, up to 20 tiles), so Auto Retaliate or a teleport anchoring scroll helps maintain uptime.

summary: Combat-heavy alternate spellbook (16 combat spells, 9 teleports); requires 50 Magic and Desert Treasure I completion, swapped in at the pyramid altar.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Combat-heavy alternate spellbook (16 combat spells, 9 teleports) using expensive runes like death and blood.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 50 Magic minimum to cast any Ancient Magicks spell (Desert Treasure I's own requirement plus prerequisite-quest xp), and completion of Desert Treasure I.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Desert Treasure I is a master-tier quest chain (The Dig Site, Temple of Ikov, The Tourist Trap, Troll Stronghold, Death Plateau, Priest in Peril, Waterfall Quest); already fully detailed under questdb:desert-treasure-i in this KB.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Swapped in at the pyramid's altar after finishing the quest; the pyramid's back-door shortcut also unlocks after the first run.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Includes some of the strongest combat spells in the game and is especially popular in PvP.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: The same quest also grants the ring of visibility, the ability to buy an ancient staff from Eblis for 80,000 coins, and access to the Smoke Dungeon.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The equipment slot for this spellbook is unknown/not applicable ("??") in the held source -- spellbooks don't occupy an equipment slot.

summary: Ranged weapon firing up to dragon bolts, 8-tile range; 70 Ranged, drop-only from Commander Zilyana in the God Wars Dungeon.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Ranged weapon firing up to dragon bolts with an 8-tile attack range (10 with longrange); counts as an Armadyl item in the God Wars Dungeon.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 70 Ranged to wield.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Drop-only, and only from Commander Zilyana in the God Wars Dungeon -- a single-boss gate with no crafting/purchase alternative.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Can later be upgraded (with a nihil horn and 250 nihil shards) into the Zaryte crossbow.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Same GWD entry caveat as bandos-chestplate: no quest needed to enter the dungeon itself, but reaching Zilyana's chamber past guards is a kill-count mechanic, left "??" here.

summary: Bandos set body armour, +4 Strength, never degrades; 65 Defence, drop-only from General Graardor in the God Wars Dungeon.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Part of the Bandos armour set; +4 Strength bonus with better defensive bonuses than the fighter torso or inquisitor's hauberk, and never degrades.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 65 Defence to wear.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Drop-only from General Graardor and his bodyguards in the God Wars Dungeon (Troll Country).

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Doesn't interfere with Ava's devices despite its metal appearance.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Death Plateau is only required for Slayer-task assignments in the God Wars Dungeon per the dungeon's own page, not for direct farming, so no quest gates entry; reaching Graardor's inner chamber past the outer guards is a mechanical kill-count gate rather than a skill/quest/item one, left "??" pending a travel:/minigame-style row for that mechanic specifically.

summary: Strength-bonus ring, no level gate; drop-only from Dagannoth Rex in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon, imbuing doubles its bonuses.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: One of the few rings that gives a Strength bonus rather than pure accuracy, raising max hit.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Drop-only from Dagannoth Rex, one of the three Dagannoth Kings deep in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon (boat from Rellekka, then descend the dungeon's sublevels to the boss room); the dungeon's own page states no formal quest gate.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Imbuing it (berserker ring (i), via Nightmare Zone points, Combat Achievements, Soul Wars Zeal Tokens, or an Emir's Arena scroll of imbuing) doubles its bonuses.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Group Ironmen without individual prestige need at least one personal Rex kill before the ring can be worn.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: Exact sublevel routing/travel time to Rex is unknown ("??") here, belonging to a travel: row.

summary: Melee boots, third-highest Strength bonus of any boots; 60 Defence, drop-only, exact source monster(s) unknown from held text.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Melee boots with the third-highest Strength bonus of any boots plus strong defensive bonuses.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 60 Defence to wear.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Drop-only, and like all dragon equipment cannot be smithed from raw materials.

facts.label: caveat
facts.value: The exact source monster(s) are unknown ("??"): the item page's Item sources section transcludes a dynamic drop-table template that does not render through wikitext fetch, and its lead text names no specific source monster -- King black dragon, Mithril dragon, Brutal black dragon, and the general Rare drop table's weapons/armour drop lists were checked directly and none list dragon boots.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Affordable relative to other dragon-tier gear, so they typically remain the feet-slot pick even after other dragon armour is replaced with higher tiers.

summary: Strongest scimitar in the game; 60 Attack, bought from Daga on Ape Atoll for 100,000 coins after Monkey Madness I, or a rare boss drop.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Strongest scimitar in the game; fast 4-tick slash weapon and a definitive early-mid melee power spike.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 60 Attack to wield and completion of Monkey Madness I.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: As dragon equipment it cannot be smithed.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Earn, not GE: buy from Daga on Ape Atoll for 100,000 coins after Monkey Madness I (must be in monkey form via greegree unless Monkey Madness II is also done, or King Awowogei was freed via Recipe for Disaster to reach Marim by boat).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Alternatively obtained as a rare drop from the Wilderness boss Scorpia or the Zombie Pirate's Locker, bypassing the quest/purchase route entirely.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: The Arkan blade (The Final Dawn quest reward) is a near-identical free alternative.

summary: Fast one-handed shortbow firing up to amethyst arrows with a special attack; 50 Ranged, fletched at 80 Fletching from magic logs and a bow string.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Fast one-handed shortbow firing up to amethyst arrows with its own special attack.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 50 Ranged to wield and 80 Fletching to craft (boostable).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Fletch from gathered magic logs (75 Woodcutting to cut) into a magic shortbow (u) at 80 Fletching, then string with a bow string spun from flax via Crafting.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Alternatively obtainable as a rare drop from spiritual rangers or from hard clue scroll caskets.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Imbuing it (magic shortbow scroll) raises ranged attack bonus to +75 and halves the special-attack energy cost.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: The strongest ranged weapon commonly available to mid-level players, a Slayer-task staple, and popular in PvP for stacking a knockout hit alongside melee.

summary: The only neck slot with +5% Magic damage; 70 Magic, drop-only from smoke devils/thermonuclear smoke devil while on an assigned 93 Slayer task.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: The only neck-slot item that grants +5% Magic damage.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 70 Magic to wear.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Requires 93 Slayer to damage smoke devils, and an active Slayer task on them.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Drop-only from smoke devils or the thermonuclear smoke devil boss in the Smoke Devil Dungeon, and only obtainable while on an assigned Slayer task at 93 Slayer -- cannot be off-task farmed; no purchase route exists.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Stacks with sources like the staff of the dead or an imbued slayer helmet; standard choice for most Magic combat setups below the 3rd age amulet.

req_items.name: slayer helmet, slayer helmet (i), or facemask
req_items.note: needed to safely fight smoke devils

summary: One-handed crossbow firing up to runite bolts; 61 Ranged, fletched at 69 Fletching from yew stock, runite limbs, and a crossbow string.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: One-handed crossbow firing up to runite bolts.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 61 Ranged to wield and 69 Fletching to craft from raw materials (boostable).

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Fletch from gathered materials: cut a yew log into a yew stock (50 Fletching xp), attach runite limbs with a hammer (100 xp) for an unstrung crossbow, then string it with a crossbow string (50 xp), 200 xp total.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: As an ironman, the level requirement can be skipped entirely by farming the crazy archaeologist, who reliably drops a finished rune crossbow.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Crafting the whole chain within Witchaven/Yanille counts toward the elite Ardougne Diary.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Pairs with a shield or god book for extra defensive bonuses, a common Slayer/TzHaar Fight Cave choice for players who want a shield slot rather than a two-handed bow.

summary: Two-handed line-hit slash weapon; 80 Attack/90 Strength, a Theatre of Blood unique charged with gathered vials of blood and blood runes.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Two-handed slash weapon that hits all targets in a line, extremely powerful against large/multi-target monsters.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 80 Attack and 90 Strength to wield.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Requires the Priest in Peril quest, the raid's only hard requirement, for Morytania access.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Rare unique drop from Verzik Vitur's treasure vault at the end of the Theatre of Blood raid, dropping uncharged.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Charging it (+20 stab/crush, +50 slash attack, +4 slash/+10 crush defence, +25 Strength bonus) is what makes it viable -- uncharged it is drastically weaker.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Charging uses vials of blood and blood runes deposited at the vyre well next to the bank in Ver Sinhaza (or, after Sins of the Father, the one in Darkmeyer); uncharging at a well returns the runes/vials, but an unprotected PvP death loses all charges with no refund.

req_items.name: vial of blood
req_items.note: per 100 charges, up to 20,000 charges total; added at a vyre well in Ver Sinhaza/Darkmeyer

req_items.name: blood runes
req_items.note: per 100 charges, up to 20,000 charges total; added at a vyre well in Ver Sinhaza/Darkmeyer

summary: Ranged weapon with venom-on-hit; 75 Ranged, fletched at 78 Fletching from a tanzanite fang, charged with Zulrah's scales, both from killing Zulrah.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Ranged weapon with a 5-tile attack range (7 with longrange), 3-tick attack speed vs monsters, and a 25% chance to venom on hit (100% vs NPCs when paired with a serpentine helm).

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 75 Ranged to wield and 78 Fletching to craft from a tanzanite fang (boostable).

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Requires the Regicide quest, needed for every fast-travel route to Zulrah's Shrine.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Both raw materials -- the tanzanite fang used to fletch the empty blowpipe (chisel + 78 Fletching), and the Zulrah's scales used to charge it (up to 16,383 per charge) -- come only from killing Zulrah.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Charges and darts both survive death if the blowpipe is protected, making it a strong Wilderness/Revenant Caves ranged option; effectively self-sustaining once a player farms their own Zulrah kills for scales.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Zulrah's Shrine is reachable by charter ship to Port Tyras, fairy ring code BJS plus a 76-Agility stepping-stone crossing, or a Zul-andra teleport scroll, but all three routes require completing Regicide first.

req_items.name: Zulrah's scales
req_items.note: Zulrah drop, used to charge it, up to 16,383 per charge load

summary: One-handed powered Magic staff with a built-in attack spell; 75 Magic, charged with gathered death/chaos/fire runes and coins, dropped by krakens.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: One-handed powered staff with a built-in attack spell usable regardless of the equipped spellbook.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 75 Magic to wield/charge.

facts.label: required-for
facts.value: Requires 87 Slayer to fight cave krakens/the Kraken boss (task-only), and 50 Magic since melee/Ranged only deal 1/7 damage to it.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Task-only drop: cave krakens (87 Slayer, must be an active assigned task) drop the uncharged trident, and the Kraken boss variant can drop it fully charged already.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Charge it with gathered death/chaos/fire runes plus coins; uncharging recovers the runes but any coins spent are permanently lost.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Frees the spellbook for teleports/utility during Magic combat; a core mid-tier Magic weapon before the sanguinesti staff or harmonised nightmare staff.

req_items.name: coins
req_items.note: per charge; up to 2,500 charges total

summary: Two-handed bow with 10-tile range that scales against high-Magic targets; 85 Ranged, a raid-points-weighted unique from Chambers of Xeric.

facts.label: overview
facts.value: Ranged bow firing any arrow up to dragon arrows with a fixed 10-tile attack range.

facts.label: unlock
facts.value: Requires 85 Ranged to wield.

facts.label: combat
facts.value: Accuracy and damage scale up sharply against targets with high Magic level/accuracy, making it uniquely dominant against Magic-heavy bosses like Commander Zilyana and TzKal-Zuk.

facts.label: items-note
facts.value: Rare unique reward from the Chambers of Xeric raid's Ancient Chest, weighted by raid points rather than gated by any single skill/quest requirement.

facts.label: mechanics
facts.value: Points accrue from combat plus a wide skilling spread performed during the raid itself (Mining, Woodcutting, Herblore, Farming, Hunter, Cooking, Fishing, Thieving, Firemaking, Agility), so a higher-skilled/larger point total raises the unique-roll odds rather than unlocking eligibility outright.

atoms.label: Talk to Sylas near the Taverley POH portal to start
atoms.detail: Sylas the collector explains he wants a griffin feather and a dwarf's helmet for his magic beans.

atoms.label: Travel to the north-east side of White Wolf Mountain
atoms.detail: Follow the marked path up White Wolf Mountain to reach Grimgnash's nest.

atoms.label: Talk to Grimgnash the griffin and tell an escalating bedtime story
atoms.detail: Route the dialogue tree to tell an increasingly violent bedtime story about a skeleton named Skullrot instead of fighting the griffin.

hints.value: 1I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
1There once was a graveyard filled with undead.
2There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
4Skullrot was insane!
4Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
3Started to strangle the poor gnome.
1He saw a hole he could just fit through.

atoms.label: Take a feather from beside Grimgnash's nest
atoms.detail: Steal a feather from next to the griffin's nest while he is distracted by the story.

atoms.label: Return the griffin feather to Sylas
atoms.detail: Hand the feather to Sylas so he can start work on the second item.

hints.value: 3I should be off, I think.

atoms.label: Travel to the stone tower south of the Mind Altar
atoms.detail: The tower sits between Goblin Village and Ice Mountain, imprisoning the dwarf Rupert.

atoms.label: Climb the tower's crumbling east wall
atoms.detail: Scale the crumbling section on the tower's east side to get inside.

atoms.label: Talk into the drain pipe twice to signal Rupert
atoms.detail: Speak into the drain pipe, then talk into it again to route the dialogue about climbing up.

hints.value: 2I think I might have an idea!
2I could try and climb up.
2Is there anything up there that can help?

atoms.label: Climb Rupert's lowered beard and talk to him
atoms.detail: Climb up the beard he lowers down and speak to Rupert the Beard.

atoms.label: Climb down and talk to Miazrqa behind the tower
atoms.detail: Miazrqa, Rupert's second cousin, will only free him if her pendant is recovered first.

hints.value: 2I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf...
4Your second-cousin, twice removed?
4I need a key for the house.
4I should be off, I think.

atoms.label: Enter the basement of the Witch's House
atoms.detail: The house is next to the Taverley POH portal; a door key and (optionally) leather gloves for an electrified gate are useful here.

atoms.label: Play the correct notes on the basement piano
atoms.detail: Play E-F-E-D-C on the upper (right) side, then A-E-G-A on the lower (left) side of the piano.

atoms.label: Search the piano for the shrunk ogleroot
atoms.detail: Searching the piano after playing the tune reveals a shrunk ogleroot.

atoms.label: Brew a shrinking potion from the shrunk ogleroot
atoms.detail: Add the shrunk ogleroot to unfinished tarromin potions to make shrinking potions.

atoms.label: Drink a shrinking potion by the mouse hole
atoms.detail: Go through the south door on the ground floor and drink a shrinking potion beside the mouse hole to shrink down.

atoms.label: Climb the nail ladders through the mouse-sized area
atoms.detail: Climb the wall nails in sequence (north-east, south-west, south, down to north-east, north-east) while avoiding level-95 mice that hit up to 9 damage.

atoms.label: Take the pendant
atoms.detail: Pick up Miazrqa's pendant once the nail-ladder area is cleared.

atoms.label: Travel back to the stone tower
atoms.detail: Head back to the tower with the recovered pendant.

atoms.label: Give the pendant to Miazrqa
atoms.detail: Hand over the pendant so Miazrqa frees Rupert.

atoms.label: Talk to Rupert to receive his helmet
atoms.detail: Rupert, now freed, hands over his helmet. Optional extra dialogue with Miazrqa and Rupert is available for flavour.

atoms.label: Give Rupert's helmet to Sylas
atoms.detail: Hand the helmet over so Sylas can grow the magic beans.

atoms.label: Plant and water the magic beans
atoms.detail: Plant then water the beans in the plot south-west of the Taverley tree patch; this creates a private instanced area with the beanstalk.

atoms.label: Climb the fast-growing beanstalk
atoms.detail: Climb the beanstalk; followers and pets cannot come along, even carried in the inventory.

atoms.label: Defeat Glod
atoms.detail: Glod is a level 118-138 cloud giant weak to Magic that quakes to drain Prayer and heals itself; looting includes a golden goblin.

atoms.label: Talk to Sylas after the battle
atoms.detail: Report back to Sylas once Glod is defeated.

atoms.label: Shrink and chop down the beanstalk
atoms.detail: Use the spare shrinking potion on the beanstalk (do not drink it), then chop it down.

atoms.label: Talk to Sylas to finish the quest
atoms.detail: Report to Sylas a final time to complete Grim Tales.

notes: Sourced from Grim Tales/Quick guide Walkthrough (manifest slug Grim_Tales_Quick_guide.s2, single fetch of the parent Walkthrough header pulled all 4 subsections inline, 3876B). Griffin coords are the {{Map|mtype=line}} path points from Sylas's area up to Grimgnash's nest (x~2864-2891, y~3429-3508, plane 0), not a single NPC pin. Sylas's opening dialogue and the electrified witch's-house gate (leather-gloves-optional per the page's Needed line) have no explicit checklist bullet in the quick guide text, so their dialogue/atom detail stayed "??" rather than fabricated; the gate is implied by the Needed list only.

atoms.label: Travel to the Dwarven Ferryman
atoms.detail: Reach the ferryman via the tunnel and cave just south of the Polar Hunter area (fairy ring code DKS), or via the Dwarven Boatman's Travel option from northern Keldagrim.

atoms.label: Pay or travel across the river with the Dwarven Ferryman
atoms.detail: Use a Ring of charos (a) to charm a free crossing, or pay coins/use the Travel option instead.

hints.value: 3(Charm) I don't have any money on me.

atoms.label: Talk to Dondakan
atoms.detail: Cross the bridges north then east past the second wooden bridge to find Dondakan firing a cannon at a rock wall.

hints.value: 2Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
1So why were you trying to get through the rock again?
1Sounds interesting!

atoms.label: Travel to western Keldagrim
atoms.detail: Head to the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop in western Keldagrim; the Dwarven Boatman gives a quick shortcut there and back.

atoms.label: Talk to the Dwarf Engineer
atoms.detail: Speak to the Dwarf Engineer in the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop.

atoms.label: Travel to the Dwarven Mine's Ice Mountain entrance
atoms.detail: Head to the Ice Mountain side entrance of the Dwarven Mine.

atoms.label: Talk to Rolad
atoms.detail: Rolad is in the east house at the mine entrance; the conversation disengages once then re-engages.

atoms.label: Optionally buy an Ammo mould from Nulodion
atoms.detail: Nulodion sells the Ammo mould needed later to cast the golden cannon ball, useful if one was not kept from Dwarf Cannon.

atoms.label: Go down the trapdoor into the Dwarven Mine
atoms.detail: Descend into the mine proper to start collecting lore-book pages.

atoms.label: Kill scorpions for Book page 1
atoms.detail: Fight scorpions in the Dwarven Mine until Book page 1 drops.

atoms.label: Search mine carts for Book page 2
atoms.detail: Search the mine carts scattered through the Dwarven Mine until Book page 2 turns up.

atoms.label: Mine any non-Adamantite/Coal rock for Book page 3
atoms.detail: Mine any rock in the Dwarven Mine except Adamantite or Coal until Book page 3 appears.

atoms.label: Return to Rolad
atoms.detail: Report back to Rolad; lie about how it went. Dialogue disengages then re-engages again.

hints.value: 2Of course. (lie)

atoms.label: Read the Dwarven lore book
atoms.detail: Read the Dwarven lore book cover to cover and keep it; it is needed again later for the base schematics.

atoms.label: Return to Dondakan at the Keldagrim mines
atoms.detail: Head back to the Keldagrim mines to talk to Dondakan.

atoms.label: Use a gold bar on Dondakan
atoms.detail: Hand Dondakan a gold bar to set up the golden cannonball plan.

atoms.label: Travel to a furnace
atoms.detail: Any furnace works; Edgeville is recommended for easy fairy-ring or Keldagrim-minecart access.

atoms.label: Smelt the golden cannon ball
atoms.detail: Use a gold bar on the furnace, with an Ammo mould held, to cast a golden cannon ball.

atoms.label: Fire the golden cannon ball at Dondakan's rock
atoms.detail: Use the golden cannon ball on Dondakan to receive a Schematic.

hints.value: 1Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.
1So you want to... fire me into the rock?
2I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

atoms.label: Read the Dwarven lore book again
atoms.detail: Re-read the Dwarven lore book to receive the base schematics.

hints.value: 1Yes

atoms.label: Collect the Engineer's schematics
atoms.detail: Return to the Dwarf Engineer at the Western Trade Consortium for their schematics.

atoms.label: Smith the gold helmet
atoms.detail: Use a gold bar on the nearby anvil to make a gold helmet; smithing it in the Wilderness Resource Area also completes a Wilderness Diary Medium task.

atoms.label: Travel to the pub in the White Wolf Mountain passage
atoms.detail: Head to the pub inside the White Wolf Mountain passage tunnel.

atoms.label: Talk to Khorvak
atoms.detail: Speak to Khorvak at the pub about the schematics.

hints.value: 1No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!

atoms.label: Assemble the completed Schematic
atoms.detail: Combine the Dondakan Schematic, the Dwarf Engineer's Schematics, and the Base schematics per the in-game diagram.

atoms.label: Equip the gold helmet and best pickaxe
atoms.detail: Gear up with the gold helmet and your best wieldable pickaxe before entering the arena.

atoms.label: Start the final battle with Dondakan
atoms.detail: Talk to Dondakan with the completed Schematic to begin; an 8-minute timer starts and removing the gold helmet mid-fight aborts the attempt, teleporting you out.

hints.value: 1You may fire when ready!

atoms.label: Mine gold ore inside the arena
atoms.detail: Mine 6 or 15 gold ore and keep it in the inventory; getting 15 lowers the Arzinian Avatar from level 125 to 75, recommended for lower-level players.

atoms.label: Pass through the first set of flames
atoms.detail: Walk to the centre of the area and go through the first set of flames.

atoms.label: Talk to the second set of flames
atoms.detail: Interact with the second set of flames to trigger the boss encounter.

atoms.label: Defeat the Arzinian Avatar
atoms.detail: The avatar variant is chosen by your highest combat stat: Magic avatar if melee is highest, Ranged avatar if Magic is highest, Strength avatar if Ranged is highest -- gear and pray accordingly.

atoms.label: Talk to Dondakan to finish
atoms.detail: Report to Dondakan a final time to complete Between a Rock...

notes: Sourced from Between a Rock.../Quick guide Walkthrough (manifest slug Between_a_Rock..._Quick_guide.s2, already cached from a prior session, 5116B -- one fetch of the parent Walkthrough header pulled all 7 subsections inline). No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} pins appear anywhere in the fetched walkthrough text, so all coords[] stayed empty rather than guessed. Ammo-mould purchase (idx 7) is flagged optional per the page's own Note (already owned from Dwarf Cannon covers it); coin cost is "??" (not stated). Gold-ore atom (idx 27) uses count 6 / cmp gte per the page's own 6-vs-15 framing (15 is a level-reduction option, not a hard requirement).

checkpoints.label: Forge the bow-sword at Doric's house
Carry the orb through the Abyss to Entrana
Trigger the swap and report back

atoms.label: Talk to the monk outside Paterdomus Temple
atoms.detail: Speak with the monk stationed outside Paterdomus Temple, east of Varrock, and agree to help him.

hints.value: Sure thing, what do you need?
Fairy ring code CKS lands nearby; run west and climb the shortcut to reach the temple quickly.

atoms.label: Travel to Doric's house north of Falador
atoms.detail: Head to Doric's house, north of Falador, to forge the strange weapon.

atoms.label: Grind the mithril 2h sword into a slender blade
atoms.detail: Use the mithril 2h sword on Doric's Whetstone to grind it down into a slender blade.

atoms.label: Attach the bow string to the slender blade
atoms.detail: Attach a bow string to the slender blade to complete the bow-sword.

atoms.label: Hand the bow-sword to the monk
atoms.detail: Return to the monk with the finished bow-sword; he trades an orb for it.

hints.value: Yep, got it right here for you.

atoms.label: Load the orb into the large pouch
atoms.detail: Put the orb the monk gave you inside a large pouch so it can be carried through the Abyss.

hints.value: Ultimate Ironmen lose the pouch on death while the orb is inside it; load the orb only after banking for the Entrana trip.

atoms.label: Swap to Abyss supplies
atoms.detail: Bank your weapons and armour, then withdraw food and prayer supplies to survive the Abyss's monsters.

atoms.label: Cross the Wilderness Abyss to the Law Altar
atoms.detail: Navigate the Wilderness Abyss to reach the Law Altar rift and pass through it.

atoms.label: Head to the church on Entrana
atoms.detail: Exit the altar portal and walk to the church on Entrana.

atoms.label: Use the pouch on the church altar
atoms.detail: Use the pouch holding the orb on the Entrana church altar and watch the swap cutscene play out.

atoms.label: Talk to the High Priest
atoms.detail: Speak with the High Priest of Entrana after the cutscene.

atoms.label: Return to Paterdomus
atoms.detail: Travel back to Paterdomus Temple.

atoms.label: Talk to the monk again
atoms.detail: Speak to the monk back at Paterdomus.

atoms.label: Search the dead monk
atoms.detail: Search the body of the dead monk at Paterdomus for the item that reveals what really happened during the swap.

hints.value: Wiki text does not name the item found; treat as an unnamed story item until confirmed.

atoms.label: Return to Entrana
atoms.detail: Travel back to Entrana.

atoms.label: Report back to the High Priest
atoms.detail: Speak with the High Priest of Entrana a second time.

hints.value: The Rat Pits minigame teleport (requires Ratcatchers) or the Pest Control minigame teleport both land close to Port Sarim as a shortcut.

atoms.label: Head to Falador Park
atoms.detail: Travel to Falador Park.

atoms.label: Report to Sir Tiffy Cashien
atoms.detail: Speak with Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to finish the quest.

hints.value: Devious Minds.

notes: Item found by searching the dead monk (idx13) is not named on the current Quick guide text; left as '??'. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} coordinate pins present in any fetched section.

checkpoints.label: Register as a hero with Achietties
Catch and cook a lava eel
Deliver all three proofs to Achietties

atoms.label: Apply to Achietties
atoms.detail: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe to begin gathering the three proof items.

hints.value: I'm a hero, may I apply to join? / I'll start looking for all those things then.

atoms.label: Ask Gerrant about lava eels
atoms.detail: Talk to Gerrant, the fishing shop owner in Port Sarim, about catching a lava eel.

hints.value: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

atoms.label: Make blamish oil
atoms.detail: Use the blamish snail slime on an unfinished harralander potion to create blamish oil.

atoms.label: Oil the fishing rod
atoms.detail: Use the blamish oil on a fishing rod so it can catch a lava eel.

atoms.label: Travel to Taverley Dungeon
atoms.detail: Head to Taverley Dungeon to reach the lava eel pool near the blue dragons.

hints.value: Alternatives: skip the key with 70 Agility for the shortcut, or use the level-60-Sailing (non-boostable) Charred Dungeon route; the Wilderness Lava Maze route is discouraged.

atoms.label: Kill the Jailer for his key
atoms.detail: Kill the Jailer standing by the prison to obtain the key to Velrak's cell.

atoms.label: Unlock Velrak's cell
atoms.detail: Use the Jailer's key on Velrak's cell door.

atoms.label: Get the dusty key from Velrak
atoms.detail: Talk to Velrak the explorer, in the southern part of the dungeon, for the dusty key. Do not ask for a reward.

hints.value: So do you know any good places to explore? / Yes please!
Skip this and the Jailer/key steps entirely if you already hold a dusty key (a steel key ring with dusty key works) or have 70 Agility for the shortcut.

atoms.label: Open the door to the blue dragons
atoms.detail: Use the dusty key on the locked door guarding the blue dragon area, or take the agility shortcut instead.

atoms.label: Catch a lava eel
atoms.detail: Run to the southernmost lava pool and fish a lava eel; only one is needed since they cannot be burned, though catching a spare is safe.

atoms.label: Cook the lava eel
atoms.detail: Cook the lava eel on a range or fire.

atoms.label: Volunteer for master-thief rank
atoms.detail: Talk to Katrine in the Black Arm gang headquarters, south-west Varrock, about earning master thief rank.

hints.value: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

This whole checkpoint needs a genuine second player from the opposite gang (Phoenix Gang if you're Black Arm, or vice versa); the quest cannot be soloed. Steps below follow the Black Arm partner's track.

atoms.label: Travel to Brimhaven
atoms.detail: Head to Brimhaven, the building directly south of the agility arena entrance.

atoms.label: Volunteer to Trobert
atoms.detail: Give the gang password to enter, then talk to Trobert about stealing Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

hints.value: Gang password: Four leaved clover.
So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks? / I volunteer to undertake that mission!

atoms.label: Equip Black armour
atoms.detail: Equip your Black armour before entering the mansion.

atoms.label: Get the Miscellaneous key from Grip
atoms.detail: Enter the mansion in the north-west of town and talk to Grip for a Miscellaneous key.

hints.value: So what do my duties involve? / Anything I can do now?

If a Miscellaneous key already sits in your bank, Grip will not hand out a second one. Hand this key to your Phoenix-gang partner, who uses it to reach Grip's mansion room via the food shop's gherkin password and secret wall panel.
Already completed the quest and just helping a friend? Skip straight to talking to Grip for the key; Black armour is not required in that case.

atoms.label: Search the cupboard to lure Grip
atoms.detail: Enter the room north of the entrance and search the cupboard so Grip comes to investigate, then close the door behind him to trap him.

hints.value: He won't notice me having a quick look.
Your partner then kills the trapped Grip with Ranged or Magic from outside; wait for them to finish.

atoms.label: Take Grip's key and the candlesticks
atoms.detail: Take Grip's key from his remains, use it on the north-west door, and take 2 candlesticks from the chest inside.

atoms.label: Turn in a candlestick for the armband
atoms.detail: Give one candlestick to your partner and keep the other, then bring your candlestick back to Katrine for the Thieves' armband.

hints.value: I have a candlestick now.

atoms.label: Defeat the Ice Queen for her gloves
atoms.detail: Fight through White Wolf Mountain's northern tunnels (mine the rockslide, then the ladder/tunnel maze) and kill the level-111 Ice Queen for her gloves.

hints.value: Skip this whole step if you already own ice gloves. Bring combat gear/food and a Mining-boost item if you need to reach 50 Mining.

atoms.label: Equip the ice gloves
atoms.detail: Equip the ice gloves.

atoms.label: Travel to Entrana
atoms.detail: Travel to Entrana.

atoms.label: Kill the Firebird for its feather
atoms.detail: Kill the Firebird near the Law Altar on Entrana and take the fire feather.

atoms.label: Deliver all three proofs
atoms.detail: Hand the cooked eel, thieves' armband, and fire feather to Achietties to complete the quest.

notes: Master thieves' armband checkpoint is genuinely two-player (opposite Shield of Arrav gangs); atoms follow the Black Arm partner's track only, with the Phoenix partner's mirrored actions folded into hints rather than duplicated as atoms since the closed verb enum has no player-to-player trade verb. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} coordinate pins present in any fetched section (the Ice Queen route uses a plain pictured map, not a coord template).

checkpoints.label: Hear Grubfoot's warning and consult Zanik
Disguise as a goblin via the Makeover Mage
Infiltrate the Goblin Temple and free Zanik
Steal all six priest keys and unlock the crypt
Defeat the four ancestor bosses and Strongbones
Activate Oldak's machine and open the way to Yu'biusk

atoms.label: Talk to Grubfoot
atoms.detail: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines, right outside the main entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan.

hints.value: Yes
Bring a light source; no pets may be following you.

atoms.label: Hear Zanik's dream
atoms.detail: Head north-west into Oldak's laboratory and talk to Zanik about her new dream.

hints.value: So why have you come to talk to Zanik? / What was this new dream? / (any) / I'm ready.

atoms.label: Let Zanik pass the temple guards
atoms.detail: Head north-west to the temple entrance stairs and talk to the two goblin guards blocking it so Zanik can pass.

atoms.label: Pick a black mushroom
atoms.detail: Pick a black mushroom near the entrance if you don't already have black dye.

hints.value: Skip if you already hold black dye.

atoms.label: Travel to the Makeover Mage
atoms.detail: Travel to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador (skills necklace to the Crafting Guild, or a Falador teleport).

atoms.label: Get transformed into a goblin
atoms.detail: Ask the Makeover Mage to turn you into a goblin.

hints.value: Can you turn me into a goblin? / I need to slip past some goblin guards. / Can you turn me into a goblin or not?

atoms.label: Pick pharmakos berries
atoms.detail: Pick berries from the pharmakos bush outside the Makeover Mage's building.

atoms.label: Brew the goblin potion
atoms.detail: Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create a goblin potion.

atoms.label: Return to the Goblin Cave
atoms.detail: Return to the Goblin Cave near the Fishing Guild, most easily via a skills necklace.

atoms.label: Drink the goblin potion
atoms.detail: Drink the goblin potion in front of the goblin guards, picking any goblin appearance.

atoms.label: Prepare black dye
atoms.detail: Use a pestle and mortar on a black mushroom with an empty vial in your inventory to make black dye, if you don't already have it.

atoms.label: Climb down into the temple
atoms.detail: Climb down the cave entrance to enter the Goblin Temple.

hints.value: Me want get into temple. / Yes, me [goblin name].

atoms.label: Dye the goblin mail black
atoms.detail: Use black dye on your goblin mail and wear it.

hints.value: If you don't already own a goblin mail, search the crates in the main temple room for a free one.

atoms.label: Equip the black goblin mail
atoms.detail: Wear the black-dyed goblin mail.

atoms.label: Search the crate for the sphere
atoms.detail: Enter the north-eastern room and search the crate inside for a Dorgesh-kaan sphere.

atoms.label: Free Zanik from her cell
atoms.detail: Talk to Zanik in the prison cell while carrying the Dorgesh-kaan sphere to free her.

atoms.label: Pass High Priest Bighead's quiz
atoms.detail: Head back to the main room, talk to High Priest Bighead in the north, and answer his goblin-lore test correctly.

hints.value: I understand Big High War God. / True. / Big High War God commands it. / False. / Goblins not mighty warriors before he chose us. / False. / That one of the commandments. / Lead goblins to victory over whole world. / Me want to know about Yu'biusk. / Where is Yu'biusk? / Can I talk to old high priests?

atoms.label: Pickpocket the northern priest
atoms.detail: Re-enter the north-eastern room, where the goblins now wear black goblin-mail, and pickpocket the priest for his Huzamogaarb key.

atoms.label: Travel to Draynor Village
atoms.detail: Leave the cave (equip a piece of gear to be thrown out, then teleport) and head to Draynor Village.

atoms.label: Ask Aggie to prepare dyes
atoms.detail: Ask Aggie in Draynor Village to prepare the black, yellow, purple, orange, and blue dyes you'll need for the remaining priests.

hints.value: Can you make dyes for me please? / Can you make black or white dye?

atoms.label: Get a raw slimy eel
atoms.detail: Acquire a raw slimy eel before heading to the Fishing Contest area.

atoms.label: Travel to Hemenster
atoms.detail: Head to the Fishing Contest area in Hemenster with a fishing rod and the slimy eel.

atoms.label: Get access to the whitefish spot
atoms.detail: Click the gate to the Fishing Contest area.

hints.value: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.

atoms.label: Catch a Hemenster whitefish
atoms.detail: Catch a Hemenster whitefish.

atoms.label: Trade the whitefish for white goblin mail
atoms.detail: Return to Aggie, trade the whitefish for a white goblin mail, and collect the prepared dyes.

hints.value: Can you make dyes for me please? / Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?
Do not teleport out of the temple later with a full inventory, or you will lose your goblin mail.

atoms.label: Return to the Goblin Temple wearing the white mail
atoms.detail: Head back into the Goblin Temple wearing the white goblin mail.

atoms.label: Steal the western priest's key
atoms.detail: Steal the Saragorgak key from the priest in the western room of the temple, then remove the mail to leave the room quicker.

atoms.label: Steal the remaining four coloured keys
atoms.detail: Repeat the dye-and-pickpocket cycle for each remaining priest, in order: yellow (north-west), purple (south-west), orange (south-east), blue (east).

atoms.label: Unlock the crypt
atoms.detail: Use all six coloured keys to unlock the crypt door before leaving; this also grants extra inventory space.

atoms.label: Enter the crypt
atoms.detail: Enter the crypt through the large door north of the temple.

hints.value: Prepare combat gear before entering; four ancestor bosses plus Strongbones wait inside.

atoms.label: Defeat and question Snothead
atoms.detail: Use "Say-name" on the south-west grave to fight Snothead, then talk to her once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

atoms.label: Defeat and question Snailfeet
atoms.detail: Use "Say-name" on the south-east grave to fight Snailfeet, then talk to him once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

atoms.label: Defeat and question Mosschin
atoms.detail: Use "Say-name" on the north-west grave to fight Mosschin, then talk to her once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

atoms.label: Defeat and question Redeyes
atoms.detail: Use "Say-name" on the north-east grave to fight Redeyes, then talk to him once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

atoms.label: Defeat Strongbones and learn Yu'biusk's location
atoms.detail: Use "Say-name" on the northern grave to fight the level-184 Strongbones, ignoring her summoned skoblins and praying Protect from Magic, then ask her where Yu'biusk is.

hints.value: Where is Yu'biusk?
Make sure to ask Strongbones about Yu'biusk before leaving the crypt.

atoms.label: Report back to Zanik
atoms.detail: Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and talk to Zanik in Oldak's laboratory.

atoms.label: Head to Oldak in the South Dungeon
atoms.detail: With a light source, travel to Oldak in the South Dungeon beneath Dorgesh-Kaan's agility course.

hints.value: Three routes: fairy ring code AJQ; a Dorgesh-kaan sphere down through the agility course; or simply run south to the agility course and take the ladder down, then east through the dungeon.

atoms.label: Talk to Oldak
atoms.detail: Speak with Oldak.

atoms.label: Activate Oldak's machine
atoms.detail: Use combination 9-4-1 on the machines next to Oldak to activate them.

atoms.label: Open the strange box
atoms.detail: Open the strange box in the north-western part of Yu'biusk to trigger the finishing cutscene and complete the quest.

notes: The four-key repeat cycle (yellow/purple/orange/blue, idx27) is rolled into one count=4 atom per the never-unroll rule rather than four near-identical dye+pickpocket atoms. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} coordinate pins present in any fetched section.

checkpoints.label: Reach My Arm at the Troll Stronghold
Gather goutweed and prep the soil patch
Sail to Tai Bwo Wannai for hardy gout tubers
Teach My Arm to farm and defend the crop

atoms.label: Travel to the Troll Stronghold kitchen
atoms.detail: Enter via the secret kitchen door after freeing the prisoners, a slayer ring mountain entrance, or a Trollheim teleport heading west; climbing boots or 12 coins may be needed for the route.

atoms.label: Talk to Burntmeat to accept the quest
atoms.detail: Speak to Burntmeat in the kitchen and agree to help My Arm.

hints.value: 1 What do you want now? -> 2 Alright, I'll lend him a hand.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm to begin the adventure
atoms.detail: My Arm stands east of Burntmeat; talking to him starts the goutweed errand.

atoms.label: Teleport to Death Plateau
atoms.detail: Use a games necklace or minigame teleport to Burthorpe, then reach the Death Plateau; thrower trolls attack along the way and on the plateau, so protect from ranged.

atoms.label: Use a bucket on the cooking pot for the goutweedy lump
atoms.detail: With one free inventory slot, use an empty bucket on the cooking pot at the plateau's centre; a spare bucket spawns south of the pot if you forgot one.

atoms.label: Return to the Troll Stronghold
atoms.detail: Carry the goutweedy lump back to the Stronghold.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm after returning with the goutweedy lump
Talk to My Arm after he leads you to a new area
atoms.detail: Follow My Arm to the new area then talk to him again; he hands you a book.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm after reading his book
atoms.detail: Read the book he gave you, then talk to him again to proceed.

atoms.label: Prepare the soil patch with dung and supercompost
atoms.detail: Use three buckets of Ugthanki dung then seven buckets of supercompost on the soil patch, in that order.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm after preparing the patch
Talk to Captain Barnaby to sail to Karamja

hints.value: 1 This is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm at Tai Bwo Wannai
atoms.detail: Meet him east of the general store.

atoms.label: Talk to Murcaily near the hardwood grove for tubers
atoms.detail: Requires at least 60% Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup favour and one free inventory slot; if he can't be found, log out and back in; raise favour to 60% first if it's below that.

hints.value: 1 A troll called My Arm wants a favour...

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm to sail back to Ardougne
atoms.detail: After the cutscene, speak to My Arm; the boat returns you to Ardougne where the bank is accessible.

atoms.label: Return to the Troll Stronghold roof
atoms.detail: Take the ladder in the west room on the upper level, past the Troll Generals, up to the roof; get a spade from the Tool Leprechaun if needed.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm on the roof
Give My Arm the rake
atoms.detail: If My Arm breaks the rake, pick up the pieces, reassemble it, and give it back to him.

atoms.label: Give My Arm supercompost or ultracompost (optional)
atoms.detail: Optional: without ultracompost/supercompost the patch may become diseased and need curing; regular compost has no effect.

hints.value: optional

atoms.label: Give My Arm the hardy gout tubers
atoms.detail: Quantity needed is not stated numerically on the quick guide.

atoms.label: Give My Arm the seed dibber
Give My Arm a plant cure if the patch is diseased
atoms.detail: Conditional: only needed if skipping ultracompost/supercompost let the patch become diseased.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm to start the boss fight
atoms.detail: This triggers the instanced fight against the Baby Roc and Giant Roc guarding the crop; bring food.

atoms.label: Defeat the level 75 Baby Roc and level 172 Giant Roc
atoms.detail: The Giant Roc's regular attacks can be dodged by moving between tiles, but its stun attack cannot be dodged.

atoms.label: Talk to My Arm after the fight
Give My Arm a spade
atoms.detail: If you don't have one, go back down and up the ladder to make the Tool Leprechaun reappear.

atoms.label: Return to Burntmeat in the kitchen
Talk to My Arm on the roof to complete the quest

notes: Quick guide's Walkthrough H2 (s2) pulled all 5 H3 subsections inline in one fetch, so every atom cites the same section slug. Hardy gout tuber hand-in quantity is never stated numerically on the page -- left count null rather than fabricated. Baby Roc (75) / Giant Roc (172) levels and the stun-attack-cannot-be-dodged note are page-stated.

checkpoints.label: Report to Witchaven command and canvas the townsfolk
Explore the hidden shrine and dungeon door
Recover and repair the page fragments
Craft the runes and defeat the Slug Prince

atoms.label: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien for the Commorb v2
atoms.detail: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to receive a Commorb v2; Savant will contact you through it multiple times to scan surroundings or give hints.

hints.value: 1 Do you have any jobs for me yet?

atoms.label: Talk to Col. O'Niall on the Witchaven dock

hints.value: 1 What's the mission? -> 3 Who are the important people in Witchaven?

atoms.label: Talk to Brother Maledict in the church
Talk to Mayor Hobb and scan with the Commorb
atoms.detail: Mayor Hobb is in the most north-west building; after Savant prompts you, scan with the Commorb v2.

hints.value: 1 I'm here to relax.

atoms.label: Talk to Holgart by the Fishing Platform boat
atoms.detail: Holgart wears a green shirt, north-east of the quest icon.

atoms.label: Talk to Col. O'Niall again to report
Descend the Old Ruin Entrance west of Witchaven
Push the false wall east of the entrance
atoms.detail: The false wall on the east wall by the entrance is shown red on the minimap.

atoms.label: Follow the path to the imposing door
atoms.detail: Use the shortcut if able, then try to open the door.

atoms.label: Scan the imposing door with the Commorb for the transcription
atoms.detail: Requires one free inventory space to receive the torn transcription.

atoms.label: Pick up a dead sea slug west of the imposing door
atoms.detail: Required before Jorral will talk to you.

atoms.label: Talk to Jorral at the outpost north-west of Ardougne
atoms.detail: Necklace of passage is a recommended item for fast travel here.

hints.value: 2 Translations (only if Making History has not been started)

atoms.label: Talk to Col. O'Niall
Talk to Brother Maledict
Search the mayor's study desk for a page fragment
atoms.detail: Search repeatedly until a page fragment is obtained.

atoms.label: Talk to Ezekial Lovecraft in the fishing store
atoms.detail: Requires one free inventory space.

atoms.label: Talk to Col. O'Niall again
atoms.detail: Requires three free inventory spaces.

atoms.label: Use swamp paste on one of the fragments
atoms.detail: Savant interrupts and stops you before this works directly.

atoms.label: Talk to Jeb near Holgart and travel to the Fishing Platform
Give the dead sea slug to Bailey
atoms.detail: Bailey is on the south-west part of the Fishing Platform.

atoms.label: Use the sea slug glue on a fragment and solve the puzzle
atoms.detail: The sea slug glue is obtained from Bailey; solving the puzzle repairs the fragment.

atoms.label: Shape essence into air, water, fire, earth, and mind runes
atoms.detail: Right-click the pages and use the shape option on rune essence for each of the five types; essence can fail and break in the process.

atoms.label: Use each chiselled stone on its matching altar
atoms.detail: Air Altar south of Falador, Mind Altar north of Falador (just below the Wilderness), Water Altar south of Lumbridge next to the Zanaris shack, Earth Altar north-east of Varrock (balloon transport if unlocked), Fire Altar west of the Emir's Arena in Al Kharid (ring of dueling); bring spare essence in case of failure.

atoms.label: Use the handmade runes on the imposing door
atoms.detail: Bring the Commorb along; this opens the door beneath Witchaven.

atoms.label: Kill the level 62 Slug Prince
atoms.detail: Only melee damages it and it drains Prayer points; it can be safespotted with a halberd.

atoms.label: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien to complete the quest

hints.value: 1 Slug Menace.

notes: The shrine's {{Map|mtype=polygon}} pin is a hexagonal area, not a single point -- all 6 polygon vertices recorded as coords on the Jorral talk-to atom rather than picking one. The 5 rune-shaping and 5 altar-visit actions are each an inherently repeated action (one per rune type); kept as one count:5 atom apiece rather than unrolled per rune, per the never-unroll-repetition rule.

checkpoints.label: Ask Ug and Aga about the problem
Gather sled materials and build the sled
Sled down the mountain and collect Trollweiss
Defeat Arrg and return to Ug

atoms.label: Travel to the Troll Stronghold via fairy ring or Trollheim
atoms.detail: Use fairy ring code AJR, a slayer ring, or a Trollheim teleport to reach the Secret Door north-east of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; climbing boots help with a shortcut on this route.

atoms.label: Talk to Ug in the south-west corner of the Stronghold

hints.value: 1 Aww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem? -> 3 Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

atoms.label: Talk to Aga in the room to the north

hints.value: 2 So... how's your... um... love life? -> 1 Errr... I've got to go.

atoms.label: Talk to Ug again
Talk to Tenzing west of the Warriors' Guild

hints.value: 4 Do you know where I can find Trollweiss? -> 2 What would I need to make such a sled?

atoms.label: Talk to Dunstan at the anvil in north-eastern Burthorpe

hints.value: 1 Talk about a quest. -> 2 I need a sled!! -> 1 Yes.

atoms.label: Talk to Dunstan again to receive the sled

hints.value: 1 Talk about a quest.

atoms.label: Use swamp tar on the bucket of wax to make Wax
Use the Wax on the sled
Run north-west from the Trollheim teleport to the cave
atoms.detail: The cave sits north-west of the Troll family (Troll child if Desert Treasure isn't done).

atoms.label: Enter the north-west cave and run past the ice trolls
atoms.detail: Do not enter through the icy gate; run north-west past the ice trolls to the crevasse.

atoms.label: Exit through the crevasse
Equip the sled and slide down the slope
atoms.detail: Go south then click to slide down.

atoms.label: Collect the rare Trollweiss flowers after the first cutscene
