atoms.detail: Screen one: finish with five relaxes.

atoms.label: Burn a log
atoms.detail: Screen two: burn a log.

atoms.label: Relax
atoms.detail: Screen two: relax once.

atoms.label: Burn a log
atoms.detail: Screen two: burn another log.

atoms.label: Relax 10 times
atoms.detail: Screen two: relax ten times.

atoms.label: Burn a log
atoms.detail: Screen two: burn a third log.

atoms.label: Relax 5 times
atoms.detail: Screen two: relax five times to finish.

atoms.label: Relax 7 times
atoms.detail: Screen three: relax seven times.

atoms.label: Pull the red rope
atoms.detail: Screen three: pull the red rope.

atoms.label: Pull the brown rope
atoms.detail: Screen three: pull the brown rope.

atoms.label: Relax 3 times
atoms.detail: Screen three: relax three times.

atoms.label: Burn a log
atoms.detail: Screen three: burn a log.

atoms.label: Relax 4 times
atoms.detail: Screen three: relax four times.

atoms.label: Pull the brown rope
atoms.detail: Screen three: pull the brown rope to land.

atoms.label: Talk to Auguste to finish
atoms.detail: Talk to Auguste after landing to complete the quest. Crashing only costs 10 more logs and a restart from Auguste.

notes: Verb enum has no dedicated minigame-button primitive: 'consume' used for drop-sandbag/burn-log (item spent), 'toggle' used for relax/rope-pull (control interaction, not item-consuming). No {{Map}} coord templates anywhere on the quick guide, so coords stayed empty throughout.

atoms.label: Talk to Commander Veldaban
atoms.detail: Speak to Commander Veldaban just west of the Keldagrim bank to begin a cutscene. Don't click the east side of the bridge as the cutscene starts or your character drifts east.

hints.value: Very interested!
Yes.
Sounds like just the job for me!

atoms.label: Buy 3 beers
atoms.detail: Buy three beers from the pub south of the drunken dwarf's house if you don't already have them.

hints.value: I'd like a beer please.
Pay.

atoms.label: Talk to the drunken dwarf
atoms.detail: Speak to the drunken dwarf in the middle of East Keldagrim, north-east of the kebab shop.

hints.value: I need to know about the Red Axe...

atoms.label: Give the drunken dwarf a beer
atoms.detail: Talk to the drunken dwarf again and hand him a beer to loosen his tongue.

hints.value: I need to know about the Red Axe...

atoms.label: Ask the rowdy dwarf for his request
atoms.detail: Speak to the rowdy dwarf outside the East Keldagrim pub; he names a random item he wants fetched.

atoms.label: Obtain the item the rowdy dwarf requested
atoms.detail: Produce or otherwise source whichever item the rowdy dwarf asked for; it is randomised per playthrough.

atoms.label: Deliver the requested item
atoms.detail: Bring the requested item back to the rowdy dwarf.

atoms.label: Travel to the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain
atoms.detail: Head to the White Wolf Mountain tunnel; optionally buy a 100-coin ticket from the Keldagrim Cart Conductor and ride the south minecart track.

atoms.label: Talk to Khorvak
atoms.detail: Speak to Khorvak in the pub under White Wolf Mountain.

hints.value: What if I offer you a drink?

atoms.label: Give Khorvak a dwarven stout
atoms.detail: Hand Khorvak a dwarven stout; one spawns on a table in the pub if you didn't bring one.

atoms.label: Return to Keldagrim (optional)
atoms.detail: Optionally buy a Keldagrim ticket from the Cart Conductor (discounted with a Ring of charos) or teleport to the Blast Furnace minigame to get back.

atoms.label: Cheers with Gauss
atoms.detail: Talk to Gauss in the bar south of the bank on the western side of Keldagrim and give him a beer.

atoms.label: Ask Rind the Gardener for permission
atoms.detail: Speak with Rind the Gardener at the Kelda Hops Patch south-east of the bank before using the patch.

atoms.label: Plant the kelda seeds
atoms.detail: Plant the kelda seeds in the patch; a rake is available just south of it.

atoms.label: Harvest the kelda hops
atoms.detail: Wait for a chat notification that the crop is ready (you can log out while waiting) then harvest the kelda hops.

atoms.label: Buy ale yeast (optional)
atoms.detail: Upstairs in the East Keldagrim pub, buy ale yeast from Blandebir for 25 coins if you didn't bring your own; an empty pot spawns near the vat.

hints.value: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.

atoms.label: Add water to the vat
atoms.detail: Pour two buckets of water into the vat first.

atoms.label: Add barley malt to the vat
atoms.detail: Add two barley malts to the vat next.

atoms.label: Add kelda hops to the vat
atoms.detail: Add the harvested kelda hops to the vat.

atoms.label: Add ale yeast to the vat
atoms.detail: Add the ale yeast last, in this order: water, barley malt, kelda hops, ale yeast.

atoms.label: Wait for the brew
atoms.detail: Wait for another chat notification (15-20 minutes) that the kelda ale has finished brewing.

atoms.label: Draw the finished ale
atoms.detail: Turn the valve and use an empty beer glass on the barrel to draw the finished kelda ale.

atoms.label: Report the ale to the drunken dwarf
atoms.detail: Return to the drunken dwarf's house north-east of the kebab shop and talk about the Red Axe again.

hints.value: I need to know about the Red Axe...

atoms.label: Ask about the closed-off tunnel
atoms.detail: Talk to the southernmost cart conductor in south-eastern Keldagrim; only one of the conductors will discuss the closed-off tunnel.

hints.value: Ask about closed off tunnel.

atoms.label: Ask your mining company director for help
atoms.detail: Find the director of the mining company you joined during The Giant Dwarf, upstairs in either the west or east marketplace; only your own director has time to talk.

hints.value: Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?

atoms.label: Ride the southernmost minecart into the tunnel
atoms.detail: Return to the minecarts and ride the southernmost cart; no ticket is needed but both hands must be free.

atoms.label: Search the box in room 1
atoms.detail: Search the box in the first room to collect stones for the cart-track puzzle.

atoms.label: Use the dwarven machinery
atoms.detail: Use the dwarven machinery in room 1 to open the sliding-block cart-track puzzle interface.

atoms.label: Solve the room 1 cart-track puzzle
atoms.detail: Set up each of the three shown paths in turn and click OK, riding the cart and collecting more stones from the box between attempts, to move on to room 2.

atoms.label: Crawl through room 2
atoms.detail: Listen to the conversation, crawl to the other side of room 2, and leave.

atoms.label: Solve the room 3 cart-track puzzle
atoms.detail: Complete the sliding-block cart-track puzzle in room 3 the same way as room 1.

atoms.label: Read the Red Axe documents in room 4
atoms.detail: Search the crates and bookshelves in room 4 until you've read three documents relating to the Red Axe, then continue on.

atoms.label: Solve the room 5 cart-track puzzle
atoms.detail: Complete the sliding-block cart-track puzzle in room 5 the same way as the previous ones. Room 6 is a cutscene with no player action, watched on entry.

atoms.label: Buy a kebab (optional)
atoms.detail: Buy a kebab from the kebab shop in East Keldagrim if you don't already have one.

atoms.label: Buy a beer (optional)
atoms.detail: Buy a beer in the East Keldagrim pub if you don't already have one.

atoms.label: Report the tunnel to Commander Veldaban
atoms.detail: Return to Commander Veldaban west of the bank and report what you found in the tunnel.

atoms.label: Drink the beer
atoms.detail: Back at the eastern pub on the east side of Keldagrim, drink your beer.

atoms.label: Eat the kebab
atoms.detail: Eat your kebab at the eastern pub to complete the quest.

notes: The three sliding-block cart-track puzzle rooms (1, 3, 5) are each the SAME 3-part path-and-collect procedure repeated, so each is one count=3 toggle atom rather than 9 unrolled atoms, per the never-unroll-repetition rule. Room 6 is a pure cutscene with no player action, folded into the room-5 atom's detail rather than given its own atom. Randomised fetch-quest item (rowdy dwarf) and the finished ale's exact item name are both left as '??' -- neither is spelled out on the quick guide.

atoms.label: Talk to Thormac
atoms.detail: Speak to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, south of Seers' Village, to receive the scorpion cage.

hints.value: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then

atoms.label: Talk to a Seer
atoms.detail: Speak to a Seer in Seers' Village (wait until he finishes checking himself in the mirror). This is mandatory -- skipping it blocks access to the Taverley Dungeon scorpion room. Scorpions can then be caught in any order with no need to return to Thormac between catches.

hints.value: Your friend Thormac sent me to speak to you.

atoms.label: Kill the jailer for a dusty key (if under 70 Agility)
atoms.detail: If you lack 70 Agility for the dungeon shortcuts, head south to the Black Knights' Base and kill the jailer to get a key.

atoms.label: Free Velrak for the dusty key
atoms.detail: Use the key on the jail cell and talk to Velrak the explorer; he gives you the dusty key. A dusty key also spawns near the lava eel fishing spot south of the blue dragon area as an alternative, or skip this with the 70/80 Agility shortcuts.

atoms.label: Reach the hidden scorpion room
atoms.detail: Enter Taverley Dungeon from South Taverley, pass the poison spider area (an anti-dragon shield is recommended near the blue dragons), and search the old wall directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut.

atoms.label: Cage the first Kharid Scorpion
atoms.detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion; trying to pick it up instead stings you.

atoms.label: Head to the Barbarian Outpost
atoms.detail: Travel to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace helps), enter the fenced area near the agility course entrance, then the building in the north-east corner.

atoms.label: Cage the second Kharid Scorpion
atoms.detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion; it may be loose outside the small room if someone else let it out.

atoms.label: Head to Edgeville Monastery
atoms.detail: Travel to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet teleports directly there), climb the eastern ladder to the east side of the floor. If a monk stops you, say you want to join the order.

coords.label: third Kharid Scorpion, Edgeville Monastery upper floor

atoms.label: Cage the third Kharid Scorpion
atoms.detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion.

atoms.label: Return the full cage to Thormac
atoms.detail: Hand the scorpion cage, now holding all three Kharid Scorpions, back to Thormac to finish the quest.

notes: Real {{Map}} pins exist for the Sorcerer's Tower and all three Kharid Scorpion spots (first is a dungeon coord, y=9796, consistent with the dungeon +6400 envelope). The scorpion cage is reused across all three catches (state advances, not consumed) -- only the final Thormac turn-in consumes it.

atoms.label: Sober up Skippy with water
atoms.detail: Right-click 'Sober-Up' on Skippy, south-east of Rimmington, using a bucket of water.

hints.value: Throw the water!

atoms.label: Use nettle tea on Skippy
atoms.detail: Right-click use the nettle tea on Skippy. Do not accidentally drink it yourself.

atoms.label: Talk to Skippy
atoms.detail: Talk to Skippy after the tea.

atoms.label: Make chocolatey milk
atoms.detail: Use the chocolate dust on the bucket of milk.

atoms.label: Brew the hangover cure
atoms.detail: Use the snape grass on the chocolatey milk. Do not accidentally drink the chocolatey milk yourself.

atoms.label: Use the hangover cure on Skippy
atoms.detail: Use the finished hangover cure on Skippy to complete the miniquest. No combat is required; the mogre Slayer-task unlock afterward is best used with 32 Slayer and fishing explosives.

notes: Miniquest with a single flat Walkthrough section, no H3 subsections and no {{Map}} templates -- one checkpoint covers all 6 atoms; coords stayed empty.

atoms.label: Talk to Captain Tock near Falador farm
atoms.detail: Speak to Captain Tock just south of the entrance to Falador farm and agree to help with his curse.

hints.value: What kind of help do you need?
Sure, I'll try to help with your curse.

atoms.label: Sail to Corsair Cove with Captain Tock
atoms.detail: Meet Captain Tock again on the single dock just west of Rimmington and sail to Corsair Cove.

hints.value: Okay, I'm ready to go to Corsair Cove.

atoms.label: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator first
atoms.detail: On arrival, speak to Ithoi the Navigator before any other NPC or their dialogue breaks. He's west along the beach, upstairs in the southernmost building.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

atoms.label: Speak to Arsen the Thief
atoms.detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief upstairs in the first house west of the docks.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

atoms.label: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin
atoms.detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin in the same room as Arsen, just east of him.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

atoms.label: Speak to Gnocci the Cook
atoms.detail: Speak to Gnocci the Cook upstairs in the building just north-west.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

atoms.label: Grab a tinderbox by Gnocci (if needed)
atoms.detail: Pick up the tinderbox next to Gnocci if you don't already carry one; it's needed later.

atoms.label: Grab a spade south of Gnocci's hut (if needed)
atoms.detail: Pick up the spade directly south of Gnocci's hut, right by the tree near the water, if you don't already carry one.

atoms.label: Receive the ogre artefact
atoms.detail: Cross the south gangplank to speak with Captain Tock back on the boat; he explains Arsen gave him a sacred ogre relic.

hints.value: Arsen says he gave you a sacred ogre relic.

atoms.label: Return the ogre artefact to Chief Tess
atoms.detail: Speak to Chief Tess in the Corsair Cove Dungeon, entrance just west in the middle of four small pillars, and hand over the ogre artefact.

hints.value: I've come to return what Arsen stole.

atoms.label: Dig the lump of sand
atoms.detail: Use a spade to dig the lump of sand next to the tropical tree west of the fishing spot where Gnocci fished in the cutscene, three steps east of the tree.

atoms.label: Use the telescope on Ithoi's deck
atoms.detail: Use the telescope on the deck of Ithoi the Navigator's hut.

atoms.label: Report findings to Gnocci
atoms.detail: Return to Gnocci the Cook and report what you found.

atoms.label: Report findings to Arsen
atoms.detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief with your findings.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

atoms.label: Report findings to Colin
atoms.detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin with your findings.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

atoms.label: Rule out the crew's theories with Captain Tock
atoms.detail: Speak to Captain Tock now that all three theories have been ruled out.

hints.value: I've ruled out all the Corsairs' theories...
So what do I do now?

atoms.label: Ask Gnocci about the meal
atoms.detail: Speak to Gnocci the Cook about when the sickness started.

hints.value: I hear it happened straight after dinner.

atoms.label: Ask Arsen about the meal and Francois
atoms.detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief about who cooked the meal and about Francois' mission.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

hints.value: I hear Ithoi cooked the meal you ate that night.
What is the mission Francois is doing?

atoms.label: Ask Colin about firing Ithoi
atoms.detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin about the Captain considering firing Ithoi.

coords.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

hints.value: I hear the Captain's thinking of firing Ithoi.

atoms.label: Confront Ithoi about the meal
atoms.detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator about cooking the meal and the Captain's plan to fire him.

hints.value: I hear you cooked the meal they ate before getting sick.
Maybe because the Captain's thinking of firing you.

atoms.label: Accuse Ithoi of faking the curse
atoms.detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator again, accusing him of faking his curse.

hints.value: I know you've faked the curse.
I bet I can prove you're well enough to get up.

atoms.label: Torch the driftwood under Ithoi's hut
atoms.detail: Use your tinderbox on the driftwood under Ithoi's hut to smoke him out.

atoms.label: Catch Ithoi not-sick
atoms.detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator again after the smoke reveals he isn't actually sick.

hints.value: I saw you running around! You're not sick!

atoms.label: Report Ithoi to Captain Tock
atoms.detail: Speak to Captain Tock to report that Ithoi isn't sick; this triggers the instanced fight.

hints.value: I've seen Ithoi running around. He's not sick at all.
I'll be back.

atoms.label: Kill Ithoi the Navigator
atoms.detail: In the instance, head west and kill Ithoi the Navigator (level 35); using Protect from Magic avoids all his damage. Recommended 20+ Combat with weapons, armour and food.

atoms.label: Report Ithoi's death to Captain Tock
atoms.detail: Speak to Captain Tock to report killing Ithoi for poisoning the crew, completing the quest.

hints.value: I've killed Ithoi for poisoning your crew.

notes: {{Map|mtype=pin}} gives named coords for every quest NPC hut plus the sand-dig/doll site -- all reused across atoms that revisit the same NPC. The sand-dig result item name and one dialogue option ({{Chat option|1}} with no label text) are both genuinely blank on the quick guide, left as '??' rather than guessed. No dedicated player-vs-NPC exchange or fire-lighting verb exists in the closed enum for the driftwood step; used 'use-on' (tinderbox on driftwood) as the closest fit.

atoms.label: Talk to the Dwarven Boatman to travel to Keldagrim
atoms.detail: Take fairy ring code DKS then head through the tunnel south-west and the Cave Entrance, or simply speak to the boatman to begin the trip.

hints.value: 1That's a deal!
1Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.

atoms.label: Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban
atoms.detail: Commander Veldaban, near the West Keldagrim bank, briefs you on the sculptor's project.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

atoms.label: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor
atoms.detail: Blasidar, on the east side of Keldagrim south of the kebab shop, explains he needs items for a statue of King Alvis.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

atoms.label: Ask Vermundi about the exquisite clothes
atoms.detail: Vermundi the silk trader works the large eastern-market building in East Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.

atoms.label: Ask the Librarian about Dwarven costumes
atoms.detail: The Librarian sits in the library at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?

atoms.label: Climb a bookcase for the costume book
atoms.detail: Climbing any library bookcase yields the Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes; carrying 30kg or more of gear blocks the climb.

atoms.label: Source coal for the spinning machine
atoms.detail: Coal can be mined in the north-east corner of East Keldagrim, or bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace if not already carried.

atoms.label: Tell Vermundi you're ready for the clothes
atoms.detail: Return to Vermundi once coal and logs are in hand.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...

atoms.label: Spin coal and logs into cloth
atoms.detail: Use coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi, then light the result with a tinderbox.

atoms.label: Buy the exquisite clothes from Vermundi for 200gp
atoms.detail: Pay Vermundi 200gp once the spun cloth is ready.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...
1I'll pay.

atoms.label: Buy 3 sapphires from Hervi if not already carried
atoms.detail: Hervi runs the gem stall just north of Vermundi.

atoms.label: Ask Saro about the special boots
atoms.detail: Saro works the anvil south-west of the West Keldagrim bank.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.

atoms.label: Speak to Dromund
atoms.detail: Dromund lives in a house just north of the West Keldagrim bank.

atoms.label: Take the left boot while Dromund isn't looking
atoms.detail: Slip the left boot away from Dromund's house while he's distracted.

atoms.label: Telegrab the right boot through the window
atoms.detail: Go outside behind Dromund's house and cast Telekinetic Grab on the right boot through the window while he isn't looking.

atoms.label: Ask Santiri about the battleaxe
atoms.detail: Santiri runs the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim and hands over the ancient dwarven battleaxe.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
2Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.
2Perhaps I can repair the axe?

atoms.label: Socket the 3 sapphires into the battleaxe
atoms.detail: Use the 3 sapphires on the ancient battleaxe now in your inventory.

atoms.label: Talk to Santiri again to confirm the axe
atoms.detail: Confirm the gem-set axe with Santiri before moving on.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.

atoms.label: Ask the Librarian about the Imcando dwarves if needed
atoms.detail: Skip this and the next step entirely if Thurgo was already met via The Knight's Sword.

atoms.label: Ask Reldo about the Imcando dwarves if needed
atoms.detail: Reldo, in the Varrock Palace library, points toward Thurgo; skip if Thurgo has already been met.

atoms.label: Get Thurgo to repair the battleaxe
atoms.detail: Thurgo works at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ); give him an iron bar to repair the axe, with a redberry pie as a possible extra if he hasn't received one recently, then take the option to return to Keldagrim immediately.

hints.value: 2Something else.
3Can you help me with this ancient axe?
1Would you like a redberry pie?
1Return to Keldagrim immediately.

atoms.label: Give Riki the clothes, boots and axe
atoms.detail: Riki, Blasidar's model, receives the exquisite clothes, both boots, and the repaired battleaxe.

atoms.label: Talk to Blasidar and watch the statue cutscene
atoms.detail: Blasidar completes the statue once Riki has the items.

atoms.label: Choose a company and offer to help its secretary
atoms.detail: Pick any company except the Red Axe from the market's upper floor; progress only counts toward the one company chosen.

hints.value: 3Is there anything I can help you with?

atoms.label: Deliver requested ores until the hidden score allows bar tasks
atoms.detail: Each successful ore delivery (5 of a kind is a safe buffer, ores can be noted) gives 20 hidden points, refusals cost 2; ores can also be bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace. Repeat until 75+ points unlocks director bar tasks.

atoms.label: Deliver bars for the director until membership is offered
atoms.detail: Bring unnoted metal bars requested by the director (12 points each); unlike the secretary, click the director again before advancing the dialogue. Continue until 100 points is reached.

hints.value: 3Do you have any more tasks for me?

atoms.label: Officially join the chosen company
atoms.detail: Accept membership when the director offers it, mentioning Blasidar sent you.

hints.value: 2I'd like to officially join your company.
3Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.
1I would support you.
1Yes! Long live the <company name>!

atoms.label: Report to Commander Veldaban to finish
atoms.detail: Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank; you may decline the meeting invite offered afterward.

notes: Sourced from The Giant Dwarf/Quick guide Walkthrough (manifest slug The_Giant_Dwarf_Quick_guide.s2, single fetch of section 2 pulled all 4 subsections inline, 6973B). No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} pins present in the fetched text, so coords[] stayed empty. Atom-level reqs (crafting 12/firemaking 16 on the spin-and-light step, thieving 14 on the boot theft, magic 33 on the telegrab) are cross-checked placements from the held quest_db row's aggregate reqs, applied to the single most plausible atom each rather than independently re-derived from the walkthrough prose. The consortium grind (idx 24-25) has no stated exact delivery counts -- modeled as until:{state:??} rather than a fabricated repeat count. Coal cost for sapphires/gems is '??' (page doesn't state gp).

atoms.label: Talk to Bert in Yanille to get a sandy hand
atoms.detail: Bert lives in the house next to the Yanille POH portal and lends you a sand-covered hand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

hints.value: 2Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?
1Yes.

atoms.label: Buy a beer from the Dragon Inn bartender if needed
atoms.detail: The Dragon Inn pub sits south of Bert's house; skip if a beer is already carried.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Give the beer to the Guard Captain
atoms.detail: The Guard Captain is stationed at the Dragon Inn pub.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell and hand over the sandy hand
atoms.detail: Ring the bell outside the eastern doors of the Wizards' Guild, or enter with 66 Magic, then give Zavistic Rarve the hand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

hints.value: 2I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.
Alternate dialogue option shown if Zogre Flesh Eaters has already been started.

atoms.label: Get Bert's rota from Bert
atoms.detail: Bert hands over his work rota.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Travel to Sandy's house in Brimhaven
atoms.detail: Sandy's house sits south of the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant and north-west of the Brimhaven pub.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Search Sandy's desk for his rota
atoms.detail: Search the desk inside Sandy's house.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Pickpocket Sandy until sand drops
atoms.detail: Repeatedly pickpocket Sandy until a portion of sand is stolen.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Return to Yanille
atoms.detail: Head back to Yanille to continue with Bert.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Get a magic scroll from Bert
atoms.detail: Bert provides a magic scroll for the next step.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Ring the bell and collect the magical orb
atoms.detail: Zavistic Rarve hands over a magical orb.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Accept a teleport to Port Sarim
atoms.detail: Zavistic Rarve offers to teleport you straight to Port Sarim.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

hints.value: 4Can you help me more?
1Yes, that would be great!
Numbering shifts to options 2/4/1 if Zogre Flesh Eaters has been started.

atoms.label: Get a bottled water from Betty
atoms.detail: Betty runs the magic shop in Port Sarim.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

hints.value: 1Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

atoms.label: Mix redberries then white berries into the water
atoms.detail: Add redberries first, then white berries, to make a pink dye; redberries are sold at the southern Port Sarim food store.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

atoms.label: Dye the lantern lens with the pink dye

atoms.detail: Combine breakable nerve endings (fire+water=steam, fire+earth=lava, earth+air=dust, fire+air=smoke) to gather 3 fire, 2 air, 2 earth, and 1 water nerve, then repair the endings in the middle of the room; use air bubbles to regenerate oxygen.

checkpoints.label: Solve the middle floor's four corner puzzles

atoms.label: Talk to Lazim to start the statue-building task
atoms.detail: Approach Lazim, north-east of the Bandit Camp Quarry, and accept the job through the dialogue.

hints.value: Of course! / Okay, I'll get on with it.

atoms.label: Gather 32kg of sandstone for the statue base
atoms.detail: Collect sandstone in any combination of pieces totalling 32kg (weight, not a piece count); big pieces can be broken down with a chisel.

atoms.label: Chisel the 32kg of sandstone into the statue base
atoms.detail: Use a chisel on the assembled 32kg of sandstone and place the finished base on the flat ground to start the statue.

atoms.label: Gather 20kg of sandstone for the statue body
atoms.detail: Repeat the sandstone collection for the body piece, again as a 20kg weight total rather than a fixed piece count.

atoms.label: Chisel the 20kg of sandstone into the statue body
atoms.detail: Chisel the assembled 20kg of sandstone into the body and set it onto the base, then chisel the combined statue to finish shaping it.

atoms.label: Talk to Lazim and choose a head design
atoms.detail: Talk to Lazim and pick any head design for the statue; remember which one is chosen, since a wrong head must be remade.

atoms.label: Mine two 5kg granite pieces
atoms.detail: Mine granite (not sandstone) for the head: one 5kg piece is carved now, the other is carried to the middle floor for later. Ironman accounts mine a third piece of any size for King's Ransom (out of scope here).

atoms.label: Carve the chosen head from a 5kg granite piece
atoms.detail: Chisel one of the 5kg granite pieces into the head design chosen earlier and give it to Lazim to fit onto the statue.

atoms.label: Top up clay or coal if not already carried
atoms.detail: Only needed if not already carrying soft clay or coal: mine some now, since both are needed on the middle floor later.

hints.value: conditional — skip if already carrying clay and coal

atoms.label: Talk to Lazim to fall into the buried temple
atoms.detail: Hand over the finished statue by talking to Lazim, which triggers the fall into the temple below.

atoms.label: Talk to Lazim on the bottom floor
atoms.detail: Talk to Lazim after landing. Optionally climb the ladder and sand pile next to the statue now to unlock exiting/entering the temple from any outer room later.

hints.value: optional shortcut — climb ladder+sand pile now for later outer-room access

atoms.label: Chisel the fallen statue four times for its limbs
atoms.detail: Use a chisel on the fallen statue four times to collect all four limbs.

atoms.label: Talk to Lazim again to retrieve the statue head
atoms.detail: Talk to Lazim a second time to get the fallen statue's head.

atoms.label: Take the M sigil from the pedestal
atoms.detail: Take the M sigil from the pedestal south of Lazim; this step can be skipped and returned to later if short on inventory space.

atoms.label: Collect the R, K and Z sigils around the outer hallways
atoms.detail: Walk the outer hallway rooms to pick up the R, K and Z sigils; the matching limb is automatically used and consumed to open each door.

atoms.label: Head to the centre room
atoms.detail: Once all four sigils are collected, walk to the centre room of the bottom floor.

atoms.label: Place all four sigils to open the centre doors
atoms.detail: Try to open each door with its sigil, completing the dialogue each time.

atoms.label: Climb the ladder to the middle floor
atoms.detail: Climb the ladder up from the centre room to reach the middle floor.

atoms.label: Use soft clay on the pedestal
atoms.detail: Mould soft clay onto the pedestal; cast a fire spell on the frozen fountain first if a water source is still needed for the clay.

atoms.label: Chisel the remaining 5kg granite piece
atoms.detail: Chisel the second 5kg granite piece (carried from the statue build) into a new stone head for the pedestal.

atoms.label: Fit the new stone head onto the pedestal
atoms.detail: Place the newly carved head into the pedestal — the original head is slightly too small, but the new one fits and triggers a cutscene; finish the dialogue.

atoms.label: Feed Pentyn in the north-west corner
atoms.detail: Use bread, cake or pie on Pentyn; right-click again on Pentyn if the food is applied to the spell instead.

hints.value: It's okay, I don't need any help.

atoms.label: Cast a wind spell on the furnace in the north-east corner
atoms.detail: Cast Wind Bolt, Wind Blast, Wind Wave or Wind Surge on the furnace.

atoms.label: Cast a fire spell on the fountain in the south-west corner
atoms.detail: Cast Fire Bolt, Fire Blast, Fire Wave or Fire Surge on the frozen fountain.

atoms.label: Light all six braziers in the south-east corner
atoms.detail: Light the six braziers with their fuels; each brazier needs a specific fuel from logs, oak logs, willow logs, maple logs, a candle or coal — the quick guide does not spell out which fuel matches which brazier, so match by trial and error or a per-brazier hint.

hints.value: exact fuel-to-brazier pairing is not stated on the fetched page — "??"

atoms.label: Pass the magic barrier and climb to the top floor
atoms.detail: With all four corner puzzles solved, walk through the now-open magic barrier and climb the ladder; talk to Lazim if the barrier still won't open.

atoms.label: Cast Crumble Undead on the first boneguard
atoms.detail: Cast Crumble Undead on the boneguard blocking the way to destroy it and open the path south.

atoms.label: Climb down the stone ladder to the south
atoms.detail: Climb down the stone ladder south of the defeated boneguard.

atoms.label: Turn on Protect from Melee
atoms.detail: Activate the Protect from Melee prayer before approaching the second boneguard.

atoms.label: Talk to the second boneguard
atoms.detail: With Protect from Melee active, talk to the new boneguard.

hints.value: Of course, I'll help you out. / Okay, I'll start building.

atoms.label: Take three sandstones from the rubble pile
atoms.detail: Collect three sandstone pieces from the nearby rubble pile.

atoms.label: Patch the southern wall with sandstone
atoms.detail: Use a sandstone piece on the southern wall, then chisel it into place; repeat for all three pieces to complete the repair.

atoms.label: Talk to the boneguard to finish the quest
atoms.detail: Talk to the boneguard again to complete Enakhra's Lament.

atoms.label: Minigame-teleport to the Giants' Foundry
atoms.detail: Use the Minigame Teleport option to travel directly to Giants' Foundry.

atoms.label: Talk to Kovac at the Giants' Plateau
atoms.detail: Speak to Kovac, who is striking a Hill Giant on the Giants' Plateau, to begin.

hints.value: Yes.

atoms.label: Enter the Giants' Foundry
atoms.detail: Walk inside the Giants' Foundry building.

atoms.label: Repair the polishing wheel
atoms.detail: Use the required repair items on the broken polishing wheel; the exact item-to-machine split isn't spelt out — bring the full needed list (oak logs, wool, nails, hammer, chisel, bucket of water or ice gloves).

hints.value: per-machine item split not stated by the fetched text

atoms.label: Repair the grindstone
atoms.detail: Use the required repair items on the broken grindstone.

atoms.label: Repair the trip hammer
atoms.detail: Use the required repair items on the broken trip hammer.

atoms.label: Talk to Kovac twice
atoms.detail: Speak to Kovac twice in a row to proceed.

atoms.label: Search the crate for items
atoms.detail: Search the nearby crate to find items to deposit into the crucible; the crate's exact contents aren't named on the fetched page.

atoms.label: Deposit the found items into the crucible
atoms.detail: Deposit everything found into the crucible (large bucket) hanging east near the bank; different item types are deposited separately.

atoms.label: Talk to Kovac to learn mould selection
atoms.detail: Speak to Kovac, who explains how to pick the correct moulds shown in red text.

atoms.label: Select the forte, blade and tip moulds at the mould jig
atoms.detail: Pick the three correctly-shaped mould pieces (forte, blade, tip) that Kovac described at the mould jig.

atoms.label: Talk to Kovac again to learn pouring
atoms.detail: Speak to Kovac again; he explains how to pour the metal.

atoms.label: Pour molten metal from the crucible into the mould
atoms.detail: Pour the metal from the crucible into the assembled mould.

atoms.label: Cool the poured sword with water
atoms.detail: Fill a bucket from the pile and use it on the waterfall, then pour it on the sword (or use ice gloves instead) — hands must be free to then pick up the preform.

atoms.label: Heat the preform to maximum on the lava pool
atoms.detail: Use the preform on the lava pool; Heat-preform raises heat in small increments while Dunk-preform heats it faster. Aim for maximum (red) heat.

atoms.label: Hammer the preform on the trip hammer
atoms.detail: Hit the preform with the repaired trip hammer, repeating until the progress bar reaches the yellow section; keep the temperature in the red band, since the hammer cools the preform and working outside the right heat band lowers sword quality.

atoms.label: Cool the preform in the waterfall
atoms.detail: Cool the preform at the waterfall until its temperature is almost green; Cool-preform is slow, Quench-preform is faster.

atoms.label: Grind the preform on the grindstone
atoms.detail: Use the preform on the repaired grindstone, repeating until progress reaches the green section; watch the temperature, since the grindstone reheats the preform.

atoms.label: Cool the preform in the waterfall again
atoms.detail: Cool the preform at the waterfall until its temperature is high green.

atoms.label: Polish the preform on the polishing wheel
atoms.detail: Use the preform on the polishing wheel, repeating until the sword is complete; watch the temperature, since the wheel cools the preform.

atoms.label: Talk to Kovac to finish the quest
atoms.detail: Speak to Kovac to hand in the finished sword and complete Sleeping Giants.

notes: Pattern-instance counts: during-x-do-y=5, buy-batch-for-later=16, pickup-en-route=20, progress-until-location=7, leg-loadout-union=11. Dominant patterns: buy-batch-for-later (vendor-stocking consolidation) and pickup-en-route (opportunistic resource gathering). Key insight: the multiquest and Faux guides heavily interleave shopping consolidation (one vendor stop for multiple downstream quest gates) and ground-resource pickup (grabbing consumables while passing through quest locations) to minimize backtracking. Progress-until-location is a critical checkpoint-parking strategy in the multiquest guide (maintaining parallel quest states). Leg-loadout-union groups diverse items for each route segment, minimizing inventory churn. All patterns reflect cost-per-action optimization (fewer banks, fewer vendor visits, fewer zones re-traversed).

checkpoints.label: Investigate the basilisk attack in Rellekka
Craft Lunar glass and V's sigil
Solve the Polishing rock geyser puzzle
Grind basilisks to 100% in the Market
Defeat Typhor and the Jormungand on the Island of Stone

atoms.label: Buy 2 kegs of beer from Thora
atoms.detail: Buy two kegs of beer from Thora in the Longhall before starting the quest, banking them later to save time and reduce weight while running around.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt to start the quest
atoms.detail: Speak with Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall to begin the quest.

hints.value: Do you have any quests? -> Yes.

atoms.label: Talk to Freygerd south of the sandpit
atoms.detail: Walk north from the Longhall to the house south of the sandpit and speak with Freygerd.

atoms.label: Equip the mirror shield
atoms.detail: Wear the mirror shield before approaching the sandpit to avoid basilisk gaze damage and stat drain.

atoms.label: Kill the Basilisk Youngling in the sandpit
atoms.detail: Search the sandpit north of Freygerd's house, then kill the level 53 Basilisk Youngling while wearing the mirror shield.

atoms.label: Pick up and read the Unsealed letter
atoms.detail: Take the Unsealed letter left near the sandpit and read it.

atoms.label: Search the rockslide for the Fang
atoms.detail: Search the rockslide west of Freygerd's house to obtain the Fang.

atoms.label: Search the boxes for the Venom gland
atoms.detail: Search the boxes south of Freygerd's house to obtain the Venom gland.

atoms.label: Give Freygerd the collected evidence
atoms.detail: Return to Freygerd and hand over the fang, venom gland and letter.

atoms.label: Report back to Brundt for the cutscene
atoms.detail: Return to Brundt to receive and read a note, then talk to him again to trigger a cutscene.

hints.value: Ask about the investigation.

atoms.label: Learn how to restore V's shield
atoms.detail: Follow Brundt south-east along the dirt path and go through every dialogue option to learn how to restore V's shield.

hints.value: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield? / Where can I get Lunar Glass? / How do I make the Polishing Rock? / How do I make V's Sigil?

atoms.label: Kill dagannoth for a Fremennik shield drop
atoms.detail: Travel to Waterbirth Island and kill dagannoth until one drops a Fremennik shield (uncommon; not the tradeable Neitiznot shield).

hints.value: Alt gather route: kill Market Guards/Warriors in Rellekka for a rarer drop; a free route exists via Bardur in Waterbirth Dungeon while wearing a Ring of charos(a), but the gp cost without the ring is unstated on the page ("??").

atoms.label: Convert molten glass with Baba Yaga
atoms.detail: Speak with Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle to turn molten glass into molten glass (i).

hints.value: option 3, or 4 if on the lunar spellbook without Ourania teleport unlocked

atoms.label: Mine 3 lunar ore from stalagmites
atoms.detail: Head north-east of Lunar Isle town to the mine and mine stalagmites for three lunar ore.

atoms.label: Craft Lunar glass at the Astral Altar
atoms.detail: Bring 100 astral runes to the Astral Altar and craft the molten glass (i) into Lunar glass, then return to Rellekka.

hints.value: Optional: destroy the Seal of passage and talk to the Oneiromancer for a teleport here; re-obtain the seal later.

atoms.label: Smelt 3 lunar bars
atoms.detail: Smelt the lunar ore into three lunar bars at a furnace (Rellekka's is convenient) or use Superheat Item.

atoms.label: Smith V's sigil on an anvil
atoms.detail: Smith the lunar bars into V's sigil on an anvil (Rellekka's is convenient).

atoms.label: Enchant V's sigil with the Fossegrimen
atoms.detail: Summon and speak with the Fossegrimen at the Strange altar south-west of Rellekka to enchant the sigil.

hints.value: Ask about V's Sigil.

atoms.label: Use the pet rock on the Mountain Camp geyser
atoms.detail: Travel east of Rellekka to the Mountain Camp, follow the path north, inspect the Large Geyser and use the pet rock on it.

hints.value: It's for the good of the Province!

atoms.label: Talk to Peer the Seer in the market
atoms.detail: Return to Rellekka and speak with Peer the Seer south-west of the market.

atoms.label: Equip ice gloves at the geyser
atoms.detail: Return to the geyser and wear the ice gloves so interacting with it is safe (re-equip and retry if you forget).

atoms.label: Inspect the geyser for the polishing rock
atoms.detail: Inspect the large geyser to the west while wearing ice gloves to obtain the polishing rock.

atoms.label: Combine the components into V's shield
atoms.detail: Use the Fremennik shield, enchanted V's sigil with Lunar glass, and polishing rock together while holding a glassblowing pipe to reforge V's shield.

hints.value: The three components (shield / glass+sigil / polishing rock) can be gathered in any order per the wiki; this combine step is the convergence point.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt south-east of Rellekka
atoms.detail: Report to Brundt south-east of Rellekka; if you destroyed your Seal of passage earlier, ask him for a replacement here.

hints.value: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt again in the Longhall
atoms.detail: Return to the Longhall and speak with Brundt a second time.

atoms.label: Equip V's shield before the Market fight
atoms.detail: Wield V's shield before entering the instanced Market to fight basilisks.

atoms.label: Grind basilisks to 100% completion
atoms.detail: Fight Monstrous Basilisks (level 135, 10% each) and Basilisks (level 61, 3.33% each) in the instanced Market until the completion meter reaches 100% (each must be hit at least once for its death to count).

atoms.label: Sail the Fremennik Boat to the Island of Stone
atoms.detail: Board the Fremennik Boat to travel from the Market to the Island of Stone.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt about the cave door puzzle
atoms.detail: Speak with Brundt on the Island of Stone, who explains the cave door (Mastermind-style) puzzle.

atoms.label: Solve the Mastermind rune code-door puzzle
atoms.detail: Solve the cave door puzzle using the feedback checks: a red check means one rune is correct but in the wrong position, a green check means one rune is correct and in the right position.

atoms.label: Equip V's shield for both boss fights
atoms.detail: Equip V's shield and keep it equipped for the full duration of both upcoming fights.

atoms.label: Kill Typhor
atoms.detail: Enter the cave and defeat Typhor (level 218), praying against whichever of Magic or Melee you are weaker against.

atoms.label: Kill the Jormungand
atoms.detail: Defeat the Jormungand (level 363, weak to crush): click to face away when the screen turns red, click repeatedly to break free when frozen in rock, and pray Protect from Magic throughout. There is a checkpoint after Typhor — you may teleport out to resupply and return via Haskell on Rellekka's western-most pier.

notes: Gather-only Fremennik-shield route chosen (kill dagannoth at Waterbirth Island) over the wiki's NPC-purchase option (Bardur, gp cost unstated on page, "??") per no-GE/no-fabrication rules; alt drop source (Rellekka Market Guards/Warriors) noted as a hint. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} coord templates appear in the fetched Quick guide text, so coords[] is empty for every atom.

checkpoints.label: Complete the jester outfit fetch quest
Collect the king's taxes on Jatizso

atoms.label: Talk to Mord Gunnars to sail to Jatizso
atoms.detail: Speak with Mord Gunnars at the northern dock in Rellekka to be ferried to Jatizso.

hints.value: Can you ferry me to Jatizso?

atoms.label: Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV
atoms.detail: Enter the checkered-floor room in Jatizso and speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV; his cat interrupts the conversation.

atoms.label: Use raw tuna on the King's cat
atoms.detail: Use a raw tuna on the King's cat to distract it.

atoms.label: Speak to the King again
atoms.detail: Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV again once the cat is settled.

atoms.label: Give the King the required ores
atoms.detail: Hand over the tin, coal and mithril ores the King asks for; the exact quantity depends on your Mining level ("??" per the page's item-requirements table).

atoms.label: Take the jester outfit from the chest
atoms.detail: Take all four pieces of the jester outfit from the chest behind the King's throne.

atoms.label: Quick travel back to Rellekka via Mord
atoms.detail: Use Mord Gunnars at the southern dock to travel back to Rellekka.

atoms.label: Quick travel to Neitiznot via Maria Gunnars
atoms.detail: Travel to Neitiznot using Maria Gunnars on the dock next to Mord.

atoms.label: Wear the full jester outfit
atoms.detail: Remove any weapon/shield and equip all four jester outfit pieces (hat, top, tights, boots).

atoms.label: Talk to Slug Hemligssen north of the bank
atoms.detail: Speak with Spymaster Slug Hemligssen north of the Neitiznot bank.

hints.value: Free stuff please. -> I am ready.

atoms.label: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar south of the bank
atoms.detail: Speak with Mawnis Burowgar in the building south of the bank to trigger a cutscene.

atoms.label: Follow Mawnis's commands in the cutscene
atoms.detail: During the cutscene, execute the commands Mawnis calls out using the right-side panel.

atoms.label: Return to Slug Hemligssen for payment
atoms.detail: Report back to Slug Hemligssen, who pays 2500 coins for the completed task.

hints.value: Yes I have. / They will be ready in two days. / Seventeen militia have been trained. / There are two bridges to repair.

atoms.label: Talk to Mawnis without the jester outfit
atoms.detail: Remove the jester outfit and speak with Mawnis Burowgar again.

atoms.label: Chop Arctic Pine logs for split logs
atoms.detail: If short on split logs, chop Arctic Pine trees and use the logs on the Woodcutting stumps east of the bank until you have eight split logs (cut two extra now if crafting your own Neitiznot shield later).

atoms.label: Spin yak hair into rope
atoms.detail: If short on rope, kill yaks in the outside pen and spin their hair into rope in the south-easternmost building.

atoms.label: Show Mawnis the repair materials
atoms.detail: Speak to Mawnis Burowgar with 8 rope, 8 split logs and a knife in your inventory, plus one free slot.

atoms.label: Learn the repair method from Thakkrad
atoms.detail: Speak with Thakkrad to learn how to repair the bridges.

hints.value: How do I repair these bridges again?

atoms.label: Turn on Protect from Missiles before repairing
atoms.detail: Activate Protect from Missiles and keep it on throughout the repairs — troll damage stacks and only applies once the repair animation finishes.

atoms.label: Repair the two broken bridges
atoms.detail: Cross the rope bridge north and right-click repair the broken bridges on the east and west sides of the island.

atoms.label: Report the repairs to Mawnis
atoms.detail: Return and speak with Mawnis Burowgar to confirm the bridges are repaired.

atoms.label: Quick travel back to Rellekka via Maria
atoms.detail: Use Maria Gunnars at the south-west dock to return to Rellekka.

atoms.label: Quick travel to Jatizso via Mord
atoms.detail: Travel back to Jatizso using Mord Gunnars.

atoms.label: Talk to the King west of the bank
atoms.detail: Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building west of the bank to start the tax-collection errand.

atoms.label: Tax the four Jatizso shopkeepers
atoms.detail: Collect tax payments from Hring Hring (8,000, south-western house), Skuli Myrka (6,000, north of Hring), Vanligga Gastfrihet (5,000, north of the palace — offering to cover her share unlocks black-market yak trading after the quest) and Keepa Kettilon (5,000, east of Vanligga).

atoms.label: Report the taxes to the King
atoms.detail: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV after taxing the four shopkeepers.

atoms.label: Collect the 1,000-coin tips
atoms.detail: Collect a 1,000-coin tip each from Hring Hring, Raum Urda-Stein (same house as Hring), Skuli Myrka, Keepa Kettilon and Flosi Dalksson (same house as Keepa).

atoms.label: Report the tips to the King
atoms.detail: Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV again once all five tips are collected.

atoms.label: Quick travel back to Rellekka via Mord
atoms.detail: Return to Rellekka using Mord Gunnars.

atoms.label: Quick travel to Neitiznot via Maria
atoms.detail: Travel back to Neitiznot using Maria Gunnars.

atoms.label: Talk to Slug Hemligssen again
atoms.detail: Speak with Spymaster Slug Hemligssen a second time.

atoms.label: Re-equip the jester outfit
atoms.detail: Equip only the jester outfit again before seeing Mawnis.

atoms.label: Trigger another jester cutscene with Mawnis
atoms.detail: Speak with Mawnis to trigger the jester cutscene a second time.

atoms.label: Talk to Slug once more
atoms.detail: Speak with Slug Hemligssen again to receive the next set of instructions.

hints.value: Yes, I am. / They are in a secluded bay, near Etceteria. / They will be given some potions. / I have been helping Neitiznot.

atoms.label: Ferry to Rellekka then Jatizso
atoms.detail: Ferry back to Rellekka and then onward to Jatizso.

atoms.label: Get the royal decree from the King
atoms.detail: Speak with King Gjuki Sorvott IV to obtain the royal decree (keep one inventory slot free or you must repeat the dialogue).

atoms.label: Deliver the decree to Mawnis
atoms.detail: Travel back to Neitiznot, remove the jester outfit, and speak with Mawnis.

atoms.label: Craft yak-hide armour top and legs
atoms.detail: Kill three yaks for hides, have Thakkrad Sigmundson cure them, then use thread and a needle on the cured hides to craft a yak-hide armour top and legs.

atoms.label: Craft a Neitiznot shield at the stump
atoms.detail: Speak with Mawnis, then use two Arctic Pine logs, a bronze nail, a hammer and a rope on the stump in the middle of the village to craft a Neitiznot shield.

atoms.label: Show Mawnis the finished tribute
atoms.detail: Speak with Mawnis again once the yak-hide armour and Neitiznot shield are ready.

atoms.label: Equip the Neitiznot shield and combat gear
atoms.detail: Equip the Neitiznot shield plus melee combat gear before heading to the cave; the shield isn't required to enter or fight but heavily reduces damage taken.

atoms.label: Turn on Protect from Melee en route
atoms.detail: Activate Protect from Melee while running to the cave entrance on the east side of the northernmost isle — the zone is multicombat with both melee and ranged ice trolls attacking.

atoms.label: Talk to Bork Sigmundson in the cave
atoms.detail: Enter the cave to trigger a cutscene, then speak with Bork Sigmundson to receive 10 Tuna, 3 Prayer potion(3) and 3 Strength potion(4) (make sure you have inventory space — you cannot request them again).

atoms.label: Kill ten ice trolls to unlock the King
atoms.detail: Kill ten ice trolls in the multicombat cave until a message confirms you have defeated enough trolls to attack the King.

until.state: defeated enough trolls to attack the King

atoms.label: Turn on Protect from Missiles before the bridge
atoms.detail: Activate Protect from Missiles before crossing the bridge toward the Troll King.

atoms.label: Switch to Protect from Magic for the King fight
atoms.detail: Switch to Protect from Magic for the entire fight and keep it on — never use Protect from Melee, since the King uses a long-range attack.

atoms.label: Kill the Ice Troll King
atoms.detail: Defeat the Ice Troll King using a melee weapon, since it has high Magic and Ranged defence.

atoms.label: Decapitate the Troll King's corpse
atoms.detail: Decapitate the defeated Troll King's corpse.

atoms.label: Return to Mawnis Burowgar to finish

Independent cross-diff of the opp-surface demand graph against classify slice order surfaced FOUR source-after-consumer route-order faults -- raw_monkfish (gather-monkfish after cook-monkfish), ranarr_seed (pps-02-steal-ranarr-seeds after farm-ranarr-patch), volcanic_ash (gather-volcanic-ash after setup-ultracompost), and the coins->pps-04-source-vials edge (ctr-02-kill-cows after pps-04-source-vials) -- which appears to corroborate the pending task 'Fix 4 source-after-consumer route faults from back-prop spike' with a concrete id list; these four are EXCLUDED from the opportunistic-map shortlist rather than weave-planned around, since grounding a broken edge before the routing fault is fixed would be wasted work. 6 opp-surface items (allotment_produce, bones, cowhide, feather, guam_weed, scimitar_best_tier) have no consumer edge and were dropped from the shortlist entirely. 22 raw opp-surface items minus 6 no-consumer minus 3 fully fault-blocked (raw_monkfish, ranarr_seed, volcanic_ash; coins itself survives via its non-faulty ctr-03 edge) = 13 shortlisted, split top-half (ranks 1-7, depth:11) / bottom-half (ranks 8-13, depth:12) matching og-o1/og-o2's split.

checkpoints.label: Travel to Miscellania and greet the King
Ferry the anthem and treaty; forge the giant pen
Grind approval to 75% and report back

atoms.label: Travel to Miscellania
atoms.detail: Take the Rellekka middle dock sailor or fairy ring code CIP to reach Miscellania castle.

atoms.label: Buy mixed flowers from the Flower Girl if needed
atoms.detail: The Flower Girl in the castle courtyard sells flowers individually for 15gp each; skip if already carrying some.

atoms.label: Speak with King Vargas
atoms.detail: Find him on the first floor of the south-west castle and accept the errand.

atoms.label: Make small talk with Princess Astrid until she has nothing new to say
atoms.detail: She is in the room directly north of the King; keep re-opening dialogue until it settles on a neutral farewell line.

hints.value: Prince Brand is an equivalent alternate romance target in the room south of the King: greet him, wait for 'Be still, my heart', clap/cheer emote, agree repeatedly, give flowers, agree, give (not eat) cake, agree, blow-kiss once dialogue reaches 'dear'/'darling', then use a ring on him. Structurally mirrors the Astrid sequence atomized here; not separately atomized to avoid duplicating an identical grain.

atoms.label: Give the flowers to Astrid
atoms.detail: She keeps them; they are not returned to the inventory.

atoms.label: Perform the dance emote inside Astrid's room
atoms.detail: Must be done while standing in her room for it to register with the romance sequence.

atoms.label: Keep agreeing with Astrid's flattering conversation options
atoms.detail: Choose the agreeable/flattering line each time until the dialogue settles back on a neutral farewell.

hints.value: That sounds like a good idea.
What happened next?
I'm quite fond of it myself
And what a great bard he makes!
I suppose you don't have much opportunity to.
It's a lovely little country.

atoms.label: Give the bow to Astrid
atoms.detail: It is not returned to the inventory.

atoms.label: Speak with Astrid again
atoms.detail: Opens the next stage of the romance dialogue.

atoms.label: Use the blow-kiss emote
atoms.detail: Performed in Astrid's room to advance the romance.

atoms.label: Repeat the agreeing conversation until she calls you dear or darling
atoms.detail: Same agreeable-option loop as before; watch for the 'dear'/'darling' line as the exit condition.

atoms.label: Use the blow-kiss emote again
atoms.detail: Second blow-kiss once she is calling you dear/darling.

atoms.label: Give the ring to Astrid to become engaged
atoms.detail: Any ring works except a silver ring or pineapple ring; it is not returned.

hints.value: Exact accepted ring item name is never spelled out beyond the silver/pineapple exclusion.

atoms.label: Cross the bridge east to the Etceteria/Miscellania grounds
atoms.detail: Optionally weed the herb and flax patches outside the Miscellania castle gates on the way past each time -- this can bank roughly 60% approval before the dedicated favour grind later.

atoms.label: Speak with Queen Sigrid upstairs
atoms.detail: Continues the anthem/treaty errand chain.

atoms.label: Return west and speak with King Vargas
atoms.detail: Part of the anthem/treaty ferry sequence.

atoms.label: Return east and speak with Queen Sigrid again
atoms.detail: Continues the ferry sequence.

atoms.label: Speak with Prince Brand to receive the Awful anthem
atoms.detail: He is in the room south of King Vargas.

atoms.label: Have Advisor Ghrim fix the Awful anthem
atoms.detail: He stands next to the King and turns the Awful anthem into a Good anthem.

atoms.label: Take the Good anthem to Queen Sigrid for the treaty
atoms.detail: She trades the fixed anthem for a treaty document.

atoms.label: Deliver the treaty to King Vargas
atoms.detail: Completes the anthem/treaty ferry loop.

atoms.label: Leave the castle and head north to the anvil symbol
atoms.detail: Derrik the blacksmith's forge.

atoms.label: Have Derrik forge a giant nib from an iron bar
atoms.detail: Carry an iron bar before speaking to him.

atoms.label: Use the giant nib on logs to craft a Giant pen
atoms.detail: Combines into the ceremonial pen needed to close the sibling-diplomacy errand.

atoms.label: Return to King Vargas with the completed errand chain
atoms.detail: Closes out the anthem/treaty/pen sequence before the favour grind.

atoms.label: Raise approval rating from 25% to at least 75%
atoms.detail: Any of: buy mixed flowers from the Flower Girl one at a time (fastest but click-intensive, exactly 1,875gp to go from 25% to 75%); rake the herb and flax patches outside the palace walls (weeds respawn ~1 min, world-hopping does not reset the patches but does force weeds to finish growing faster, ~8 min to 100%); mine coal on the north side of Miscellania (~10 min to 100% with high Mining and a good pickaxe); chop maple trees in the centre of Miscellania; fish tuna, lobster or swordfish at the Miscellania docks.

hints.value: Advisor Ghrim reports the current approval percentage on request; the quest log also updates automatically.

atoms.label: Speak with King Vargas once approval reaches 75%
atoms.detail: Completes Throne of Miscellania.

notes: Astrid path atomized as the canonical romance sequence; Brand's mirrored path (clap/cheer emote instead of dance, cake instead of bow) folded into a note hint on the first romance atom rather than duplicated, since the closed schema has no branch{} field and the two tracks are structurally identical. Held row's romance/anthem/pen/favour-grind summary matches the fetched Quick guide closely, no wiki-vs-held discrepancies found. Exact accepted engagement-ring item name and Astrid's first two dialogue prompts (narrated, not {{Chat option}}-wrapped) are unspecified by the source -- left as "??"/note rather than guessed.

checkpoints.label: Descend into the dungeon and repair the lift
Fight through to the final battle

atoms.label: Ask Advisor Ghrim what has been happening in the kingdom
atoms.detail: Fairy ring code CIP reaches Miscellania directly.

hints.value: Has anything been happening in the kingdom recently?
Very well, I'll sort it out.

atoms.label: Talk to your married sibling and watch the cutscene
atoms.detail: Princess Astrid or Prince Brand, whichever was married during Throne of Miscellania.

atoms.label: Talk to King Vargas
atoms.detail: Continues the investigation into the stolen goods.

hints.value: Right away, your Majesty.

atoms.label: Talk to Gardener Gunnhild by the flax patch
atoms.detail: She stands next to the castle entrance.

atoms.label: Talk to Queen Sigrid
atoms.detail: Continues the citizen interviews.

hints.value: Of course, it's my duty.

atoms.label: Talk to Matilda
atoms.detail: She is in or around the southern building inside the castle walls.

atoms.label: Talk to Queen Sigrid again
atoms.detail: Wraps up the interview round before the dungeon.

hints.value: I suppose so...

atoms.label: Gear up at the bank in northern Etceteria
atoms.detail: Bring an antipoison for the boss fight plus 5 coal (or 5 free inventory spaces) for the lift repair; you will not return here until after the boss fight. Do not try to mine coal near Miner Magnus -- it yields no resources, the real coal spot comes later underground.

atoms.label: Talk to King Vargas
atoms.detail: Starts the dungeon-access errand.

atoms.label: Talk to Advisor Ghrim
atoms.detail: Continues the dungeon-access errand.

hints.value: King Vargas asked me to talk to you.

atoms.label: Talk to the Sailor at the Miscellania docks
atoms.detail: Leads toward the runaway-children thread.

hints.value: I'm looking for a sailor...

atoms.label: Talk to King Vargas with one free inventory slot
atoms.detail: He hands over a scroll proving you are Regent of Miscellania.

atoms.label: Enter the dungeon via the courtyard ladder
atoms.detail: Along the castle's south wall.

atoms.label: Talk to Donal in the pub
atoms.detail: He agrees to deal with the monsters below.

hints.value: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!

atoms.label: Take a pickaxe from the rock next to the dwarves, if needed
atoms.detail: Only necessary if not already carrying one for the coal you will need.

atoms.label: Use the mining prop on the crevice and proceed through
atoms.detail: Opens the way further into the dungeon.

atoms.label: Take an engine and fuel it with 5 coal
atoms.detail: The engine is later placed on the engine platform to power the lift.

atoms.label: Take 2 beams, 3 pulley beams and 1 rope from the crates
atoms.detail: Raw parts for the broken scaffold and platform repair.

atoms.label: Combine a beam with a pulley beam to make a long pulley beam
atoms.detail: First combine step of the scaffold repair.

atoms.label: Combine another beam with the long pulley beam to make a longer pulley beam
atoms.detail: Second combine step.

atoms.label: Add a pulley beam, the longer pulley beam, another pulley beam and a rope to the broken scaffold
atoms.detail: Repairs the scaffold structure.

atoms.label: Take 1 more beam and 1 more rope from the crates
atoms.detail: Parts for the platform and the later rope crossing.

atoms.label: Add the beam to the platform
atoms.detail: Completes the platform repair.

atoms.label: Put the fuelled engine on the engine platform
atoms.detail: Powers the lift.

atoms.label: Use the lift and take the plank
atoms.detail: Rides the repaired lift up and collects a plank for the rock crossing ahead.

atoms.label: Enter the tunnel, run east and use the rope on the rock
atoms.detail: Keep running through the character's dialogue as it plays.

atoms.label: Search the fire remains across the cave for all 5 burnt diary pages
atoms.detail: Cross the slippery rocks with the plank between fires and avoid the steam vents, which cause damage.

atoms.label: Read the reassembled diary and continue through the crevice
atoms.detail: Triggers a cutscene before reaching Armod.

atoms.label: Talk to Armod
atoms.detail: Closes out the dungeon chapter.

atoms.label: Follow the passage north and enter the crevice at the end
atoms.detail: Leads into the instanced boss room.

atoms.label: Kill the Giant Sea Snake
atoms.detail: Level 149, 100 HP, poison hits up to 9 -- use Protect from Missiles and attack at range, magic preferred; bring antipoison.

atoms.label: Take the heavy box dropped by the Giant Sea Snake
atoms.detail: Quest-required drop.

atoms.label: Leave the crevice and climb the rope shortcut back to Etceteria castle
atoms.detail: Faster than retracing the dungeon route.

atoms.label: Talk to Queen Sigrid with two free inventory slots
atoms.detail: She hands over a letter and 20,000 coins.

atoms.label: Deliver Queen Sigrid's letter to King Vargas
atoms.detail: Completes Royal Trouble.

notes: Held row's chain (Ghrim -> spouse cutscene -> citizen interviews -> Regent scroll -> lift repair -> diary pages -> Giant Sea Snake -> letter hand-off) matches the fetched Quick guide closely; agility 40/slayer 40/quest-chain reqs already structured in quest_db, not re-derived here. Rope/beam/pulley-beam item counts cross-checked and balance exactly (2 ropes gathered across two crate hauls, 2 consumed: 1 at the scaffold, 1 at the rock crossing).

checkpoints.label: Reach the lighthouse and prepare for battle
Repair the mechanism and open the basement

atoms.label: Reach the lighthouse
atoms.detail: Fairy ring code ALP teleports directly, or use a games necklace/Grouping teleport to the Barbarian Outpost and hop over the rocks north.

atoms.label: Talk to Larrissa
atoms.detail: Accept the errand to help fix the lighthouse.

hints.value: With what?
But how can I help?
Okay, I'll help!
I'll see what I can do

atoms.label: Run east to the second bridge and use a plank on it
atoms.detail: Repairs the first broken bridge span.

atoms.label: Jump the bridge and use a second plank on it
atoms.detail: Repairs the second span.

atoms.label: Talk to Gunnjorn at the Barbarian Outpost agility arena for a key
atoms.detail: Requires the Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl miniquest to be completed to enter the arena.

atoms.label: (Optional) Complete a lap of the Barbarian Outpost agility course
atoms.detail: Counts toward the medium Kandarin diary task; not required for quest progress.

hints.value: optional -- diary task only

atoms.label: Talk to Larrissa again
atoms.detail: Advances past the outpost detour.

atoms.label: Fix the lighthouse's lighting mechanism
atoms.detail: On the lighthouse roof, use swamp tar, a tinderbox and molten glass on the mechanism; the tinderbox is a reusable tool, not consumed.

atoms.label: Sacrifice runes and weapons on the strange wall
atoms.detail: In the basement, use 1 of each elemental rune (air, water, earth, fire), any sword and any arrow on the strange wall.

atoms.label: Open the eastern strange wall doorway and talk to Jossik
atoms.detail: Climb down the ladder beyond the wall puzzle first.

atoms.label: Kill the level 100 Dagannoth
atoms.detail: Safespottable before the Dagannoth Mother fight.

atoms.label: Kill the level 100 Dagannoth Mother
atoms.detail: She cycles her damage-type weakness roughly every 18 seconds through white/air, blue/water, brown/earth, red/fire spells, then orange/melee and green/ranged -- match each colour with the matching attack style.

atoms.label: Pick up the rusty casket dropped by the Dagannoth Mother
atoms.detail: Quest-completion trigger.

atoms.label: Trade the rusty casket to Jossik upstairs for a damaged prayer book
atoms.detail: Choose any one of the damaged prayer books; the others can be bought from him afterward for 5,000 coins each. If no casket was received, Jossik provides one during the conversation.

notes: Held row's summary (lighthouse fix, wall-sacrifice puzzle, safespottable Dagannoth, weakness-cycling Dagannoth Mother) matches the fetched Quick guide exactly, including the agility-35/barcrawl-miniquest gate already structured in quest_db. Single flat Walkthrough section covered the whole quest in one fetch, no per-subsection cache needed.

checkpoints.label: Report back to Jorral and King Lathas

atoms.label: Reach the outpost north-west of Ardougne
atoms.detail: Walk there or use a necklace of passage to teleport directly.

atoms.label: Talk to Jorral to start the quest
atoms.detail: He assigns 3 independent historical leads, completable in any order.

hints.value: Tell me more.
Ok, I'll make a stand for history!

atoms.label: Talk to the Silver merchant in the East Ardougne market
atoms.detail: Ask about the outpost to learn where to dig.

hints.value: Ask about the outpost.

atoms.label: Dig for the buried chest north of Castle Wars
atoms.detail: Requires a spade.

coords.label: Buried chest dig spot, north of Castle Wars

atoms.label: Open the chest with the enchanted key to get a journal
atoms.detail: Reveals Erin's lead.

hints.value: The enchanted key's acquisition point is never stated in the fetched Quick guide text -- modelled as a pre-existing consumed item.

atoms.label: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet
atoms.detail: Needed to understand Droalak.

atoms.label: Talk to Droalak outside the Port Phasmatys general store
atoms.detail: Starts the ghost's lead.

atoms.label: Give Melina a strung sapphire amulet
atoms.detail: She is in the building east of the general store, directly south of the pub.

atoms.label: Talk to Droalak again to receive the scroll
atoms.detail: Completes Droalak's lead.

atoms.label: Talk to Blanin east of the longhall in Rellekka
atoms.detail: Introduces Dron's lead.

atoms.label: Answer Dron's trivia quiz
atoms.detail: He tests knowledge gathered from Blanin and around town: iron mace (weapon), rats (breakfast), kittens (lunch), bunnies (tea), red spider blood (favourite drink), 36 years 8 months 21 days (his age), Fifth and Fourth ages (his study), north-east side of town (house location), Blanin (brother's name), Fluffy (pet cat's name), 12 (5 plus 7).

An iron mace
Breakfast
Lunch
Bunnies
Red
Fifth and Fourth
North East side of town
Blanin
Fluffy
12, but what does that have to do with anything?

atoms.detail: All 3 leads must be complete first.

atoms.label: Talk to King Lathas on the first floor of Ardougne Castle
atoms.detail: Relays the findings to the King.

atoms.label: Talk to Jorral back at the outpost

checkpoints.label: Reach Mountain Camp and accept the search for Hamal's daughter
Cross the wilderness route to the shining pool
Broker peace between Mountain Camp and Rellekka
Secure a new food source on White Wolf Mountain
Defeat The Kendal and bury the daughter's remains

atoms.label: Travel to the Mountain Camp entrance east of Rellekka
atoms.detail: Head to the entrance of the mountain camp, east of Rellekka or north of the ajr fairy ring.

atoms.label: Push past the guard using your rope on the boulder
atoms.detail: Take the path north past the guard, then use a rope on the boulder blocking the way to push it aside and continue.

atoms.label: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain and offer to search for his daughter
atoms.detail: Enter the camp and speak with Hamal the Chieftain, who explains the crisis; agree to search for his missing daughter.

hints.value: Why is everyone so hostile? -> So what are you doing up here? -> I will search for her! (option numbering shifts if The Fremennik Trials is completed)

atoms.label: Dig mud from the pond south of Hamal's house
atoms.detail: Dig some mud from the mud pond just south of Hamal's house; it is used to climb the tall tree ahead.

atoms.label: Take a pole north of Hamal's house if you lack a staff
atoms.detail: If you don't already have a staff, pick up a pole just north of Hamal's house; keep it for the rest of the quest to pole-vault obstacles.

hints.value: optional -- only needed if you don't already have a staff

atoms.label: Follow the path along the lake westward
atoms.detail: Head north from Hamal's house and follow the path along the lake to the west, toward the climbing tree.

atoms.label: Use mud on the tall tree and climb it
atoms.detail: Use the mud on the tall tree to make it climbable, then climb it; you never need to re-mud it for later climbs.

atoms.label: Pole-vault the clump of rocks with your pole or staff
atoms.detail: Use your pole or staff on the clump of rocks ahead to pole-vault across the gap.

atoms.label: Cross the flat stones using your plank
atoms.detail: Use your plank on the flat stones to bridge the gap; keep the plank for the rest of the quest.

atoms.label: Listen to the shining pool and agree to help
atoms.detail: Listen to the shining pool, which explains the situation further, and agree to help it.

hints.value: Hello! Who are you? -> So what exactly do you want from me? -> That sounds like something I can do. -> I'll get right on it.

atoms.label: Return to shore across the flat stone with your plank
atoms.detail: Use your plank on the flat stone again to cross back to the mainland shore.

atoms.label: Ask Hamal about the people of Rellekka
atoms.detail: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain about the people of Rellekka to learn why the camp distrusts them.

hints.value: About the people of Rellekka... -> Why do you hate them so much?

atoms.label: Talk to Jokul north of the Chieftain's tent before leaving
atoms.detail: Speak to Jokul, just north of the Chieftain's tent, before heading out to look for Svidi.

atoms.label: Search for Svidi between Rellekka and the Keldagrim entrance
atoms.detail: Find and talk to Svidi, who is searching somewhere between Rellekka and the entrance to Keldagrim.

hints.value: Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?

atoms.label: Ask Brundt the Chieftain about the mountain camp
atoms.detail: Go to Rellekka and talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall about the mountain camp.

hints.value: Ask about the mountain camp. -> Did it contain vast magical powers? (option numbering shifts if Lunar Diplomacy is started or completed)

atoms.label: Return to the Mountain Camp's southern tent
atoms.detail: Go back to the Mountain Camp and enter the large tent south-west of Hamal the Chieftain.

atoms.label: Mine the Ancient Rock in the southern tent for a rock sample
atoms.detail: Use your pickaxe on the Ancient Rock in the southern tent to obtain half a rock sample.

atoms.label: Optionally mine Rellekka coal for a diary task
atoms.detail: While still holding the pickaxe, optionally mine some coal in the Rellekka mine to progress a Fremennik diary task (requires The Fremennik Trials completed).

hints.value: optional -- Fremennik diary task, requires The Fremennik Trials

atoms.label: Show Brundt the rock sample for safe passage
atoms.detail: Take the rock sample back to Rellekka and talk to Brundt the Chieftain, who grants a guarantee of safe passage.

hints.value: Ask about the mountain camp. (option numbering shifts if Lunar Diplomacy is started or completed)

atoms.label: Give the guarantee of safe passage to Svidi
atoms.detail: Deliver the guarantee of safe passage to Svidi; no need to check back on her afterward.

atoms.label: Report back to Hamal about the Rellekka peace deal
atoms.detail: Return to Hamal the Chieftain and tell him the peace arrangement with Rellekka is complete.

hints.value: About the people of Rellekka...

atoms.label: Ask Hamal about the camp's food supplies
atoms.detail: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain again, this time about the camp's food supplies.

hints.value: About your food supplies... -> Never mind.

atoms.label: Ask Jokul about the White Pearl plant
atoms.detail: Talk to Jokul, just north of Hamal, who tells you of a very hardy White Pearl plant (skip if already spoken to earlier).

atoms.label: Travel to White Wolf Mountain
atoms.detail: Travel to White Wolf Mountain via the Keldagrim minecart system (if The Giant Dwarf is complete) or the Gnome glider (if The Grand Tree is complete).

atoms.label: Equip gloves before picking the thorny bushes
atoms.detail: Equip gloves near the gnome glider so the thorny bushes can be picked without harm.

atoms.label: Pick a White Pearl from the thorny bushes
atoms.detail: Pick from the thorny bushes near the gnome glider to obtain a white pearl.

atoms.label: Eat the white pearl to get its seed
atoms.detail: Eat the white pearl you picked to obtain a white pearl seed.

atoms.label: Give Hamal the white pearl seed
atoms.detail: Speak to Hamal the Chieftain and hand over the white pearl seed to solve the food shortage.

hints.value: About your food supplies...

atoms.label: Speak to the shining pool again to cross to the island
atoms.detail: Speak to the shining pool once more, using the pole/staff and plank as before to reach the island.

atoms.label: Cross back to shore without the plank
atoms.detail: Cross the gap back to shore without using the plank this time, which leaves you closer to the cave.

atoms.label: Follow the northern path east to the cave
atoms.detail: Follow the northern path east until you reach a cave entrance.

atoms.label: Chop the trees blocking the path with your axe
atoms.detail: Chop down the trees blocking the path while facing east to clear the way to the cave.

atoms.label: Enter the cave
atoms.detail: Enter the cave to find The Kendal.

atoms.label: Talk to The Kendal before the fight
atoms.detail: Speak to The Kendal, exchanging dialogue before combat begins.

hints.value: It's just me, no one special. -> You mean a sacrifice? -> You look like a man in a bearsuit! -> Can I see that corpse? -> I humbly request to be given the remains. -> I will kill you myself!

atoms.label: Kill The Kendal
atoms.detail: Kill The Kendal (level 70, melee-only); he can be safespotted using the skeletons around the room.

atoms.label: Take the corpse of the woman
atoms.detail: Pick up the corpse of the woman after defeating The Kendal.

atoms.label: Return to Hamal with the corpse
atoms.detail: Return to Hamal the Chieftain and tell him of your victory and the corpse you recovered.

hints.value: But he's not a god! -> I will.

atoms.label: Get Asleif's necklace from Ragnar
