atoms.label: If you need limestone, mine some.
atoms.detail: Head east through the dense forest, jump the leaves trap, and enter the mine; watch for level 88 dire wolves. Requires a pickaxe.

atoms.label: Return to where you collected the barrels for the small furnace, or teleport to a bank near a furnace (e.g. Falador, Edgeville).
Use limestone on any furnace to make a pot of quicklime.
atoms.detail: Keep gloves equipped or you'll take damage; redo with fresh limestone if this goes wrong.

atoms.label: Grind the quicklime with a pestle and mortar.
atoms.detail: A pot must be in your inventory.

atoms.label: Grind the sulphur with a pestle and mortar.
If you don't already have a strip of cloth, make one.
atoms.detail: Use four balls of wool on the loom at the farm south of Falador, or near the Hosidius house portal.

atoms.label: Travel to Rimmington.
atoms.detail: Coal from the bank can travel noted; un-note it with Phials at the nearby general store once you arrive.

atoms.label: Talk to the Rimmington chemist about your quest.
atoms.detail: The Big book of bangs must be in your inventory or the Quest Journal won't update.

hints.value: Your quest.

atoms.label: Use a barrel of coal-tar on the fractionalising still with 20 un-noted coal in your inventory.
atoms.detail: Leaving the still's interface resets all distillation progress.

atoms.label: Operate the still to distil naphtha.
atoms.detail: Turn the tar valve fully right, wait for the pressure gauge to enter the green zone then set the pressure valve to the middle and don't touch the valves again, then slowly feed coal (2 to start, 1 more whenever the heat gauge falls low). Never add 4 coal at once -- a 'pop' sound just means restart the coal-feeding without exiting the interface; the process can finish using only 4-5 coal.

atoms.label: Make a second barrel of naphtha the same way.
atoms.detail: Needed later for Mourning's End Part I; no sulphur or quicklime required this time.

atoms.label: Combine the pot of quicklime and ground sulphur into a barrel of naphtha.
atoms.detail: Makes an unfused barrel bomb.

atoms.label: Use the strip of cloth on the unfused barrel bomb.
atoms.detail: Finishes the barrel bomb.

atoms.label: Travel back through the Underground Pass carrying the barrel bomb.
atoms.detail: Bringing summer pies is strongly recommended since the bomb is very heavy.

atoms.label: If you don't already have a cooked rabbit, kill and cook one north-west of the Elf Tracker.
atoms.detail: Use the fire at Iorwerth Camp if you lack an axe.

atoms.label: Head to the catapult north of Tyras Camp.
atoms.detail: Buy a tinderbox from the Quartermaster's general store to the south first if you don't have one.

atoms.label: Use the cooked rabbit on the guard near the catapult.
atoms.detail: Distracts him.

atoms.label: Use the barrel bomb on the catapult.
atoms.detail: Destroys Lord Iorwerth's target.

atoms.label: Talk to Lord Iorwerth after firing the catapult.
Attempt to enter Ardougne Castle.
Talk to King Lathas to complete the quest.

notes: Single get --section 2 --strip pulled the entire Walkthrough (all 6 H3s inline, parent-pulls-children pattern), so every atom cites the one Regicide_Quick_guide.s2 slug. Zero {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} templates anywhere in the section -- coords[] empty on all 42 atoms, a fetch-confirmed gap. Held quest_db reqs.skills (crafting 10, agility 56) have no explicit level-gated action named in the walkthrough text (agility only shows up as optional potion/pie boosting for traps), so left off every atom's reqs rather than guessed onto a specific trap/action. The Underground Pass return trip's ~9 individual obstacle bullets were compressed into one composite use-on atom (idx2) with turn-by-turn detail, per the same-zone-navigation-folds-into-action-atom precedent, rather than minted as one atom per obstacle. Coal quantity actually burned during still distillation (4-20) and the exact items handed over per Lord-Iorwerth trade dialogue (idx20) are never stated as fixed numbers on the page -- left as "??" rather than guessed.

steps.label: Talk to Fred the Farmer (start Sheep Shearer)
steps.detail: Fred's house by the sheep pen north of Lumbridge Castle; he supplies shears if you don't already carry any.

steps.label: Shear 20 sheep in Fred's pen
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'fastest route is buying 20 balls of wool' shortcut (flagged GE-violation) -- shear + spin instead.

hints.note: Sheep can slip away mid-shear; keep trying, avoid the horned rams and "The Thing" (unshearable).

steps.label: Spin 20 wool into balls of wool
steps.detail: Spinning wheel in the south bedroom, 1F Lumbridge Castle. Deliveries can be split if inventory space is short.

steps.label: Talk to Fred the Farmer (hand in 20 balls of wool)
steps.detail: Noted balls of wool are rejected -- must be unnoted.

checkpoints.label: Sheep Shearer: start -> shear -> spin -> turn-in

notes: GE-violation FIX applied per queue fix_ids: the wiki's own Introduction recommends buying 20 balls of wool from the GE as the 'fastest' route -- modeled the gather (shear)+produce (spin) alternative instead per the hard rule. Reward is 150 Crafting xp base, +50 bonus (200 total) only if wool is spun rather than bought pre-made -- the GE shortcut also forfeits that bonus xp, a second reason to always model the gather/produce path.

steps.label: Talk to Father Aereck (start The Restless Ghost)
steps.detail: Lumbridge chapel, east of Bob's Brilliant Axes. He points you to Father Urhney as a ghost expert.

steps.label: Go to Father Urhney's house (Lumbridge Swamp)
steps.detail: West through the swamp to a small coastal house.

steps.label: Talk to Father Urhney (get amulet of ghostspeak)
steps.detail: Keep this amulet -- reused across several later quests, per the wiki's own note.

steps.label: Go to the Lumbridge graveyard
steps.detail: Small building in the south-east corner of the graveyard, beside the chapel.

steps.label: Equip amulet of ghostspeak
steps.detail: Required before the coffin will yield the ghost.

steps.label: Search the marble coffin (free the ghost)
steps.detail: Ghost emerges and explains a warlock at the Wizards' Tower stole his skull.

steps.label: Go to the Wizards' Tower
steps.detail: Island south of Draynor Village; climb down the ladder in the room beside the entrance.

steps.label: Search the altar for the ghost's skull
steps.detail: Basement altar, opposite the entrance ladder.

hints.value: leave-room
hints.note: A level-13 skeleton spawns and attacks -- fighting it is not required, simply leave the room with the skull.

steps.label: Return to the Lumbridge graveyard
Use the ghost's skull on the coffin
steps.detail: Completes the quest -- ghost's spirit departs into the river.

notes: No gather/produce items required (ghostspeak amulet + skull both quest-given). Combat requirement is fully avoidable (skeleton fight optional) -- reqs.skills left empty, only reqs.quests-style combat-capability note lives in detail.

steps.label: Talk to Veos (start X Marks the Spot)
steps.detail: The Sheared Ram pub, Lumbridge. Requires an owned spade (Eastfloor spade does not work).

steps.label: Dig at the first clue location (Bob's Brilliant Axes)
steps.detail: From Bob's Brilliant Axes: 1 east, 7 north, 5 west, 1 south, then dig; exact tile "??".

steps.label: Dig at the second clue location (behind Lumbridge Castle)
steps.detail: Tile south-west of the large crate by the Cook's kitchen door.

steps.label: Go to Draynor Village area
Feel the orb and dig at the warm spot (east of Draynor)
steps.detail: Four tiles north of the bush near Leela, NW of the jail, south of the wheat field.

hints.note: Chebyshev-distance hot/cold feedback -- walk and re-feel the orb to home in, same mechanic as Hot Cold Treasure Trails.

steps.label: Decode the cipher and dig in the Draynor pig pen
steps.detail: Caesar-shift cipher decodes to 'DRAYNOR PIG PEN'; dig centre of the pen north of the market.

steps.label: Go to Port Sarim docks (Rusty Anchor Inn)
Talk to Veos (hand in the ancient casket)
steps.detail: Northernmost dock outside the Rusty Anchor Inn.

notes: Dig-spot tiles are relative-direction/landmark descriptions in the wiki prose, not {{Map}} coordinate pins -- all left "??" rather than guessed; a later pass with the page's own {{Map:X Marks the Spot}} template data could resolve exact tiles.

steps.label: Read the notice board (start A Porcine of Interest)
steps.detail: Behind Fortunato's Wine Shop, Draynor Village -- bounty posted by Sarah.

steps.label: Go to the Falador Farm
Talk to Sarah (learn about the cart attack)
Go to the crossroads north of Draynor Village
Investigate the overturned cart and follow the trail
steps.detail: Trail of produce + broken trees leads north-east to a hole by the River Lum.

steps.label: Use rope on the hole and climb down
steps.detail: Cave leads to a skeleton with a note; a Pig Thing then knocks you out -- Spria rescues you.

steps.label: Talk to Spria (get reinforced goggles)
steps.detail: She explains the sourhog's acid attack and gives protective goggles.

steps.label: Return to the Sourhog Cave
Kill the sourhog
steps.detail: Level 37, reinforced goggles required to negate acid attack.

hints.value: own:knife-or-slash-weapon
hints.note: Weak to stab/ranged; a bronze scimitar spawns near the entry skeleton if no knife/slash weapon carried. Immune to poison this fight.

steps.label: Cut the sourhog for its foot (bounty proof)
steps.detail: Knife or slashing weapon on the carcass.

steps.label: Return to the Falador Farm
Talk to Sarah (claim the bounty)
Go to Spria's house in Draynor Village
Talk to Spria (finish the quest)

notes: Rope + knife/slash weapon are owned items (not sourced during the quest) -- reqs stay at atom-detail level, no gather step authored for them since the wiki lists them as pre-quest requirements, not obtainables.

steps.label: Talk to Launa (start A Soul's Bane)
steps.detail: East of Varrock, south of the Earth Altar. She is searching for her son Tolna and husband.

steps.label: Use rope on the rift and climb down
steps.detail: Triggers a cutscene into the instanced rift -- don't click during cutscenes or they replay.

steps.label: Clear the Rage room

hints.value: match-weapon-to-monster
hints.note: Four weapons on a rack each only damage one of four monster types (unicorn/bear/rat/goblin) -- wield the matching weapon per kill, one weapon held at a time.

steps.label: Clear the Fear room (5 fear reapers)

hints.note: Reapers jump from a random dark hole each time; circle the room and search holes until one triggers.

steps.label: Clear the Confusion room (kill the real beast per door)

hints.note: Infobox 'kills' lists 6 confusion beasts as untankable-only, but the walkthrough has you kill the one REAL beast among 5 illusions repeatedly (one door closes per kill) until a single door remains -- exact kill count left "??" pending a reconciled source.

steps.label: Clear the Hopelessness room (5 creatures, 3 phases each)

hints.value: range-attack-preferred
hints.note: Ranged attacks are much weaker than their melee phase-2/3 -- fight from distance where possible.

steps.label: Defeat Tolna's three heads

hints.note: Multicombat room, all three heads attack at once; northern head melees rapidly up close, ranged/magic recommended.

steps.label: Talk to Tolna (return to the surface, finish quest)

notes: Entire quest is one instance -- no bank access mid-run (progress saves per completed room only); rooms modeled per U7 as one semi-atomic 'clear the room' atom each rather than unrolling individual kills, since each room is a single until-condition loop in its own right. Repetition/loot counts genuinely uncertain (confusion room) left "??" rather than guessed from the ambiguous infobox vs walkthrough text.

steps.label: Bank: withdraw Death Plateau loadout
steps.detail: Withdraw: 60+ coins for the dice game (up to 1000 recommended), 10 unnoted bread, 10 unnoted cooked trout, an iron bar, and an Asgarnian ale (or buy one at the Burthorpe pub).

steps.label: Talk to Denulth (start Death Plateau)
steps.detail: Tent south-east of the Warriors' Guild, Burthorpe.

steps.label: Talk to Eohric (learn about Harold)
steps.detail: Top floor of Burthorpe Castle.

steps.label: Talk to Harold at the Toad and Chicken (first attempt)
steps.detail: Upstairs, west side of the pub south-east of the castle. He refuses to discuss the combination.

steps.label: Talk to Eohric again (beer + gambling advice)
Give Harold an Asgarnian ale
steps.detail: Buy or take from the bar downstairs; loosens him up for gambling.

steps.label: Gamble dice with Harold until he offers an IOU
steps.detail: Keep betting until Harold runs out and hands over an IOU.

hints.note: Bets must be 60-1000 coins to trigger the IOU outcome; a Blurberry special/Premade blurb' sp. makes Harold drunk enough to auto-lose every round (optional shortcut, not modeled as required).

steps.label: Read the IOU (reveal the combination)
steps.detail: IOU is replaced in-inventory by the Combination item.

steps.label: Pick up the 5 coloured stones (Burthorpe castle grounds)
steps.detail: Blue, yellow, red, purple, green -- yellow ball sits just south of the green one.

steps.label: Place the stones in the storage-room door (correct order)
steps.detail: Blue bottom-left, yellow bottom-right, red middle-left, purple middle-right, green top-right -- must be done AFTER reading the Combination or the door stays locked.

steps.label: Go to Saba's cave (north-west of Burthorpe)
Talk to Saba (learn of the secret path)
Follow the southern fork to Tenzing's house
steps.detail: Northern fork is the dangerous troll-guarded route -- do not take it.

steps.label: Talk to Tenzing (ask for help)
steps.detail: He wants 10 loaves of bread and 10 cooked trout in exchange, and hands over climbing boots on account.

steps.label: Go to Dunstan (north-east Burthorpe)
steps.detail: Marked by an anvil, north-east of the castle.

steps.label: Talk to Dunstan (learn his condition)
steps.detail: Wants his son inducted into the Imperial Guard, plus an iron bar, before he'll spike the boots.

steps.label: Talk to Denulth (get the induction certificate)
Give Dunstan the iron bar and certificate
Return to Tenzing with the supplies
Give Tenzing the bread, trout and spiked boots

hints.note: Wiki states all 21 items must be handed over in one go -- exact item breakdown beyond the 10+10 food is "??".

steps.label: Walk the secret path east (ignore the troll warning popup)
steps.detail: Exit Tenzing's backyard, over the stile, north then east past the second Mountain Goat; the warning popup is harmless on this path.

steps.label: Talk to Denulth (report the secret path, finish quest)

notes: Ironman iron-bar sourcing has 4 wiki-listed alternatives (smith from ore, spawn locations, dwarf drop, sailing salvage) -- not modeled as separate atoms since the quest item list treats iron bar as a flat owned prerequisite; left for a future ironman-specific pass if warranted.

steps.label: Talk to Doric (start Doric's Quest)
steps.detail: Small house on the crossroads north of Falador, east of the Taverley gate.

steps.label: Gather 6 clay

hints.value: rimmington-mine
hints.note: Clay/copper/iron/tin rocks sit together in the Dwarven Mine south of Doric's house; Rimmington mine (south of Falador) has all three ore types adjacent as an alternate site.

steps.label: Gather 4 copper ore
Gather 2 iron ore

hints.value: mining-15-required-for-iron
hints.note: Iron ore needs 15 Mining; ironmen below that can pickpocket H.A.M. members (uncommon iron-ore chance) or kill sand/rock crabs (drop both copper and iron) instead.

steps.label: Talk to Doric (hand in the materials)
steps.detail: All materials must be turned in at once (12 inventory slots); unlocks free use of Doric's anvils.

notes: No GE mention in the wiki's own route for this quest (mining is the primary path, trading with other players is a secondary option the page itself notes without endorsing GE specifically) -- no FIX flag needed.

steps.label: Bank: withdraw Dragon Slayer I loadout
steps.detail: Withdraw: unfired bowl, wizard's mind bomb, lobster pot, silk, hammer, 90 steel nails, 3 planks, 2000 coins, 10,000 coins (or air+law runes if Magic 33+), anti-dragon shield once obtained, combat gear + food, antifire potions if members.

steps.label: Talk to the Guildmaster (start Dragon Slayer I)
steps.detail: Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Requires 32 quest points to enter.

steps.label: Talk to Oziach (get tasked with slaying Elvarg)
steps.detail: North-west Edgeville, near the Wilderness ditch.

steps.label: Talk to the Guildmaster (ask all follow-up questions)

hints.value: ask-all-four
hints.note: Must ask about the map route, each map piece's location, the ship, AND dragonfire protection -- each answer unlocks a stage; skipping one forces a return trip.

steps.label: Get an anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio

hints.value: drop-trick-for-spares
hints.note: 1F Lumbridge Castle; the drop trick can bank extra spares in case of death during the Elvarg fight.

steps.label: Go to Melzar's Maze
Clear Melzar's Maze (5-key gauntlet) for the first map piece

hints.value: corridor-flinch
hints.note: Sequential room puzzle: zombie rat (red key) -> ghost weak to air (orange) -> skeleton weak to earth (yellow) -> zombies weak to fire (blue) -> Melzar the Mad (magenta) -> lesser demon weak to water, safespottable in the corridor (green) -> open+search the green-door chest.

steps.label: Go to the Oracle (Ice Mountain)
Talk to the Oracle (ask about the map piece)
steps.detail: Only available to ask if the Guildmaster follow-up about Thalzar's piece was already asked.

steps.label: Go to the magic door room (Dwarven Mine, NE)
Use silk, mind bomb, bowl and pot on the magic door

hints.value: any-order-ok
hints.note: Using the wrong item first does not fail the puzzle -- simply leave and return with the missing item, progress is kept.

steps.label: Go to Port Sarim jail
Pay Wormbrain for the map piece
steps.detail: Third cell from the jail entrance. Requires having asked the Guildmaster about Lozar's piece first.

steps.label: Kill Wormbrain and telegrab the map piece
steps.detail: Alternative to paying 10,000 coins: Ranged/Magic attack (5 HP) then Telekinetic Grab (33+ Magic, law+air runes) the dropped piece.

steps.label: Combine the three map pieces into the Crandor map
Go to Port Sarim docks
Buy the Lady Lumbridge from Klarense
steps.detail: Klarense, second-most-southern dock.

steps.label: Patch the hull (3 clicks)
steps.detail: Board the ship, climb down, click the hole 3 times.

steps.label: Go to Ned's house (Draynor Village)
Talk to Ned (sail to Crandor)
steps.detail: Requires the ship already repaired and the Crandor map handed over; triggers the voyage cutscene with Cabin Boy Jenkins.

steps.label: Kill Elvarg
steps.detail: Avoid aggressive skeletons/moss giants/hobgoblins/lesser demons en route to the volcano hole; opens the Karamja-volcano shortcut back afterward.

hints.value: se-corner-flinch
hints.note: Level 83; anti-dragon shield + Protect from Magic mandatory, antifire potions members-only bonus. Weak to stab (melee), water spells (magic, 30% bonus) and ranged. SE-corner flinch spot exists for melee (see wiki image).

steps.label: Return to Edgeville (Oziach)
steps.detail: Teleport out, or exit via the Karamja-volcano shortcut past red spiders and climb the rope.

steps.label: Talk to Oziach (report Elvarg slain, finish quest)
steps.detail: Unlocks purchase/wear of rune platebody, green d'hide body, dragon platebody.

notes: The three map pieces are collectible in any order per the wiki -- kept Melzar->Thalzar->Lozar sequencing (as narrated) rather than authoring a 3-way branch{}, since none of the three gate each other. Wormbrain modeled as a genuine branch{} (pay vs. fight+telegrab) per U9. Ship-purchase price left "??" (wiki elides it with a template placeholder in the fetched text).

steps.label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (start Dwarf Cannon)
steps.detail: South of the Coal Trucks, north-west of the Fishing Guild. Enter the fenced area from the south, or cross the log from the east (20 Agility).

steps.label: Repair all 6 broken railings

hints.note: Inspect (not hammer) each bent railing; failed attempts can cost 1-2 HP or temporarily lower Strength/Crafting.

steps.label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (learn the watchtower is silent)
Go to the watchtower south of the gate
Retrieve Gilob's remains (top floor)
Return the remains to Captain Lawgof
steps.detail: Devastated, he asks you to find Gilob's still-missing son Lollk in the goblin hideout.

steps.label: Go to the Goblin Cave
steps.detail: South-east corner of the Fishing Guild; take the centre passage north-west to the goblin outpost.

steps.label: Search the northernmost crate for Lollk
steps.detail: Room filled with crates past the outpost; Lollk runs back to Captain Lawgof after being found.

steps.label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (accept the cannon-repair task)
Repair the cannon with the toolkit (3-part puzzle)

hints.value: pliers-safety,hook-spring,tooth-gear
hints.note: Fixed order: pliers on the safety switch, hooked tool on the spring, toothed tool on the gear at the base of the hammer.

steps.label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (told to ask Nulodion)
Go to Nulodion (dwarf base, south of Ice Mountain)
Talk to Nulodion (get ammo mould and notes)
steps.detail: Western building of the dwarf base.

steps.label: Return to Captain Lawgof
Hand over the ammo mould and notes (finish quest)

notes: No gather/produce items required beyond quest-given hammer/railings/toolkit -- no GE flag needed.

steps.label: Talk to Lady Servil (start Fight Arena)
steps.detail: South-west of the Ardougne Monastery, NE corner of the Tree Gnome Village maze.

steps.label: Search the chest for Khazard armour
steps.detail: Most north-eastern house of the building group south of the Monastery.

steps.label: Equip the Khazard armour
steps.detail: Required to be let into the prison; do not remove it once inside or guards stop talking to you.

steps.label: Go to the Khazard prison
Talk to Sammy Servil (northernmost east-wing cell)
steps.detail: He directs you to the Head Guard for the cell keys.

steps.label: Talk to the Head Guard (south-east staircase)
steps.detail: Mentions a craving for Khali brew.

steps.label: Buy Khali brew from the Khazard barman
steps.detail: Bar west of the jail's western entrance; requires finishing the head-guard dialogue first.

steps.label: Give the Head Guard the brew (get the cell keys)
Use the keys on Sammy's cell door
steps.detail: Triggers the arena cutscene -- Sammy runs to find his father Justin.

steps.label: Kill the Khazard ogre

hints.value: behind-skeleton
hints.note: Level 63; safespottable behind a nearby skeleton for Magic/Ranged/halberd.

steps.label: Talk to Hengrad (cellmate, between fights)
Kill the Khazard scorpion
steps.detail: Level 44, non-poisonous, closes distance quickly -- same safespot or Protect from Melee.

steps.label: Kill Bouncer
steps.detail: Level 137 hellhound; counts toward Hellhound Slayer tasks.

steps.label: Kill General Khazard (optional)
steps.detail: Level 142; quest progresses identically if you leave via the door's Quick-escape instead.

steps.label: Return to Lady Servil
Talk to Lady Servil (finish quest)

checkpoints.label: Staging a breakout: Khali brew + keys

notes: General Khazard fight modeled as an optional branch{} per U9/U8 (quest completes identically whether fought or skipped).

steps.label: Talk to Gertrude (start Gertrude's Cat)
steps.detail: Her house west of Varrock, south of the Cooks' Guild. Fluffs is missing; her children saw her last.

steps.label: Buy a raw sardine (Gerrant's Fishy Business)
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'seasoned sardine bought from the GE' item note.

steps.label: Gather doogle leaves
steps.detail: South of Gertrude's house.

steps.label: Combine doogle leaves with the raw sardine
Pay Wilough or Shilop for Fluffs' location
steps.detail: Varrock Square -- their secret playground is the Lumber Yard, north-east of Varrock.

steps.label: Go to the Lumber Yard
steps.detail: Climb the broken fence on the south side, then the ladder in the centre.

steps.label: Use bucket of milk on Fluffs
steps.detail: She still hisses -- milk alone is not enough.

steps.label: Use the seasoned sardine on Fluffs
steps.detail: She becomes too afraid to leave -- kittens can be heard mewing nearby.

steps.label: Search the crates for the kitten
steps.detail: Down the ladder; do not drop the kitten or it runs away and must be re-found.

hints.note: The 'Mew!' icon moves between crates but the kitten's actual location is fixed -- keep searching different crates.

steps.label: Use the kitten on Fluffs
steps.detail: Both cat and kitten return home.

steps.label: Return to Gertrude's house
Talk to Gertrude (finish quest)

hints.value: wear-to-choose-kitten-colour
hints.note: Wearing a ring of charos (a) lets you pick the kitten's colour; ironmen should keep the chocolate cake for A Tail of Two Cats and the stew for The Queen of Thieves.

notes: ADDITIONAL GE-violation found beyond the queue's flagged set (only quest-sheep-shearer was pre-flagged for this bundle): the item list's primary suggestion is 'Seasoned sardine (Bought from the Grand Exchange)'. steps.label: Talk to General Bentnoze or Wartface (start Goblin Diplomacy)
steps.detail: Goblin Village, north of Falador, east of Taverley -- goblins want orange armour instead of their usual colour.

steps.label: Search the 3 village crates for goblin mail
steps.detail: Behind the generals' hut, inside the western hut, and up the ladder near the village gate. Dye only 2 of the 3 (1 orange, 1 blue) -- keep the third plain.

steps.label: Kill goblins until goblin mail drops (alternate source)
steps.detail: Village goblins drop red/green goblin mail (dyeable); a plain brown mail must still come from the ladder crates.

steps.label: Buy woad leaves from Wyson the gardener
steps.detail: Falador Park; offer 'about 20 coins' in dialogue for 2 leaves -- the cheapest blue-dye source.

steps.label: Gather 2 onions
steps.detail: Field north of Rimmington, or Farmer Fred's backyard in Lumbridge (next to the sheep paddock).

steps.label: Buy 3 redberries (Wydin's Food Store)
steps.detail: Port Sarim, Wydin's Food Store.

steps.label: Pick 3 redberries (west of Varrock)
steps.detail: West of Varrock's south-east mine -- free alternative to Wydin's.

steps.label: Go to Aggie's house (Draynor Village)
Have Aggie make yellow, red and blue dye
Combine yellow and red dye into orange dye
steps.detail: Must mix the dyes BEFORE using them on mail -- using yellow dye directly on brown mail makes red mail instead, and vice versa.

steps.label: Dye one goblin mail orange and one blue
steps.detail: Leave the third goblin mail plain/brown -- do not dye all 3.

Give the generals the orange mail (rejected)

atoms.label: Teleport toward Tirannwn via Ardougne
atoms.detail: Recommended route: teleport to Ardougne (or use a Catherby teleport tablet) then take the charter ship to Port Tyras to reach elf territory.

atoms.label: Track down and offer help to Islwyn
atoms.detail: Find Islwyn west of Lletya or north-east of the Tyras Camp (world-hop if the elves aren't present) and offer to help him.

hints.value: Tell the truth?
Maybe I could help.

atoms.label: Talk to Eluned

atoms.label: Run past the kitchen and climb the stairs at the dungeon's south end

atoms.label: Talk to the professor upstairs after the cutscene
atoms.detail: He's ready to show you the finished telescope.

hints.value: Talk about the Observatory quest.

checkpoints.label: Reach the Fishing Platform and gather torch materials
Meet Kennith on the upper platform
Rescue Kent from the remote island
Light the torch and save Kennith
Return to shore and report to Caroline

atoms.label: Talk to Caroline in Witchaven
atoms.detail: She explains the Fishing Platform situation.

hints.value: I suppose so, how do I get there?

atoms.label: Talk to Holgart and give him the swamp paste
atoms.detail: He's right next to Caroline; the paste fixes his boat.

atoms.label: Travel to the Fishing Platform via Holgart
atoms.detail: Right-click Holgart and pick the Travel option.

atoms.label: Pick up the broken glass on the floor
atoms.detail: In the hut to the west of the platform.

atoms.label: Pick up damp sticks at the north-east corner of the platform
atoms.detail: They're right by the ladder you'll climb next.

atoms.label: Climb the ladder next to the sticks
atoms.detail: Leads to the upper platform.

atoms.label: Talk to Kennith in the west cabin of the upper platform
Climb back down the ladder to sea level
Travel to the remote island via Holgart
Talk to Kent on the remote island
atoms.detail: Kennith's father.

atoms.label: Travel back to the Fishing Platform via Holgart
Talk to Bailey in the south-west cabin
atoms.detail: He gives you an unlit torch.

atoms.label: Use the broken glass on the damp sticks
atoms.detail: Dries them out.

atoms.label: Rub the dry sticks together to light the torch
Climb back up the ladder
Talk to Kennith again
Kick the badly repaired wall from outside the cabin to make an opening
Talk to Kennith again through the new opening
Activate the crane controls just outside Kennith's cabin to rotate it
atoms.detail: Triggers a cutscene, but only if you talked to Kennith again after kicking in the wall.

hints.value: Make sure the wall-kick + follow-up Kennith talk both happened first or the cutscene won't trigger.

atoms.label: Climb back down the ladder to sea level

atoms.label: Travel back to shore via Holgart
Report back to Caroline

checkpoints.label: Navigate the temple: boots, lava bridge, lever, ice arrows
Fight the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus and cross the lava
Choose a side with the Guardians of Armadyl (good path shown)

atoms.label: Talk to Lucien at the Flying Horse Inn in north-west East Ardougne
atoms.detail: He asks you to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl and hands you his pendant.

hints.value: Why can't you get it yourself?
Yes.

atoms.label: Enter the temple dungeon south of the Ranging Guild
atoms.detail: Climb down the ladder to get inside.

atoms.label: Slash the web downstairs to the west and take the boots of lightness
atoms.detail: Needs a light source plus a knife or slash weapon.

atoms.label: Equip the boots of lightness
atoms.detail: They reduce carried weight by 4.5kg, needed for the lava bridge crossing.

atoms.label: Equip the Pendant of Lucien
atoms.detail: Required to pass through the temple's north gate.

atoms.label: Go back upstairs and through the north gate
atoms.detail: The pendant must be equipped to pass.

atoms.label: Cross the lava bridge
atoms.detail: You must weigh -1kg or less (the boots alone are enough) or you'll fail and take 20 damage.

atoms.label: Open the large door beyond the bridge
Take the lever inside
Cross the lava bridge again to head back
Attach the lever to the bracket on the wall west of the entry ladder
Pull the attached lever
atoms.detail: Triggers hidden machinery somewhere in the dungeon.

atoms.label: Go through the south gate and follow the icy path
Search chests along the icy path for ice arrows
atoms.detail: 16 arrows is enough with Ava's device and 60+ Ranged; re-search a chest right after it drops an arrow since the same chest can hit multiple times in a row, and search every chest to reset them (world-hopping no longer works for that).

atoms.label: Head back through the north gate (pendant equipped) and continue north to a small lever room
Search the lever for traps, then pull it
atoms.detail: Requires 42 Thieving.

atoms.label: Go west then north through the doors
Kill the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus (level 84) with ice arrows
atoms.detail: He spawns automatically when you try the second door; Protect from Magic negates his damage. Requires Ranged 40 to wield the ice-arrow bow; 60+ is recommended for efficient arrow farming above.

atoms.label: Give Winelda 20 unnoted limpwurt roots all at once
atoms.detail: She teleports you across the lava; this is one-way, so ultimate ironmen must be careful not to be juggling items when it triggers.

atoms.label: Optional: follow the path to its end and take the shiny key
atoms.detail: Opens a dungeon shortcut from McGrubor's Wood.

hints.value: Optional — not required to finish the quest.

atoms.label: Push the wall to the north into the Guardians of Armadyl room
atoms.detail: You now choose a side: the walkthrough below follows the good path (siding with the Guardians); the evil path instead has you take the Staff of Armadyl straight off the table, possibly fighting a safespottable level 43 Guardian of Armadyl, then handing the staff to Lucien.

hints.value: Evil-path alternative folded in here rather than atomized separately: grab the staff (may require killing a level 43 Guardian), then give it to Lucien west of the Grand Exchange.

atoms.label: Remove the Pendant of Lucien
atoms.detail: Required before approaching a Guardian of Armadyl on the good path.

atoms.label: Talk to a Guardian of Armadyl
atoms.detail: Convince them you'll help rather than steal the staff for Lucien.

hints.value: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.
Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!
You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.
Ok! I'll help!

atoms.label: Receive the Armadyl pendant from the Guardian in place of Lucien's pendant
atoms.detail: The walkthrough doesn't spell out the exact hand-off, only that you now carry an Armadyl pendant instead.

hints.value: Item swap inferred from the walkthrough's wording change (Pendant of Lucien -> Armadyl pendant); the exact hand-off action isn't spelled out.

atoms.label: Enter the building west of the Grand Exchange wearing the Armadyl pendant
Kill Lucien (level 14)
atoms.detail: Completes the good path and the quest.

checkpoints.label: Retrieve Glarial's pebble from the gnome dungeon
Raid Glarial's tomb for the amulet and urn
Solve the waterfall dungeon and finish at the chalice

atoms.label: Talk to Almera north-east of Baxtorian Falls
atoms.detail: Games-necklace teleport to Barbarian Outpost then head south up the hill to reach her.

hints.value: How can I help?

atoms.label: Board the raft west of the house
Talk to Hudon
atoms.detail: Go through the full dialogue or the book you need next won't spawn.

hints.value: Must exhaust all dialogue options or the Book on Baxtorian never appears.

atoms.label: Walk to the southern end of the island and swim across the water
Enter the large building to the north where Hadley is
Search the southernmost bookcase upstairs on the eastern wall
Read the Book on Baxtorian, then close it again
atoms.detail: Closing it is required or the key needed for the next part won't appear.

atoms.label: Enter the Tree Gnome Village maze

hints.value: If Tree Gnome Village isn't started yet, start it here too to avoid redoing the maze later.

atoms.label: Enter the dungeon at the end of the maze
Search the off-coloured crate east of the dungeon entrance for a key
Go west and unlock the gate with the key
Talk to Golrie
atoms.detail: He gives you Glarial's pebble.

hints.value: Worth keeping the pebble banked afterward — Roving Elves needs it too.

atoms.label: Bank everything except Glarial's pebble, food, and a teleport method
atoms.detail: Anything not "peaceful" (runes) blocks tomb entry; jewellery including combat-bonus jewellery is fine. Keep at least 2 free inventory slots.

hints.value: Ultimate Ironmen: a table in Hadley's building can hold items temporarily instead.

atoms.label: Head to Glarial's Tombstone east of the Waterfall
Use the pebble on the tombstone to enter the tomb
atoms.detail: The pebble isn't consumed by this.

atoms.label: Search the chest to the west for Glarial's amulet

hints.value: You can pick up an extra amulet or two by dropping and re-picking it up.

atoms.label: Go the other way and search the tomb for Glarial's urn
Withdraw 6 air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, a rope, food, Glarial's amulet, and Glarial's urn
atoms.detail: Weapons and armour can come back too if you left them.

atoms.label: Head back to Baxtorian Falls and board the raft again
Use the rope on the rock south across the water
atoms.detail: Do not get in the barrel here.

atoms.label: Use the rope on the dead tree
atoms.detail: Completes the rope route into the waterfall dungeon.

atoms.label: Carry or equip Glarial's amulet and enter the doorway
Take the right path and search the northernmost crates for a key
Go back and take the left side, avoiding the fire giants

hints.value: Killing a fire giant here is a medium Kandarin Diary task, if you want it.

atoms.label: Unlock the door with the key
Place one air, one water, and one earth rune on each of the 3 pillars
atoms.detail: 6 of each rune are recommended as a buffer since checking whether a rune type is already placed uses one up too.

atoms.label: Put Glarial's amulet on her statue
atoms.detail: The ground rises up to the chalice.

hints.value: Do not click "Take treasure" here or you'll be washed out of the cave.

atoms.label: Pour Glarial's urn into the chalice
atoms.detail: Make sure you have 5 free inventory slots; completes the quest.

steps.label: Speak to Elena to begin the quest
steps.detail: Talk to Elena in her East Ardougne house, directly west of the shortcut log, to start the quest and agree to retrieve her distillator.

hints.value: 1I'll try to retrieve it for you.

steps.label: Speak to Jerico
steps.detail: Speak to Jerico in the house just south of the northern Ardougne bank (the house with pigeon cages in the backyard).

steps.label: Search Jerico's cupboard for bird feed
steps.detail: Search the cupboard to obtain bird feed; click continue or it won't be added to your inventory.

steps.label: Take a pigeon cage from the backyard
steps.detail: Grab a pigeon cage from Jerico's backyard.

steps.label: Walk to the West Ardougne watchtower
steps.detail: Go south-west of Ardougne Castle to speak with Omart, then north to the small watchtower in front of the West Ardougne gates and stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.

steps.label: Distract the watchtower guard with bird feed
steps.detail: Use bird feed on the watchtower fence to lure the guard's attention.

steps.label: Open the pigeon cage
steps.detail: Click open on the pigeon cage in your inventory while the guard is distracted.

steps.label: Equip the gas mask
steps.detail: Equip your gas mask before crossing into West Ardougne.

steps.label: Cross into West Ardougne with Omart
steps.detail: Run south from the watchtower and speak to Omart; after a short delay you arrive in West Ardougne.

hints.value: 1Ok, lets do it.

steps.label: Squeeze into the Mourner HQ backyard
steps.detail: Head around the Mourner Headquarters to the north-eastern area with the vat and mangle, then squeeze through the fence into the backyard.

steps.label: Pick up the rotten apple
steps.detail: Pick up the rotten apple in the backyard.

steps.label: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron
steps.detail: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron, then squeeze back through the fence.

steps.label: Walk to Nurse Sarah's house
steps.detail: Go to Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the West Ardougne church.

steps.label: Search the cupboard for a medical gown
steps.detail: Search the cupboard in the northern part of the house for a medical gown.

steps.label: Equip the medical gown
steps.detail: Equip the medical gown, go back to the Mourner Headquarters and open the door.

steps.label: Kill a mourner upstairs
steps.detail: Go upstairs inside the headquarters and kill a mourner; a key is placed in your inventory automatically.

steps.label: Unlock the caged room
steps.detail: Use the key on the gate to get into the caged room.

steps.label: Search the crate for the distillator
steps.detail: Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator.

steps.label: Return the distillator to Elena
steps.detail: With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the Plague City sewers).

steps.label: Walk to the Rimmington chemist
steps.detail: Go to the chemist in south-western Rimmington (ship from Captain Barnaby at the Ardougne Dock for 30gp, or teleport).

steps.label: Get the touch paper from the chemist
steps.detail: Speak to the Chemist about your quest; he gives you the touch paper.

hints.value: 2Your quest.

steps.label: Give Chancy the liquid honey
steps.detail: Find Chancy, Da Vinci and Hops around a fire outside the Chemist's house and give Chancy the vial of liquid honey.

hints.value: 2You give him the vial of liquid honey...

steps.label: Give Da Vinci the ethenea
steps.detail: Give Da Vinci the vial of ethenea. Giving any henchman the wrong vial forces you to redo the round with all three in Varrock before retrying.

hints.value: 1You give him the vial of ethenea...

steps.label: Give Hops the sulphuric broline
steps.detail: Give Hops the vial of sulphuric broline.

hints.value: 3You give him the vial of sulphuric broline...

steps.label: Walk to the fenced area south-east of Varrock bank
steps.detail: Teleport or travel to Varrock and head to the fenced area south-east of the bank; the guard searches you but lets the plague sample and touch paper through.

steps.label: Get a free priest gown from Asyff (optional)
steps.detail: (Optional) Speak to Asyff, the Fancy Dress Shop owner, in the building south-east for a free priest gown top and bottom, or buy one from him.

steps.label: Equip the priest gown
steps.detail: Equip the priest gown top and bottom.

steps.label: Walk to the Dancing Donkey Inn
steps.detail: Head to the Dancing Donkey Inn to reclaim the vials.

steps.label: Reclaim the vial from Hops
steps.detail: Talk to Hops to get the processed vial back; make sure you have free inventory space. Do not pass back through the Varrock gate or the vials are confiscated and you must get new samples from Elena.

steps.label: Reclaim the vial from Da Vinci
steps.detail: Talk to Da Vinci to get the processed vial back.

steps.label: Reclaim the vial from Chancy
steps.detail: Talk to Chancy to get the processed vial back.

steps.label: Walk to Guidor's house
steps.detail: With the priest gown equipped, head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.

steps.label: Deliver the sample to Guidor
steps.detail: Speak to Guidor and tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed.

hints.value: 1I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.

steps.label: Report back to Elena
steps.detail: Return to Ardougne and speak to Elena.

steps.label: Walk to King Lathas' floor in Ardougne Castle
steps.detail: Go to the first floor of Ardougne Castle.

steps.label: Report to King Lathas to finish
steps.detail: Speak to King Lathas to complete the quest.

hints.value: 1I don't understand...

checkpoints.label: Sneak the gas mask past the watchtower
Infiltrate Mourner HQ for the distillator
Fetch touch paper from the Rimmington chemist
Deliver plague-sample vials to the chemist's henchmen
Reclaim the vials at the Dancing Donkey Inn
Deliver evidence to Guidor and report to King Lathas

steps.label: Talk to Ceril Carnillean to start Hazeel Cult
steps.detail: Ceril Carnillean is on the ground floor of his house south-west of East Ardougne castle. Ask what's wrong and agree to help.

hints.value: What's wrong? / Yes.

steps.label: Enter the Ardougne sewers
steps.detail: Sewer entrance is east of the East Ardougne clocktower, south of Valve 3.

steps.label: Talk to Clivet and refuse to help revive Hazeel
steps.detail: Clivet explains Hazeel's history and asks for help reviving him; choose to refuse. He sails off on a raft.

hints.value: I won't help you.
hints.note: Player's own side-choice, not a requisite gate.

steps.label: Turn all 5 sewer valves (Ceril route)
steps.detail: Valve 1 (across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house): right. Valve 2 (behind the house): right. Valve 3 (north of the cave): left. Valve 4 (south of the zoo penguin cage): right. Valve 5 (south-east of valve 4, past the monk): right.

steps.label: Kill Alomone in the cave hideout
steps.detail: Board the raft to the southernmost room and talk to Alomone; he reveals the butler is a cultist, then attacks.

steps.label: Search the chest for Carnillean armour
steps.detail: Open the chest in Alomone's room. Extra pieces are obtainable via the drop trick, but only during the quest.

steps.label: Return the armour to Ceril Carnillean
steps.detail: Board the raft back to the entrance, return to the Carnilleans' house and hand over the armour. This is a fake ending screen -- the real reward comes next.

steps.label: Search the upstairs cupboard for evidence
steps.detail: Search the cupboard on the first floor of the Carnilleans' house to find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison -- evidence against Butler Jones.

steps.label: Show Ceril the evidence to finish Hazeel Cult
steps.detail: Show Ceril the Mark of Hazeel and poison bottle; he fires Butler Jones and gives the real quest reward.

steps.label: Talk to Clivet and accept helping revive Hazeel
steps.detail: Free up an inventory slot first. Clivet explains Hazeel's history and asks for help; accept. He gives a bottle of poison and asks you to poison Ceril's food.

hints.value: Alright, how do I do it?
hints.note: Player's own side-choice, not a requisite gate.

steps.label: Turn sewer valves 1 and 2 (Hazeel route)
steps.detail: Valve 1 (across the bridge south of the house): right. Valve 2 (behind the house): right.

steps.label: Poison the cooking range in Ceril's basement
steps.detail: Go to the basement of the Carnilleans' house and use the bottle of poison on the cooking range.

steps.label: Talk to Ceril upstairs about the accident
steps.detail: Ceril reveals his son fed the poisoned meal to Scruffy the family dog instead of him.

steps.label: Talk to Clivet to receive Hazeel's mark
steps.detail: Clivet accepts the accidental dog-poisoning as proof of loyalty and gives you Hazeel's mark, then directs you to meet Alomone.

steps.label: Turn sewer valves 3, 4 and 5 (Hazeel route)
steps.detail: Valve 3 (north of the cave): left. Valve 4 (south of the zoo penguin cage): right. Valve 5 (south-east of valve 4, past the monk): right.

steps.label: Talk to Alomone in the hideout
steps.detail: Board the raft to the main hideout and talk to Alomone. He asks you to help the Carnilleans' butler retrieve a magical scroll from the house.

steps.label: Talk to Butler Jones in the Carnilleans' house
steps.detail: Butler Jones believes the scroll is hidden where the family won't find it.

steps.label: Search the basement crate for a chest key
steps.detail: Search the crate in the basement; finish the dialogue fully or the key won't be added to your inventory.

steps.label: Retrieve the scroll of restoration
steps.detail: Go up the ladder then the stairs, knock on the wall in the east room's north side, go up the ladder again, then unlock and search the chest.

steps.label: Return the scroll to Alomone to finish Hazeel Cult
steps.detail: Deliver the scroll of restoration to Alomone, starting Hazeel's resurrection and completing the quest.

notes: Two mutually-exclusive side branches (alt_group qhc-side) share the same id numbering (qhc-03..qhc-09/13) since only one branch is ever active in a real playthrough -- both carry branch.optional:false because the QUEST itself always requires picking exactly one side, not because either is skippable. Both branches turn the same 5 valves in the same directions (right,right,left,right,right); the Hazeel route just splits the turning into two batches (1-2, then 3-4-5) around the poisoning detour. Reward split (5 extra coins vs Hazeel's mark) is cited from Rewards (s7) rather than guessed. No {{Map}} coord templates were present in any fetched section; coords stayed on the location object only (region/zone), no coords[] array populated.

steps.label: Talk to the Strange Old Man at the Barrows
steps.detail: He wanders the Barrows mounds east of Mort'ton and asks you to retrieve an icon guarded by the Barrows Brothers for an unnamed entity.

steps.label: Defeat all six Barrows Brothers
steps.detail: Verac the Defiled, Dharok the Wretched, Ahrim the Blighted, Torag the Corrupted, Karil the Tainted and Guthan the Infested must all be killed in one crypt run before the chest can be opened.

hints.value: keep:6-free-slots
hints.note: Leave at least 6 inventory spaces open before searching the chest -- the strange icon will not drop to the ground, and a full inventory means refighting all six brothers.

steps.label: Search the Barrows chest for the strange icon
steps.detail: Open the reward chest after all six brothers are dead.

steps.label: Return the strange icon to the Strange Old Man
steps.detail: Completes the miniquest.

notes: Short 4-atom miniquest, single checkpoint (no bank-loadout atom authored since the page's own 'items' field is just 'combat equipment + spade' -- generic loadout, not itemised enough to warrant a withdraw atom). Dusty lamp grants 20,000 Prayer xp per Rewards (s3) -- left as a produces entry rather than an xp/grants field per the reused questatoms precedent. Required-for (s4, Desert Treasure II) is a downstream consumer, not a prerequisite -- noted here, not modelled as a reqs.quests entry.

steps.label: Bank: withdraw the Icthlarin's Little Helper loadout
steps.detail: Withdraw a cat/kitten, tinderbox, willow log, bag of salt (or empty bucket), bucket of sap, a full waterskin(4), linen, and your chosen desert-entry method.

steps.label: Talk to the Wanderer about your cat
steps.detail: She is north-east of Sophanem, near the Agility Pyramid, and objects to your cat.

hints.value: Why? What's your problem with it? / Ok I'll get your supplies.

steps.label: Give the Wanderer a tinderbox and waterskin(4)
steps.detail: Hand over the requested supplies.

hints.value: Yes. I have them all here.

steps.label: Enter the pyramid
steps.detail: Touch the door of the pyramid; you black out and wake up inside for the first flashback.

steps.label: Navigate the trapped corridor via the minimap
steps.detail: Click the minimap rather than the main viewport to auto-avoid the aggressive level-84 mummies and poison scarabs.

steps.label: Jump the pit (first crossing)
steps.detail: Requires at least 20% run energy; higher Agility raises the success chance.

hints.note: Success chance scales with Agility level; exact rate not sourced.

steps.label: Solve the golden bird puzzle
steps.detail: West of the pit: click the golden bird to reset it until it lands on the pictured solution, then click the indicated tiles.

steps.label: Answer the Sphinx's riddle
steps.detail: Drop your cat first, then ask the Sphinx for help. Riddle answer: 9. Wrong answers make the cat disappear.

hints.value: I need help. / 9. / Totally positive.

steps.label: Talk to the High Priest
steps.detail: He is south-west of the Sphinx.

steps.label: Re-enter the pyramid for the second flashback
steps.detail: Open the door and jump the pit again to trigger it.

steps.label: Take the canopic jar from the western room
steps.detail: Open the western door directly south and take back the correct canopic jar -- only the right one can be picked up.

steps.label: Defeat the guardian apparition
steps.detail: A level 75-81 apparition (Apmeken/Crondis/Scabaras/Het, matched to the jar taken) appears and must be killed before the jar can be kept.

hints.note: Which of the four guardians appears is fixed per-account by the jar taken, not random per attempt; combat style needed varies (magic vs melee).

steps.label: Return the jar and re-solve the door puzzle
steps.detail: Leave the room, jump the pit both ways, solve the western door puzzle again, and drop the jar back where it was found.

steps.label: Exit the pyramid
steps.detail: Jump the pit once more and leave via the entrance ladder.

steps.label: Agree to help prepare the ceremony
steps.detail: Talk to the High Priest back in Sophanem.

hints.value: Sure, no problem.

steps.label: Give the Embalmer linen, salt and sap
steps.detail: House south of the church, south of Sophanem.

steps.label: Buy linen from Raetul if missing
steps.detail: Raetul runs the Spinning Wheel shop north-east of the Embalmer's house; 30 coins per linen. Ask the Embalmer where to find linen first, or Raetul won't sell it.

steps.label: Give the Carpenter your willow logs
steps.detail: East of the Embalmer's house. He returns a holy symbol.

steps.label: Re-enter the pyramid for the third flashback
steps.detail: Right-click open the door and jump the pit again.

steps.label: Use the holy symbol on a sarcophagus

notes: 7 independent council-vote trials (order-free, modeled in the wiki's own listed order: Manni, Olaf, Sigli, Sigmund, Swensen, Thorvald, Peer) plus start/turn-in -- largest atom count in this bundle (53) because each trial is functionally its own mini-quest. Sigmund's trial is a 12-NPC reverse-delivery fetch chain, modeled as 12 separate talk-to atoms (each is a genuine quest-state change per U5) collapsed into ONE final delivery atom (U1: mechanical hand-offs with no player decisions, same semi-atomic treatment as A Soul's Bane's rooms). Olaf's lyre-crafting vs. monster-drop and raw-fish-buy-vs-fish-yourself are both modeled as branch{} per U9, non-GE (Rufus' Meat Emporium/Poison Salesman are named NPC vendors, not the Grand Exchange). Peer's riddle answer and water-puzzle sequence are semi-atomic per U7 (single continuous puzzle, no serialized sub-steps). No GE-violation in this quest despite complexity -- confirmed no bare 'Grand Exchange' item-buy language anywhere in the fetched page.
