steps.detail: Pick a second one now to save a return trip for Shadow of the Storm.

steps.label: Pick up the strange implement (north-western corner of the temple)
Go to the Digsite (talk to Elissa)
steps.detail: North-eastern corner of the Digsite; fastest via digsite pendant or gnome glider.

steps.label: Talk to Elissa about the letter (learn of Varmen's notes)
Search the Exam Centre's south-eastern bookshelf for Varmen's notes
Return to Elissa (ask where the statuette went)
steps.detail: Points to the Varrock Museum.

steps.label: Pickpocket Curator Haig Halen for the display cabinet key
steps.detail: Varrock Museum ground floor; 25 Thieving.

steps.label: Unlock Display Case 30 and take the statuette
steps.detail: Upstairs, first row, fourth case. Re-use the key on the empty cabinet if the statuette is lost.

steps.label: Return to the Ruins of Uzer
Use the statuette on the alcove and turn all 4 statues to face the doors
steps.detail: East statues face right, west statues face left, all facing north toward the double doors.

steps.label: Use chisel and hammer on the throne (2 rubies, 2 emeralds, 2 sapphires)
steps.detail: Optional bonus loot, not required for the quest.

steps.label: Grind the black mushroom into black dye (pestle and mortar)
Use the phoenix feather on the ink, then on the papyrus (write the Golem program)
Use the strange implement then the golem program on the golem (finish quest)

checkpoints.label: Returning to Uzer: statuette puzzle + program

notes: PRE-FLAGGED GE-violation FIX target -- checked directly, zero Grand Exchange mentions on the page. Papyrus (10gp, Ali Morrisane) is a named-NPC buy, not GE. No FIX modeling needed -- false positive.

steps.label: Talk to the Squire (start The Knight's Sword)
steps.detail: Courtyard of the White Knights' Castle, Falador. He lost Sir Vyvin's ceremonial sword.

steps.label: Talk to Reldo (learn of Thurgo the Imcando dwarf)
steps.detail: Varrock Palace library, ground floor. Skip if The Giant Dwarf is already complete.

steps.label: Cook a redberry pie
steps.detail: Pie dish from the Varrock Palace kitchen, redberries just west of the South-east Varrock mine. 10 Cooking.

steps.label: Go to Thurgo's hut (Mudskipper Point, south of Port Sarim)
Give Thurgo the redberry pie (ask about a special sword)
Search Sir Vyvin's cupboard for the portrait
steps.detail: Upper floor of the White Knights' Castle; wait for Sir Vyvin to leave the room or hop worlds.

hints.value: hop-worlds
hints.note: He blocks the search if inside and facing you.

steps.label: Give Thurgo the portrait
Mine 1-3 blurite ore (Asgarnian Ice Dungeon)
steps.detail: All enemies aggressive -- run past pirates north then east to the icy room; safespot in front of the wyvern-section entrance. 10 Mining. Mine 2-3 for Falador Diary/an extra sword.

steps.label: Give Thurgo the iron bars and blurite ore (craft the sword)
steps.detail: Ask for a replacement after dropping the first if you want your own blurite sword.

steps.label: Give the Squire the blurite sword (finish quest)

checkpoints.label: Acquiring the picture: Sir Vyvin's portrait

notes: PRE-FLAGGED GE-violation FIX target -- checked directly, the only 'Grand Exchange' hit is 'Ring of wealth to Grand Exchange' as a members' fast-travel option to Varrock, not an item purchase. No item in this quest's own list is sourced via GE (iron bars: mine+smith or several non-GE drop/spawn alternatives per the wiki's own ironman notes; redberry pie: cooked). No FIX modeling needed -- false positive.

steps.label: Talk to King Bolren (start Tree Gnome Village)
steps.detail: Centre of the Tree Gnome Village maze, south-east of East Ardougne. Three orbs of protection have been stolen by Khazard troops.

steps.label: Gather 6 normal logs (or kill goblins for them)
steps.detail: Chop with an axe, kill maze goblins for spawns, or retrieve stored logs from the canoe station near the north entrance.

steps.label: Talk to Commander Montai (give the 6 logs)
steps.detail: North of the maze at the battlefield; wears red clothing.

steps.label: Talk to Commander Montai again (learn 3 trackers are missing)
Talk to the first tracker gnome (get a coordinate)
steps.detail: Behind/beside the biggest north-west building.

steps.label: Talk to the second tracker gnome (Khazard Prison Cell, get a coordinate)
steps.detail: North-east building.

steps.label: Talk to the third tracker gnome (decode the riddled coordinate)
steps.detail: Roaming outside the south-west stronghold corner; driven mad, gives a riddle instead of a number.

hints.note: Riddled number 1-4, e.g. 'less than my hands'=1, 'more than my head less than my fingers'=2.

steps.label: Fire the ballista using the third tracker's coordinate
steps.detail: South-west corner of the battlefield (not the catapult next to Montai); retry if you miss.

steps.label: Talk to Commander Montai (proceed to the stronghold)
Fight through the stronghold to the chest (2 level-48 Khazard commanders, optional)
steps.detail: Low HP (22 each); both fights can be skipped by simply running past them to the chest.

hints.value: northern-broken-chair
hints.note: Optional fight; skip both and head straight to the ladder/chest if you prefer.

steps.label: Search the chest for the first orb of protection
Talk to King Bolren (report; learn the Warlord has the other two orbs)
steps.detail: Return via Elkoy at the north-west maze entrance.

steps.label: Kill the Khazard warlord (level 112, drops the last 2 orbs)
steps.detail: North past the stronghold, near the West Ardougne wall; 170 HP. Unaggressive until spoken to.

hints.value: west-ardougne-wall-flinch
hints.note: Ranged/Magic can wedge him against the wall near the large dead tree; melee flinch also works at the large skull to the south.

steps.label: Talk to King Bolren (hand over all 3 orbs, finish quest)

checkpoints.label: Getting started: repair defences, find trackers

notes: No gather/produce items sourced from GE -- logs are chopped/looted, no vendor purchases in this quest. Optional stronghold-guard fights modeled with an until:'??' (wiki doesn't commit to an exact skip condition beyond 'you can skip defeating the commander'), left honest rather than invented.

steps.label: Talk to Morgan (start Vampyre Slayer)
steps.detail: His house just north of Ned's in Draynor Village. Search the upstairs cupboard for garlic if not already carried.

steps.label: Go to the Blue Moon Inn (Varrock)
Talk to Dr Harlow (he wants a drink first)
Buy a beer from the bartender
Give Dr Harlow the beer (receive the stake and advice)
steps.detail: He advises the stake, a hammer to drive it in, and that vampyres dislike garlic.

steps.label: Buy a hammer (Varrock General Store)
Go to Draynor Manor
Kill Count Draynor (level 34, in the coffin room)
steps.detail: Open the coffin in the centre of the east basement room to start the fight. Garlic deals 10 dmg + debuffs his stats on first hit; without a hammer you cannot finish the kill. He heals to full and resets if the fight drags on too long.

hints.value: sw-corner-skeleton
hints.note: South-western corner between the staircase and skeleton; Magic recommended if flinching, since he regenerates ~6x normal rate.

steps.label: Automatically stake Count Draynor (quest completes on the kill)

checkpoints.label: The vampyre threat: Morgan + Dr Harlow

notes: No GE mentions. Beer/hammer are cheap named-vendor buys (bartender, Varrock General Store), well within gather-not-GE. No count-draynor kill count uncertainty -- single fixed kill.

steps.label: Talk to Almera (start Waterfall Quest)
steps.detail: House north-east of Baxtorian Falls; worried about her son Hudon across the river.

steps.label: Board the log raft (crash onto the small island)
Talk to Hudon (finish all dialogue)
steps.detail: He refuses to leave; complete every dialogue line or the book won't spawn downstream.

steps.label: Swim south (wash ashore near the fisherman's building)
Search the southernmost bookcase (get the book on Baxtorian)
steps.detail: Eastern wall, upstairs.

steps.label: Read the book on Baxtorian
steps.detail: Reveals Glarial's pebble is hidden under Tree Gnome Village. Must be read or the key won't appear later.

steps.label: Go to the Tree Gnome Village maze
Find the key in the east room of the maze basement
steps.detail: Slightly different-coloured crate next to the two stacked crates, south-east corner.

steps.label: Unlock the door and talk to Golrie (receive Glarial's pebble)
steps.detail: West room. Use the drop trick here for spare pebbles if planning Roving Elves later.

steps.label: Go to Glarial's Tomb (south-east of Baxtorian Falls)
steps.detail: Bank any prohibited items first (weapons, armour, capes, runes, arrows, logs) -- strict item restrictions inside.

steps.label: Use Glarial's pebble on the tombstone (enter the tomb)
Search the western chest for Glarial's amulet (past the moss guardians)
steps.detail: Attack a lower-level skeleton/zombie first to avoid aggroing the level-84 moss guardians in this single-combat area.

steps.label: Search the southern coffin for Glarial's urn
steps.detail: You cannot act while searching the coffin, but can still be attacked. Drop trick for spares recommended at low levels.

steps.label: Return to Almera's house and board the raft again
Use rope on the grey rock (small patch of land downstream)
steps.detail: Do not swim or touch the tree without the rope prepared first.

steps.label: Use rope on the dead tree and climb it
Kill a Fire Giant (level 86, optional Kandarin Diary task)
steps.detail: Single-combat cavern; attacking a shadow spider instead prevents Fire Giants from engaging if skipping this.

steps.label: Search the crates in the eastern passage for a key
steps.detail: Room with level-16 skeleton mages.

steps.label: Place air, water and earth runes on each of the 6 pillars
steps.detail: Follow the order carefully -- misplaced runes wash you out or deal up to 20 damage.

steps.label: Use Glarial's amulet on the Statue of Glarial
steps.detail: Warning: any item dropped in the pillar chamber becomes unretrievable after this.

steps.label: Use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity (finish the dialogue)
Take the reward from the chalice (5 free inventory slots required)

checkpoints.label: Searching for treasure: Almera + Hudon + the book
The Chalice of Eternity: pillar puzzle + reward

notes: No GE mentions in the walkthrough itself -- the only 'Grand Exchange' hit is a Spirit Tree fast-travel note (post-Tree Gnome Village), not an item purchase, so no FIX needed despite the quest sitting inside this bundle's GE-flag window. Runes (6 air/water/earth) are pre-owned per the item list, not gathered mid-quest.

steps.label: Talk to Hetty (start Witch's Potion)
steps.detail: South-east Rimmington. She needs a rat's tail, burnt meat, an eye of newt, and an onion.

steps.label: Kill a level 1 rat for a rat's tail
steps.detail: Archery shop west of Hetty's house. Rat's tail only drops once the quest is started; giant rats never drop it.

steps.label: Burn a piece of meat (cook on Hetty's fireplace or purposely overcook)
steps.detail: Kill a giant rat near the chapel graveyard or a cow south of Falador for raw meat; a player-lit fire also works.

steps.label: Buy an eye of newt (Port Sarim magic shop)
Gather an onion
steps.detail: Field north of Rimmington/east of Melzar's Maze, or Fred the Farmer's Lumbridge backyard.

steps.label: Talk to Hetty (hand in all 4 ingredients, drink from the cauldron)

notes: No GE mentions. All 4 ingredients are skippable-if-owned (wiki notes each with '- You can skip this point if you have already obtained X') -- kept as standard gather/produce/buy atoms since a fresh account still needs them sourced.

checkpoints.label: Accept the totem-recovery job from Kangai Mau
Redirect the totem's crate at the Ardougne depot
Talk your way into Lord Handelmort's hideout
Recover the totem and deliver it home

atoms.label: Accept Kangai Mau's totem-recovery job
atoms.detail: Speak to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store and agree to help track down the tribe's stolen totem.

hints.value: I'm in search of adventure! -> Ok, I will get it back.

atoms.label: Travel to the Ardougne GPDT depot
atoms.detail: Head to Ardougne (a ship from Brimhaven also completes an easy Karamja Diary task) and go to the shipping depot just south of the eastern bank.

atoms.label: Find the address label on the north-east crate
atoms.detail: Investigate the most north-eastern crate at the depot to obtain an address label.

atoms.label: Relabel the nearby crate to reroute it
atoms.detail: Use the address label on the crate two tiles south of the first one to redirect its delivery.

atoms.label: Ask the depot employee about the delivery
atoms.detail: Talk to a GPDT employee at the depot and ask when the relabelled crate ships out.

hints.value: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

atoms.label: Get teleported by Wizard Cromperty
atoms.detail: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in his house north-east of the Ardougne market (checkered floor), ask about his invention, and accept the teleport offer; he sends you straight to the collector's hideout. The dialogue chain is shorter if the medium-or-higher Ardougne diary is already complete.

hints.value: So what have you invented? -> Can I be teleported please? -> Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

atoms.label: Speak the password to open the hideout door
atoms.detail: Go two doors west and speak the password KURT; typing it too quickly makes the attempt fail, so enter it slowly.

hints.value: KURT

atoms.label: Unlock and climb the hideout staircase
atoms.detail: Investigate the staircase, which requires 21 Thieving to unlock, then climb to the top floor.

atoms.label: Search the chest for the totem
atoms.detail: Search the chest on the top floor for the tribal totem, and be sure to finish the resulting dialogue completely before clicking away.

atoms.label: Return to Brimhaven
atoms.detail: Travel back to Brimhaven to report your success to Kangai Mau.

atoms.label: Give the totem to Kangai Mau
atoms.detail: Hand the recovered totem to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven, completing the quest.

notes: Exact dialogue text for the chest-search prompt at idx8 isn't given on the page (only 'you must finish the dialogue'), recorded as '??'. Wizard Cromperty's option chain shortens if the player already holds a medium+ Ardougne diary, both variants folded into idx5's detail/hint rather than branched.

checkpoints.label: Forge a spear and hasta under Otto's guidance
Brew the barbarian potion with Otto

atoms.label: Ask Otto about heavy-rod fishing
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach heavy-rod fishing.

hints.value: What can I learn about the use of a fishing rod?

atoms.label: Search the barbarian bed for a rod
atoms.detail: Search the barbarian bed to obtain a barbarian fishing rod.

atoms.label: Catch a leaping fish nearby
atoms.detail: Catch a leaping fish at one of the fishing spots near Otto's camp using the barbarian rod and bait or feathers.

atoms.label: Dissect the leaping fish for roe
atoms.detail: Use a knife on the leaping fish to dissect it, keeping the roe it yields for the herblore lesson later.

atoms.label: Report the heavy-rod success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you fished successfully with the barbarian rod.

hints.value: I've fished with a barbarian rod!

atoms.label: Ask Otto about barehanded fishing
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach barehanded fishing.

hints.value: Please teach me of your cunning with harpoons.

atoms.label: Catch a fish barehanded at a harpoon spot
atoms.detail: Go to any fishing spot that normally requires a harpoon and catch a fish with no tool equipped.

atoms.label: Report the barehanded success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you fished successfully with your bare hands.

hints.value: I've fished with my hands!

atoms.label: Ask Otto about bow firemaking
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach firemaking with a bow.

hints.value: I'm ready for your firemaking wisdom. Please instruct me.

atoms.label: Light logs using the bow
atoms.detail: Use a set of logs on any standard log-strung bow to light them; the page points to a level table for which log tier your Firemaking level allows, but that table wasn't captured by this fetch.

atoms.label: Report the bow-firemaking success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you lit logs using a bow.

hints.value: I've set fire to logs with a bow!

atoms.label: Ask Otto what follows bow firemaking
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed again and ask what comes after firemaking with a bow.

hints.value: I have completed firemaking with a bow. What follows this?

atoms.label: Kill mithril dragons for chewed bones
atoms.detail: Kill mithril dragons until one drops a set of chewed bones (a rare, roughly 3/128 drop).

atoms.label: Build and light a funeral pyre ship
atoms.detail: At a pyre site, construct a funeral pyre from logs using a woodcutting axe, then light it with a tinderbox or a suitable bow.

atoms.label: Ask Otto about fist farming
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach bare-handed seed planting.

hints.value: How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?

atoms.label: Plant a seed bare-handed
atoms.detail: Plant any seed except grape seeds directly into a free farming patch with no seed dibber; bring spares in case one gets crushed.

atoms.label: Report the fist-planting success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you planted a seed with your bare hands.

hints.value: I've planted seeds with my fists!

atoms.label: Ask Otto about pot-smashing farming
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed again and ask about other bare-handed farming tricks.

hints.value: Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?

atoms.label: Plant a sapling by smashing its pot
atoms.detail: Plant any sapling in a free farming patch using a spade, smashing the sapling's pot in the process.

atoms.label: Report the pot-smashing success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you smashed a pot while farming.

hints.value: I've smashed a pot whilst farming!

atoms.label: Ask Otto about barbarian spears
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach spear-smithing.

hints.value: Tell me more about the use of spears.

atoms.label: Forge exactly one bronze spear
atoms.detail: Use a bronze bar and a log on the nearby barbarian anvil to smith exactly one bronze spear, no more.

atoms.label: Ask Otto about spears again
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto about spears a second time to unlock the hasta topic.

hints.value: Tell me more about the use of spears.

atoms.label: Ask Otto about the one-handed hasta
atoms.detail: Ask Otto about hastae, the one-handed spears he just mentioned.

hints.value: What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

atoms.label: Forge one bronze hasta
atoms.detail: Use the second bronze bar and log on the barbarian anvil to smith a bronze hasta.

atoms.label: Report the hasta success to Otto
atoms.detail: Ask Otto about hastae again to confirm you've learned to smith one.

hints.value: What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

atoms.label: Ask Otto about barbarian herblore
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about the secret barbarian herblore knowledge.

hints.value: What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?

atoms.label: Brew a barbarian potion from roe
atoms.detail: Use the roe saved from the fishing lesson on a 2-dose attack potion to make a barbarian potion; a knife is also listed as required.

atoms.label: Report the herblore success to Otto
atoms.detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you made a barbarian potion.

hints.value: I've made a barbarian potion!

notes: The six lessons are independent and doable in any order per the page; checkpoint order here just follows the page's own Fishing->Firemaking->Farming->Smithing->Herblore listing. Firemaking-with-a-bow's log-tier/level table (referenced as 'see the table') is a separate table not present in this section's fetched text, so idx9's Firemaking level and log item are '??' rather than guessed. Pyre-ship's chewed-bones drop rate (3/128) is the page's own stated figure, quoted in detail rather than modeled as a count.

checkpoints.label: Talk to Grish and reach the Zogre cave
Search the cave for the backpack, torn page, and black prism
Identify the tankard's owner in Yanille
Relocate the ceremonial grounds with Grish
Optional: craft a composite ogre bow

atoms.label: Ask Grish about the sick ogres
atoms.detail: Speak with Grish in Jiggig and offer to help investigate the zombified ogres.

hints.value: What do you mean sickies? -> Can I help in any way? -> Yes.

atoms.label: Get the ogre guard to remove the barricade
atoms.detail: Speak to the Ogre guard east of Grish so he clears the way into the Zogre-infested area.

atoms.label: Climb the barricade and descend into the cave
atoms.detail: Climb over the crushed barricade, run east to the stairs, and go down them.

atoms.label: Search the skeleton and defeat the zombie it spawns
atoms.detail: Search the skeleton next to the broken lecturn; a zombie appears and must be killed to get the ruined backpack.

hints.value: Under 89 combat, Zogre/Skogre attacks from here on can cause disease that lowers a random skill 10 levels roughly every minute -- carry super restore potions.

atoms.label: Open the ruined backpack
atoms.detail: Open the backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, rotten food, and a knife.

atoms.label: Search the broken lecturn for the torn page
atoms.detail: Search the broken lecturn and keep the torn page it holds.

atoms.label: Cut open the coffin and search it for the black prism
atoms.detail: Use the knife on the coffin west of the skeleton, then search it (may take a few tries) for the black prism.

atoms.label: Show the tankard to the Yanille bartender
atoms.detail: Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon inn tankard on the bartender to begin identifying its owner.

atoms.label: Speak to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild
atoms.detail: Find Zavistic Rarve inside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (ring the bell out front if you lack the level to enter).

hints.value: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres (only if Hand in the Sand already started)

atoms.label: Speak to the bedridden Sithik Ints
atoms.detail: Sithik is bedridden in the upstairs bedroom of the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild; ask to look around his room.

hints.value: Do you mind if I look around?

atoms.label: Search Sithik's drawers, cupboard, and wardrobe
atoms.detail: Search all three pieces of furniture in the room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a Book of H.A.M.

hints.value: More papyrus can be found here if a re-sketch is needed later.

atoms.label: Read all three found books
atoms.detail: Read the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M before acting on them.

atoms.label: Use all three books on Sithik
atoms.detail: Use the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M on Sithik in turn.

atoms.label: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch his portrait
atoms.detail: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch a portrait whose examine text must read a classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

hints.value: A low Crafting level (1-10) reduces the odds of sketching a correct portrait on the first try; 20+ Crafting is recommended to speed this up -- soft speed factor, not a hard requirement.

atoms.label: Show the sketched portrait to Sithik
atoms.detail: Use the portrait on Sithik; he must appreciate its honesty, not just its truth.

atoms.label: Return to the Dragon Inn
atoms.detail: Head back to the Dragon Inn in Yanille to get the portrait signed.

atoms.label: Have the bartender sign the portrait
atoms.detail: Use the tankard then the portrait on the bartender; he signs the portrait as an affidavit.

atoms.label: Return to the Wizards' Guild
atoms.detail: Head back to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild with the evidence in hand.

atoms.label: Present the evidence to Zavistic Rarve
atoms.detail: Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the necromancy book, Book of H.A.M, the tankard, and the signed portrait to receive a strange potion.

hints.value: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
Text doesn't explicitly say whether the 4 items are truly consumed here vs merely checked -- modeled as consumed.

atoms.label: Spike Sithik's tea
atoms.detail: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.

atoms.label: Reset Sithik's dialogue by leaving and returning
atoms.detail: Go downstairs then back upstairs so Sithik has drunk the spiked tea before you talk to him.

atoms.label: Get the three secrets out of Sithik
atoms.detail: Question Sithik for the cures to the disease, the removal of the undead ogres, and the effects of the spell -- needed for Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows.

hints.value: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? / How do I get rid of the undead ogres / How do I get rid of the disease / Sorry, I have to go.

atoms.label: Report the culprit to Grish
atoms.detail: Tell Grish you found who's responsible for the Zogres; he gives you an ogre gate key for the ceremonial chamber.

hints.value: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

atoms.label: Learn to equip a composite ogre bow
atoms.detail: Ask Grish about an easier way to kill Zogres to learn how to equip composite ogre bows.

hints.value: "??" (option 2, label text not given)

atoms.label: Chop an achey tree for logs
atoms.detail: Optional: cut an achey tree for logs to make a composite ogre bow instead of relying on Crumble Undead.

hints.value: Optional side-path; not required to finish the quest.

atoms.label: Make an unstrung comp bow
atoms.detail: Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory and select box 2 to create an unstrung comp bow.

atoms.label: String the composite ogre bow
atoms.detail: String the unstrung bow with a bow string to finish it.

atoms.label: Brew Relicym's balm
atoms.detail: Optional: add a Rogue's purse to a vial of water then add snake weed to brew Relicym's balm; not needed for the quest itself but unlocks purchasing more from Uglug Nar.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also lists 'buy one from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule; only the gather/produce path is modeled.

atoms.label: Cut achey trees for arrow logs
atoms.detail: Optional: cut achey trees for logs to fletch brutal arrows instead of buying them.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also says 'if you have access to the Grand Exchange, just buy the arrows and skip this section' -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule.

atoms.label: Fletch the logs into ogre arrow shafts
atoms.detail: Fletch the achey tree logs with a knife into ogre arrow shafts.

atoms.label: Add feathers to the arrow shafts
atoms.detail: Add feathers to the ogre arrow shafts to make flighted ogre arrows.

atoms.label: Nail the flighted arrows into brutal arrows
atoms.detail: With a hammer in your inventory, use nails on the flighted ogre arrows to finish them.

atoms.label: Head to the ceremonial chamber
atoms.detail: Return to Jiggig, travel west through both sets of doors, then go down the stairs.

atoms.label: Search the stand at the end of the chamber
atoms.detail: Follow the chamber to its end and search the stand to approach Slash Bash.

hints.value: No item result is stated for this search -- treated as a pure trigger.

atoms.label: Kill Slash Bash
atoms.detail: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash, who uses both Ranged and Melee; safe-spot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

atoms.label: Return to Grish to finish
atoms.detail: Report Slash Bash's defeat to Grish to complete the quest.

hints.value: "??" (option 1, label text not given)

notes: The 'produce' verb (vs use-on) was used specifically for pure additive-creation bullets with no explicit 'use X on Y' target phrasing (stringing the bow, brewing the balm, feathering the shafts) -- a scope call, flag for consolidator review. Post-quest optional black-prism sale (2000/5000gp) excluded: it's a sub-bullet aside under the Grish return step, not its own checklist bullet, per the established optional-content precedent. Two ge_violation notes flagged (balm, arrows) -- both have real gather/produce paths modeled instead of the GE alternative the page also lists.

checkpoints.label: Speak to Halgrive and Orbon, gear up

atoms.label: Ask Halgrive about the sheep problem

checkpoints.label: Get the builder's costume and enter the tower

atoms.label: Take the pipe machine's supplies
atoms.detail: Search the crates for 4 pipes, 5 pipe rings, and 6 rivets.

atoms.label: Head up two more floors
atoms.detail: Climb up two floors to the room with the pipe machine.

atoms.label: Fix the pipe machine

atoms.label: Take the cage's supplies

atoms.label: Head to the top floor

atoms.label: Report the fixed machines to Effigy

atoms.label: Watch the alchemist cutscene

atoms.label: Talk to Effigy outside
atoms.detail: Go back outside to talk to Effigy again.

hints.value: Logic route: 1,3,3,1,2,2,3

Magic route (alternate, not both): 2,2,1 Runecraft/enchant/alchemy,3 bananas or peaches,3 depends where headed but teleports are safe,1 yes magic potions boost skills,1 by harnessing the power of the gods

atoms.detail: Speak to Effigy once more after the quiz.

atoms.label: Descend to the dungeon floor
atoms.detail: Go through the trapdoor to the south to reach the dungeon floor inside the tower.

atoms.label: Talk to the Homunculus to finish

atoms.detail: Run south-south-west to the altar.

atoms.label: Offer the raw chicken to the altar
atoms.detail: Use a raw chicken on the altar.

atoms.label: Offer the raw swordfish to the altar
atoms.detail: Use a raw swordfish on the altar.

atoms.label: Activate the altar
atoms.detail: Activate the altar to spawn the swordchick.

atoms.label: Kill the swordchick
atoms.detail: Kill the swordchick for the Medium Ardougne Diary task.

notes: The Homunculus quiz's Logic vs Magic answer sequences are two mutually-exclusive completion routes -- both recorded as separate dialogue hints on the same atom rather than picking one, extending the Astrid/Brand romance-branch precedent (only one is followed per playthrough). checkpoints.label: Talk to Brother Kojo and reach the four-door hub

atoms.label: Return and climb to the ground floor

atoms.label: Fit the red cog on the red spindle

atoms.label: Fit the blue cog on the blue spindle

atoms.label: Head to the basement fire

atoms.label: Fit the black cog on the black spindle

atoms.label: Head through the north-western door

checkpoints.label: Reach Eagles' Peak and gather starting feathers
Open the eagle door and reach Nickolaus

atoms.detail: Climb the rocks attached to the mountain next to the campsite (25 Agility), or follow the grey path south-east of the campsite if you lack the level.

atoms.label: Open the dungeon entrance

atoms.detail: Try to take a giant feather from the south-western-most pile; Nickolaus, trapped by a giant eagle, shouts at you.

atoms.label: Collect 10 eagle feathers
atoms.detail: Pick up 10 eagle feathers from any of the piles on the ground.

atoms.label: Travel to the Fancy Clothes Store
atoms.detail: Head to the south-east corner of Varrock to the Fancy Clothes Store (Varrock teleport, Rat Pits Grouping teleport, etc).

hints.value: Items required for the disguise: 10 eagle feathers, 50gp, swamp tar, yellow dye.

atoms.label: Ask Asyff about the bird costumes

hints.value: I've got the feathers and materials you requested. -> Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up.

atoms.detail: Take the bronze feather from the pedestal now that the winches are set.

atoms.label: Take 6 handfuls of bird seed

checkpoints.label: Filling the three tomes in Forthos Dungeon

atoms.detail: Kill any monsters in Forthos Dungeon until 4 of each tattered sun, moon and temple page have dropped; killing Temple spiders with multi-hit Ancient Magicks or a fast weapon such as the Toxic Blowpipe under Protect from Melee is a fast, semi-AFK option (reset aggression every 10 minutes).
