steps.label: Search the bookcase for a battered book (Seers' Village)
steps.detail: House immediately south-west of the Seers' Village bank; the bookcase is on the east wall.

steps.label: Read the battered book (start Elemental Workshop I)
steps.detail: Reveals the Fifth Age history of the ore and the sealed workshop.

steps.label: Cut the battered book open with a knife or slash weapon
steps.detail: A knife spawns in the house north of the church if none is carried. Produces a slashed book plus a battered key -- do not drop the slashed book, it is needed again at the end.

steps.label: Enter the workshop (northern anvil-icon building)
steps.detail: Enter the northern building with the anvil icon; use the key on the cracked wall and climb down the stairs into the workshop.

steps.label: Turn the water controls and start the water wheel
steps.detail: Turn the east water control first, then the west one, so both show green (order matters -- reset the west one if it was turned first), then pull the lever beside the wheel.

steps.label: Repair the bellows with thread and leather
steps.detail: Bellows are in the eastern chamber. Thread and leather spawn in crates (north-west of the central room, and the western room) if not carried; use both on the bellows (Crafting 20) then pull its lever to start it pumping.

steps.label: Mine an elemental rock and kill the earth elemental it wakes
steps.detail: West cavern (Mining 20 to attempt). The rock springs to life as a level-35 earth elemental on the mining attempt -- kill it and pick up the elemental ore it drops (the elementals already walking around do not count).

hints.note: Killing 2-3 extra earth elementals here banks spare elemental ore for Elemental Workshop II and a spare shield -- optional, not required for this quest alone.

steps.label: Fill a stone bowl with lava and light the furnace
steps.detail: Search the boxes north-east of the hatch for a stone bowl, fill it with lava from the trough in the southern chamber, then use the filled bowl on the furnace in the same chamber -- the inside should glow orange.

steps.label: Smelt the elemental ore into elemental metal
steps.detail: Use the elemental ore with 4 coal on the lit furnace (Smithing 20). Bring 4 more coal per extra shield you want to make now.

steps.label: Smith the elemental shield on the workbench
steps.detail: With the slashed book in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the central workbench (Smithing 20) -- quest complete. If the shield option is unavailable, destroy the slashed book and re-fetch a fresh one from the bookcase.

checkpoints.label: Bound under lock and key (Seers' Village -> workshop entrance)
A lost art (smelt metal, smith shield)

notes: The queue's fix_ids flagged this as a GE-violation, but the fetched main-page walkthrough's only Grand-Exchange mention is a post-quest optional resale line for the finished shield ('may also be sold on the Grand Exchange') -- no sourcing step recommends buying a quest item, so no gather/produce fix was needed; flagged as a false positive, consistent with the [oppgran] og-g1/og-g4 pattern of over-broad GE regex flags. All coal/thread/leather counts are the page's own stated numbers.

steps.label: Search the Exam Centre bookcase for a beaten book
steps.detail: South-east corner of the Exam Centre (south of the Digsite): search the bookcase two tiles down from the corner, the one attached to both a wall and another bookcase.

steps.label: Read the beaten book and its scroll (start the quest)
steps.detail: Read the book then the loose scroll bookmarked inside it. Keep the book for the rest of the quest -- discarding it early blocks the mind helmet at the end.

steps.label: Get the battered key and slashed book (if not already held)
steps.detail: House south-west of the Seers' Village bank; search the north-east bookcase for a slashed book and battered key, the same process as Elemental Workshop I.

steps.label: Search the water elemental room machinery for the hatch key
steps.detail: Enter the workshop via the key+wall (as in Elemental Workshop I). In the northern water elemental room, search the machinery on the south-west side -- the search option only appears if the scroll was read.

steps.label: Mine and smelt elemental ore into elemental metal (x2, x3 for a shield)
steps.detail: Before descending: mine elemental rocks in the west room to wake and kill 2 earth elementals (3 for a mind shield too), then smelt the ore with 4 coal per bar into elemental metal in the south room. Skip this atom entirely if pre-made elemental metal bars are already carried.

steps.label: Unlock the hatch and descend
steps.detail: Use the key on the locked hatch in the middle of the room and go downstairs.

steps.label: Take the crane and lever schematics
steps.detail: Schematic crate is directly beside an old lever to the south of the entry room.

steps.label: Smith the crane claw
steps.detail: Upstairs, use ONE elemental metal bar on the workbench (careful -- the smithing menu defaults to make-all). Do not make a mind helmet here.

steps.label: Fix the crane, pipe junction, and cog machinery
steps.detail: Pull the south-west lever beside the old crane and use the claw on it. Upstairs, connect the junction-box pipes per the lever schematic (top-right of the lever to the top-middle supply pipe; the two remaining lever pipes to the press's top-left and bottom-left). Search bottom- and upper-floor crates (near the stairwells, water valve, and schematics crate) for a small cog, medium cog, large cog, and pipe piece -- locations are randomised per player. Use the pipe on the broken pipe upstairs, then fit the cogs on the wind-tunnel pins: small upper-left, medium lower-left, large right.

hints.note: Crate contents (which crate holds which cog/pipe) are randomised per player; keep searching only the crates that yield an item.

steps.label: Run the crane/press/tank/fan cycle to prime the bar(s)
steps.detail: Place the elemental metal on the jig cart at the crane; raise, rotate, dip in lava, raise, rotate back, lower then raise again to seat it on the jig. Pull the yellow-sign lever to advance the cart to the press (flatten it with the east lever), then to the water tank (open door, corkscrew the cart in twice, close eastern valve, open western valve to cool blue, reverse to drain, corkscrew out, close door), then to the fan (toggle on then off to dry white). Pull the final lever and collect the primed bar. Repeat the whole cycle for a second bar if a mind shield is also wanted.

steps.label: Drain a primed bar into a mind bar at the extractor
steps.detail: One level down, in the mind-symbol room: place the primed bar on the extractor gun and operate the extractor hat. Each bar powered temporarily drains 20 Magic -- only power a second bar if a mind shield is also wanted this trip.

steps.label: Smith the mind bar into a mind helmet
steps.detail: Back at the workshop anvil, with the beaten book in your inventory, use a mind bar on it -- makes a mind helmet and completes the quest (without the book, the anvil makes a second mind shield instead).

steps.label: Smith the second mind bar into a mind shield
steps.detail: Post-quest only: use the second mind bar on the anvil with the Elemental Workshop I slashed book in your inventory (not the beaten book) to make a mind shield instead of a second helmet.

checkpoints.label: Finishing up (mind bar, helmet, optional shield)

notes: Another false-positive GE flag from the queue: the page's only Grand-Exchange mention is a post-quest optional resale line for the finished mind shield/helmet, not a sourcing shortcut -- no fix applied. Puzzle atoms (pipe junction, cog placement) are collapsed to one atom each per U4/U7 (solved once, not per click).

steps.label: Talk to Kangai Mau (start Tribal Totem)
steps.detail: Shrimp and Parrot restaurant, Brimhaven. Say you're seeking adventure -- he explains Lord Handelmort of Ardougne has stolen the Rantuki tribe's totem for his private museum.

steps.label: Go to the GPDT depot (west of Ardougne docks)
steps.detail: West of the Ardougne docks, south of the eastern bank.

steps.label: Reroute the Wizards' Tower crate to Handelmort's mansion
steps.detail: Investigate the north-eastern crate for an address label. A separate crate to the south, addressed to the Wizards' Tower, holds Wizard Cromperty's new teleport block -- use the label on that crate to redirect its delivery to the mansion instead.

steps.label: Ask a GPDT employee to deliver the crate now
steps.detail: He agrees to deliver the relabelled crate immediately.

steps.label: Go to Wizard Cromperty's house (north-east of Ardougne market)
Ask Cromperty to teleport you via the block
steps.detail: Do NOT use the right-click Teleport option -- it sends you to the Rune essence mine instead. Ask what he's invented, then ask to be teleported and confirm; you land inside Handelmort's mansion.

hints.value: ask-to-be-teleported-then-confirm
hints.note: Right-click Teleport is a trap option -- use the dialogue path only.

steps.label: Unlock the password door (K U R T)
steps.detail: Go west through two doors; the second needs Lord Handelmort's middle name entered with the left/right arrows: K=10 right, U=6 left, R=9 left, T=7 left, then click enter. If it reports incorrect, enter the letters slowly -- fast clicks can be dropped.

steps.label: Disarm the booby-trapped stairs before climbing
steps.detail: Investigate the stairs (Thieving 21) rather than climbing up directly, then climb up. Triggering the trap instead drops you into the Ardougne sewers -- climb the ladder out and get another teleport from Cromperty (no need to re-enter the door code).

hints.value: sewer-exit-then-recromperty
hints.note: Failing the trap costs a Cromperty round-trip, not a door-code re-entry.

steps.label: Search the chest for the tribal totem
steps.detail: Exit onto the balcony via the southern door, enter the room to the east, open the chest and search it.

steps.label: Return to Brimhaven
Hand the tribal totem back to Kangai Mau
steps.detail: Quest complete -- he thanks you with 5 swordfish.

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: the quest's own Details lists 'items = None' and the walkthrough never mentions buying anything -- nothing to fix. Dig-spot-style password digits (K U R T) are the page's own stated arrow-click counts, not a fabricated sequence.

steps.label: Talk to King Lathas (start Underground Pass)
steps.detail: 1F of Ardougne Castle. He explains the Underground Pass is the only way to reach his corrupted brother King Tyras, but the cultist Iban has moved in; sends you to his tracker Koftik.

steps.label: Talk to Koftik outside the Underground Pass
steps.detail: Through West Ardougne's front gates, west to the cave entrance. Koftik warns the cave corrupts the will of men and tells you to meet him by the bridge inside.

steps.label: Fire-arrow the bridge rope and cross
steps.detail: Take the northernmost of the three entrance paths (never the middle swamp path). At the fire, Koftik gives an oily cloth; use it on an arrow, then the result on the fire for a fire arrow. Fire the lit arrow at the rope holding up the bridge to drop it and cross. Do not pull the lever right after the bridge (resets you to the start); take the plank just past it first.

hints.value: keep:spare-fire-arrows
hints.note: Stack a few lit arrows before firing in case the shot misses.

steps.label: Rope-swing across the dark pit
steps.detail: South from the plank, avoid the blessed-spider swamp and head east instead. Use a rope on the rock hanging over the pit to swing across.

hints.value: restart-from-entrance
hints.note: Failing drops you into the pit, loses the rope, and sends you all the way back to the Underground Pass entrance -- bring spares; extra ropes are sold at the Ardougne general store.

steps.label: Cross the trial-and-error damage grid
steps.detail: Each wrong tile deals a flat 15 damage into a pit; find a safe path by trial and error, then pull the lever on the far side to open the gate. This exact path is randomised per player but is permanent -- you must retrace it twice more during Regicide, so write it down.

hints.note: Path is fixed per player once discovered; remember or record it for Regicide.

steps.label: Collect the four orbs of light and destroy them at the furnace
steps.detail: From the room with the sinister well, four tunnels each hold one orb: north (disarm three traps with the plank), north-west (run past level-39 spiders/level-53 ogres, Protect from Melee helps), middle (disarm traps like the north path), south-west (do NOT pick up the orb until the trap beneath it is disarmed). Backtrack to the furnace near the trap corridor and use each orb on it to destroy them, then descend the now-unlit well.

hints.value: disarm-or-run-through
hints.note: Traps can be disarmed (risk of a 5-14 damage fail) or run through at low current-HP for less damage.

steps.label: Dig the hidden tunnel and cross the obstacle maze
steps.detail: West through the slave-cage area; pick the first (south-east) cell's lock and use a spade on the odd patch of ground inside for a hidden tunnel. Edge the narrow ledge, then either cross the raised-beam maze (first right, then left, then left) or -- with 50 Thieving -- pick the gate lock just south of the maze to bypass it entirely. Squeeze through the pipe to the third area. Drop the bow, arrows, spade, rope, and oily cloth here -- none are needed again.

steps.label: Crush the caged unicorn for its horn
steps.detail: Search the unicorn's cage for a loose piece of railing (none obtainable if one is already stashed in your bank). South of the cage, use the railing to pry loose a boulder and crush the unicorn, then search the smashed cage for its horn.

steps.label: Kill the three paladins for their badges
steps.detail: Sir Carl, Sir Jerro, and Sir Harry (level 62 each, melee only, safespottable by running west) camp north of the well. They first offer food (2 bread, 2 meat pies, a stew, a prayer potion(2), an attack potion(2)) -- then must be killed for their red, blue, and green badges.

hints.value: run-west
hints.note: They will not follow far west of their camp.

steps.label: Offer the horn and badges at the well to open the Doors of Iban
steps.detail: West past the traps (plank still useful here) to a second well. Use the unicorn horn and all three badges on it -- the doors of Iban open. Drop the plank now, it's no longer needed.

steps.label: Talk to the three dwarves (Niloof, Klank, Kamen)
steps.detail: In the largest area, descend into the small fenced dwarf camp south-west. Niloof explains the corrupted Well of Voyage and points to the witch Kardia; Klank gives Klank's gauntlets (protects against half-soulless bites); decline Kamen's brew offer (accepting costs 4 Agility) -- he'll still sell food for 75 coins either way (named NPC, non-GE).

steps.label: Return Kardia's cat and loot her chest for the doll of Iban
steps.detail: Walk the platform paths north of the dwarf camp to Kardia's house; her cat has wandered off along the western path -- retrieve it (yellow minimap dot) and bring it back. Knock on her door; while she fetches the cat, sneak in and search the chest for a stat restore potion, super attack potion, the history of Iban book, and the doll of Iban.

steps.label: Burn Iban's tomb to imbue the doll with his ashes
steps.detail: South-east corner of the dwarf level. Take a bucket from the larger dwarf building and a tinderbox from the smaller one; fill the bucket from the barrel of dwarven brew inside the small building, dump it on the tomb, and light it with the tinderbox. The resulting ashes auto-apply to the doll. Drop the bucket and tinderbox afterward.

steps.label: Kill Kalrag to smear the doll with her blood
steps.detail: North from the tomb through a blessed-spider corridor (max hit 4) to the level-89 spider Kalrag (max hit 9, fairly inaccurate in melee armour). Heal up before the killing blow -- you're stunned for two seconds afterward while the blood auto-applies to the doll, during which the spiders can pile on.

hints.value: far-north-corner-or-eastern-wall
hints.note: Luring her to the far north or trapping her against the eastern wall jut avoids most spider interference.

steps.label: Kill the three demons for Iban's shadow
steps.detail: Level-91 Doomion, Othainian, and Holthion, reached north and west of the witch's house then south. Kill each (safespottable on the narrow pathways) and loot its amulet, then open the chest just north of Doomion's spot -- the three amulets convert into Iban's shadow, auto-applied to the doll.

hints.value: narrow-pathways
hints.note: After looting an amulet the matching demon stops attacking and can't be re-attacked -- no need to avoid it afterward.

steps.label: Search the half-soulless cage for Iban's dove
steps.detail: Wear Klank's gauntlets first. Head north along the western ledge, across the first broken bridge, then north, east, north, and west to a dead-end cage; search it for the dove's remains, which auto-smear onto the doll.

steps.label: Destroy Iban at the Well of the Damned
steps.detail: Loot a disciple of Iban's Zamorak monk robes near the central temple and wear both pieces before entering. Iban attacks with recurring stun-spikes near the entrance; run in with full health and use the completed doll on the well at the centre as soon as possible (may take a few tries if his attacks interrupt you).

steps.label: Report Iban's death to King Lathas
steps.detail: Follow the now-sane Koftik back to the entrance, leave the cavern, and return to Ardougne Castle. All quest items are removed on completion -- drop any souvenirs first.

checkpoints.label: Entrance + bridge (Ardougne Castle -> across the pit)
The dwarves + the ritual of Iban (third area)

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: the only purchase mentions (Kamen's food, ropes at the Ardougne general store) are both named non-GE NPC vendors. reqs.quests for this coarse item should flatten to [biohazard, plague-city] per the page's own nested Details chain (Biohazard -> Plague City) -- left for the Lane-5 consolidation pass since this contribution is atoms-only. Heaviest atomization in this bundle (18 atoms) given the Long quest length and four-branch Iban-doll collection sequence.

steps.label: Talk to Vanstrom Klause (start In Search of the Myreque)
steps.detail: Hair of the Dog tavern, Canifis, north-east corner. Agree to deliver weapons to the Myreque rebels; he mentions a boatman, Cyreg Paddlehorn, in Mort'ton.

steps.label: Fill the druid pouch with silver-sickled Mort myre fungus
steps.detail: GATHER-NOT-GE FIX: the page's own item list offers 'buying from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative to collecting charges -- gather instead. Use a (blessed) Silver sickle (b) on fungus-covered logs in Mort Myre Swamp; each fill adds 3 charges to the druid pouch, so 6 fungus tops it to the 5+ charges needed.

steps.label: Travel to Mort'ton
steps.detail: On foot through Mort Myre Swamp (ghasts drain druid pouch charges en route -- the extra fungus covers refills), or with 50+ Agility and fairy rings unlocked, ring code bip then the agility shortcut south of the swamp.

steps.label: Persuade Cyreg Paddlehorn to ferry you across
steps.detail: Eastern edge of Mort'ton, by his boat at the Barrows bridge. With all five steel weapons and a 5+-charge druid pouch in your inventory, choose the four-step guilt-trip dialogue chain in order (own words: 'they'll die without weapons' -> 'resourceful enough for their own steel?' -> 'their deaths are on your head' -> 'what kind of man says that'). He asks for 3 planks to fix his boat and 3 more for a bridge, then ferries you to The Hollows for 10 coins (waived with a ring of charos (a)).

hints.value: four-step-guilt-chain
hints.note: Exact order matters; each response escalates the guilt angle.

steps.label: Repair the rope bridge into the Hollows
steps.detail: North from the landing, avoiding ghasts, to a damaged rope bridge in a strange tree. Mend it while crossing with 3 planks and 225 steel nails (75 per plank), then climb down the far side.

steps.label: Answer Curpile Fyod's loyalty question
steps.detail: North to the hollow tree. Tell Curpile you've brought weapons; he asks one randomised question to confirm you're telling the truth (own-words answer key: only female member = Sani Piliu; Mort Myre leader = Veliaf Hurtz; the boatman = Cyreg Paddlehorn; the scholar member = Polmafi Ferdygris; the youngest member = Ivan Strom; the ruling vampyre family = Drakan). A wrong answer knocks you out at the boat -- the bridge stays fixed and the pouch charge requirement is waived on retry.

hints.note: One of six possible questions, randomised per attempt.

steps.label: Introduce yourself to the five Myreque members
steps.detail: Circle north to the hidden south-east alcove cave entrance. Talk to Veliaf first, then briefly greet each of the other five members ('I'll be back later' is enough -- no follow-up questions required).

steps.label: Kill the level-97 Skeleton Hellhound
steps.detail: Return to Veliaf and hand over the five steel weapons -- a cutscene reveals Vanstrom Klause as a vampyre, who kills two members and summons a 55-HP hellhound (no Magic defence, weak to Earth). Kill it; there is a safespot in the upper-east corner behind the chair.

hints.value: upper-east-corner-behind-chair

steps.label: Ask Veliaf how to leave the hideout
steps.detail: He reveals a secret passage to Canifis.

steps.label: Exit via the secret passage to Canifis
steps.detail: Search the wall at the end of the tunnel to open it, then climb the ladder up behind the Canifis tavern. Exiting via any other route requires a repeat trip to progress the quest.

steps.label: Talk to the Stranger in the tavern to finish
steps.detail: Vanstrom is gone, replaced by a nondescript Stranger. Quest complete.

notes: REAL GE-violation found + fixed (qisotm-02): the page's own items list names 'buying from the Grand Exchange' as an explicit alternative to a Silver sickle (b) gather route for druid-pouch charges -- modelled the gather route only, per the hard rule. reqs.quests for this coarse item should flatten to [priest-in-peril, the-restless-ghost, nature-spirit] per the page's own Details chain (left for Lane-5 consolidation, this contribution is atoms-only).

steps.label: Talk to King Narnode Shareen (start The Grand Tree)
steps.detail: Ground floor of the Grand Tree, with 2 free inventory slots. He shows you the dying roots underground and gives a translation book and a bark sample, asking you to visit Hazelmere.

steps.label: Travel to Hazelmere's house
steps.detail: Small island east of Yanille, upstairs. Level-44 jungle spiders roam the path but are not poisonous.

steps.label: Give Hazelmere the bark sample
steps.detail: He examines the bark and gives back a message written in his own language.

steps.label: Decode the message for King Narnode
steps.detail: Use the translation book to decode Hazelmere's message ('a man came with the King's seal; I gave him Daconia rocks; Daconia rocks will kill the tree'). Select 'None of the above' for the first two dialogue prompts, then the three real lines in order. Narnode realises his seal was forged and sends you to his head tree guardian, Glough.

hints.value: none-none-then-three-real-lines-in-order

steps.label: Talk to Glough
steps.detail: Treehouse south of the Grand Tree, east of the balloon ramp. He dismisses humans as untrustworthy and says he'll handle it.

steps.label: Talk to Charlie the prisoner
steps.detail: Narnode reveals Glough imprisoned a human found with Daconia rocks. Top floor of the Grand Tree: Charlie says Glough paid him to steal from Hazelmere and suggests searching Glough's house.

steps.label: Search Glough's cupboard for his journal
steps.detail: The journal details a plan to frame humans as a threat to the tree gnomes. Confronting Glough with it gets you thrown into the cell beside Charlie's; Charlie gives the shipyard password 'Ka-Lu-Min'.

steps.label: Escape to Karamja on the Gnome glider
steps.detail: Narnode apologises and points you to the top-floor glider beside the cells. Ask the pilot to fly you to Karamja.

steps.label: Get the lumber order from the Shipyard foreman
steps.detail: The glider crash-lands west of the Shipyard. Run east past aggressive level-53 jogres; tell the gate worker Glough sent you plus the password. Talk to the level-23 foreman on the south docks, say Glough sent you, and answer his three personal questions (own-words key: his late wife -> 'Sadly his wife is no longer with us'; favourite dish -> 'He loves worm holes'; girlfriend's name -> 'Anita') to get a lumber order.

steps.label: Sneak back into the Tree Gnome Stronghold
steps.detail: Glough has barred the gate guards from letting you in. If Tree Gnome Village is done, use the Battlefield or Grand Exchange spirit tree instead. Otherwise talk to Femi by the gate -- free if never entered via the gate before, or if you helped her move boxes on first entry; 1,000 coins if you previously declined.

steps.label: Show King Narnode the lumber order
steps.detail: He still doubts you and sends you away for your own safety, but Charlie later mentions Glough's chest key is with his girlfriend Anita.

steps.label: Fetch Glough's key from Anita and open his chest
steps.detail: Climb the north-western-most ladder by the tortoise pens to talk to Anita for Glough's key. Use the key on the chest in Glough's house and click continue to receive his invasion plans.

steps.label: Spell TUZO on the watchtower pillars
steps.detail: Ensure 4 free inventory slots; bring the plans to King Narnode (still unconvinced, but gives 4 bundles of twigs). Climb the east watchtower in Glough's house (Agility 25) and use the twigs on the four pillars to spell TUZO (translation-book word for 'open'), starting from the far left. This unlocks the trapdoor -- do not descend until ready for the demon fight.

steps.label: Kill the level-172 black demon
steps.detail: Climb down; complete Glough's threatening dialogue in full without interacting with anything else, or you'll have to repeat it. The demon (40% weak to water spells, negative Magic defence) can be safespotted one tile north then east of the ladder. If not killed within 10 minutes it disappears and the fight must be restarted from the top-floor ladder.

hints.value: one-north-then-east-of-ladder
re-enter-via-narnode-ladder
hints.note: 10-minute timer resets the fight if not killed in time.

steps.label: Search the roots for the last Daconia rock
steps.detail: After the fight, a guard finds Glough hiding and Narnode apologises. Ensure 1 free inventory slot, then search the roots around the area until the rock turns up -- click continue to claim it.

steps.label: Return the Daconia rock to King Narnode
steps.detail: Quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Encountering the Black demon + the adamant king

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: no Grand Exchange mention anywhere on the fetched page. The Femi/spirit-tree re-entry step is genuinely a branch{} alternate (U9), not a coarse GE issue.

steps.label: Talk to Charlie (start Eagles' Peak)
steps.detail: South-west part of Ardougne Zoo, south of the scorpion cage. He explains a delivered ferret escaped and the huntsman sent to recapture one, Nickolaus, has gone quiet; agree to look for him.

steps.label: Travel to Eagles' Peak
steps.detail: West of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Fairy ring code AKQ is fastest, or a necklace of passage to the Outpost then north-west.

steps.label: Read the bird book for the metal feather
steps.detail: At the base tent, Nickolaus is missing. Inspect the books on the ground for a bird book; reading it shakes loose a metal feather.

steps.label: Open the peak door and shout to Nickolaus
steps.detail: Climb to the peak (south-side path, or the Agility shortcut beside the tent) to a feather-inscribed rock door; use the metal feather to open it. Inside, take the southern tunnel past the giant feathers to a ledge and shout to Nickolaus, trapped across a chasm by a giant eagle.

steps.label: Gather 10 eagle feathers
steps.detail: Piles of giant feathers spawn near where Nickolaus is trapped and throughout the cave.

steps.label: Have Asyff sew two eagle disguises
steps.detail: Fancy Dress Shop, south-east Varrock (gated area). Ask Asyff about bird costumes; she makes two eagle capes+beaks from the 10 giant feathers, swamp tar, yellow dye, and 50 coins.

steps.label: Bring the disguises back to Nickolaus
steps.detail: Return to the dungeon and shout to him again -- he asks for the disguises to be brought to the eagle door.

steps.label: Free the bronze feather from its net trap
steps.detail: West tunnel from the eagle door. Attempting to take the pedestal feather triggers a net trap; operate all four corner winches to break it, then take the feather.

steps.label: Follow the trail and fight for the silver feather
steps.detail: Second tunnel. Inspecting the empty pedestal (Hunter 27) reveals a partial trail; follow successive rock-heap inspections until a hidden tunnel is found. A level-13 kebbit attacks -- kill or threaten it for the silver feather (re-searchable from the tunnel if lost).

steps.label: Solve the bird-seed lever puzzle for the gold feather
steps.detail: North-east tunnel. Take bird seed from the holder near the entrance (need six placements total). Four levers move five metal eagles blocking the corridor west to the pedestal: centre lever moves east/north-west eagles, east lever moves the north-west eagle, south-west lever moves north-west/south eagles, north-west lever clears the corridor to the feather room. Fill feeders and pull levers in sequence to clear the path, then take the gold feather. A reset lever sits outside the chamber if the puzzle gets stuck.

steps.label: Use all three feathers and disguise past the guard eagle
steps.detail: Use the bronze, silver, and gold feathers on the eagle door to open it, then wear the full eagle disguise to walk past the guarding eagle to Nickolaus (skipping the disguise costs minor damage).

steps.label: Talk to Nickolaus and agree to meet at camp
Learn to catch a ferret from Nickolaus
steps.detail: Exit the dungeon and find Nickolaus back at the tent; he teaches the capture method (no box trap needed for this scripted catch -- if the ferret is released afterward, a real box trap he provides can recatch it).

steps.label: Deliver the ferret to Charlie
steps.detail: Ardougne Zoo. Quest complete.

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: the only purchase (eagle disguise materials) is bought from the named NPC Asyff at the Fancy Dress Shop, not the Grand Exchange.

steps.label: Travel to the Abandoned Mine
steps.detail: South-west Morytania, south of the swamp, west of Mort'ton/Burgh de Rott. Reach it via Nature Spirit access, a Mort'ton/Barrows teleport, or the Agility-25 low-fence shortcut from Burgh de Rott (needs partial In Aid of the Myreque).

steps.label: Talk to the Saradominist zealot (start Haunted Mine)
steps.detail: Wandering between the mine and the swamp. Pick any non-Zamorak response. He explains Treus Dayth, a Zamorakian mage bound to guard Salve-amulet crystals deep in the mine, and that he holds a key to a lower second entrance.

steps.label: Pickpocket the zealot's key
steps.detail: The key drops to the floor if your inventory is full.

steps.label: Enter the Abandoned Mine
steps.detail: Follow the cart track south past feral vampyres; climb over the mine cart (Agility 15) into the cart tunnel, or without 15 Agility use the southern entrance on the mountain's west side instead.

steps.label: Navigate the upper cave levels to the level-3 ladder
steps.detail: Dormant corpse-skeletons wake on approach, possessed pickaxes may attack when picked up, and self-moving carts damage on contact. Follow the cart track west, exit west, re-enter the southern entrance, ladder down, east then ladder down again, then time the north-south cart (wait for it to head south, follow, hide in the western alcove, then dash to the ladder when it returns north).

steps.label: Pick a glowing fungus
steps.detail: Stagnant pool west of the level-3 ladder. This is the only usable light source deeper in the mine -- never carry it outside the cave or drop it, both crumble it to ash.

steps.label: Route the mine cart to the north-west ladder
steps.detail: Place the fungus in the searchable cart north-west of the pool, then set the ten junction levers (A-E south-east of the control panel, F-J north around the corner; F/G/H are fixed/inaccessible) so the panel's route sends the cart to the top-right ladder. Press start; re-set levers and retry if it sinks or returns.

hints.note: Starting lever positions are randomised per player; the target route is fixed.

steps.label: Retrieve the fungus at the north-west ladder
steps.detail: Backtrack over the top of the mine, exit west, through the northern cave, down to the north-west corner ladder, and search the cart to reclaim the fungus that arrived.

steps.label: Pick up a chisel (if not already carried)
steps.detail: Crate spawn in the side cave east of the flooded tracks.

steps.label: Open the water valve and take the lift down
steps.detail: Around the large pipe near the flooded tracks: use the zealot's key on the valve to start the water flow, then run back and take the lift before a mischievous ghost shuts it off (retry the valve if the ghost wins).

steps.label: Reach the crane-and-cart boss chamber
steps.detail: From the flooded chamber (lit by the fungus), follow the east track past possessed pickaxes, down the stairs, into the loading-crane chamber. Do not take the innocent-looking key until ready for the fight.

steps.label: Fight the ghost of Treus Dayth
steps.detail: Taking the innocent-looking key summons the level-95 ghost. He teleports invisible between attacks (yellow minimap arrow marks his location) using mine carts (up to 9 dmg/tick on cart tracks -- run across instead of standing), possessed cranes (up to 10 dmg adjacent), thrown pickaxes (up to 15, Protect Missiles only reduces ~33%), and rare melee. Magic is recommended (weak to Wind/Crumble Undead); retreat through the east door any time to heal safely -- his HP doesn't reset.

hints.value: avoid-cart-tracks-and-crane-adjacency
east-door-heal-reset
hints.note: Boss keeps its current HP if you retreat and return.

steps.label: Cut a salve shard from the crystal outcrop
steps.detail: Climb back to level 5, take the second staircase down; the crystal-mine key opens the crystal room. Use a chisel on a crystal outcrop (Crafting 35) -- cut a couple extra as backup. Quest completes on returning to the surface.

checkpoints.label: Preparation + the mysteries of Mort Ridge
Into the depths + getting a light

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: no Grand Exchange mention on the fetched page at all -- the only purchase-adjacent text is a hard-Morytania-diary tip about mining mithril post-quest, unrelated to progression. reqs.quests = [priest-in-peril] per the page's own Details.

steps.label: Talk to Dimintheis (start Family Crest)
steps.detail: Fenced house above the clothes shop, south-eastern Varrock. Agree to help; his three sons split the family crest into pieces decades ago and scattered; his son Caleb now cooks in Catherby.

steps.label: Travel to Catherby
Ask Caleb for his crest piece
steps.detail: Inside or near the sink building south of the Farming shop. Confirm his identity, ask what happened to the crest (mandatory to unlock the other pieces), then agree to bring fish-salad ingredients.

steps.label: Gather 5 cooked fish for Caleb
steps.detail: One each of cooked shrimp, salmon, tuna, bass, and swordfish. Ironman note (named non-GE vendors, no substitution needed for a normal account): raw fish from Frankie's Fishing Emporium (Port Piscarilius), cooked salmon from the West Ardougne General Store, cooked swordfish from the Shrimp and Parrot in Brimhaven (also a Tribal Totem reward), cooked bass from the Warrior Guild Food Shop.

steps.label: Deliver the fish to Caleb for his crest piece
steps.detail: He hands over his crest piece and mentions brother Avan was last seen searching the desert for treasure.

steps.label: Ask the Al Kharid gem trader about Avan
steps.detail: North Al Kharid, by the gnome glider. He recalls Avan searching for 'perfect gold' in the sand dunes.

steps.label: Find Avan at the Al Kharid mine
steps.detail: Wandering the northern Al Kharid mine pit entrance, wearing a yellow cape. He wants a ring and necklace of 'perfect gold' to win a lady's affection and mentions a dwarf named Boot who may know a source.

steps.label: Ask Boot about perfect gold
steps.detail: Down the trapdoor behind the eastern building of the Dwarven Mine (west of Edgeville Monastery); Boot wanders south-west of the entrance by the rock columns. He points to the Witchaven Dungeon east of Ardougne. Must be spoken to before Avan will accept the finished jewellery, even though it can technically be mined/smithed beforehand.

steps.label: Solve the Witchaven Dungeon lever puzzle
steps.detail: Enter and head north-east past hobgoblin/ogre rooms (Protect from Melee negates all their damage; no kills required). Six-step sequence to permanently unlock the hellhound room: north-room outer lever up; south room via east door, inner lever up, exit west door; north room outer lever down then inner lever up; north room outer lever up again; south room via west door, lever down, exit east door.

steps.label: Mine 2 perfect gold ore
steps.detail: In the unlocked hellhound room, mine the gold rocks (Mining 40) while zigzagging the level-122 hellhounds' short aggro range; a safespot exists behind the rock column south of the entrance if aggro is drawn (world-hop to reset a mined rock).

hints.value: rock-column-south-of-entrance

steps.label: Smelt and smith the perfect ring and necklace
steps.detail: At any furnace (Al Kharid is convenient for the Avan hand-off): smelt the 2 perfect gold ore into bars (Smithing 40), then use the ring mould and necklace mould with 2 cut rubies to smith a perfect ring and perfect necklace (Crafting 40) -- do not pick the plain gold jewellery menu options.

steps.label: Give Avan the jewellery for his crest piece
steps.detail: He hands over his crest piece and directs you to Johnathon at the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of Varrock.

steps.label: Cure Johnathon with an antipoison potion
steps.detail: 1F of the Jolly Boar Inn, north-west room. He's delirious from a poisonous spider bite -- use any antipoison potion on him (fully consumed regardless of dose).

steps.label: Weaken and kill Chronozon for the last crest piece
steps.detail: Johnathon lost the crest fighting Chronozon (level 170) in the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon, by the poison spiders near the Earth obelisk. Cast Wind, Water, Earth, and Fire Blast, landing one confirmed hit each ('Chronozon weakens...' in chat), in any order, then finish with any style. A safespot exists one tile in front of the eastern standing torch.

hints.value: one-tile-front-of-eastern-torch
low-population-world
hints.note: This is a Wilderness fight -- other players can attack you.

steps.label: Reassemble the crest and return it to Dimintheis
steps.detail: Combine the three crest pieces, return to Varrock, and hand the crest to Dimintheis. Quest complete -- pick one of Caleb's/Avan's/Johnathon's gauntlet imbuements.

notes: Not in the queue's fix_ids and confirmed clean: no Grand Exchange mention anywhere on the page; all named vendors (Frankie's Fishing Emporium, West Ardougne General Store, Shrimp and Parrot, Warrior Guild Food Shop) are non-GE NPC shops, correctly kept as sourcing alternatives in qfc-04's detail.

steps.label: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz (start In Aid of the Myreque)
steps.detail: Myreque Hideout below Canifis (fairy ring dls, or the Canifis trapdoor + secret passage). He asks you to help establish a new base at Burgh de Rott now that the Hollows hideout is compromised.

steps.label: Travel to Burgh de Rott
steps.detail: South of Mort'ton. Carry 1 food item, hammer, pickaxe, spade, 1-5 buckets, 6 planks, and 44 nails -- there is no functioning bank here until it's repaired later.

steps.label: Prove goodwill to Florin and enter Burgh de Rott
steps.detail: Florin refuses entry, suspecting you're collecting food/blood for the vampyres. Use a food item on the open chest directly in front of the gate; he lets you in and the shades stop attacking. Ask about out-of-the-way places -- he suggests the inn cellar.

steps.label: Clear the pub cellar rubble
steps.detail: Climb over the broken wall into the inn (south-east of the gate), mine the trapdoor rubble, descend, then mine and spade every rubble pile into your buckets (3 loads/bucket) and empty them on the pile south-west outside the bar until the cellar is fully cleared. A cutscene reveals a wall plaque once done; leftover items dropped in the cellar vanish on exit.

hints.note: Bonus nails/rock/glass/scroll/fragment surface passively every few piles -- not quest-critical.

steps.label: Offer to help Razvan and Aurel fix the town
steps.detail: Talk to Razvan (usually just north of the bar) about helping, then to Aurel in the General Store (north-east) -- he asks for the roof and wall repaired.

steps.label: Repair the General Store roof and wall
steps.detail: Climb the ladder on the store's outside south wall; use 3 planks + 12 nails on the roof hole. Climb down and use 3 planks + 12 nails on the damaged wall east of the ladder.

steps.label: Fill Aurel's stock crate
steps.detail: Aurel always needs 10 bronze axes + 3 tinderboxes, plus either 10 mackerel OR 10 snail meat (randomly assigned per player -- reroll by exiting his dialogue before the crate handoff). Fill the crate with unnoted items and hand it back. While banking, also grab 5 planks, a hammer, swamp paste, and 20 nails for the next repair.

hints.note: Randomised per player; reroll available before accepting the crate.

steps.label: Repair the bank and recruit Cornelius as banker
steps.detail: South of the city. Inspect the bank booth, then the west wall, using 5 planks + 20 nails + swamp paste + a hammer. Talk to Cornelius, who agrees to become the banker.

steps.label: Repair the furnace and fight Gadderanks' juvinates
steps.detail: South-east corner. Repair the furnace with 2 steel bars + a hammer, add coal, light with a tinderbox -- a cutscene reveals Vanstrom's tithe collector Gadderanks demanding blood. Equip a silver weapon or Efaritay's aid; in the General Store, fight two level-54 Vampyre Juvinates (flinchable/safespottable behind the table) then Gadderanks himself (Veliaf assists).

hints.value: behind-general-store-table

steps.label: Talk to the fallen Gadderanks, then Veliaf
steps.detail: Gadderanks shares vampyre lore before succumbing; Veliaf asks you to return to the Hollows hideout to plan the move.

steps.label: Return to the Myreque Hideout
steps.detail: Bank any pets first (barred from the next instance). Veliaf asks you to escort Ivan Strom to Paterdomus Temple and ask Drezel about Ivandis's weapon.

steps.label: Arm and feed Ivan before the escort
steps.detail: Strongly recommended for lower-combat accounts: use a spare steel med helm, steel chainbody, steel platelegs, silver sickle, and up to 15 food items (stew/salmon/snails/slimy eel) on Ivan. None of these are returned afterward.

steps.label: Escort Ivan through the swamp instance
steps.detail: Talk to Radigad or Polmafi to signal departure, then Ivan to begin. Choose Route 1 (short: 2x level-75 Vampyre Juvinates) over Route 2 (long: 4x level-50s) -- easier to protect Ivan against fewer enemies. Keep Ivan behind you and tank the juvinate directly ahead; if he flees on low food/health, leave and retry with fresh food (he keeps any gear already given).

hints.value: keep-ivan-positioned-behind-you

steps.label: Press Drezel and read The sleeping seven
steps.detail: West trapdoor at the escort's end. Press Drezel about Ivandis's weapon until he relents and gives a library key; use it on the keyholed wall east, descend, search the middle bookcase for 'The sleeping seven' and read it.

steps.label: Make a rod mould from the coffin
steps.detail: East of the Myreque hideout tunnel, use a hammer on the boarded 'X' entrance, enter, and use soft clay on the coffin inside.

steps.label: Craft and enchant the Silvthrill rod
steps.detail: At any furnace, use a silver bar + mithril bar + cut sapphire with the rod mould to craft a Silvthrill rod, then cast Lvl-1 Enchant on it (normal spellbook required; 1 cosmic + 1 water rune).

steps.label: Charge the Rod of Ivandis at the Paterdomus well
steps.detail: Take the enchanted rod and a rope to the Paterdomus Temple basement; use the rod on the well beside Drezel's room.

steps.label: Deliver the Rod of Ivandis to Veliaf
steps.detail: Burgh de Rott inn cellar. Quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Repairing the store, bank, and furnace

notes: GE-violation flag was a false positive: the only purchase mentions are named non-GE NPC vendors in the ironman-only section (Blair's Armour in Shayzien, Frankie's Fishing Emporium) and a Trivia note about player-to-player bucket-of-rubble trading, not a sourcing route. reqs.quests = [in-search-of-the-myreque] per the page's own Details (which itself flattens to nature-spirit/priest-in-peril/the-restless-ghost, already covered by that quest's own contribution).

steps.label: Talk to Father Reen (start Shadow of the Storm)
steps.detail: South of Al Kharid bank. He gives a free uncoloured Silverlight if you don't already carry a regular one -- bank any spare dyed Silverlight first, since carrying both later blocks progress.

steps.label: Travel to the Ruins of Uzer
steps.detail: Shantay Pass + magic carpet, a necklace of passage to Eagles' Eyrie then south-east, or fairy ring dlq then north-east. Bring Silverlight -- it's needed to continue.

steps.label: Talk to Father Badden and pick a black mushroom
steps.detail: Ask through all of his dialogue options. Pick a black mushroom outside the dungeon if not already carried, then enter.

steps.label: Dye Silverlight and 3 clothing items black
steps.detail: Grind the black mushroom into black dye with a pestle & mortar + vial. Assemble any 3 quest-accepted black clothing items (own-words per the page's own list -- e.g. a dyed desert shirt + robe, a black priest gown, dark mystic robes, black dragonhide, or 3 black cosmetic slot items; several black-looking cosmetic items like the black mask do NOT count, per the page's own exclusion list). Also dye Silverlight itself black with the same dye -- never carry a normal and a dyed Silverlight together.

steps.label: Convince Evil Dave to let you through the portal
steps.detail: Wearing all 3 black clothing items, tell Evil Dave you want to join the group. He leads you to Denath, the group's leader, who explains the plan to summon Agrith-Naar and gives a player-specific incantation order to remember (also written, reversed, in a demonic tome found later).

hints.note: Randomised per player; the demonic tome carries the reverse order as a backup.

steps.label: Cut gems from the demon's throne (optional)
steps.detail: Use a chisel and hammer on the demon's throne for 2 sapphires, 2 rubies, 2 emeralds -- skip if already done during The Golem.

steps.label: Get the sigil mould and the clay golem's account
steps.detail: Talk to Jennifer for a demonic sigil mould, then Matthew about Josef -- he asks you to find Josef's dropped book. Talk to the clay golem: it reveals Denath killed Josef and hid the book in an outdoor kiln (must ask the golem before the kilns become searchable).

steps.label: Search the outdoor kilns for the Demonic Tome
steps.detail: Four kilns around Uzer (near the magic carpet and east of the temple) -- search until the tome turns up.

steps.label: Craft the demonic sigil
steps.detail: At any furnace (fairy ring dkr to Edgeville is fastest), use the silver bar with the demonic sigil mould.

steps.label: Chant the incantation in Denath's order
steps.detail: Read the Demonic Tome (its incantation is the reverse of Denath's), return through the portal, and hand Matthew the book. Join Denath's circle and chant the incantation in the order Denath gave using your sigil -- Denath walks into the portal and vanishes: he WAS Agrith-Naar, and the 'backwards' order banished rather than summoned him.

steps.label: Recruit five allies and their sigils
steps.detail: Pick up Denath's dropped sigil (or immediately chase Tanya back through the portal for a double sigil/bones drop). Chase Evil Dave, Eric, and Tanya through the portal -- Tanya and Eric die to hazards (loot their sigils), then convince Evil Dave to return and hand over his. Recruit Father Badden and Father Reen (give each a spare sigil) and the clay golem (use the strange implement found in the lair on it first, then ask again) as the final participants.

hints.note: Optional trick, not required to progress.

steps.label: Summon and kill Agrith-Naar with Silverlight
steps.detail: Re-enter the portal, talk to Matthew to gather everyone, chant the incantation in the book's (opposite) order. Agrith-Naar (level 100) appears, kills Matthew, then attacks you -- melee by default, switches to Fire Blast if you pray/step out of range, or Telekinetic Grabs you back in if you pray Magic from range. No cannon allowed. The final blow MUST land with Silverlight or his HP snaps back to 12; Silverlight merges into Darklight automatically on the kill.

hints.value: flinch-with-silverlight-never-behind-pillar-before-final-blow
hints.note: Ducking behind a pillar/torch right before the kill registers voids the final hit.

checkpoints.label: Starting Out (Al Kharid -> Uzer -> black outfit)

notes: Not in the queue's fix_ids and confirmed clean: no Grand Exchange mention anywhere on the page. Note the route-grand step id is 'quest-shadow-storm' but the real quest title is 'Shadow of the Storm' -- refs cite the correct title/slug.

steps.label: Talk to the Dwarven Boatman to travel to Keldagrim
steps.detail: Take fairy ring code DKS then head through the tunnel south-west and the Cave Entrance, or simply speak to the boatman to begin the trip.

hints.value: 1That's a deal!
1Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.

steps.label: Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban
steps.detail: Commander Veldaban, near the West Keldagrim bank, briefs you on the sculptor's project.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

steps.label: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor
steps.detail: Blasidar, on the east side of Keldagrim south of the kebab shop, explains he needs items for a statue of King Alvis.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

steps.label: Ask Vermundi about the exquisite clothes
steps.detail: Vermundi the silk trader works the large eastern-market building in East Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.

steps.label: Ask the Librarian about Dwarven costumes
steps.detail: The Librarian sits in the library at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?

steps.label: Climb a bookcase for the costume book
steps.detail: Climbing any library bookcase yields the Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes; carrying 30kg or more of gear blocks the climb.

steps.label: Source coal for the spinning machine
steps.detail: Coal can be mined in the north-east corner of East Keldagrim, or bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace if not already carried.

steps.label: Tell Vermundi you're ready for the clothes
steps.detail: Return to Vermundi once coal and logs are in hand.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...

steps.label: Spin coal and logs into cloth
steps.detail: Use coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi, then light the result with a tinderbox.

steps.label: Buy the exquisite clothes from Vermundi for 200gp
steps.detail: Pay Vermundi 200gp once the spun cloth is ready.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...
1I'll pay.

steps.label: Buy 3 sapphires from Hervi if not already carried
steps.detail: Hervi runs the gem stall just north of Vermundi.

steps.label: Ask Saro about the special boots
steps.detail: Saro works the anvil south-west of the West Keldagrim bank.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.

steps.label: Speak to Dromund
steps.detail: Dromund lives in a house just north of the West Keldagrim bank.

steps.label: Take the left boot while Dromund isn't looking
steps.detail: Slip the left boot away from Dromund's house while he's distracted.

steps.label: Telegrab the right boot through the window
steps.detail: Go outside behind Dromund's house and cast Telekinetic Grab on the right boot through the window while he isn't looking.

steps.label: Ask Santiri about the battleaxe
steps.detail: Santiri runs the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim and hands over the ancient dwarven battleaxe.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
2Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.
2Perhaps I can repair the axe?

steps.label: Socket the 3 sapphires into the battleaxe
steps.detail: Use the 3 sapphires on the ancient battleaxe now in your inventory.

steps.label: Talk to Santiri again to confirm the axe
steps.detail: Confirm the gem-set axe with Santiri before moving on.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.

steps.label: Ask the Librarian about the Imcando dwarves if needed
steps.detail: Skip this and the next step entirely if Thurgo was already met via The Knight's Sword.

steps.label: Ask Reldo about the Imcando dwarves if needed
steps.detail: Reldo, in the Varrock Palace library, points toward Thurgo; skip if Thurgo has already been met.

steps.label: Get Thurgo to repair the battleaxe
steps.detail: Thurgo works at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ); give him an iron bar to repair the axe, with a redberry pie as a possible extra if he hasn't received one recently, then take the option to return to Keldagrim immediately.

hints.value: 2Something else.
3Can you help me with this ancient axe?
1Would you like a redberry pie?
1Return to Keldagrim immediately.

steps.label: Give Riki the clothes, boots and axe
steps.detail: Riki, Blasidar's model, receives the exquisite clothes, both boots, and the repaired battleaxe.

steps.label: Talk to Blasidar and watch the statue cutscene
steps.detail: Blasidar completes the statue once Riki has the items.

steps.label: Choose a company and offer to help its secretary
steps.detail: Pick any company except the Red Axe from the market's upper floor; progress only counts toward the one company chosen.

hints.value: 3Is there anything I can help you with?

steps.label: Deliver requested ores until the hidden score allows bar tasks
steps.detail: Each successful ore delivery (5 of a kind is a safe buffer, ores can be noted) gives 20 hidden points, refusals cost 2; ores can also be bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace. Repeat until 75+ points unlocks director bar tasks.

steps.label: Deliver bars for the director until membership is offered
steps.detail: Bring unnoted metal bars requested by the director (12 points each); unlike the secretary, click the director again before advancing the dialogue. Continue until 100 points is reached.

hints.value: 3Do you have any more tasks for me?

steps.label: Officially join the chosen company
steps.detail: Accept membership when the director offers it, mentioning Blasidar sent you.

hints.value: 2I'd like to officially join your company.
3Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.
1I would support you.
1Yes! Long live the <company name>!

steps.label: Report to Commander Veldaban to finish
steps.detail: Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank; you may decline the meeting invite offered afterward.

atoms.label: Start the quest with Alec Kincade
atoms.detail: Talk to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild to begin Dragon Slayer II.

hints.value: 2 How can I gain access to the Guild? / 1 Yes.

atoms.label: Talk to Dallas Jones at Musa Point
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones at the Karamja pub in Musa Point to continue the investigation.

hints.value: 2 Yes I know it well.

atoms.label: Travel to Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor
atoms.detail: Head to Elvarg's Lair under Crandor, using the Karamja volcano shortcut.

atoms.label: Talk to Dallas Jones in Elvarg's old lair
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once inside the lair where Elvarg was fought in Dragon Slayer I.

atoms.label: Pickaxe the marked northern wall and enter the tunnel
atoms.detail: Use a pickaxe on the northern wall in Elvarg's old lair (marked with a red line on the minimap), then enter the revealed tunnel.

atoms.label: Investigate the Ancient Mural
atoms.detail: Investigate the Ancient Mural to the north of the tunnel; doing so triggers a hostile spawn.

atoms.label: Kill the spawn guarding the mural
atoms.detail: Kill the level 100 spawn that attacks after the mural is first investigated.

atoms.label: Investigate the Ancient Mural again
atoms.detail: Investigate the Ancient Mural a second time now that the guardian spawn is defeated.

atoms.label: Report the mural to Dallas Jones
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones after investigating the mural to close out this checkpoint.

atoms.label: Enter the House on the Hill basement on Fossil Island
atoms.detail: Head to the basement of the House on the Hill on Fossil Island.

atoms.label: Ask Dallas Jones about the island
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones in the house basement about Fossil Island.

hints.value: 1 Ask about the island.

atoms.label: Search the open chest for map pieces
atoms.detail: Search the open chest north of the puzzle map for 5 jigsaw map pieces.

atoms.label: Search the upstairs stone chest for map pieces
atoms.detail: Go upstairs and search the open stone chest on the north wall for 3 more jigsaw map pieces.

atoms.label: Search the fungi outside for map pieces
atoms.detail: Go outside and search the fungi just north of the staircase for 4 jigsaw map pieces.

atoms.label: Search the Hook briar for map pieces
atoms.detail: Search the Hook briar south of the house for 7 jigsaw map pieces.

atoms.label: Search the mushtree for the final map pieces
atoms.detail: Run east and search the Mushroom Meadow mushtree for the last 5 jigsaw map pieces (24 total collected).

atoms.label: Solve the 24-piece jigsaw map
atoms.detail: Use all 24 collected map pieces on the puzzle map, rotating and dragging them into place (pieces can be handed to Dallas Jones to save inventory space instead of carrying all 24).

atoms.label: Tell Dallas Jones the map is solved
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once the map puzzle is solved.

hints.value: 1 Let's talk about the investigation. / 1 Let's do it!

atoms.label: Talk to Dallas Jones again
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones a further time after the puzzle conversation.

atoms.label: Talk to Jardric at the museum camp
atoms.detail: Talk to Jardric at the museum camp to close out this checkpoint.

atoms.label: Build a rowboat to Lithkren
atoms.detail: Bring 8 oak planks, 10 swamp paste, at least 12 nails, a hammer and a saw to the island's west coast (south-west of the Mushroom Meadow mushtree) and build a rowboat.

atoms.label: Board the rowboat with Dallas Jones
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones and board the rowboat to Lithkren.

hints.value: 1 I'm ready.

atoms.label: Reach the ruined courtyard
atoms.detail: Sail north-west to the ruined courtyard and climb the western stairs.

atoms.label: Descend into the depths beneath Lithkren
atoms.detail: Climb down the southern trapdoor, then take the staircases north and north again into the depths.

atoms.label: Talk to Dallas Jones in the depths
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once inside the depths.

atoms.label: Read Aivas' diary from the skeleton
atoms.detail: Search the skeleton to the east and read Aivas' diary.

atoms.label: Talk to Dallas Jones after reading the diary
atoms.detail: Talk to Dallas Jones again after reading Aivas' diary.

atoms.label: Find and talk to Bob the Cat
atoms.detail: Locate Bob the Cat using the Catspeak amulet (e) and talk to him.

hints.value: Bob's usual haunts change post A Tail of Two Cats; he roams and may need to be relocated with the amulet.

atoms.label: Ask the Sphinx to enchant cat-speech
atoms.detail: Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem, who enchants permanent cat-speech so the Catspeak amulet is no longer needed to talk to cats.

hints.value: 1 Ask the Sphinx for help with Bob's memories.

atoms.label: Travel to Lunar Isle
atoms.detail: Head to Lunar Isle to begin the Robert the Strong checkpoint.

atoms.label: Ask the Oneiromancer about Bob's memories
atoms.detail: Talk to the Oneiromancer on Lunar Isle about Bob's memories.

hints.value: 3 Bob's memories. / 1 Yes.
A seal of passage is needed to speak to the Oneiromancer, though the bank run by 'Bird's-Eye' Jack works without it.

atoms.label: Crush and grind an astral rune
atoms.detail: Crush an astral rune with a hammer, then grind the shards with a pestle and mortar.

atoms.label: Brew the dream potion
atoms.detail: Fill the dream vial with water from the sink west of the bank, then add the goutweed and ground astral rune to brew a dream potion.

atoms.label: Light the brazier and enter the dream
atoms.detail: Gear up for a fight, light the Ceremonial Brazier in the island's largest building, then use the dream potion on the flame to enter Bob's dream.

atoms.label: Talk to Bob and Not Bob inside the dream
atoms.detail: Talk to Bob and Not Bob inside the dream, then exit via the giant history book if you need to regear before the fight.

atoms.label: Re-enter the dream through the barrier
atoms.detail: Talk to Bob outside the brazier to re-enter the dream, then head through the barrier toward Robert the Strong.

hints.value: The dream potion does not need remaking if you leave the dream and re-enter later.

atoms.label: Kill Robert the Strong
atoms.detail: Kill Robert the Strong with melee/crush gear only (ranged and magic cannot be used); run behind a pillar when he shouts his warning line to dodge his heavy special attack, which otherwise deals up to 60 damage and strips prayers.

atoms.label: Descend into the Kharazi Jungle maze
atoms.detail: Head to the south-eastern coast of the Kharazi Jungle and descend the staircase into the golem maze; turn off Auto Retaliate before entering.

atoms.label: Navigate the maze past the coloured golems
atoms.detail: Navigate to the maze centre, avoiding spike/trap tiles with Thieving and Agility, and matching each golem's protection prayer to its colour: red is melee, green is ranged, blue is magic.

atoms.label: Take the Karamja dragon key piece
atoms.detail: Take the dragon key piece from the plinth at the maze's centre; using the plinth also teleports you back out.

atoms.label: Ask Reldo about Tristan
atoms.detail: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library and ask about Tristan.

hints.value: 1 Ask about Tristan.

atoms.label: Search the marked library bookcase
atoms.detail: Search the second bookcase from the north, on the west side of the central row.

atoms.label: Ask Reldo about Tristan again
atoms.detail: Talk to Reldo again after searching the bookcase.

hints.value: 1 Ask about Tristan.

atoms.label: Speak to Sarah in Port Phasmatys
atoms.detail: Travel to Port Phasmatys and speak to Sarah, west of the bank.

atoms.label: Bring key-piece materials to Ava
atoms.detail: Bring a dragonstone, 2 molten glass, a glassblowing pipe and a chisel to Ava in Draynor Manor.

hints.value: 3 I need your help with a key piece.

atoms.label: Craft the locator orb
atoms.detail: Use the glassblowing pipe on the dragonstone to make an inert locator orb, then use it on Ava to get a working locator orb.

atoms.label: Dowse Mort Myre Swamp for the buried key piece
atoms.detail: Head to Mort Myre Swamp and repeatedly use the locator orb (starting at Fairy code BKR) to narrow down the buried key piece's location; each use damages you, so bring food.

until.state: location narrowed to single dig spot

atoms.label: Dig up the Morytania dragon key piece
atoms.detail: Dig up the dragon key piece once the locator orb has narrowed the dig spot down.

atoms.label: Ask Brundt about the dragonkin fortress
atoms.detail: Ask Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka about the dragonkin fortress.

hints.value: 2 or 3 Ask about the dragonkin fortress (option varies by seal of passage ownership), or 4 if The Fremennik Exiles is not yet started.

atoms.label: Sail to Ungael with Torfinn
atoms.detail: Talk to Torfinn on the Rellekka dock to sail to Ungael (100,000gp instance cost).

hints.value: 1 Yes please.

atoms.label: Kill Vorkath
atoms.detail: Fight Vorkath with full anti-dragonfire/anti-venom preparation, moving off his fireball tiles, re-enabling prayers after his pink fireball, and reacting to his periodic acid-spam or freeze-and-zombie special attacks.

atoms.label: Reach the cave north-west of the crater
atoms.detail: Climb over the ice chunks north of the crater and walk along the path to the cave on the island's north-west, watching for venomous spiders inside.

atoms.label: Pull the lever and beat the timer
atoms.detail: Pull the lever in the south-west section, then immediately run to the room on the east wall before the timer expires (needs at least 15% run energy).

atoms.label: Claim the Ungael dragon key piece and ancient key
atoms.detail: Search the stone chest for the Ungael dragon key piece and the ancient key needed later at the Ancient Cavern.

atoms.label: Enter the crypt south of the Graveyard of Heroes
atoms.detail: Enter the crypt whose entrance is in the southern part of the Graveyard of Heroes and follow the dirt path south to a small building; the crypt holds aggressive skeletons and zombies attacking with all three combat styles.

atoms.label: Inspect the tomb to reveal the puzzle
atoms.detail: Head to the bottom of the crypt and inspect the tomb to find the statue-placement puzzle.

atoms.label: Place the four statues per the account-specific clues
atoms.detail: Place the four statues using the account-specific person/weapon/location riddle clues: the statue seated by its own location goes north, the one opposite the paired weapon-holder goes south, the one asked about first goes west, and the remaining statue goes east.

until.state: account-specific statue solution, see quest's own person/weapon/location table

atoms.label: Claim the Kourend dragon key piece
atoms.detail: Search the tomb to get the Kourend dragon key piece once the statue puzzle is solved.

atoms.label: Travel to the Ancient Cavern
atoms.detail: Use a games necklace to teleport to Barbarian Outpost, run south to the whirlpool, and descend the stairs into the Ancient Cavern.

atoms.label: Open the mithril door with the ancient key
atoms.detail: Run south then west to the mithril door guarding the three clumped mithril dragons and open it with the ancient key found at Ungael.

atoms.label: Cast Fire Wave on the three dragon heads
atoms.detail: Cast Fire Wave or Fire Surge on each of the three dragon heads in the mithril door room.

hints.value: Rune counts given are for 3 casts of Fire Wave (21 fire, 15 air, 3 blood).

atoms.label: Reach the anvils in the south-west caverns
atoms.detail: Leave the dragon-head room, go east down the staircase, then climb the rough-hewn steps in the south-western area of the caverns.

atoms.label: Forge the Dragon key
atoms.detail: Use one of the anvils to forge the four dragon key pieces into the completed Dragon key.

atoms.label: Return to Lithkren by rowboat
atoms.detail: Return to Fossil Island and take the Rowboat back to Lithkren, west of the Mushroom Meadow mushtree, to the area where Dallas Jones is.

atoms.label: Unlock the ancient doors with the Dragon key
atoms.detail: Use the completed Dragon key on the ancient doors to unlock them.

atoms.label: Trigger the Lithkren cutscene with Dallas
atoms.detail: Enter the doors, head north, and speak to Dallas Jones to start a cutscene.

atoms.label: Finish dialogue with Jardric and Bob
atoms.detail: After the cutscene, finish the dialogue with Jardric and Bob to close out the Lithkren checkpoint.

atoms.label: Warn King Roald of the dragon threat
atoms.detail: Travel to Varrock and speak with King Roald about the dragon threat.

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

atoms.label: Warn Sir Amik Varze of the dragon threat
atoms.detail: Speak with Sir Amik Varze in Falador about the dragon threat.

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

atoms.label: Warn King Lathas (or King Thoros) of the dragon threat
atoms.detail: Speak with King Lathas in East Ardougne about the dragon threat (King Thoros if Song of the Elves is complete).

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

atoms.label: Warn Brundt the Chieftain of the dragon threat
atoms.detail: Speak with Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka about the dragon threat; the rulers can be visited in any order.

hints.value: 2 or 3 Talk about the dragon threat (option varies if The Fremennik Exiles is complete).

atoms.label: Finalize the plan in Varrock's dining room
atoms.detail: Return to Varrock and enter the dining room north of the throne room to finalize the plan with all four rulers.

hints.value: 1 It's a good plan.

atoms.label: Talk to Bob after the war council
atoms.detail: Talk to Bob after exiting the dining room to close out the World United checkpoint.

atoms.label: Return to Ungael for the assault
atoms.detail: Return to Rellekka and take Torfinn's boat back to Ungael (100,000gp instance cost) for the final assault.

atoms.label: Defend the ship from the boarding raid
atoms.detail: Hold off the assault on your ship for 4 minutes by clicking leaks to fill them, fires to douse them, injured Fremennik warriors to heal them, and damaged masts to repair them.

hints.value: Checkpoint after this defence phase; safe to log out and resume.

atoms.label: Equip dragonfire protection for the boarding fight
atoms.detail: Put on full dragonfire protection and combat gear before advancing across the ship toward Varrock's grand ship.

atoms.label: Fight through the approach dragons
atoms.detail: Fight through a red dragon, an iron dragon, and a brutal green dragon on the way to Varrock's grand ship.

atoms.label: Kill the green and blue dragons on the grand ship
atoms.detail: Kill the two green and two blue dragons battling the Varrockian soldiers on the grand ship; a checkpoint follows.

atoms.label: Kill the black, steel and brutal red dragons
atoms.detail: Kill the black, steel, then brutal red dragons that arrive one at a time; run away whenever Galvek performs a casting animation. A checkpoint follows.

atoms.label: Kill the mithril, adamant and rune dragons
atoms.detail: Kill the mithril, adamant, then rune dragons one at a time, dodging their melee/ranged/magic/dragonfire attacks; the adamant dragon adds a Blood-Forfeit ranged hit and a poison splash (mitigated by Antidote++), and the rune dragon adds a Life-Leech ranged hit and an electric arc (mitigated by insulated boots). A checkpoint follows.

atoms.label: Gear up fully for the Galvek fight
atoms.detail: Equip both a dragonfire shield and a dragonfire potion (super antifire alone is not enough protection) plus ranged gear, and turn off Auto Retaliate before engaging Galvek.

hints.value: Thralls cannot be summoned in this fight.

atoms.label: Kill Galvek across his four phases
atoms.detail: Kill Galvek across his four 300-hitpoint phases: dodge his ground-targeted fireballs and re-enable prayers after his pink dragonfire strips them, using Protect from Magic in phase 1 and Protect from Missiles in phases 2-4; dodge phase 1's fire traps, phase 2's stat-drain projectile, phase 3's wave gaps, and phase 4's earth-bind projectiles.

atoms.label: Finish the quest with Alec Kincade
atoms.detail: Return to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild to complete Dragon Slayer II.

hints.value: 2 Let's talk about my quest.

notes: 83 atoms (idx 0-82) across 14 checkpoints, atomized from Dragon Slayer II/Quick guide s3-s17 (per-subsection slugs cited per atom, all confirmed present in manifest.jsonl). Section 8 ('The dragon key', a 156B-listed stub) parent-pulled all 5 key-piece children (s9-s13) inline, extending the parent-pulls-children-even-when-parent-is-the-stub precedent -- cited the precise child subsection slug per atom rather than the coarse s8 parent since all 5 children were separately fetched and manifest-recorded. Section 15 ('The Assault') likewise parent-pulled its 'The Final Battle' child (s16) inline; both were also fetched and cited separately. Only one {{Map}} template exists across the entire Quick guide (Karamjan Temple entrance, 2946,2900 plane 0, surface envelope) -- attached to the Karamja maze-entry atom (idx 37); every other atom's coords[] is empty, a fetch-confirmed gap not a shortfall. Zero 'Grand Exchange' mentions anywhere in the fetched text -- no GE-violation flag needed. Several bare/variant {{Chat option}} templates (Reldo, Sir Amik Varze, King Lathas dialogue lines) render as plain option text with no numeric branching ambiguity, so their exact option text was cited verbatim rather than left as '??'; the two genuinely branching dialogue lines (Brundt the Chieftain's fortress/threat lines, gated on seal-of-passage/Fremennik-Exiles progress) are recorded as multi-option hints rather than picking one arbitrarily. The Ungael and 'return to Ungael for the Assault' boat trips both cite the wiki's stated 100,000gp Instance cost as a consumed gp amount, not an item. Zero branch{} field used anywhere (this quest has no player-facing route choice, unlike Hazeel Cult/Throne of Miscellania precedents) -- flat sequential atoms throughout.

checkpoints.label: Report to King Narnode Shareen about Glough's disappearance
Investigate Glough's house and decode his hidden note
Infiltrate Kruk's dungeon on Ape Atoll and kill Kruk
Defeat Kob and Keef, then locate Assistant Le Smith
Sabotage the airship platforms and reach Glough's laboratory
Fight through the tortured gorillas to reach Glough's hideout
Defeat Glough across his three-room final battle

atoms.label: Tell King Narnode Shareen you'll help find Glough
atoms.detail: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree, who reports Glough missing and asks for help investigating.

hints.value: I'll help you look for Glough.

atoms.label: Climb the eastern tree at Glough's house and investigate it
atoms.detail: Enter Glough's house south-east of the Grand Tree, climb the eastern tree, then right-click investigate it to receive a handkerchief. Carry no weapons or armour.

atoms.label: Ask Anita what's wrong
atoms.detail: Visit Anita's house north of the Gnome Ball Field; she says Glough might be in trouble and offers to help.

hints.value: What's wrong? -> He might be in trouble, I could help.

atoms.label: Turn the gnome statue to unlock the cupboard
atoms.detail: Return to Glough's house, climb the tree to the second then third floor (via the northern branch), then investigate and turn the gnome statue to unlock the cupboard.

hints.value: climbing to the 3rd floor requires clicking the northern branch

atoms.label: Search the cupboard for the book of spyology
atoms.detail: Search the now-unlocked cupboard to obtain a book of spyology.

atoms.label: Search the gnome crates for a brush
atoms.detail: Search the gnome crates in the same room to obtain a brush.

atoms.label: Search the fire remains for a mysterious note
atoms.detail: Search the fire remains to obtain a mysterious note.

atoms.label: Prepare reagents and reveal the scrawled note
atoms.detail: Solve the invisible-ink puzzle: crush the lemon with the pestle and mortar, use the resulting reagent on the notes over the candles, crush the grapes, coat the brush in the juice, then use the juice-coated brush on the mysterious note to reveal a scrawled note underneath. Read it once revealed.

hints.value: the exact intermediate reagent item names are not stated on the quick guide -- collapsed into one puzzle atom rather than fabricating names

atoms.label: Show King Narnode the scrawled note and read the translation book
atoms.detail: Talk to King Narnode Shareen, who hands over a translation book (skipped if already held from The Grand Tree).

atoms.label: Translate the note with the translation book
atoms.detail: Use the translation book on the scrawled note to attempt a translation, then talk to King Narnode again about the result.

atoms.label: Ask Anita to translate the notes
atoms.detail: Show the partially-translated notes to Anita and ask her to translate them fully, then read the translated note.

hints.value: Could you translate these notes?

atoms.label: Report the translated note to King Narnode
atoms.detail: Return to King Narnode Shareen and hand over the fully translated note.

atoms.label: Ask Assistant Lori who she is
atoms.detail: Talk to Assistant Lori, who stands next to the hot air balloon beside Glough's house.

hints.value: Who are you?

atoms.label: Fly the hot air balloon to Entrana
atoms.detail: Board the hot air balloon beside Glough's house and fly to Entrana.

atoms.label: Ask Auguste about Assistant Le Smith
atoms.detail: Talk to Auguste on Entrana about Assistant Le Smith.

hints.value: Talk about Assistant Le Smith. -> Thanks for the information.

atoms.label: Fly the balloon back to the Gnome Stronghold
atoms.detail: Return via hot air balloon to the Gnome Stronghold.

atoms.label: Report back to King Narnode to close Chapter I
atoms.detail: Talk to King Narnode Shareen once more to conclude Chapter I.

atoms.label: Travel to Ape Atoll
atoms.detail: Reach Ape Atoll via the CLR fairy ring code, one of the two Ape Atoll teleports, or the gliders used in the first quest.

atoms.label: Equip a monkey/gorilla greegree
atoms.detail: Equip a ninja monkey greegree or ancient gorilla greegree and use the agility shortcut vine to climb down into the village.

atoms.label: Buy a monkey talisman from Tutab if needed
atoms.detail: If you don't already have a monkey talisman, purchase one from Tutab in the Ape Atoll Magic shop.

hints.value: skip if a monkey talisman is already held

atoms.label: Tell Garkor King Narnode sent you
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor outside Awowogei's house.

hints.value: King Narnode has sent me. -> It's worth a shot.

atoms.label: Offer to discuss military strategy with Awowogei
atoms.detail: Talk to Awowogei.

hints.value: I'm here to discuss military strategies. -> Of course, my king.

atoms.label: Return to Garkor
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor again.

atoms.label: Ask a Monkey Archer about Kruk
atoms.detail: Travel to the west side of the island and up the hill to the Monkey Archers, then ask one about Kruk.

atoms.label: Follow the tracks to the dungeon trapdoor and descend
atoms.detail: Follow the foot prints from the foot of the hill to a trapdoor at the foot of a palm tree just north-west of the bamboo gate, then go down and head south.

hints.value: if inventory is full the greegree drops to the floor on entering

atoms.label: Cross the dodgy-ground agility route to the eastern cave
atoms.detail: Take the agility path east through Kruk's dungeon: only step on the uncracked (non-dodgy) tiles, switch Protect from Melee or Ranged as needed whenever you fall through, and head to the nearest hanging vine to climb back up until reaching the eastern cave (checkpoint 3).
