hints.value: alternate tank path: cut webs with a slash weapon and mine blocking rocks with a pickaxe, pray ranged, take the north or south fork to loot a scratched or damaged combat key from one of two chests, then disarm/dodge floor-blade and dart traps and open the matching door -- both routes converge at checkpoint 5

atoms.label: Pick the chest lock in the eastern cave
atoms.detail: Pick the lock on the chest in the small eastern cave and search it for a bronze key.

atoms.label: Pass the bronze door and continue to checkpoint 5
atoms.detail: Move through the bronze door north-west of the chest, then continue north to checkpoint 4 (praying Ranged when falling) and west to checkpoint 5, watching the map for the correct route.

atoms.label: Cross the final dodgy ground into Kruk's room
atoms.detail: Pray Melee when falling on this stretch, keep prayer active after climbing the rope to guard against the three monkeys above, and follow whichever path does not give a 'feels wrong' message.

atoms.label: Investigate the untaken-path wall to unlock the bank shortcut
atoms.detail: Before crossing the dodgy ground into Kruk's room, investigate the wall facing the path you did not take to unlock a shortcut back to the dungeon entrance for restocking.

atoms.label: Kill Kruk
atoms.detail: Enter the large cave south of the dodgy ground to find Kruk (level 207, instanced) and kill him. He can be flinched by standing against a cave wall so he stands diagonally from you, attacking each time his health bar disappears then stepping back; otherwise use stamina potions, ranged, and Protect from Missiles with hit-and-run tactics.

atoms.label: Pick up Kruk's paw
atoms.detail: Pick up Kruk's paw after the kill.

atoms.label: Bring Kruk's paw and a monkey talisman to Zooknock
atoms.detail: Talk to Zooknock at the end of the Ape Atoll Dungeon from Monkey Madness I, bringing Kruk's paw and a monkey talisman; he gives a Kruk monkey greegree, which prevents damage from undead monkeys and spiders in the dungeon from here on.

hints.value: Talk about your mission.

atoms.label: Report to Awowogei
atoms.detail: Talk to Awowogei.

atoms.label: Report to Garkor to close Chapter II
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor.

atoms.label: Teleport to Trollheim and enter the Troll Stronghold
atoms.detail: Teleport to Trollheim on the standard spellbook (or use a stony basalt) and enter the Troll Stronghold.

atoms.label: Confront Kob
atoms.detail: Go south-west of the entrance into Kob's room, activate Protect from Melee, and talk to him.

hints.value: I know about your deal with the monkeys. -> You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you. -> I accept your challenge.

atoms.label: Fight Kob until he gives up
atoms.detail: Fight Kob (hits up to 58 through Protect from Melee if not active; can be safespotted in the doorway) until he gives up -- if the fight runs too long he despawns and his health resets, so flinching is not viable.

atoms.label: Talk to Kob again
atoms.detail: Talk to Kob a second time to conclude his part.

atoms.label: Travel to Gu'Tanoth
atoms.detail: Make your way to Gu'Tanoth using the level-71 Agility shortcut, or the western path for lower Agility.

hints.value: 71 Agility shortcut is optional; the western path works at any level

atoms.label: Confront Keef
atoms.detail: Activate Protect from Melee and talk to Keef.

hints.value: I know about your deal with the monkeys. -> I offer to spare your life. -> I accept your challenge.

atoms.label: Fight Keef until he gives up
atoms.detail: Fight Keef (also hits through protection prayers and despawns on a long fight) until he gives up; a tree north of him can be used as a safespot.

atoms.label: Bank combat gear and withdraw the graceful outfit
atoms.detail: Bank heavy armour and weapons and withdraw the graceful outfit plus stamina potions, since no more combat follows until Chapter IV.

atoms.label: Return to Ape Atoll
atoms.detail: Teleport back to Ape Atoll and talk to Garkor near Awowogei.

atoms.label: Check in with Garkor
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor near Awowogei's house.

atoms.label: Find and question Assistant Le Smith
atoms.detail: Find Assistant Le Smith on the rooftops of Marim -- he spawns at one of four possible spots: the broken building's top floor near the Monkey Child, the jail's top floor, the building west of the Magic Stall's top floor (or its dungeon-cave shortcut, which can deal 30+ fall damage), or atop the bridge between the two main-gate watchtowers.

hints.value: I was going to ask you the same question. -> Why is that? -> Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. -> Where is the fleet, currently?

atoms.label: Report the fleet location to Garkor
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor.

atoms.label: Ask the monkey guard for passage to the airship platform
atoms.detail: Go to the west side of the island and talk to the monkey guard next to a boat to travel to the airship platform.

hints.value: What's going on here? -> Construction platform? -> Can I visit the platform?

atoms.label: Collect 6 satchels from the crates
atoms.detail: Sneak through the airship maze avoiding ninja monkeys: from the ground floor's east wall, pass the cyan ladder and climb the green ladder, go south then west and climb down the blue ladder, then pick up 6 satchels from the crates.

atoms.label: Fill the satchels with explosives
atoms.detail: Climb back to the ground floor's cyan ladder, climb down the magenta ladder, follow the path north to the explosives, then click the barrel to fill all 6 satchels (getting caught after this point means refilling them).

atoms.label: Place all 6 satchels on the marked sabotage points
atoms.detail: Place a filled satchel on each of the 6 marked weak points across the platform: weakened floorboards below the magenta ladder, support beams east of the ground floor, weakened floorboards at the end of the west path's north fork, both gas cylinders on the top floor, and the support beams in the west fork near the entrance, avoiding ninja monkey patrols throughout.

atoms.label: Return to the boat
atoms.detail: Head back to the boat -- getting caught on the way out no longer matters and can be faster.

atoms.label: Report the sabotage to Garkor
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor.

atoms.label: Re-enter the dungeon where Kruk was fought
atoms.detail: Enter the trapdoor down to the dungeon where Kruk was fought.

atoms.label: Cross the monkey bars with the Kruk greegree
atoms.detail: Go north to the monkey bars, equip the Kruk greegree, and use the monkey bars to cross.

atoms.label: Enter Glough's laboratory
atoms.detail: Enter the passage into Glough's laboratory.

atoms.label: Mount the stunted demonic gorilla
atoms.detail: Climb on the stunted demonic gorilla and ride it down the stairs.

atoms.label: Fight the three gorillas until they retreat
atoms.detail: Fight the three gorillas (use Protect from Melee if necessary) until they return to their cages.

atoms.label: Dismount the stunted demonic gorilla
atoms.detail: Use the holding area to dismount the stunted demonic gorilla.

atoms.label: Search the crates for a chisel and hammer if needed
atoms.detail: Search the crates for a chisel and hammer if not already carrying them.

hints.value: skip if already held

atoms.label: Tamper with the device upstairs
atoms.detail: Go upstairs and tamper with the device to the north.

atoms.label: Deconstruct the charged onyx with the chisel
atoms.detail: Use the chisel on the charged onyx to deconstruct it, then use the deconstructed onyx on the device.

atoms.label: Investigate the incubation chamber
atoms.detail: Investigate the incubation chamber found in the laboratory.

atoms.label: Report to Garkor
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor.

atoms.label: Report to Awowogei
atoms.detail: Talk to Awowogei.

atoms.label: Report to Garkor to close Chapter III
atoms.detail: Talk to Garkor again.

atoms.label: Return to the Grand Tree
atoms.detail: Travel back to the Grand Tree (e.g. via spirit tree, gnome glider, or teleport).

atoms.label: Report to King Narnode
atoms.detail: Talk to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.

atoms.label: Talk to Nieve about Monkey Madness II
atoms.detail: Talk to Nieve, who will wait at the Grand Tree's front doors if lost track of later.

hints.value: Talk about Monkey Madness II. -> Yes.

atoms.label: Kill 4 tortured gorillas around the Gnome Stronghold
atoms.detail: Walk around the Gnome Stronghold killing tortured gorillas (melee-only, safespottable behind objects) until Nieve notifies you to find Garkor.

atoms.label: Report to Garkor north-west of the Grand Tree
atoms.detail: Gear up with two attack styles and go north-west of the Grand Tree, near the swamp toad, king worm swamp, and tortoise enclosure, to find Garkor.

atoms.label: Enter the cave north-east of the Gnome Stronghold
atoms.detail: Leave the Gnome Stronghold and head north-east, past the tortured gorillas, to enter the (instanced) cave and follow the path to Glough.

atoms.label: Kill the 2 tortured and 2 demonic gorillas guarding Glough
atoms.detail: Kill 2 tortured gorillas and 2 demonic gorillas blocking the path; killing a tortured gorilla then the demonic gorilla that drops down, before repeating on the other pair, is recommended. This is a safe point to teleport out and restock -- Glough himself hits up to 66 melee and 40+ ranged.

atoms.label: Fight Glough in the first room until he retreats
atoms.detail: In the first (instanced) room, attack Glough (safespottable here) until he moves on to the next room.

atoms.label: Lure and fight Glough in the second room until he retreats
atoms.detail: Lure Glough back into the first room and hug the north wall two squares past the divot to safespot him with ranged or magic -- Protect from Missiles does not protect here -- until he moves on to the final room.

atoms.label: Kill Glough in the final room
atoms.detail: In the final room, kill Glough (level 431): use Protect from Melee up close and Protect from Magic at range, since he pushes/pulls you depending on distance; he can be flinched with a bow of range 10+ but requires a 10-minute de-aggro first.

atoms.label: Ask Zooknock to teleport you to the Grand Tree
atoms.detail: Talk to Zooknock and ask him to teleport you to the Grand Tree.

atoms.label: Complete the quest with King Narnode
atoms.detail: Talk to King Narnode to finish the quest.

notes: Grandmaster 5-chapter quest; Chapter II's Kruk-dungeon maze is a genuine two-route branch (agility vs tank/web-slashing path) -- atomized the agility path (listed first on the quick guide) as canonical and folded the tank path into a note hint on its first atom, per the Hazeel Cult/Tower of Life branch-fold precedent (gotchas #78/#123/#124). Airship-platform stealth minigame (6 satchels x 6 sabotage points) collapsed into 3 count=6 atoms rather than unrolled per-satchel, per the never-unroll-repetition rule. Invisible-ink note-decoding puzzle (Chapter I) collapsed into one atom since the quick guide never names the intermediate reagent items -- left unnamed rather than fabricated. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} pins present in the fetched Quick guide walkthrough text, so all coords are empty.

steps.label: Talk to Dondakan (start Between a Rock...)
steps.detail: Keldagrim SW mine, across the Dwarven Ferryman's river (2 coins or free with ring of charos(a)). Ask why he's firing a cannon at the wall, then ask again -- he wants information about the rock and sends the player to the Librarian.

steps.label: Talk to the Engineer (Keldagrim palace anvil room)
steps.detail: Western Trading Consortium, near the anvil (not the anvil itself, the room housing it). Sends the player to Rolad at the Dwarven Mine camp near Ice Mountain.

steps.label: Talk to Rolad
steps.detail: Eastern house, Dwarven Mine entrance camp. Asks the player to find 3 pages from a book about the rock.

steps.label: Kill scorpions for page 1
steps.detail: South-eastern Dwarven Mine.

hints.note: May take several kills; try switching worlds if unlucky.

steps.label: Search the mine carts for page 2
steps.detail: Along the mine's cart tracks.

steps.label: Mine an ore rock for page 3
steps.detail: Clay, copper, tin, or iron rocks inside the mine.

steps.label: Talk to Rolad (deliver the pages, lie to keep the book)
steps.detail: Give all 3 pages for the Dwarven lore book; when asked to return it, choose the lying dialogue option and keep it.

steps.label: Buy an ammo mould from Nulodion
steps.detail: Western house next to Rolad's, Dwarven Mine camp.

steps.label: Talk to Dondakan (show a gold bar)
steps.detail: Use a gold bar (or a gold ore, from the vein south of Dondakan's) on him -- he wants a golden cannonball made from it.

steps.label: Smith a golden cannonball
steps.detail: Any furnace (Falador, Edgeville, Zanaris after Lost City, Rellekka after Fremennik Trials) with the gold bar and the cannonball mould.

steps.label: Talk to Dondakan (give the golden cannonball)
steps.detail: He fires it through the wall, then wants to fire the player through too -- needs cannon-firing schematics and a gold helmet (Smithing 50) for safety.

steps.label: Smith a gold helmet
steps.detail: Any anvil, 3 gold bars.

steps.label: Get the second schematic from the Engineer
steps.detail: Western Keldagrim palace anvil room.

steps.label: Read the last page of the Dwarven lore book
steps.detail: Reveals the third schematic.

steps.label: Talk to Khorvak (fourth schematic)
steps.detail: White Wolf Tunnel bar, via Camelot Teleport or Burthorpe Games Room. Give him a dwarven stout from the table, or refuse -- either way he provides the final schematic.

steps.label: Assemble all four schematics
steps.detail: Move/rotate each of the 3 gathered pieces to fit the original schematic Dondakan gave.

steps.label: Talk to Dondakan (assembled schematic)
steps.detail: Return with the completed design.

steps.label: Mine gold ore before entering the rock
steps.detail: 6 minimum, 15 recommended (lowers the boss's combat level from 125 to 75). Must remain in the inventory -- equip the gold helmet first or any gold already carried disappears.

steps.label: Fight the Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
steps.detail: Equip the gold helmet, ask Dondakan to fire the player in, then talk to the second set of flames at the centre. 8-minute timer to mine gold AND defeat it; form (Magic/Ranged/Strength) depends on the player's highest combat stat.

hints.note: Removing the gold helmet at any point teleports the player back out to Dondakan -- an emergency escape.

steps.label: Talk to Dondakan (quest complete)
steps.detail: Quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Riddle of the Rock: Arzinian Avatar fight

notes: No GE-violation found. refs[] cites the manifest-recorded slug 'Between_a_Rock...' (literal trailing ellipsis, confirmed via search per the [depth:08-] literal-ellipsis-title gotcha).

steps.label: Talk to Lazim (start Enakhra's Lament)
steps.detail: South of the Bandit Camp, west of the Ancient Pyramid (free ferry via Ruins of Unkah + Shantay Pass, or Pharaoh's Sceptre to Jaldraocht). Agree to help build his statue -- asked for 32kg of sandstone.

steps.label: Mine 32kg of sandstone and deliver it
steps.detail: Nearby quarry; sandstone comes in 1/2/5/10kg blocks (chisel bigger blocks smaller as needed). Give pieces to Lazim one at a time until 32kg total.

steps.label: Chisel the 32kg block into a statue base
steps.detail: Chisel the fused 32kg block, then place it on the ground next to Lazim.

steps.label: Mine 20kg more sandstone and deliver it
steps.detail: Same quarry.

steps.label: Chisel the 20kg block into a statue body
steps.detail: Chisel and attach to the base.

steps.label: Mine granite and chisel a statue head
steps.detail: Mine two 5kg granite pieces (one for the head now, one spare for later) plus clay and coal while at the quarry. Chisel one 5kg piece into the chosen head (own head refused; choose Lazim, camel, or a god's head).

steps.label: Place the head on the statue
steps.detail: The statue falls through the ground into a hidden temple below -- Lazim pushes the player down after it.

steps.label: Talk to Lazim (in the temple)
steps.detail: He admits this was the plan all along and offers a treasure share -- explains the temple's doors need stone limbs, not keys.

steps.label: Chisel/mine the 4 stone limbs off the fallen statue
steps.detail: Left/right arm, left/right leg -- each opens one outer door.

steps.label: Open the 4 outer doors and collect the Z/R/K sigils
steps.detail: Travel anticlockwise so the 4 cutscenes play in order (own-words: Enakhra completing the temple for Zamorak; Avarrockian knights slain trying to stop her; Akthanakos failing to turn her from Zamorak; Enakhra animating a weak skeleton weapon for Zamorak). Each big room has a sigil (Z/R/K, plus the starting room's M).

steps.label: Use a sigil to unlock the central door
steps.detail: Climb the ladder up; a magic barrier blocks progress next to a recessed pedestal.

steps.label: Make a camel-head mould and matching granite head
steps.detail: Soft clay (from mined clay + water) on the recess pedestal makes a positive mould; chisel the spare 5kg granite to match.

steps.label: Place the granite camel head into the pedestal
steps.detail: Cutscene: Akthanakos is revealed standing confused by the pedestal before Enakhra freezes him.

steps.label: Clear the Smoke room's furnace
steps.detail: North-east corridor; cast a Wind Bolt or stronger to clear the blocked grate.

steps.label: Light the Shadow room's braziers
steps.detail: South-east corridor; light a candle before entering to avoid darkness damage. Own-words: guess-and-check which of logs/oak logs/willow logs/maple logs/a candle/coal lights each of the 6 braziers (Firemaking 45 only reveals the answer, it isn't required to light them).

steps.label: Talk to Pentyn (Blood room) and give him food
steps.detail: North-west corridor; the frozen knight is starving. Give a full (not half-eaten) bread/pie/cake/pizza/baked potato -- right-click use it on him. He shares advice on the other 3 rooms.

steps.label: Thaw the Ice room's fountain
steps.detail: South-west corridor; cast a Fire Bolt or stronger.

steps.label: Cast Crumble Undead on the first Boneguard
steps.detail: North of the barrier ladder. The spell must land; it collapses and a freed spirit asks the player to bury 5 big bones.

steps.label: Talk to the second Boneguard with Protect from Melee active
steps.detail: It attacks a couple of times then relents -- reveals it was enslaved by Enakhra and asks for help finishing a wall to block her line of sight, for 3 loads of sandstone.

steps.label: Repair the Boneguard's wall (3 loads)
steps.detail: Take sandstone from the nearby rubble pile, use on the wall, then chisel to trim; repeat 3 times.

steps.label: Talk to the freed Boneguard (reveals Akthanakos)
steps.detail: It crumbles and reveals itself as the Mahjarrat Akthanakos, freed after millennia -- gives the Camulet. Cutscene: Enakhra destroys the wall and both flee north as skeletons -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Desert quarry: build the sandstone/granite statue
Temple entry: statue limbs, sigils, camel-head puzzle

notes: No GE-violation found. Single-region (desert quarry + temple) but genuinely puzzle-dense (statue build, 4 sigil doors with lore cutscenes, camel-head mould puzzle, 4 elemental rooms, 2-stage Boneguard fight+wall-repair). Firemaking 45 is listed as a quest requirement but the page's own footnote says it's not actually needed to complete the brazier puzzle (guess-and-check works) -- kept the reqs note but modeled the room as guess-and-check per the source's own correction. Boneguard 1 kill is a single Crumble-Undead-must-hit atom (U4), not a full combat sequence, since it's a scripted one-cast kill.

steps.label: Travel to Entrana (trip 1: papyrus, wool, potatoes, dyes, silk)
steps.detail: Via Port Sarim boat; Entrana bans weapons/armour. Carry only papyrus, candle, ball of wool, sack of potatoes, dyes, silk, empty sacks for this leg.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste (start Enlightened Journey)
steps.detail: West Entrana, north of the Herblore shop. Agree to help test his balloon transport system.

steps.label: Make an origami balloon
steps.detail: Use papyrus on the ball of wool for a balloon structure, then the unlit candle on it -- do not light it, or the items must be regathered.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste (first test launch)
steps.detail: Cutscene: the origami balloon launches.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste again (second launch)
steps.detail: He takes the remaining papyrus and sack of potatoes -- second cutscene (mob attacks the balloon). Receives a basket of apples and Auguste's willow sapling.

steps.label: Make 8 sandbags
steps.detail: Use empty sacks on the sand pit south of Auguste.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste (hand over all trip-1 items)
steps.detail: Give every remaining item; cycle all dialogue options so nothing is missed.

steps.label: Plant Auguste's willow sapling
steps.detail: Any tree patch; give the local farmer the basket of apples to protect it. Gather/produce alternative to the wiki's own 'buy 12 unnoted willow branches from the GE' shortcut -- grown from the quest's own sapling instead.

steps.label: Cut 12 willow branches
steps.detail: Secateurs on the grown tree; 6 branches per cut, with a wait between cuts for more to regrow.

steps.label: Gather 10 regular logs
steps.detail: Axes cannot be brought to Entrana -- cut/bank the logs beforehand.

steps.label: Travel to Entrana (trip 2: branches, logs, tinderbox)
steps.detail: Return with the willow branches, regular logs, and a tinderbox.

steps.label: Use a willow branch on the balloon basket
steps.detail: Triggers a cutscene; the log storage interface appears.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste (flight tips)
steps.detail: Explains the balloon control panel before the flight interface opens.

steps.label: Fly the balloon through all three screens
steps.detail: Own-words: sandbag drop = up 2, log = up 1, relax = right, rope = down 1, red rope = down 2. Avoid every obstacle (birds/trees/houses/clouds) across 3 screens and land one space above the marked pad without overshooting.

steps.label: Talk to Auguste (landed, quest complete)
steps.detail: Quest complete; unlocks the balloon transport system.

notes: GE-violation FIX applied (found beyond the queue's 0-flag classification, per og-g2/og-g3's re-check-every-quest precedent): the wiki's own recommended items list says the 12 willow branches can be 'bought from the Grand Exchange, or plant a willow sapling and wait 4 hours' -- modeled the gather path only (plant Auguste's own quest-given sapling, wait, cut branches with secateurs), the GE half of the sentence dropped entirely per the hard rule.

steps.label: Talk to Commander Veldaban (start Forgettable Tale...)
steps.detail: Dwarven Black Guard HQ, west of the Keldagrim bank. Agree to investigate the Red Axe's sudden departure -- auto-transported by cutscene to a drunk dwarf's house in east Keldagrim.

steps.label: Buy a beer
steps.detail: Laughing Miner Pub or King's Axe Inn, Keldagrim, 2 coins.

steps.label: Talk to the drunk dwarf (give beer)
steps.detail: He wants 'the REALLY good stuff' (Kelda stout) instead -- gives the first of 4 kelda seeds needed to grow it.

steps.label: Talk to the Rowdy Dwarf (trade for a seed)
steps.detail: Laughing Miner pub. He asks for one random item from a long list (e.g. cabbage, banana, ashes, broken glass, potato, king worm) in exchange for the second seed -- own-words: bring/gather/produce the requested item, re-ask if the current request is unobtainable.

hints.note: The requested item is randomised per player; wait and re-ask for a different request if the current one is impractical.

steps.label: Talk to Khorvak (borrow/trade for a seed)
steps.detail: White Wolf Mountain pub, reached via minecart. Convince him to lend the seed, or give him a dwarven stout from a nearby table -> third seed.

steps.label: Talk to Gauss (toast for the last seed)
steps.detail: King's Axe Inn, west Keldagrim. Toast with a full or empty beer glass -> fourth seed.

steps.label: Plant the 4 kelda seeds
steps.detail: Kelda hops patch in front of the West Keldagrim palace, east of the bank -- ask Rind the gardener for permission first, weed with the free rake. Kelda hops grow only underground and cannot be diseased.

steps.label: Harvest the kelda hops
steps.detail: Pick once grown (15-20 min).

steps.label: Brew Kelda stout
steps.detail: East Keldagrim fermenting vat (Port Phasmatys vat will NOT work). Add 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, the kelda hops, then ale yeast (or a free pot filled by Blandebir for 25gp). Ferments 15-20 min; turn the valve and use a beer glass on the barrel when ready.

steps.label: Talk to the drunk dwarf (give Kelda stout)
steps.detail: He drinks it and tells of a boarded-up tunnel (cutscene).

steps.label: Talk to the mining company director
steps.detail: Upstairs in either Keldagrim marketplace (the director from The Giant Dwarf). Ask for help with the boarded tunnel -- boards removed at once.

steps.label: Ride the new tunnel cart and solve the track puzzles (Rooms 1-6)
steps.detail: Southernmost cart, no ticket, empty hands required. Six connected rooms: Rooms 1/3/5 are cart-track junction puzzles (place green/yellow direction stones, ride to search a box, return); Room 2 is an eavesdropped cutscene revealing the Red Axe's bribery plot; Room 4 is an archive -- search all 3 crates and a bookcase for lore letters; Room 6 shows the Red Axe's Chaos Dwarf army before Grunsh the ogre shaman wipes the player's memory of the caves.

steps.label: Talk to Commander Veldaban (memory wiped)
steps.detail: No memory remains of the tunnel, but instinct pulls the player toward beer and a kebab in east Keldagrim.

steps.label: Buy a kebab and a beer
steps.detail: East Keldagrim: kebab from the store south-west of the drunk dwarf's house (1gp), beer from the pub (1-2gp). Do not consume before talking to Veldaban.

steps.label: Eat the kebab and drink the beer at the east pub
steps.detail: Triggers the final cutscene: the player tells a nonsensical drunken story -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Keldagrim: start -> beer -> four kelda seeds
Brewing: plant -> harvest -> ferment Kelda stout
Tunnel: boards removed -> minecart puzzle rooms 1-6

notes: No GE-violation found (grepped fetched page, none present). Rooms 1/3/5's exact stone-placement solutions are the wiki's own worked answer key -- collapsed into a single own-words 'use-on minecart_puzzle_rooms' atom (U4 repetition-collapse) rather than transcribing the wiki's move-by-move solution, since the mechanic is a positioning puzzle rather than a completion-relevant gather/produce edge. Two ~15-20min RECURRING waits (hops growth, vat fermentation) modeled as until:{state:grow-timer/ferment-timer:'??'} pending a sourced duration constant.

steps.label: Talk to Queen Ellamaria (start Garden of Tranquillity)
steps.detail: Fenced garden east of Varrock Palace. She hands over her wanted-plants list and sends the player to the Wise Old Man about diplomacy first.

steps.label: Talk to the Wise Old Man (diplomacy quiz)
steps.detail: Draynor Village, ring of charos in hand. Answer 6 required diplomacy prompts correctly (own-words: choosing compromise, generosity, enthusiasm for farming, humility, flattery, and patience over confrontation) -- the 7th accepts any answer. He enchants the ring.

steps.label: Talk to Elstan (agree to grow marigolds)
steps.detail: Farming patch south of Falador, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about delphinium seeds; accept growing marigolds WITHOUT using the charm dialogue option (using charm gets refused first).

steps.label: Plant the marigold seed
steps.detail: Compost, water, plant cure as normal; ~20 minutes to grow.

steps.label: Harvest and deliver the marigolds
steps.detail: Give the harvested marigolds to Elstan.

steps.label: Talk to Lyra (agree to grow onions)
steps.detail: Allotment patch west of Port Phasmatys, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about orchid seeds; accept growing onions WITHOUT charm.

steps.label: Plant 3 onion seeds
steps.detail: Flower patch must be empty first; ~40 minutes to grow.

steps.label: Talk to Lyra (deliver the onions)
steps.detail: Rewards 3 yellow + 3 pink orchid seeds.

steps.label: Talk to Kragen (agree to grow cabbages)
steps.detail: Allotment patch north of East Ardougne, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about snowdrop seeds; accept growing cabbages WITHOUT charm.

steps.label: Plant 3 cabbage seeds
steps.detail: Flower patch must be empty first; ~40 minutes to grow.

steps.label: Talk to Kragen (deliver the cabbages)
steps.detail: Rewards 4 snowdrop seeds.

steps.label: Talk to Dantaera (charm for the white tree)
steps.detail: Catherby farming patch. Ask how to grow a White Tree, charm her -- she permits cutting a branch from the white tree atop Ice Mountain.

steps.label: Cut and grow a white tree sapling
steps.detail: Ice Mountain, west of Edgeville, near the Oracle. Secateurs on the white tree for a shoot; use it on a filled plant pot with the gardening trowel, then water it. Grows to a sapling in ~5 minutes.

steps.label: Talk to Brother Althric (charm; told to discard the ring)
steps.detail: Edgeville Monastery garden, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him about the rosebushes -- he calls the ring an 'evil talisman' and demands it be thrown in the Edgeville well or destroyed.

steps.label: Discard the ring of charos(a) as instructed
steps.detail: Throw the ring into the Edgeville well (recoverable by fishing) or destroy it outright (recoverable by re-pickpocketing Dr Fenkenstrain).

steps.label: Recover the ring of charos(a)
steps.detail: If thrown in the well: fish it out with a fishing/fly fishing rod (several tries may be needed). If destroyed: pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain again.

hints.note: Fishing the ring from the well can take several attempts.

steps.label: Talk to Brother Althric again (no ring)
steps.detail: Attempt to take the seeds again without the ring equipped -- he's now satisfied. Rewards all three rose seed colours.

steps.label: Talk to Bernald (charm; treat the dying vines)
steps.detail: The Toad and Chicken pub garden, Burthorpe, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him about his dying vines; use one plant cure on them -- it doesn't work. Told to find Alain in Taverley.

steps.label: Talk to Alain (learn to strengthen the cure)
steps.detail: Taverley tree patch, near the members' gate. Do NOT use the charm dialogue option, or he refuses to help.

steps.label: Make a strengthened plant cure
steps.detail: Hammer a rune/pure essence into rune shards, then pestle and mortar into rune dust; use the dust on the remaining plant cure.

steps.label: Talk to Bernald (cure the vines)
steps.detail: Use the strengthened cure on the vines -- cured. Rewards Burthorpe vine seeds.

steps.label: Talk to Queen Ellamaria (get the statue trolley)
steps.detail: Ask about getting the statues -- she provides a trolley.

steps.label: Push/pull the king's statue from Lumbridge to the garden
steps.detail: Lumbridge Castle south exit; identify the 'king' statue, push/pull it across the bridge, then east and south into Ellamaria's garden; place on the north-east (east side) plinth.

hints.value: re-fetch from Ellamaria
hints.note: If the statue takes over 5 minutes to place it gets 'recaptured' and must be fetched again.

steps.label: Push/pull the Saradomin statue from Falador to the garden
steps.detail: Falador city square (not the park statue); a cutscene plays before the guards notice. Push/pull it out of Falador's north gate, then east and south into the garden; place on the central plinth.

hints.value: re-fetch from Ellamaria
hints.note: Guards discover the theft after 5 minutes; the statue must be re-fetched if so.

steps.label: Plant every seed/sapling in Ellamaria's garden
steps.detail: Rake the weeds first; no compost/watering needed except on the orchid pots (compost required there). Plant delphinium, orchids (both colours), snowdrop, all 3 rose colours, Burthorpe vine seed, and the white tree sapling; ~10-15 minutes to grow.

steps.label: Fetch King Roald and give the garden tour
steps.detail: South-east ground floor of Varrock Palace, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him where possible; escort back without opening any interfaces or walking away -- cutscene tour, then the queen rewards the player.

checkpoints.label: Varrock: start -> Wise Old Man ring enchant
Catherby + Ice Mountain: Dantaera / white tree
Edgeville Monastery: Althric / roses / ring discard+recover
Burthorpe + Taverley: Bernald / Alain / vine seeds

notes: No GE-violation found. Highest atom count in this bundle (26) -- genuine complexity: 6 independent NPC seed-fetch sub-quests across 6 regions plus 2 statue-fetch legs plus a final multi-seed planting. The Wise Old Man's 7-question diplomacy quiz and each NPC's charm-dialogue ladder are summarised own-words (choose compromise/generosity/etc.) rather than the wiki's exact answer transcript, per own-words-only. Ring-of-charos discard+recovery modeled as a branch{} pair (well-fishing vs Fenkenstrain-pickpocket) since either recovery path is equally valid depending on which discard method was chosen.

steps.label: Gather bones + buckets/pots for the Ectofuntus
steps.detail: Kill level-1 undead chickens near the farm west of the Ectofuntus for bones; buy/carry 7 empty buckets and 7 empty pots (Port Phasmatys, entering via charter ship from Port Sarim costs 1,300gp before tokens are gathered).

steps.label: Fill buckets with slime and grind bones to bonemeal
steps.detail: Down the trapdoor west of the Ectofuntus fountain; use a bucket on the Pool of Slime to auto-fill all carried buckets, then use a bone on the loader by the bone grinder (interacting with the grinder speeds up the automated cycle).

steps.label: Worship the Ectofuntus for ecto-tokens
steps.detail: Click the Ectofuntus to consume each slime+bonemeal set, then talk to a ghost disciple while wearing the ghostspeak amulet. ~35 recommended (20 with an activated ring of charos(a)).

steps.label: Talk to Velorina (start Ghosts Ahoy)
steps.detail: Pay 2 ecto-tokens at the Energy Barrier north of Port Phasmatys; she explains the ghosts' plight and sends the player to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus temple.

steps.label: Talk to Necrovarus (first attempt)
steps.detail: He refuses to discuss releasing the ghosts.

steps.label: Talk to Velorina again
steps.detail: She recalls an old friend who might help without Necrovarus -- a small wooden shack in Morytania near the sea, between two castles.

steps.label: Make nettle tea
steps.detail: Fill a bowl with water at the waterpump west of the farm patches; pick nettles east of Slayer Master Mazchna (closed-fingered gloves required); use nettles on the water bowl, then light a fire and use the bowl on it.

steps.label: Talk to the Old Crone (tea, then milk)
steps.detail: North-west of Mazchna, between the Slayer Tower and the Mausoleum. She only drinks from her own cup (gives a porcelain cup to pour the tea into); refuses again until a bucket of milk is added. Once satisfied, she recalls Velorina and explains that enchanting the Ghostspeak amulet needs Necrovarus's magical robes, his book of rituals (Haricanto), and a translation manual. She also gives a model ship for her sailor son.

steps.label: Repair the model ship
steps.detail: Canifis bank/general store for silk, needle and thread (or costume needle), and a knife -- use them on the model ship.

steps.label: Read the wrecked ship's flag colours
steps.detail: Wrecked ship on the north coast of the farm patch; climb to the quarterdeck, wait for low wind, then search the mast up to 3 times to identify the tattered flag's colours (own-words: mixing red+yellow=orange, red+blue=purple, blue+yellow=green as needed) before dyeing the ship to match.

hints.note: Colours are randomised per player; check the mast at least 3 times.

steps.label: Dye the model ship to match the flag
steps.detail: Mix the needed dyes and paint the model ship's pieces.

steps.label: Talk to the Old Man (give the model ship)
steps.detail: He recognises it as his own -- gives a chest key.

steps.label: Open the two accessible chests for map scraps
steps.detail: Chest 1 (captain's quarters, use the key): first scrap. Cross the rock-jump path north-west of the deck (Agility 25, boostable, no fall risk into water) to a second chest: second scrap.

steps.label: Kill the Giant lobster guarding the third chest
steps.detail: Level 32, appears when searching the chests near the ladder; must be killed within two minutes or it resets.

hints.value: west of the ladder
hints.note: Safespottable with Magic or Ranged from west of the nearest ladder.

steps.label: Search the chest for the third map scrap
steps.detail: After the Giant lobster is dead.

steps.label: Combine the three map scraps
steps.detail: Use one scrap on another twice to assemble the full treasure map.

steps.label: Sail to Dragontooth Island and dig up the book
steps.detail: Ghost captain on the Port Phasmatys dock; pay 25 ecto-tokens (10 with an activated ring of charos(a), or 500 for permanent access). Follow the treasure map's step-count directions from the Statue of Saradomin and dig with a spade.

steps.label: Get the translation manual from Ak-Haranu (via Robin)
steps.detail: Ak-Haranu on the Port Phasmatys docks wants Robin's signature on an oak longbow in trade for the manual. Beat Robin at Rune-Draw at the nearby pub (draw runes for points, avoid drawing a death rune, until he owes 100 coins) for his signature, then return it to Ak-Haranu.

hints.value: beat-robin-repeatedly
hints.note: Rune-Draw is a dice-style minigame vs Robin; repeat until he owes 100 coins.

steps.label: Talk to the Ghost innkeeper (get a bedsheet)
steps.detail: He wants a bedsheet delivered to Robin -- keep it instead, to disguise as a ghost.

steps.label: Colour the bedsheet with Ectofuntus slime
steps.detail: Buy a bucket of slime from a Trader crewmember on the east docks (or fill one at the Ectofuntus slime pool), then dip the bedsheet.

steps.label: Gather 10 petition signatures in disguise
steps.detail: Wear the dyed bedsheet; talk to Gravingas near the north entrance for a petition form, then ask nearby ghost villagers for signatures (don't ask the same one twice in a row; skip any who demand ecto-tokens).

hints.note: Cycle between 2-3 willing ghosts, or switch worlds, until 10 signatures are collected.

steps.label: Talk to Necrovarus (show the petition)
steps.detail: He rages at the petition and drops a bone key -- pick it up.

steps.label: Unlock Necrovarus's room and take his robes
steps.detail: Use the bone key on the locked upstairs door; open and search the coffin.

steps.label: Talk to the Old Crone (enchant the amulet)
steps.detail: Give the robes, Book of Haricanto, translation manual, and ghostspeak amulet -- she performs a dancing ritual to empower the amulet.

steps.label: Talk to Necrovarus (command him to release the ghosts)
steps.detail: With the empowered ghostspeak amulet equipped, command him to free the ghosts he's holding.

steps.label: Talk to Velorina (quest complete)
steps.detail: She senses the barrier's removal and hands over a vial of ectoplasm -- the Ectophial.

checkpoints.label: Port Phasmatys: start -> Necrovarus refuses -> Velorina's hint
Ship + treasure map: repair, dye, lobster, dig

notes: No GE-violation found. Heaviest atom count in this bundle (26) -- genuinely a long/convoluted quest (pre-quest ecto-token farm + 5 distinct sub-hubs: Old Crone, ship/treasure-map with a safespottable lvl32 kill, Rune-Draw minigame, petition-signature gather, final spell). Mansion-style precision content (exact mast-colour table, Rune-Draw scoring) collapsed to rng-variance/do-while hints rather than copied verbatim. quest_phase field left broad ('port-phasmatys'/'canifis-to-morytania') since several sub-legs revisit the same hub.

steps.label: Talk to Gertrude (start Ratcatchers)
steps.detail: West of Varrock. Directs the player to the Sisters Grime in Varrock Sewers.

steps.label: Talk to the Sisters Grime (Phingspet + Grimesquit)
steps.detail: East of the Palace exit, Varrock Sewers. They must sniff the cat before it starts counting caught rats -- then tasks the player with catching 8 rats.

steps.label: Chase 8 rats in the Varrock Sewers
steps.detail: Use the cat's 'Chase' option.

steps.label: Talk to the Sisters Grime (turn in)
steps.detail: Rewards a rat pole; directs the player to Jimmy Dazzler in East Ardougne.

steps.label: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler
steps.detail: House west of the Flying Horse Inn, East Ardougne. He needs a client's mansion cleared of rats unofficially -- gives Directions, then teleports the player to the mansion gardens.

steps.label: Sneak through the mansion and catch 6 rats
steps.detail: Own-words: three guard-patrol checkpoints must be crossed unseen (Run recommended, patience required -- being spotted resets to the last checkpoint, not the start). Catch 1 rat in the first upstairs room, 2 in the next, then the last 3 plus the kitchen once past the guards entirely.

hints.value: checkpoint-timing
hints.note: Guard patrol timing is scripted; wait for the correct guard position before each dash, per each room's own pattern.

steps.label: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler (turn in)
steps.detail: Rewards access to the Ardougne Rat Pits; directs the player to Hooknosed Jack in south-east Varrock.

steps.label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack
steps.detail: South-east Varrock. Warehouse rat infestation -- he can make rat poison from a vial, red spiders' eggs, and a kwuarm if not already carried.

steps.label: Poison 4 cheese
steps.detail: Use rat poison on 4 pieces of cheese.

steps.label: Poison the warehouse's 4 rat holes
steps.detail: Top of the warehouse south of the pub; use the poisoned cheese on each hole (don't eat it).

steps.label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (Pox got poisoned)
steps.detail: His cat Pox ate a poisoned rat -- sends the player to the Apothecary for an antidote.

steps.label: Make cat antipoison at the Apothecary
steps.detail: West Varrock; give a marrentill herb, crushed unicorn horn, and a bucket of milk.

steps.label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (cure Pox)
steps.detail: Give the antipoison -- Pox recovers; warns of the King rat.

steps.label: Send the cat to fight the King rat
steps.detail: Warehouse upstairs; 10 HP, max 1 damage per hit. Use the cat on the hole in the wall to start; heal with fish on the same hole (not the cat) as needed.

hints.value: be-careful
hints.note: Choose 'Be careful!' so the cat auto-retreats at 1 HP instead of risking death.

steps.label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (turn in)
steps.detail: Rewards access to the Varrock Rat Pits; directs the player to Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim.

steps.label: Talk to Smokin' Joe
steps.detail: East Keldagrim, by the pickaxe shop. Agree to help smoke out his rats.

steps.label: Smoke out Smokin' Joe's rat hole
steps.detail: Light a pot of weeds with a tinderbox, use on the rat hole east of Smokin' Joe. Drop the cat on the ground, wear the catspeak amulet, then use the smouldering pot on the hole again -- the cat offers to ambush the rats; accept.

steps.label: Talk to Smokin' Joe (turn in)
steps.detail: Rewards access to the Keldagrim Rat Pits; directs the player to The Face in Port Sarim.

steps.label: Talk to The Face
steps.detail: Port Sarim, by the fishing shop. Directs the player down to Felkrash in the rat pits.

steps.label: Talk to Felkrash (rat pits)
steps.detail: Wants all of Port Sarim's vermin cleared at once.

steps.label: Talk to The Face again (ask about the snake charmer)
steps.detail: 3rd dialogue option; reveals a snake charmer in Pollnivneach.

steps.label: Talk to Ali/Badir the Snake Charmer
steps.detail: South of the bar, Pollnivneach. Use a coin on his money pot for attention; ask about charming other animals, offer money, then walk away until prompted to stop. Rewards a music scroll + snake charm for 100gp (50gp with ring of charos, and skips the walk-away step).

steps.label: Play the charming tune at the Port Sarim docks
steps.detail: Own-words: compose the notes shown on the music scroll in order, then play -- charms the vermin into following the player into the ocean (cutscene).

steps.label: Talk to Felkrash (quest complete)
steps.detail: Quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Varrock warehouse: Hooknosed Jack + King rat
Port Sarim + Pollnivneach: The Face, Felkrash, snake charm

notes: No GE-violation found. 5 independent region hubs (Varrock sewers, Ardougne mansion, Varrock warehouse, Keldagrim, Port Sarim/Pollnivneach) each gated behind the prior hub's completion -- genuinely long even though 'Medium' length. Mansion guard-patrol tile-by-tile choreography is the wiki's own precise solution key; collapsed to one gather atom with a safespot-type hint (own-words: 'checkpoint timing') rather than transcribing the exact tile sequence, matching Enakhra's-Lament's puzzle-collapse precedent.

steps.label: Talk to Awusah the Mayor (start Spirits of the Elid)
steps.detail: Nardah. Learns of the town's curse and dried-up water supply.

steps.label: Talk to Ghaslor the Elder (get the ballad)
steps.detail: House just north of the mayor's. Do not bank or drop the ballad -- it's needed later.

steps.label: Search the cupboards for torn robes
steps.detail: Building housing Shiratti the Custodian, west of the mayor's house.

steps.label: Repair the robes of Elidinis
steps.detail: Needle and thread on both torn robe pieces.

steps.label: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the ancestral key
steps.detail: Steals it from its enclosed display area.

steps.label: Travel to the River Elid waterfall and enter
steps.detail: North-west of Nardah, following the river bank to its source (passes a bronze pickaxe/shortbow/bronze arrow respawn and a pluckable Desert Phoenix feather). Use a rope on the root above the waterfall to enter.

steps.label: Open the temple door wearing the robes
steps.detail: Robes of Elidinis worn, ballad and ancestral key carried.

steps.label: Kill the Black golem (crush attacks)
steps.detail: North-east room. Level 75; vulnerable to crush.

steps.label: Clear the north-east water channel
steps.detail: Attack the target across the channel with Ranged or Magic.

steps.label: Kill the Grey golem (slash attacks)
steps.detail: East room. Level 75; vulnerable to slash.

steps.label: Clear the east water channel
steps.detail: Use a pickaxe on the channel.

steps.label: Kill the White golem (stab attacks)
steps.detail: South room. Level 75; vulnerable to stab.

steps.label: Clear the south water channel
steps.detail: Requires Thieving 37 to clear.

steps.label: Talk to the spirits Nirrie, Tirrie and Hallak
steps.detail: Through the remaining north door, around the lake. Told to recover the Statue of Elidinis from a crevice west of Nardah.

steps.label: Remove the soles from the mayor's shoes
steps.detail: Nardah; knife on the shoes left by his door.

steps.label: Travel to the crevice and enter
steps.detail: West of the Nardah general store; rope on the crevice, light source required to avoid bug damage.

steps.label: Talk to the genie (trade soles for the statue)
steps.detail: Give the mayor's soles to receive the Statue of Elidinis.

steps.label: Place the Statue of Elidinis on the shrine plinth
steps.detail: Nardah shrine (same building the ancestral key was stolen from) -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Nardah: start, ballad, robes, ancestral key

notes: No GE-violation found. Clean 3-region-phase structure (Nardah prep, waterfall-dungeon golem gauntlet, crevice/genie). The 3 golem kills each get their own atom since they require genuinely distinct attack styles/skills to clear (crush/slash/stab, plus a distinct Ranged-Magic/pickaxe/Thieving channel-clear per U4 -- 3 kills, not unrolled repetition of one kill).

steps.label: Make a sapphire lantern (pre-quest)
steps.detail: Add a cut sapphire to a bullseye lantern (unf), fill with lamp oil made from swamp tar (chemist's still, Rimmington, or the Dorgesh-Kaan lamp still), then light with a tinderbox. Bullseye lantern itself is gather/produce only per the quest's own list: Smithing 49, or pickpocket cave goblins at Thieving 36, or a Slayer 35 wall-beast kill -- never GE.

steps.label: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves
steps.detail: Rope needed on first entry via the swamp entrance (dodge wall beasts by stopping one tile short of each hole, then running past; take the south path to avoid poison cave crawlers). Faster/safer via the Lumbridge cellar route if The Lost Tribe has been partially completed (pickaxe to clear rocks).

steps.label: Talk to Juna (tell her stories)
steps.detail: Chasm of Tears, deep in the caves. Tell her stories of the player's adventures -- she explains a stone bowl is needed to collect the tears, made from rock across the chasm, reached by attracting a light creature.

steps.label: Attract a light creature across the chasm
steps.detail: Climb the rocks back the way in; use 'attract' on a light creature with the lit sapphire lantern -- it carries the player across.

steps.label: Mine a magic stone and chisel it into a bowl
steps.detail: Pickaxe on the magic stone, then chisel into a stone bowl.

steps.label: Talk to Juna (give the bowl)
steps.detail: Climb down to Juna and hand over the stone bowl -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Prepare sapphire lantern, enter the caves
Juna: stories -> light creature -> bowl -> turn in

notes: No GE-violation found. Short/clean quest, matches its own 'Very Short' length rating.

steps.label: Talk to Lucien (start Temple of Ikov)
steps.detail: Flying Horse Inn, north-western East Ardougne. Agree to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl from the Temple of Ikov -- given the Pendant of Lucien to enter the Chamber of Fear.

steps.label: Enter the Temple of Ikov dungeon
steps.detail: South of the Ranging Guild, west of the Sorcerer's Tower. Climb down the ladder.

steps.label: Get the boots of lightness
steps.detail: West to a set of stairs down (light source needed); slash the web, take and equip the boots -- the cheapest way to reach -1kg for the bridge.

steps.label: Cross the unsteady bridge at -1kg or lighter
steps.detail: Pendant of Lucien worn to pass the north gate. Drop any items needed to reach -1kg or lower (failing costs 20 damage) before crossing; take the lever on the far side.

steps.label: Pull the lever to open the southern room
steps.detail: Place the retrieved lever on the wall bracket south-west of the entrance, then pull it.

steps.label: Gather ice arrows from the ice chamber chests
steps.detail: 6 chests, only one holding arrows (1-5) at a time -- keep re-searching. Only 1 ice arrow is needed if using throwing weapons instead of a bow.

hints.note: Arrow spawn chest is reselected randomly after each loot, including in succession.

steps.label: Search then pull the trapped lever
steps.detail: Small alcove north of the ice chamber. Search for traps first (Thieving 42) or take 20 spike damage, then pull to unlock the western passage.

steps.label: Defeat the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
steps.detail: Level 84; only takes damage from ice arrows (or a throwing weapon with at least 1 ice arrow equipped, which bypasses the Ranged 40 requirement). Uses only Magic -- Protect from Magic recommended.

steps.label: Talk to Winelda (pay the lava crossing)
steps.detail: Give all 20 unnoted limpwurt roots at once -- she teleports the player across the lava.

steps.label: Push the brick wall to reveal the hidden room
steps.detail: Past the skeletons -- opens into the room where the choice is made.

steps.label: Side with the Guardians of Armadyl
steps.detail: Unequip the Pendant of Lucien first. Tell them Lucien wants the staff for a reward, accept their cleansing, then agree to help defeat Lucien -- given the Armadyl pendant (must be worn to fight him).

steps.label: Side with Lucien
steps.detail: Take the Staff of Armadyl from the north-west table -- a level 43 Guardian attacks; defeat it and take the staff. (Killing rather than talking to the Guardians preserves the option to still obtain the Armadyl pendant later.)

steps.label: Defeat Lucien (Guardians' side)
steps.detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange, Armadyl pendant equipped -- level 14 -- quest complete.

steps.label: Give the staff to Lucien (Lucien's side)
steps.detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Temple dungeon: boots, bridge, southern room
Ice chamber + Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
Picking a side: Guardians vs Lucien

notes: No GE-violation found. Genuine end-quest branch{} choice (side with Lucien vs the Guardians of Armadyl) modeled as two mutually-exclusive alt_group pairs (11a/11b entry choice, 12a/12b matching turn-in) rather than a single collapsed atom, since the two paths diverge in NPC/kill target and reward flavour (Armadyl pendant access differs) -- both preference-ordered with Lucien's side listed first per the wiki's own note that killing (not talking to) the Guardians preserves the Armadyl-pendant option either way.

steps.label: Search the tent and camping equipment (start)
steps.detail: Campsite south of the lizardman settlement, Kebos Lowlands (fairy ring BLS closest). Search the tent for Kasonde's journal (Old Ones lore) and the camping equipment for secateurs if not already carried, then climb down the hole.

steps.label: Search the camp dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
steps.detail: Stone tables (1st stone tablet), two more stone tables (2 wood carvings), one vase (a dirty note hinting at translation), and the stone chest (phrase 'Miki Toka').

steps.label: Translate the camp dungeon's words
steps.detail: Own-words: input the discovered word-pairs for island/lake/time/vessel/garden/north per the carvings' illustrations -- directs the player north, under the island on Lake Molch.

steps.label: Travel to Molch Island
steps.detail: Fairy ring DJR then south-west to the east dock, boat across; or Kharedst's memoirs to Shayzien and run north-west.

steps.label: Search the Molch Island dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
steps.detail: Climb down behind the hut; a dirty note on the vines hints Kasonde returned to camp. Cut the vines with secateurs; search tables (2nd stone tablet), one more table (3rd wood carving), the east vases (4th wood carving + phrase 'Tlane Kualt'), the chest (phrase 'Olkat'), and rubble by the farming patches (5th wood carving).

steps.label: Translate the Molch Island words
steps.detail: Own-words: input the 8 discovered word-pairs (west/poison/animal/body/food/earth/air/fire) -- directs the player west of the lake, to Xeric's Shrine.

steps.label: Travel to Xeric's Shrine
steps.detail: Board the boat back to Molch, then south-west to Xeric's Shrine.

steps.label: Search Xeric's Shrine dungeon's tablets, carvings and compass
steps.detail: Climb down at the shrine's east side. South-east stone table (3rd stone tablet), the adjacent open chest (a compass giving the cardinal-direction words), a north vase, two more stone tables, and the central mushroom (4 more wood carvings).

steps.label: Translate Xeric's Shrine words
steps.detail: Own-words: input the 7 discovered word-pairs (build/yes/no/move/arrive/east/south) -- directs the player to a structure south-east, in a forest: the Ruins of Morra.

steps.label: Travel to the Ruins of Morra
steps.detail: Boat to Shayzien then south-east past the Shayziens' Wall, or teleport to Shayzien via Kharedst's memoirs and run south.

steps.label: Search the Ruins of Morra dungeon's final tablet and carvings
steps.detail: Hole in front of the step pyramid. Southern stone table (final stone tablet), remaining tables/vase/chest/rubble for the last wood carvings and a warning note.

steps.label: Translate the final words and read the warning
steps.detail: Own-words: input the final 8 word-pairs (small/big/light/dark/life/death/knowledge/home). Read the completed tablet, then the warning note revealing Kasonde reached the same conclusion about the Old Ones and soul transference -- quest complete.

checkpoints.label: Kebos camp dungeon: journal, secateurs, first tablet
Xeric's Shrine dungeon: third tablet + compass
Ruins of Morra: final tablet + warning note

notes: No GE-violation, no dialogue at all (pure environmental quest per its own Details). refs[] cites manifest slug 'Garden_of_Death' -- title-redirect trap: infobox/canonical title is 'The Garden of Death' (url The_Garden_of_Death) but the manifest recorded slug from this fetch is the bare 'Garden_of_Death' searched title; used the manifest-recorded slug, not the canonical url, per the [items]/[quests] title-redirect gotcha. The word-translation tables (island=Ikam etc.) are quest data, not narrative prose -- summarised as 'own-words: input the discovered word-pairs' rather than reproducing the wiki's full glossary tables, extending og-g2's Natural History Quiz never-copy-trivia-tables precedent.

steps.label: Talk to Bert (start The Hand in the Sand)
steps.detail: Bert works the sandpit east of the Yanille POH portal; found a severed hand and is afraid to report it. Agree to help -> receive sandy hand.

steps.label: Buy a pint of beer
steps.detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn bartender, Yanille, 2 coins.

steps.label: Talk to the captain of the guards (give beer, hand)
steps.detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn; give the beer, he drops the sandy hand in it -> beer-soaked hand; suspects the wizards.

steps.label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (Wizards' Guild)
steps.detail: Ring the guild bell if under 66 Magic; show the hand -> identified as student wizard Clarence's; asks about Bert's recent working hours.

steps.label: Talk to Bert (ask about his schedule)
steps.detail: He gives his copy of the sand-hauling rota (Sandy's Sand Corp, Brimhaven) -> compare against Sandy's original in Brimhaven (30 coins via Ardougne ferry, or teleport).

steps.label: Search Sandy's desk (Brimhaven office)
steps.detail: Sandy's office, north-west of the Dead Man's Chest bar, Brimhaven; search the desk for his original rota to compare against Bert's copy.

steps.label: Pickpocket Sandy for sand
steps.detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; keep the sand pinched from his pocket -- needed later as the personal item for the truth serum.

hints.note: May take multiple pickpocket attempts.

steps.label: Talk to Bert (hand over both rotas)
steps.detail: Yanille; give Bert's and Sandy's rotas -- he doesn't remember the change, blames wizard magic leaking nearby -> exchanges a mind-altering magic scroll found in his house.

steps.label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give the magic scroll)
steps.detail: Confirms it's a mind-altering scroll explaining Bert's forgetting; suspects Sandy -- tasks the player with getting a truth serum from Betty in Port Sarim and recording Sandy with a magical orb. Offers one free teleport to Betty's shop for an empty vial.

hints.value: walk,zavistic-teleport(1x,consumes:empty_vial)
hints.note: Zavistic offers one free teleport to Betty's shop in exchange for an empty vial.

steps.label: Buy redberries (Food Store, Port Sarim)
steps.detail: Port Sarim Food Store.

steps.label: Talk to Betty (about the quest)
steps.detail: Betty's shop, Port Sarim; explain the quest -- she asks for another empty vial and gives bottled water in return.

steps.label: Make redberry juice
steps.detail: Use redberries on the bottled water.

steps.label: Make pink dye
steps.detail: Use white berries on the redberry juice. White berries are not sold by Betty; source per the quest's own alternative list (Farming 59 whiteberry seed, or a rare drop from cave crawlers / Yanille Agility Dungeon chaos druid warriors) -- gather/produce only, never GE.

steps.label: Make a rose-tinted lens
steps.detail: Use pink dye on the lantern lens.

steps.label: Talk to Betty (focus the lens)
steps.detail: Stand in the doorway while it's open; use the rose-tinted lens on the counter to focus light onto an empty vial while she pours the serum. The lens shatters; she says she still needs a personal item from Sandy.

steps.label: Talk to Betty (give Sandy's sand)
steps.detail: Give the sand pickpocketed from Sandy earlier -- she finishes the truth serum and warns it must be diluted in tea or coffee.

steps.label: Buy 5 earth runes from Betty
steps.detail: 20gp from Betty's shop, before leaving Port Sarim.

steps.label: Talk to Sandy (distract, dose his coffee)
steps.detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; distract him with tall tales (try every dialogue option -- no single guaranteed one) until he looks out the window, then use the truth serum on his coffee. Activate the magical orb and talk to him again to record his confession.

hints.value: try-all-options
hints.note: No single distraction option is guaranteed to work; cycle through them.

steps.label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (show the recorded confession)
steps.detail: Yanille; hand over the filled magical orb as proof of Sandy's confession. He asks for 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand to compensate Bert.

steps.label: Fill a bucket of sand at Bert's sandpit
steps.detail: Bert's sandpit, Yanille.

steps.label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give runes + sand)
steps.detail: Hand over the 5 earth runes and bucket of sand -- he casts a spell to permanently refill Bert's sandpit, then asks the player to check the Entranan sandpit for the rest of Clarence's remains.

steps.label: Deposit weapons/armour (Port Sarim bank deposit box)
steps.detail: Entrana bans weapons and armour; use the deposit box at Port Sarim before crossing.

steps.label: Talk to Mazion (Entrana sandpit)
steps.detail: Entrana; recovers the dead wizard's head.

steps.label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (hand over the wizard's head)
steps.detail: Yanille; confirms it's Clarence's head. Sandy is arrested and Zavistic rewards the player -- quest complete.

steps.label: Talk to Pirate Pete at the dock to start
steps.detail: Pirate Pete waits at the dock north-east of the Ectofuntus; agree to help him, agree past his Barrelor warning, then refuse the money he offers before he knocks you out and rows you off.

hints.value: 2I'll help you.
2I'm not scared.
2No, keep your money.

steps.label: Wake up and talk to Captain Braindeath
steps.detail: A cutscene reveals Pete's story was fabricated; you wake in the rum brewery on Braindeath Island and Captain Braindeath explains the zombie-pirate siege and the rum plan.

steps.label: Take the rake and seed dibber from the basement cupboard
steps.detail: If not already held, go down the north-west ladder to the basement and head south-east past the spiders to a cupboard.

steps.label: Intimidate zombie swabs blocking the farming patches
steps.detail: Leave via the southernmost stairway; if attacked by zombie swabs, walk out of combat and right-click Intimidate to permanently stop them attacking.

steps.label: Rake and plant the blindweed seed
steps.detail: Use the rake on the only usable (south-eastern) patch to clear weeds, then plant Braindeath's seed with the dibber.

steps.label: Harvest the grown blindweed
steps.detail: Wait for the "I wonder how my blindweed is coming along..." notification, then harvest. If lost afterward, Braindeath supplies a backup.

steps.label: Add blindweed to the hopper upstairs
steps.detail: Climb the south-eastern ladder and use the blindweed on the north-western hopper.

steps.label: Ask Braindeath for the next ingredient (stagnant water)
steps.detail: He hands over a bucket if not already held and sends you to a nearby volcano.

steps.label: Fill the bucket with stagnant water at the volcano
steps.detail: Exit south then west past 50% Luke's gate (Ring of charos (a) or a tinderbox on him for optional dialogue) and up the volcano.

steps.label: Pour the stagnant water into the hopper
steps.detail: Return to the house and add the water to the hopper, then talk to Braindeath.

steps.label: Catch 5 sluglings (or karamthulhu) at the nearby fishing spot
steps.detail: Braindeath hands over a fishbowl tangled in a net (use them on each other if untangled). Fish at the spot by the farming patch.

steps.label: Add the sluglings to the pressure barrel and pull the lever
steps.detail: Upstairs next to the hopper; pulling the lever sets the brewing apparatus spinning.

steps.label: Get the wrench blessed by Davey
steps.detail: Former priest Davey, west side of the house, only blesses the wrench with 47+ available Prayer points (does not drain Prayer).

steps.label: Beat the possessed controls and kill the Evil spirit
steps.detail: Hit the controls south of Braindeath with the blessed wrench; a level-150 Evil spirit attacks — negate with Protect from Melee or a Ranged/Magic/halberd safespot.

steps.label: Learn the final ingredient is a fever spider carcass
steps.detail: Complete the full dialogue with Braindeath or the carcass will not drop from the kill.

steps.label: Kill a fever spider in the basement for its carcass
steps.detail: Fever spiders inflict disease even through Protect from Melee; negate with a safespot, Slayer gloves, or a cure such as Relicym's balm.

hints.value: Killing the fever spider also completes a medium Morytania Diary task.

steps.label: Add the fever spider carcass to the hopper
steps.detail: Finishes the rum recipe.

steps.label: Collect the finished 'rum' from the output tap
steps.detail: South end of the machinery; Braindeath supplies a bucket if not already held.

steps.label: Give the 'rum' to Captain Donnie
steps.detail: Found near the farming patches; he downs it and accidentally names his boss, Rabid Jack.

steps.label: Report Rabid Jack's name to Braindeath to finish
steps.detail: He is shocked, then thanks you and confirms the brewery stays put.

checkpoints.label: Setting out and reaching Braindeath Island
Evil spirits and the fever spider

steps.label: Slice a banana into Karamjan rum
steps.detail: Pick a banana at the Musa Point plantation, buy Karamjan rum at the Karamja Spirits Bar, slice the banana with a knife/spear, then add the slice to the rum before leaving the island (leaving unslied breaks it).

steps.label: Talk to Timfraku to start the quest
steps.detail: Upstairs in the north-west house of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring CKR); mention Trufitus sent you, then ask "So far??" to receive the task of reuniting his three sons.

hints.value: 2Trufitus sent me.
3So far??

steps.label: Ask Tamayu about the Shaikahan
steps.detail: South-east of the village at the mine; talk twice, asking when he'll succeed and offering to join his next hunt. A cutscene shows him failing against The Shaikahan.

steps.label: Net-fish 20+ raw karambwanji at the Holy Lake
steps.detail: South-west of Tamayu; keep a few spares in case of a low Cooking level burning the karambwan later.

steps.label: Become Lubufu's karambwan apprentice
steps.detail: By the south-eastern Brimhaven shore; ask his age, offer to help collect bait, catch and hand over 20 karambwanji, then ask about his catching method and become his apprentice to unlock the karambwan vessel and 65-Fishing raw karambwan catching (1500 Fishing xp).

hints.value: Collect extra vessels here (drop and re-ask Lubufu) — one each for Tiadeche, Tinsay, and yourself.

steps.label: Give Tiadeche a full karambwan vessel
steps.detail: North-east corner of the Karamja jungle (fairy ring DKP); fill a vessel with karambwanji first, then hand it over for a raw karambwan (vessel is not returned).

steps.label: Grab seaweed on the beach near Tiadeche
steps.detail: Spawns on the beach by Tiadeche; needed later for Tinsay's seaweed sandwich.

steps.label: Cook the karambwan and grind it into paste
steps.detail: Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, then grind it with a pestle and mortar into karambwan paste (use the "use" option, not eat, to avoid damage).

steps.label: Poison the spear with karambwan paste
steps.detail: Any of iron/steel/mithril/adamant/rune/dragon spear works; do NOT give it to Tamayu before poisoning it.

steps.label: Get jogre bones on the way back to Tamayu
steps.detail: Kill a Jogre en route back south (also a fallback source for an iron spear if none carried).

steps.label: Give Tamayu the poisoned spear and 4-dose agility potion
steps.detail: Cross the agility shortcut back to the mine; use the poisoned spear then a full 4-dose agility potion on him (can be topped up over multiple potions), then join his hunt for a successful cutscene.

steps.label: Kill a monkey and have Tamayu skin it
steps.detail: Ranged/Magic/halberd only (melee does 0 damage); use the corpse on Tamayu to skin it and keep the monkey skin (saves a Tinsay trip later).

steps.label: Climb to Cairn Isle and talk to Tinsay
steps.detail: Up the rockslide (Agility 15) and across the bridge; he asks for three items to regain his sanity and repair the Tribal Statue.

steps.label: Give Tinsay the banana rum
steps.detail: First of his three requests.

steps.label: Make and deliver a seaweed sandwich
steps.detail: Combine the seaweed and monkey skin into a seaweed sandwich (do not combine before skinning, or it becomes a joke item), then give it to Tinsay.

steps.label: Give Tinsay a spare karambwan vessel
steps.detail: Unlocks the Crafting manual for Tiadeche (he won't hand it over until the sandwich is delivered).

steps.label: Burn, grind, paste, and cook jogre bones into marinated bones
steps.detail: Burn jogre bones on a tinderbox (Firemaking 30+) or a furnace/Superheat Item if lower; grind a raw karambwanji into paste and add it to the burnt bones; cook the result on a range or fire until green (white means it was done in the wrong order).

steps.label: Give Tinsay the marinated jogre bones
steps.detail: His third request; he regains his sanity and agrees to return to the village.

steps.label: Bring the Crafting manual back to Tiadeche
steps.detail: Both brothers then head back to Tai Bwo Wannai.

steps.label: Talk to Timfraku to finish the quest
steps.detail: Same north-west house; completes the quest. Afterward, talk to each brother in their village house to claim their individual xp rewards.

steps.label: Talk to Rantz to start the quest
steps.detail: Rantz the ogre is south-east of Gu'Tanoth (Fairy ring AKS, Feldip Hills teleport, or gnome glider). The quest must be started by talking to him first, and he only accepts arrows you make yourself.

steps.label: Kill 4 level-64 wolves for wolf bones
steps.detail: In the crater south-west of Rantz; safespottable near the north-east swamp roots.

steps.label: Chisel the wolf bones into wolfbone arrowtips
steps.detail: Each bone yields 2-6 tips at random.

steps.label: Chop 4 achey trees for logs
steps.detail: Growing near Rantz.

steps.label: Knife the achey logs into ogre arrow shafts
Feather the shafts into flighted ogre arrows
Attach wolfbone arrowtips to the flighted arrows
steps.detail: Finishes at least 6 usable ogre arrows for the hand-in.

steps.label: Hand at least 6 ogre arrows to Rantz
steps.detail: He explains the swamp toads his children play with; ask him every listed question or the chest cannot be opened later.

hints.value: Ask every dialogue option offered, not just the minimum — required to open the chest later.

steps.label: Enter the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs
steps.detail: North of Rantz; they explain their ogre bellows are locked in a rock-weighted chest.

steps.label: Unlock the chest and search it for the bellows
steps.detail: Failed unlock attempts reduce Strength by 1; search immediately after opening or it re-locks.

hints.value: Keep the bellows afterward if planning Mourning's End Part I and/or Recipe for Disaster.

steps.label: Inflate 3 swamp toads into bloated toads
steps.detail: South-west of Rantz at the swamp (also findable near poison spiders in the Yanille Agility dungeon); the bellows hold 3 charges before needing a refill at the swamp bubbles.

hints.value: Carrying capacity for bloated toads is 3 — inflating more replaces one already held.

steps.label: Return to Rantz to learn the lure spot
steps.detail: He shows the flashing arrow tile where toads should be dropped to lure a chompy bird.

steps.label: Offer to shoot for Rantz and receive the ogre bow
steps.detail: After his first miss (he blames the arrows), offer to help; he hands over his ogre bow.

steps.label: Lure and kill a chompy bird with the ogre bow
steps.detail: Drop a bloated toad on the marked tile and stand back but in view; range the bird once it appears (re-bait if the lure fails). You must land the kill yourself — a bought/traded raw chompy will not progress the quest.

hints.value: Purchasing a raw chompy bird instead of killing one yourself will NOT progress the quest — confirmed on the quest's own page, not a real GE-alternative.

steps.label: Pluck the chompy and bring it back to Rantz
steps.detail: He asks for it cooked with a seasoning of his children's choosing.

steps.label: Ask Fycie and Bugs what seasoning they want
steps.detail: Two of three needed ingredients (onion, doogle leaves, equa leaves, tomato, potato, cabbage) are randomised per player; only one bird is cooked.

steps.label: Gather the 3 requested seasoning ingredients around the area
steps.detail: Onion/tomato near the fire west-south-west of Rantz; doogle leaves to the west by the glider; equa leaves on the south-east peninsula; potato south-east near the equa spawns; cabbage scattered south-west/south-east — pick another plant if a seed drops instead.

steps.label: Cook the chompy with all 3 seasonings on the spit
steps.detail: North of Rantz; hold all three ingredients plus the raw chompy.

steps.label: Present the seasoned chompy to Rantz to finish
steps.detail: Completes the quest.
