steps.label: Ask Grish about the sick ogres
steps.detail: Speak with Grish in Jiggig and offer to help investigate the zombified ogres.

hints.value: What do you mean sickies? -> Can I help in any way? -> Yes.

steps.label: Get the ogre guard to remove the barricade
steps.detail: Speak to the Ogre guard east of Grish so he clears the way into the Zogre-infested area.

steps.label: Climb the barricade and descend into the cave
steps.detail: Climb over the crushed barricade, run east to the stairs, and go down them.

steps.label: Search the skeleton and defeat the zombie it spawns
steps.detail: Search the skeleton next to the broken lecturn; a zombie appears and must be killed to get the ruined backpack.

hints.value: Under 89 combat, Zogre/Skogre attacks from here on can cause disease that lowers a random skill 10 levels roughly every minute -- carry super restore potions.

steps.label: Open the ruined backpack
steps.detail: Open the backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, rotten food, and a knife.

steps.label: Search the broken lecturn for the torn page
steps.detail: Search the broken lecturn and keep the torn page it holds.

steps.label: Cut open the coffin and search it for the black prism
steps.detail: Use the knife on the coffin west of the skeleton, then search it (may take a few tries) for the black prism.

steps.label: Show the tankard to the Yanille bartender
steps.detail: Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon inn tankard on the bartender to begin identifying its owner.

steps.label: Speak to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild
steps.detail: Find Zavistic Rarve inside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (ring the bell out front if you lack the level to enter).

hints.value: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres (only if Hand in the Sand already started)

steps.label: Speak to the bedridden Sithik Ints
steps.detail: Sithik is bedridden in the upstairs bedroom of the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild; ask to look around his room.

hints.value: Do you mind if I look around?

steps.label: Search Sithik's drawers, cupboard, and wardrobe
steps.detail: Search all three pieces of furniture in the room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a Book of H.A.M.

hints.value: More papyrus can be found here if a re-sketch is needed later.

steps.label: Read all three found books
steps.detail: Read the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M before acting on them.

steps.label: Use all three books on Sithik
steps.detail: Use the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M on Sithik in turn.

steps.label: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch his portrait
steps.detail: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch a portrait whose examine text must read a classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

hints.value: A low Crafting level (1-10) reduces the odds of sketching a correct portrait on the first try; 20+ Crafting is recommended to speed this up -- soft speed factor, not a hard requirement.

steps.label: Show the sketched portrait to Sithik
steps.detail: Use the portrait on Sithik; he must appreciate its honesty, not just its truth.

steps.label: Return to the Dragon Inn
steps.detail: Head back to the Dragon Inn in Yanille to get the portrait signed.

steps.label: Have the bartender sign the portrait
steps.detail: Use the tankard then the portrait on the bartender; he signs the portrait as an affidavit.

steps.label: Return to the Wizards' Guild
steps.detail: Head back to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild with the evidence in hand.

steps.label: Present the evidence to Zavistic Rarve
steps.detail: Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the necromancy book, Book of H.A.M, the tankard, and the signed portrait to receive a strange potion.

hints.value: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
Text doesn't explicitly say whether the 4 items are truly consumed here vs merely checked -- modeled as consumed.

steps.label: Spike Sithik's tea
steps.detail: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.

steps.label: Reset Sithik's dialogue by leaving and returning
steps.detail: Go downstairs then back upstairs so Sithik has drunk the spiked tea before you talk to him.

steps.label: Get the three secrets out of Sithik
steps.detail: Question Sithik for the cures to the disease, the removal of the undead ogres, and the effects of the spell -- needed for Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows.

hints.value: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? / How do I get rid of the undead ogres / How do I get rid of the disease / Sorry, I have to go.

steps.label: Report the culprit to Grish
steps.detail: Tell Grish you found who's responsible for the Zogres; he gives you an ogre gate key for the ceremonial chamber.

hints.value: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

steps.label: Learn to equip a composite ogre bow
steps.detail: Ask Grish about an easier way to kill Zogres to learn how to equip composite ogre bows.

hints.value: "??" (option 2, label text not given)

steps.label: Chop an achey tree for logs
steps.detail: Optional: cut an achey tree for logs to make a composite ogre bow instead of relying on Crumble Undead.

hints.value: Optional side-path; not required to finish the quest.

steps.label: Make an unstrung comp bow
steps.detail: Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory and select box 2 to create an unstrung comp bow.

steps.label: String the composite ogre bow
steps.detail: String the unstrung bow with a bow string to finish it.

steps.label: Brew Relicym's balm
steps.detail: Optional: add a Rogue's purse to a vial of water then add snake weed to brew Relicym's balm; not needed for the quest itself but unlocks purchasing more from Uglug Nar.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also lists 'buy one from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule; only the gather/produce path is modeled.

steps.label: Cut achey trees for arrow logs
steps.detail: Optional: cut achey trees for logs to fletch brutal arrows instead of buying them.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also says 'if you have access to the Grand Exchange, just buy the arrows and skip this section' -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule.

steps.label: Fletch the logs into ogre arrow shafts
steps.detail: Fletch the achey tree logs with a knife into ogre arrow shafts.

steps.label: Add feathers to the arrow shafts
steps.detail: Add feathers to the ogre arrow shafts to make flighted ogre arrows.

steps.label: Nail the flighted arrows into brutal arrows
steps.detail: With a hammer in your inventory, use nails on the flighted ogre arrows to finish them.

steps.label: Head to the ceremonial chamber
steps.detail: Return to Jiggig, travel west through both sets of doors, then go down the stairs.

steps.label: Search the stand at the end of the chamber
steps.detail: Follow the chamber to its end and search the stand to approach Slash Bash.

hints.value: No item result is stated for this search -- treated as a pure trigger.

steps.label: Kill Slash Bash
steps.detail: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash, who uses both Ranged and Melee; safe-spot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

steps.label: Return to Grish to finish
steps.detail: Report Slash Bash's defeat to Grish to complete the quest.

steps.label: Search the shelf in the SW ruined house to start
steps.detail: Also search the smashed table in the same building for 2 free tarromin + a Rogue's purse (keep the purse for Zogre Flesh Eaters); a spare vial spawn is here too.

steps.label: Brew 2 doses of Serum 207
steps.detail: Use tarromin on a vial of water to make tarromin potion (unf) if not already carried, then add ashes to finish. Make two doses.

hints.value: Serum 207 can be bought on the GE, but at least one dose must be player-made for this quest step to register — gather/produce path modeled, GE not used.

steps.label: Use Serum 207 on Razmire Keelgan and learn about the shades
steps.detail: In the general store; he explains the shades are restless spirits and asks for 5 Loar Shade remains.

steps.label: Kill 5 level-40 Loar Shades for their remains
steps.detail: Kills only count toward the task once Razmire has asked for them; remains come from the kill itself.

steps.label: Give Razmire 2 shade remains
steps.detail: Use Serum 207 on him again, then he takes 2 remains for experiments and mentions Ulsquire Shauncy.

steps.label: Buy olive oil and temple building materials from Razmire's stores
steps.detail: General store: olive oil. Builders' store (Razmire opens it): timber beam, limestone brick, swamp paste (Flamtaer hammer optional, ~13,000gp, highly recommended if the minigame is unpopulated).

steps.label: Cure Ulsquire Shauncy and learn about the temple
steps.detail: House south-east of Razmire's; give a Serum 207 dose then a shade remain, then ask both "What did you find out about the remains?" and "What can you tell me about that temple?" (both required or the temple can't be interacted with).

steps.label: Repair the temple to full and light the sacred flame
steps.detail: Minigame on the island NE of the general store: use a hammer/Flamtaer hammer and building materials to repair the walls (Crafting 20); sanctity accrues from repairing/reinforcing or killing Loar Shades. World 377 is the dedicated minigame world if solo repair is too slow.

steps.label: Pour olive oil on the sacred flame for sacred oil
steps.detail: Requires at least 10% Sanctity from the temple repair.

steps.label: Dip the remaining Serum 207 in the flame for Serum 208
steps.detail: Optional but highly recommended (permanently cures Razmire/Ulsquire); needs 20%+ Sanctity.

steps.label: Cut a dead tree for logs if none carried
steps.detail: Near the funeral pyres, west of the general store.

steps.label: Combine sacred oil with logs into a pyre log
Light the pyre log with the shade remains on a funeral pyre
steps.detail: Use the pyre log then the remaining loar shade remains on one of the stone-pillar funeral pyres, then light it (25 Prayer xp) and collect the reward from the pillar.

steps.label: Talk to Ulsquire to finish (re-serum him if needed)
steps.detail: Use a Serum 207/208 dose first if he has reverted to being afflicted, then speak to him to complete the quest.

checkpoints.label: Repairing the temple and making Serum 208

steps.label: Search the hilltop bush for the missing teddy bear
steps.detail: North of the Exam Centre, east walkway, easternmost bush by the large blue urn.

steps.label: Pan the river for the special cup
steps.detail: Take a panning tray from the tent table, use a cup of tea on the panning guide, then pan the river east of the tent.

hints.value: Panning has a small chance to also yield an uncut opal, needed later for the level-3 exam — keep it if received here.

steps.label: Pickpocket Digsite workmen for the animal skull
steps.detail: Repeat until the skull drops.

hints.value: A specimen brush needed later can also drop from these pickpockets — keep it if received here.

steps.label: Deliver the teddy, cup, and skull to the three lost-item students
steps.detail: Blonde/green-shirt student (animal skull) north of the tent; orange-shirt student (special cup) further north-east; purple-clothed female student (teddy bear) north-west — talk to each twice.

steps.label: Retake the exam for the Level 1 certificate
steps.detail: Re-ask each student for their answer, then answer the Examiner's 3 questions correctly.

steps.label: Retake the exam for the Level 2 certificate
steps.detail: Re-consult all three students for the new round of answers first.

steps.label: Give the female student an opal for the Level 3 answer
steps.detail: She additionally demands an opal/uncut opal this round; pan the river again if none is held, hand it over across two conversations.

steps.label: Retake the exam for the Level 3 certificate
steps.detail: Consult all three students once more, then answer correctly for full digging permission.

hints.value: Certificates can later be exchanged with the Museum Curator for a chocolate cake (Desert Treasure I) or fruit blast (Recipe for Disaster) — keep at least the Level 3 certificate for that.

steps.label: Take a specimen jar from the Exam Centre cupboard
steps.detail: South wall inside the Exam Centre; speak to Terry Balando about the tools first if there's no search option.

steps.label: Dig a level-3 site with the trowel for the ancient talisman
steps.detail: South-westernmost or northernmost level-3 dig site; can take several minutes of repeated attempts.

steps.label: Bring the talisman to Terry Balando
steps.detail: He identifies it as a talisman of Zaros and grants an invitation letter for the private dig shafts.

steps.label: Show the invitation letter to a workman by the west winch
steps.detail: Must be the pickpocketable 'Digsite workman' near a winch, not the plain 'Dig site workman'.

steps.label: Rope down the west winch into the sublevels
steps.detail: Requires Agility 15 to operate; grab an arcenia root just north of the rope landing and search the bricks blocking the south-east path.

steps.label: Rope down the north-east winch and talk to Doug Deeping
steps.detail: Ask how to move the rock pile blocking the way; he hands over a chest key.

steps.label: Unlock the chest in the panning tent for chemical powder
Open the centre barrel with the trowel and fill a vial
steps.detail: Deals 25 non-fatal damage and breaks the vial if dropped after filling — do not drop it.

steps.label: Get charcoal if not already carried
steps.detail: Search the specimen tray north of the tent with a specimen jar held, if charcoal was not brought.

steps.label: Have Terry Balando identify the powder and liquid
steps.detail: Use the chemical powder on him (ammonium nitrate), then the unidentified liquid (nitroglycerin) without dropping/emptying it; read the Book on chemicals on a nearby bookshelf first if he won't identify it.

steps.label: Combine powder, liquid, charcoal, and root into a chemical compound
steps.detail: Ammonium nitrate + nitroglycerin -> mixed chemicals (Herblore 6); grind charcoal with pestle and mortar -> ground charcoal; add ground charcoal to mixed chemicals (Herblore 8); add arcenia root to finish (Herblore 10). Dropping the finished compound deals 65 non-fatal damage.

steps.label: Blast the bricks open and enter the chamber
steps.detail: Down the western winch: use the chemical compound on the bricks, then a tinderbox to detonate; watch for level-22 skeletons if under 45 Combat.

steps.label: Pick up the stone tablet in the exposed chamber
Hand the stone tablet to Terry Balando to finish
steps.detail: He remarks on the Saradomin cover-up of the Zaros altar and rewards 2 gold bars.

checkpoints.label: Failing the first exam and gathering student favors
The ancient talisman and the Digsite Dungeon winches
Brewing the explosive compound and the hidden chamber

notes: Fresh whole-page get "The Dig Site" --strip (16732B, previously only section-cached s1/s16) had full Details+Walkthrough+Rewards, no /Quick guide fetch needed. Sole GE mention ("ring of wealth to Grand Exchange" as a Varrock-museum fast-travel option) is a destination reference, not item sourcing — extends the og-g3 fast-travel-not-violation precedent. The three retake-exam loops are collapsed one atom per certificate level (not one per student-consult) since the underlying action is identical each round (re-ask 3 students, answer 3 fixed questions) per U4.

steps.label: Climb the Watchtower trellis and talk to the wizard
steps.detail: Climb the trellis (Agility 18) on the north side of the Watchtower, north-west of Yanille, then the ladder. The wizard explains the tower's ogre-repelling spell has failed because its power crystals were stolen.

steps.label: Search the north-west bush for Skavid fingernails
steps.detail: Other bushes yield red-herring items only (old robe, unusual armour, damaged dagger, tattered eye patch).

steps.label: Show the wizard the fingernails to learn about the relic
steps.detail: He identifies them as Skavid and explains the ogres stole 4 power crystals; you'll need pieces of an ogre relic from three tribe chieftains to enter the ogre city.

steps.label: Talk to Og at the north-west ogre tribe
steps.detail: Through Yanille's west gate or the agility shortcut, bank first for armour/food/2 ropes/1 dragon bones. Og's nemesis Toban stole his gold bar; he gives you a key to Toban's chest.

steps.label: Rope-swing to Grew's island south of Og
steps.detail: Long-branched tree on the west shore; the rope is lost on the swing. Grab jangerberries on the island for later.

steps.label: Talk to Grew about his enemy Gorad
steps.detail: He asks you to knock a tooth out of Gorad on the third island.

steps.label: Kill Gorad for a tooth
steps.detail: Level-68 chieftain, south of the ladder on Toban's island (reached via the Skavid caves x4 without a map, or around Gu'Tanoth's south edge, then west through a rock hole past a death rune spawn). Safespottable in the island centre for Ranged/Magic.

steps.label: Give Toban dragon bones for the third relic piece
steps.detail: Baby dragon bones do not work; do not bury them.

steps.label: Open Toban's chest for Og's stolen gold bar
steps.detail: A second rope spawns near the roots south-west of the island's ladder if needed for the swing back.

steps.label: Give Grew the tooth for the second relic piece and the yellow crystal
steps.detail: Rope-swing back to Grew's island; pick jangerberries first if not already held.

steps.label: Give Og his gold bar for the final relic piece
Return the 3 relic pieces to the wizard to assemble the Ogre relic
steps.detail: Pick up a candle from the ground-floor spawn if a light source is still needed.

steps.label: Show the assembled relic to the Ogre guards for entry
steps.detail: North-west trail split into Gu'Tanoth; the relic must be shown via dialogue, not used directly on them.

steps.label: Steal a rock cake from the market food stall
steps.detail: Southern stall in the ogre market; do not left-click (eats it, forcing a re-steal).

steps.label: Buy a pestle and mortar and vial from Grud if needed
steps.detail: Non-aggressive ogre merchant in the market; ~7 coins total.

steps.label: Say you're a friend and hand over the rock cake at the second gate
steps.detail: First dialogue option only, or the guard knocks you out of the area; use (not eat) the rock cake on him.

steps.label: Jump the broken bridge gap and pay the toll
steps.detail: Agility 25 to jump; the guards then ask for 20 coins to let you cross. Grab the knife spawn here for cutting webs later.

steps.label: Solve the city guards' word puzzle with the death rune
steps.detail: The answer is 'death rune'; hand over the death rune picked up earlier south of the rock hole.

steps.label: Learn the Skavid language from the Scared skavid (cave 1)
steps.detail: East of Gu'Tanoth along the south-east branch; promise not to hurt it.

steps.label: Give the correct response to each of the 4 regular Skavids
steps.detail: Cave 2 (NE, main path): "Bidith tanath." -> "Cur." Cave 3 (N, path opening): "Gor cur..." -> "Ar." Cave 4 (N, south of west Yanille gate): "Cur Bidith." -> "Ig." (take 2 Cave nightshade here). Cave 5 (E, east side of the mountain): "Tanath gor." -> "Nod."

steps.label: Return to the Scared skavid to be declared ready for the Mad skavid
Use the gold bar on a guard to reach the Mad skavid's cave
steps.detail: South of the Scared skavid cave along the south-east entrance path; go south and west across a bridge into cave 6.

steps.label: Answer the Mad skavid's randomised word-repeat challenge
steps.detail: One randomised opening line from a fixed 8-line/8-response table (e.g. 'Ar cur'->'Gor', 'Bidith ig'->'Cur', 'Gor nod'->'Tanath', 'Cur tanath'->'Bidith', 'Bidith tanath'->'Cur', 'Tanath gor'->'Nod', 'Cur bidith'->'Ig', 'Gor cur'->'Ar') read directly off the source page's own table; answering correctly grants the magenta crystal. If short on cave nightshade, 2 more spawn just inside.

hints.value: Do not eat the cave nightshade — it damages you; the hole in the corner is a shortcut back to Yanille.

steps.label: Use a nightshade on an Ogre Enclave guard to enter
steps.detail: West cave entrance in the Gu'Tanoth market; talking to the guards directly triggers an attack instead. 'Use'/'eat' options are swapped for nightshade here — do not eat it, and complete the full dialogue or the nightshade is wasted.

steps.label: Run past the shamans and blue dragons to the north-east exit
steps.detail: A cutscene shows an Ogre shaman and Blue dragon; do not talk to or attack shamans (20-30 damage instantly). Exits near a northern Skavid cave facing Yanille.

steps.label: Kill a giant bat behind the webbed house for bat bones
steps.detail: House east of the Watchtower with a web-covered entrance; cut through with a slashing weapon/knife.

steps.label: Brew and enchant the magic ogre potion with the wizard
steps.detail: Order matters: guam leaf + vial of water -> guam potion (unf); add jangerberries (do not left-click-eat them; they respawn on Grew's island if lost); grind bat bones with pestle and mortar then add; hand the finished potion to the wizard to enchant it.

steps.label: Use the second nightshade on a guard to re-enter the Enclave
steps.detail: Bring pickaxe, anti-dragon/dragonfire shield, food. Same use/eat-swapped, dialogue-must-complete rule as the first entry.

steps.label: Use the magic ogre potion on all 6 ogre shamans
steps.detail: Instantly kills each shaman with no damage taken; the last one drops the cyan crystal automatically into your inventory. If lost, a Shaman robe in the SE corner can be searched for a replacement.

steps.label: Mine the Rock of Dalgroth for the last crystal
steps.detail: Centre of the Enclave; only mineable after the shamans are dead. Mine (not prospect) before leaving, or fresh nightshades are needed to return.

steps.label: Place all 4 crystals and pull the lever to finish
steps.detail: Leave via the north-east exit (or a Nightmare Zone teleport); yellow crystal in the south-west pillar, grey in the south-east, cyan in the north-west, magenta in the north-east, then pull the west-side lever. Do not drop anything before pulling the lever or it is lost permanently in the instance.

checkpoints.label: Og, Grew, and Toban: the ogre relic
Into Gu'Tanoth: rock cake, bridge, and city guards
The Skavid caves and the Mad skavid
Slaying the shamans and mining the last crystal

notes: Fresh whole-page get "Watchtower" --strip (26677B, previously only section-cached s1/s14 + Quick guide walkthrough sections) had full Details+Walkthrough+Rewards, no /Quick guide fetch needed — largest single-fetch page in this bundle. Longest/most multi-region quest of the 7: phase-split into 8 location.quest_phase legs per the design doc's Multiquest lever (Watchtower base, Og/Grew/Toban islands, Gu'Tanoth city, Skavid caves, Enclave scout run, potion-brew back at base, Enclave shaman kill, final revival) since the walkthrough itself repeatedly bounces back to the Watchtower/Yanille bank between legs. Mad skavid's randomised opening line collapsed to ONE atom listing the full 8-line/8-response table in the detail (own words, table content itself is unavoidably enumerable game data) rather than fabricating a fixed playthrough, extending the og-g2 Murder Mystery multi-hop-random-decision precedent. No GE-violation language anywhere in the fetched text (queue's 0-flag count held); all ironman-tier alternate item-source lists (dragon bones, gold bar, guam leaves) are recommended/ironman-field content, not part of the core walkthrough path, so left un-atomized per the established recommended-vs-required distinction.

checkpoints.label: Start the quest and gear up

atoms.label: Ask the Guildmaster for a quest
atoms.detail: Speak to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild to start the quest.

atoms.label: Learn about the dragon from Oziach
atoms.detail: Speak to Oziach in Edgeville; he explains the rune platebody and the dragon Elvarg.

atoms.label: Get the maze key and map-piece leads
atoms.detail: Return to the Guildmaster; get the Melzar's Maze key and ask where all three map pieces and the right ship are.

atoms.label: Get an anti-dragon shield if you lack one
atoms.detail: Optional: if you don't already own an anti-dragon shield, ask Duke Horacio on the 1st floor of Lumbridge Castle for one.

hints.value: skip if shield already owned

atoms.label: Ask the Oracle about Thalzar's map piece
atoms.detail: Speak to the Oracle on Ice Mountain about the map piece, after already asking the Guildmaster where it is.

atoms.label: Open the magic door in the Dwarven Mine
atoms.detail: In the Dwarven Mine's north-east side, use silk, a lobster pot, an unfired bowl, then the wizard's mind bomb on the magic door; it opens automatically.

atoms.label: Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece
atoms.detail: Open and search the chest beyond the magic door to collect the map piece; re-entry does not require reusing the items.

atoms.label: Enter Melzar's Maze
atoms.detail: With the maze key in hand, travel to Rimmington and enter Melzar's Maze.

atoms.label: Kill the long-tailed zombie rat for a key
atoms.detail: Kill the small zombie rat with the long tail, take its key, and go through the north-western door.

atoms.label: Kill the hooded ghost for a key
atoms.detail: Kill the ghost wearing a hood and tube top (no cape), take its key, go through the second door from the north on the east wall.

atoms.label: Kill the round-shield skeleton for a key
atoms.detail: Kill the skeleton carrying the round shield, take its key, go through the westmost door on the south wall and descend the ladder three times.

atoms.label: Kill zombies until a key drops
atoms.detail: Kill the maze zombies for a key, then go through the blue door. Exact number of zombies to defeat is unconfirmed.

atoms.label: Kill Melzar the Mad for a key
atoms.detail: Kill Melzar the Mad, take his key, and go through the purple (magenta) door.

atoms.label: Kill the level-82 lesser demon for a key
atoms.detail: Kill the level-82 lesser demon (can be safespotted by luring it to the magenta door), take its key, and go through the green door.

atoms.label: Search the maze's final chest
atoms.detail: Open and search the chest to collect Melzar's map piece.

atoms.label: Go to the Port Sarim jail
atoms.detail: Travel to the jail in Port Sarim to find Wormbrain.

atoms.label: Obtain Lozar's map piece from Wormbrain
atoms.detail: Kill Wormbrain with a ranged/magic/halberd attack and telegrab the dropped map piece, or pay him instead; ask the Guildmaster first for his location.

hints.value: pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins instead of killing him

atoms.label: Combine the three map pieces
atoms.detail: Use the three collected map pieces on each other to assemble the full Crandor map.

atoms.label: Ask the Guildmaster about a ship and captain
atoms.detail: Return to the Guildmaster and ask where to find a ship and its captain.

atoms.label: Withdraw boat-repair supplies
atoms.detail: Withdraw a hammer, 3 planks, 90 steel nails, and 2,000 coins from the bank.

atoms.label: Buy the ship from Klarense
atoms.detail: Speak to Klarense at the southern docks of Port Sarim near the Void Outpost boat and pay 2,000 coins for the ship.

atoms.label: Repair the hole in the ship
atoms.detail: Board the ship, climb down the ladder, and repair the hole three times using the planks, nails, and hammer.

atoms.label: Sail to Crandor with Ned
atoms.detail: Speak to Ned in Draynor Village with the Crandor map in your inventory to sail to Crandor.

atoms.label: Climb the volcano into Elvarg's lair
atoms.detail: Climb to the top of the volcano and enter the hole down to Elvarg's cave.

atoms.label: Equip the anti-dragon shield
atoms.detail: Equip the anti-dragon shield (and drink an antifire potion if carried) before approaching Elvarg.

atoms.label: Open the shortcut wall (optional)
atoms.detail: Optional: before teleporting out, open the wall south of Elvarg's cave to unlock a permanent shortcut through the Karamja volcano dungeon.

hints.value: unlocks a Karamja diary task and a shortcut route back

atoms.label: Kill Elvarg
atoms.detail: Kill the level-83 dragon Elvarg; flinching her from the south-east corner of the cave is a safer but slower approach. Her head is collected automatically as proof.

atoms.label: Report back to Oziach
atoms.detail: Return to Oziach in Edgeville to complete the quest.

notes: Wormbrain's map piece has a kill-or-pay branch (10,000 coins); modeled as a single kill atom with an alt-method hint. atoms.label: Ask Martin about his failed crops
atoms.detail: Speak to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Market to start the quest; do not pickpocket him or he becomes unavailable for 10 in-game minutes.

atoms.detail: Wait 5 minutes of real-world time for Martin's crops to fail again, then speak to him a second time.

atoms.detail: Make your way to Fairy Nuff's ransacked grotto in Zanaris, just north of the bank.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Pick up and study Nuff's certificate
atoms.detail: Take Nuff's healing certificate off the grotto floor and study it; if lost, another copy can be found by searching the potion shelves.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Decode the certificate using the Rune temple sign
atoms.detail: Read the Rune temple sign just south of the Cosmic Altar in south-west Zanaris to decipher the certificate's fairy-symbol code.

atoms.label: Ask the Fairy Godfather about the Queen
atoms.detail: Speak to the Fairy Godfather in the throne room about where the Fairy Queen was taken.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Learn to use the fairy ring network
atoms.detail: Speak to the Co-ordinator north of the throne room to unlock use of the fairy rings.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Speak to Fairy Fixit
atoms.detail: Speak to Fairy Fixit near the fairy ring west of the throne room.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Equip the dramen staff
atoms.detail: Equip the dramen staff before using the fairy ring so it can be operated.

atoms.label: Fairy-ring route to the Fairy Queen's hideout
atoms.detail: With Nuff's certificate in inventory, teleport via the fairy ring in sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ (no movement), then AJS to reach the hideout.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Learn the Queen's condition from Fairy Nuff
atoms.detail: Speak with Fairy Nuff and Fairy Very Wise in the north-east corner of the hideout about the dying Queen and the stolen secateurs.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Speak with Fairy Very Wise
atoms.detail: Speak with Fairy Very Wise alongside Fairy Nuff in the hideout.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Fairy-ring back to Zanaris
atoms.detail: Use fairy code BKS to return to Zanaris.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather for the secateurs
atoms.detail: Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather in Zanaris while he and his henchmen are not looking to obtain the Queen's secateurs; requires level 40 Thieving, no stat boost usable.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Fairy-ring back to the hideout
atoms.detail: Return to the hideout via fairy code sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Give the secateurs to Fairy Nuff
atoms.detail: Give the Queen's secateurs to Fairy Nuff. Do not mix the magic essence potion before she explains how to make it, or it will not work on the Queen.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Wait for and pick a star flower
atoms.detail: Travel to fairy code CKP (requires Nuff's certificate in inventory) and wait for a star flower to grow, then pick it. Growth time is roughly 2-5 minutes per the guide.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Kill a gorak for its claws
atoms.detail: Travel to fairy code DIR, kill a level-145 gorak (can be safespotted using terrain), and pick up its claws.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Fairy-ring back to the hideout
atoms.detail: Return to the hideout via fairy code sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

atoms.label: Learn the magic essence recipe from Fairy Nuff
atoms.detail: Speak to Fairy Nuff so she explains how to brew the magic essence potion before you attempt to mix it.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Steep the star flower in a vial of water
atoms.detail: Use the star flower on a vial of water to prepare the flower base for the potion.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Grind the gorak claws into powder
atoms.detail: Grind the gorak claws into gorak claw powder.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.detail: Use the star-flower mixture and gorak claw powder on each other to brew a magic essence potion; requires level 57 Herblore.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

atoms.label: Use the magic essence on the Fairy Queen
atoms.detail: Right-click use the magic essence potion on the Fairy Queen, who is laying on the stretcher near Fairy Nuff.

atoms.label: Speak with the revived Fairy Queen
atoms.detail: Speak with the Fairy Queen to complete the quest; she lets the Godfather keep the throne given his numerical advantage.

checkpoints.label: Free King Arthur at Black Knights' Fortress

atoms.label: Speak to Gossip outside Sinclair Mansion
atoms.detail: Speak to Gossip outside Sinclair Mansion to begin the quest.

atoms.label: Speak to the guard in the courtyard
atoms.detail: Speak to the guard in the courtyard to the north of the mansion.

atoms.label: Break into the mansion
atoms.detail: Break in through the smashed window on the east side of Sinclair Mansion.

atoms.label: Take the scrap paper
atoms.detail: Grab the scrap paper in the ground-floor dining room next to the fireplace.

atoms.label: Take and read the address form
atoms.detail: Go up to the 1st floor library in the centre of the mansion, take the address form off the table, and read it.

atoms.label: Search the bookcase for a black knight helm
atoms.detail: Search the bookcase on the library's western wall for a black knight helm.

atoms.label: Hand the three items to the guard
atoms.detail: Return to the guard via the smashed window and give him the scrap paper, address form, and black knight helm.

atoms.label: Report back to Gossip
atoms.detail: Speak to Gossip again, working through all of the dialogue options.

atoms.label: Travel to the Seers' Village courthouse
atoms.detail: Travel south-east of the Seers' Village bank to the courthouse for Anna's trial.

atoms.label: Begin Anna's trial
atoms.detail: Speak to Anna, then head down the stairs to begin the trial.

atoms.label: Call the Dog Handler as a witness
atoms.detail: Ask the judge to call the Dog Handler, then question him about the poison.

atoms.label: Call the Butler as a witness
atoms.detail: Ask the judge to call the Butler, then question him about the dagger.

atoms.label: Call the Maid as a witness
atoms.detail: Ask the judge to call the Maid, then question her about the night of the murder.

atoms.label: Ask about the thread
atoms.detail: Ask the Maid (or another witness) about the thread; a correct trial ends with Anna declared not guilty.

atoms.label: Speak to Anna after the trial
atoms.detail: Exit the courtroom through the gate and speak to Anna again in her cell.

atoms.label: Find the statue at Camelot Castle
atoms.detail: Head east around Camelot Castle, past the gate, to the north-east, and search the statue there to trigger a cutscene.

atoms.label: Search the statue to start the cutscene
atoms.detail: Search the statue; clicking anywhere during the cutscene ends it early and it must be repeated.

atoms.label: Speak to the imprisoned Merlin
atoms.detail: Speak with Merlin inside his cell about what to do next.

atoms.label: Reach for the cell vent
atoms.detail: Reach for the vent at the north of Merlin's cell.

atoms.label: Telekinetic Grab the guard's hair clip
atoms.detail: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the guard fixing his hair outside the cell to obtain a hair clip; knights inside the cell can alternatively provide a lockpick or telekinetic-grab runes.

hints.value: ask the knights in the cell for a lockpick or runes instead

atoms.label: Pick the cell door lock
atoms.detail: Use the hair clip or a lockpick on the door to start the tumbler puzzle.

atoms.label: Solve the four-tumbler lock
atoms.detail: Raise each of the four tumblers by trial and error: start all at the lowest height, leave any tumbler green once it shows, and keep raising the rest until the lock opens.

atoms.label: Climb to the top floor
atoms.detail: Climb the staircases up to the top floor of the prison tower.

atoms.label: Search the table
atoms.detail: Search the table on the top floor.

atoms.label: Take the round purple box
atoms.detail: Choose the round purple box, second from the right, from the table.

atoms.label: Get an Animate Rock scroll from Wizard Cromperty
atoms.detail: Speak to Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne for an Animate Rock scroll; talk to him even if the scroll is already owned from One Small Favour.

atoms.label: Travel to Black Knights' Fortress
atoms.detail: Travel to Black Knights' Fortress, west of Edgeville and north of Ice Mountain.

atoms.label: Equip full black armour
atoms.detail: Equip a full set of black armour before entering the fortress.

atoms.label: Enter through the sturdy south door
atoms.detail: Enter the fortress through the sturdy door on the south wall while wearing full black armour.

atoms.label: Push the north wall
atoms.detail: Push the wall to the north to reveal the way down.

atoms.label: Free King Arthur with granite
atoms.detail: Climb down the ladder and free King Arthur from his statue using the granite.

atoms.label: Give King Arthur the helm and chainbody
atoms.detail: Talk to King Arthur and give him the bronze med helm and iron chainbody.

atoms.label: Return to Camelot's round table
atoms.detail: Travel back to Camelot Castle's round table room.

atoms.label: Report to King Arthur to finish
atoms.detail: Speak to King Arthur at the round table to complete the quest.

notes: Tumbler-lock puzzle heights are per-instance/randomized and have no fixed published values, so its atom is until-modeled with state '??' rather than a fabricated count; the guide's own trial-and-error method is described instead. Telekinetic Grab vs. lockpick-from-knights is a genuine alt-method branch, modeled as a hint on one primary atom rather than two parallel atoms. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} coordinate templates appeared in the fetched Quick guide walkthrough section, so all coords are empty. Details/Rewards H2s on the Quick guide are transclusion stubs and were not fetched; reqs/xp already sourced in quest_db per the held row.

checkpoints.label: Find and calm the fallen man in the Lunar Isle mine

atoms.label: Travel to Lunar Isle and enter the mine cave
atoms.detail: Head to Lunar Isle, enter the mine in the north-east area, and crawl through the marked cave entrance to reach the fallen man.

atoms.label: Talk to the fallen man and close the interface
atoms.detail: Speak to the collapsed man in the cave, follow the dialogue, then close the interface that appears afterward.

atoms.label: Feed him the first round of food (4 pieces)
atoms.detail: Feed him 4 pieces of food, starting with whichever type you have seven of and cycling between the different foods without repeating one twice in a row.

atoms.label: Reassure him with a positive response
atoms.detail: Talk to him again and pick the reassuring dialogue option.

hints.value: Just don't worry. / Of course.

atoms.label: Feed him the second round of food (4 pieces)
atoms.detail: Feed him 4 more pieces of food as before, continuing to cycle between food types.

atoms.label: Keep reassuring him until he sits up
atoms.detail: Talk to him repeatedly, choosing positive responses, until a cutscene plays of him sitting up.

atoms.label: Feed him the third round of food (6 pieces)
atoms.detail: Feed him 6 more pieces of food, completing the 3-type, 20-piece total food requirement.

atoms.label: Talk him upright, then once more
atoms.detail: Talk to him repeatedly with positive responses until a cutscene shows him stand up, then talk to him one additional time.

until.state: fallen man stands up (cutscene), plus one extra talk

atoms.label: Ask 'Birds-Eye' Jack about Cyrisus's gear
atoms.detail: Talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack in the bank and ask about Cyrisus in the mine to learn which equipment set he needs.

hints.value: Cyrisus in the mine

atoms.label: Withdraw the matching Armament equipment set
atoms.detail: Withdraw the equipment set matching Cyrisus's dominant combat style -- melee: dragon med helm, Abyssal whip, Ahrim's robetop/robeskirt, ranger boots; magic: Robin hood hat, dragon chainbody, black d'hide chaps, infinity boots, ancient staff; ranged: splitbark helm, Karil's leathertop, Torag's platelegs, adamant boots, magic shortbow -- then confirm the correct set with the NPC Contact spell.

atoms.label: Return the confirmed gear to Cyrisus
atoms.detail: Bring the confirmed equipment set back to Cyrisus for a cutscene, then choose to discuss the Armament.

hints.value: Talk about the Armament

atoms.label: Feed Cyrisus until his health reaches 100%
atoms.detail: Use food on Cyrisus repeatedly until his health bar fills to 100%.

atoms.label: Reassure Cyrisus until his spirit maxes out
atoms.detail: Talk to him again multiple times with positive responses until a cutscene triggers; feed him a bit more if it doesn't trigger yet.

atoms.label: Talk to the Oneiromancer for a dream vial
atoms.detail: Speak to the Oneiromancer at the Astral Altar to receive a dream vial.

hints.value: Cyrisus.

atoms.label: Optionally switch spellbook for the final fight
atoms.detail: Change spellbook now if you plan to use spells from a different spellbook during the Dream Hall fight.

hints.value: Optional -- only needed if your planned fight strategy uses a non-default spellbook.

atoms.label: Fill the dream vial with water
atoms.detail: Fill the vial received from the Oneiromancer with water.

atoms.label: Add goutweed to the vial
atoms.detail: Add a goutweed to the water-filled dream vial.

atoms.label: Hammer the astral rune into shards
atoms.detail: Use a hammer on an astral rune to crack it into shards.

atoms.label: Grind the shards into ground astral rune
atoms.detail: Grind the astral rune shards with a pestle and mortar.

atoms.label: Add the ground astral rune to finish the potion
atoms.detail: Add the ground astral rune to the prepared dream vial to complete the dream potion.

atoms.label: Gear up for the four fights
atoms.detail: Prepare combat gear for four consecutive fights where prayers and emergency teleports are disabled; keep the seal of passage on you rather than banking it, since 'Birds-Eye' Jack will not serve you without it beforehand.

hints.value: Do not bank the seal of passage before entering the Dream Hall.

atoms.label: Light the Ceremonial Brazier
atoms.detail: Light the Ceremonial Brazier inside the dream hall building to begin the encounter.

atoms.label: Talk to Cyrisus to start the fight
atoms.detail: Speak to Cyrisus and agree to proceed into the fight.

hints.value: Yes, let's go!
You can leave at any time via the lectern to the north, but this forces a re-battle of any defeated bosses.

atoms.label: Defeat The Inadequacy (level 343)
atoms.detail: Fight and kill The Inadequacy, the hardest of the four bosses; magic is recommended since it has low magic defence.

atoms.label: Defeat The Everlasting (level 223)
atoms.detail: Fight and kill The Everlasting; it can be safespotted from the lectern to the north.

atoms.label: Defeat The Untouchable (level 274)
atoms.detail: Fight and kill The Untouchable; it can also be safespotted from the lectern to the north.

atoms.label: Defeat The Illusive (level 108)
atoms.detail: Fight and kill The Illusive, which burrows and relocates during the fight.

atoms.label: Return to the Oneiromancer to finish
atoms.detail: Head back to the Oneiromancer and talk to her to complete the quest.

hints.value: Cyrisus.

notes: 45 atoms total across 3 checkpoints, atomized straight from Dream Mentor/Quick guide sections 3-5 (Helping the fallen man / Dream potion / Dreamland). No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} pins anywhere in the fetched text -- coords[] empty on all atoms. Cyrisus's final food-to-100%-health count is unspecified by the source -- left as "??" rather than guessed. This is a real hardcore-ironman death risk (no teleports/prayer in the Dream Hall, lectern is the only exit) per the held quest_db row; not separately atomized since it's a standing constraint on the whole Dreamland checkpoint, not a discrete step.

checkpoints.label: Talk to Radimus Erkle and begin the quest
Map the Kharazi Jungle and summon Gujuo
Craft, bless, and fill the golden bowl; retrieve the binding book
Free Ungadulu and defeat Nezikchened the first time
Restore the water source (evil/good branching path)
Grow the Yommi tree and win the final fight
Report back to Radimus Erkle to finish

atoms.label: Talk to a Legends' Guard east of Ardougne
atoms.detail: Speak to a Legends' Guard east of Ardougne and ask to be taken to Grand Vizier Erkle; fairy ring code BLR reaches the area.

hints.value: Can I speak to someone in charge? / Can I go on the quest? / Yes, I'd like to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle.

atoms.label: Talk to Radimus and accept the quest
atoms.detail: Talk to Radimus Erkle and agree to hear about and start the quest.

hints.value: Yes actually, what's involved? / Yes, it sounds great!

atoms.label: Take a machete from the cupboards
atoms.detail: Open the cupboards next to Radimus Erkle to obtain a machete, if you don't already carry one.

atoms.label: Take papyrus from the table
atoms.detail: Grab papyrus from the table next to Radimus Erkle, if needed for the jungle mapping.

atoms.label: Travel to the Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village
atoms.detail: Head to the Kharazi Jungle via fairy ring code CKR, or the Karamja gnome glider plus the stepping stones to the south-west, then chop through the jungle bush to get in.

atoms.label: Optionally restock papyrus and charcoal
atoms.detail: Buy extra papyrus and charcoal from the Shilo Village General Store before mapping, if you're short.

hints.value: Optional resupply -- skip if already carrying enough papyrus/charcoal.

atoms.label: Map the west section of the jungle
atoms.detail: Right-click Radimus notes and select 'complete' once you finish exploring the western jungle section.

atoms.label: Map the middle section of the jungle
atoms.detail: Complete the mapping of the middle jungle section with Radimus notes before moving on.

atoms.label: Map the east section of the jungle
atoms.detail: Complete the mapping of the eastern jungle section with Radimus notes to finish the map.

atoms.label: Trade the completed notes for a bullroarer
atoms.detail: Use the completed Radimus notes on a Jungle forester south of Shilo Village to receive a bullroarer; read the map to him first if he refuses.

hints.value: Yes, go ahead make a copy!

atoms.label: Return into the Kharazi Jungle
atoms.detail: Cut your way back into the jungle interior.

atoms.label: Swing the bullroarer to summon Gujuo
atoms.detail: Swing the bullroarer beside a totem pole; try a different pole if it doesn't work.

atoms.label: Talk to Gujuo about the native people
atoms.detail: Speak with Gujuo, working through the dialogue about attracting and befriending the jungle natives.

hints.value: I was hoping to attract the attention of a native. / I want to develop friendly relations with your people. / Can you get your people together? / What can we do instead then? / How do we make the totem pole? / I will release Ungadulu...

atoms.label: Search the Mossy rock and crawl inside
atoms.detail: Search the Mossy rock in the north-western jungle section and crawl inside; requires 50 Agility.

atoms.label: Investigate the Fire Wall
atoms.detail: Investigate the Fire Wall inside the cave to learn how it can be doused with sacred water.

hints.value: How can I extinguish the flames? / Where do I get pure water from?

atoms.label: Leave the cave and swing the bullroarer again
atoms.detail: Exit the cave and swing the bullroarer once more to ask Gujuo about the pure water and the vessel needed to carry it.

hints.value: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames. / Where is the pool of sacred water? / What kind of a vessel?

atoms.label: Smith the golden bowl
atoms.detail: Use 2 gold bars with a hammer on an anvil (a barbarian anvil will not work) to smith a golden bowl; this can fail.

atoms.label: Have Gujuo enchant the golden bowl
atoms.detail: Swing the bullroarer to summon Gujuo and ask him to bless the golden bowl; requires at least 42 Prayer points and can fail, costing prayer points on failure.

hints.value: Yes, I'd like you to bless my gold bowl.

atoms.label: Fill the blessed bowl with sacred water
atoms.detail: At the Water Pool west of the jungle centre, use a machete on the nearby reeds, then use the reeds on the pool to fill the blessed golden bowl.

atoms.label: Squeeze through the crevice behind the eastern bookcase
atoms.detail: Re-enter the north-western cave and search the eastern bookcase to slip through the hidden crevice behind it.

atoms.label: Pick the first gate's lock
atoms.detail: Use a lockpick on the gate to open it; carry a spare lockpick in case it breaks.

atoms.label: Smash the three boulders
atoms.detail: Smash all three boulders blocking the path; a failed smash can reduce Mining by 1, so bring a restore potion if needed.

atoms.label: Force open the second gate
atoms.detail: Push open the next gate; requires 50 Strength.

atoms.label: Walk to the marked wall
atoms.detail: Walk south-west then north-west, jumping the jagged walls along the way, until you reach the marked wall.

atoms.label: Search the marked wall first
atoms.detail: Search the marked wall before using runes on it, or the runes will be consumed with no effect.

atoms.label: Use the runes on the marked wall in order
atoms.detail: Use Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, and Law runes on the marked wall in that exact order.

atoms.label: Place the cut gems on the matching carved rocks
atoms.detail: Use each cut gem -- opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond -- on the carved rock whose colour matches it, per the in-cave map.

atoms.label: Pick up and read the binding book
atoms.detail: Take the binding book that appears once the wall opens, and read it.

atoms.label: Teleport out to prepare, then return
atoms.detail: Teleport away to gear up for the Nezikchened fight, then return to the first room of the cave.

atoms.label: Refill the bowl with sacred water if needed
atoms.detail: Top up the golden bowl with sacred water again -- leaving the jungle can evaporate what's inside.

atoms.label: Douse the fire around Ungadulu
atoms.detail: Use the sacred-water-filled golden bowl on the fire surrounding Ungadulu.

atoms.label: Bind Ungadulu with the binding book
atoms.detail: Use the binding book on Ungadulu, being careful not to left-click attack him by mistake.

atoms.label: Defeat Nezikchened (level 187)
atoms.detail: Fight and defeat Nezikchened; prayer drains to 1/10 of your level at the start, so ranged or melee with Protect from Melee is recommended since he strongly resists magic. Taking too long lets him despawn, forcing a redo of the water-and-book steps.

atoms.label: Talk to the freed Ungadulu
atoms.detail: Speak with Ungadulu about collecting Yommi tree seeds, careful not to attack him by mistake.

hints.value: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo. / How do I grow the Yommi tree? / What will you do now? / How do I get out of here? / Ok, thanks...

atoms.label: Exit and tell Gujuo Ungadulu is free
atoms.detail: Leave the area, summon Gujuo, and tell him Ungadulu has been freed from the demon that possessed him.

hints.value: Ungadulu is free, he was possessed by a demon and I killed it. / What do I do now? / Ok thanks for your help.

atoms.label: Water the Yommi tree seeds
atoms.detail: Use your bowl of water on the Yommi tree seeds.

atoms.label: Cut reeds and try to refill the bowl
atoms.detail: Cut more reeds and attempt to refill the bowl at the pool.

hints.value: The pool has dried up at this point -- the refill attempt fails until the water source is restored later.

atoms.label: Tell Gujuo the water source is dry
atoms.detail: Summon Gujuo and explain the water pool has dried up, asking about the water's source and for his help reaching it.

hints.value: The water pool has dried up and I need more water. / Where is the source of the spring of pure water? / If I went, could you help me? / Ok thanks for your help.

atoms.label: Collect ardrigal from a large-leaved palm tree
atoms.detail: Search a large-leaved palm tree to collect ardrigal, if you're not already carrying extra from Jungle Potion.

atoms.label: Collect snake weed from a marshy jungle vine
atoms.detail: Search a marshy jungle vine to collect snake weed, if you're not already carrying extra.

atoms.label: Mix a bravery potion
atoms.detail: Mix the ardrigal and snake weed with a vial of water to make a bravery potion.

atoms.label: Drink the bravery potion before descending
atoms.detail: Drink the bravery potion now to save inventory space before heading back through the cave.

atoms.label: Cast Charge Orb on the north gate
atoms.detail: Return through the cave to the gem-pool chamber and cast a Charge Orb spell on the north gate to open it.

atoms.label: Use the rope on the winch and climb down
atoms.detail: Use a rope on the winch and climb down; without a rope, smash a barrel instead (a monster may spawn) and expect 10-20 fall damage either way.

atoms.label: Climb over the rocks to reach the bottom
atoms.detail: Climb over the rocky ledge to reach the bottom of the chasm; this can deal 40+ fall damage.

atoms.label: Kill the level-106 skeleton for a crystal piece
atoms.detail: Defeat the level-106 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

atoms.label: Kill the level-100 skeleton for a crystal piece
atoms.detail: Defeat the level-100 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

atoms.label: Kill the level-92 skeleton for a crystal piece
atoms.detail: Defeat the level-92 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

atoms.label: Feed the crystal pieces to the furnace
atoms.detail: Use each of the 3 crystal pieces on the north-eastern furnace to form a heart.

atoms.label: Use the heart on the mossy rock
atoms.detail: Search the one searchable mossy rock in the middle of the room, then use the heart on it.

atoms.label: Use the heart on the recess and walk through the barrier
atoms.detail: Run south-east, use the heart on the recess next to the barrier, then walk through the barrier.

atoms.label: Push a boulder aside
atoms.detail: Push one of the boulders to the west to clear the way.

atoms.label: Talk to Echned Zekin
atoms.detail: Speak with the ghost Echned Zekin about needing the water, and agree to help him.

hints.value: Who's asking? / What can I do about that? / I'll do what I must to get the water. / Ok, I'll do it.

atoms.label: [Evil path] Equip the dagger
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: climb back to the top of the ridge and equip the dagger.

hints.value: evil-short-path

atoms.label: [Evil path] Provoke and kill Viyeldi
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: try to take the blue hat and attack Viyeldi during the dialogue to kill him; confirm your dagger is glowing afterward before going back down.

hints.value: evil-short-path

atoms.label: [Evil path] Push the boulder; the ghost takes the dagger
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: go back and push the boulder; the ghost takes the glowing dagger from you.

hints.value: evil-short-path

atoms.label: [Evil path] Defeat Nezikchened again
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: a level-187 demon spawns immediately and drains your prayer -- defeat Nezikchened.

hints.value: evil-short-path

atoms.label: [Evil path] Push the boulder to reach the water
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: push the boulder again to reach the now-restored water pool.

hints.value: evil-short-path

atoms.label: [Evil path] Water the seeds if not already done
atoms.detail: Evil/short path: fill the bowl from the restored pool and use it on the seeds if you haven't already.

hints.value: evil-short-path
Teleporting evaporates the water -- the pool is now a repeatable source going forward.

atoms.label: [Good path] Pass through the fire wall
atoms.detail: Good/long path: do not touch the hat or talk to Viyeldi; teleport out, bank if desired, return to the start of the cave, and investigate the fire wall to pass through.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Use the dark dagger on Ungadulu
atoms.detail: Good/long path: use the dark dagger on Ungadulu.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Cast Charge Orb again
atoms.detail: Good/long path: head back into the cave and cast another Charge Orb spell on the door.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Push the boulder
atoms.detail: Good/long path: push the boulder aside.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Reveal Zekin's true form with Holy Force
atoms.detail: Good/long path: do not tell Zekin you lost the dagger -- instead cast Holy Force to reveal his true form.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Defeat Nezikchened
atoms.detail: Good/long path: defeat Nezikchened once his true form is revealed.

hints.value: good-long-path

atoms.label: [Good path] Push the far west boulder and collect water
atoms.detail: Good/long path: push the far west boulder out of the way and collect the sacred water.

hints.value: good-long-path
Teleporting evaporates the water -- the pool is now a repeatable source going forward.

atoms.label: Plant the Yommi tree seeds
atoms.detail: Use the germinated seeds on the fertile soil patch 8 steps north and 5 steps west of the pool; requires 45 Herblore (boostable) and may need retries until a sapling grows.

atoms.label: Water the Yommi bush into an adult tree
atoms.detail: Use sacred water on the grown Yommi bush to turn it into an adult Yommi tree.

hints.value: The tree rots if you delay too long before carving it, forcing a redo of the growth process including getting sacred water again.

atoms.label: Chop and carve the Yommi tree into a totem
atoms.detail: Use an axe on the adult Yommi tree, then use the axe on the downed tree twice more to carve it into a totem.

atoms.label: Pick up the Yommi totem
atoms.detail: Lift the carved totem from the ground into your inventory.

atoms.label: Activate Protect from Melee before the ritual
atoms.detail: Turn on Protect from Melee before using the totem -- you'll take 4 unavoidable hits, up to 72 damage total on one tick, without being able to move, eat, or change prayers.

atoms.label: Use the totem on an old totem pole
atoms.detail: Use your Yommi totem on any old, brown totem pole to begin the final ritual.

atoms.label: Kill the three ritual skeletons in sequence
atoms.detail: Kill the three skeletons that appear one at a time; keep Protect from Melee active, since Nezikchened reappears and hits you after each one dies.

atoms.label: Defeat Nezikchened at the totem pole
atoms.detail: Defeat Nezikchened once he appears after the three skeletons, keeping Protect from Melee active throughout.

atoms.label: Use the totem on the pole again
atoms.detail: Use your Yommi totem on the totem pole a second time to finish the ritual.

atoms.label: Receive the gilded totem from Gujuo
atoms.detail: Gujuo appears and hands over the gilded totem; swing the bullroarer to summon him if he doesn't show up.

atoms.label: Hand in the gilded totem and Radimus notes
atoms.detail: Talk to Radimus at the Legends' Guild (fairy ring code BLR) while carrying the gilded totem and the Radimus notes.

atoms.label: Choose four skills for training
atoms.detail: Talk to Radimus again in the main guild hall and select four skills for the quest's training reward.

atoms.label: Talk to Radimus once more to finish
atoms.detail: Speak to Radimus one final time to complete the quest.

notes: 79 atoms across 7 checkpoints, atomized from Legends' Quest/Quick guide sections 3-9. The 'Restoring the pool' checkpoint is a genuine mutually-exclusive branch (evil/short vs good/long path to the same restored water source) -- modeled as flat sequential atoms tagged {"type":"branch","value":"evil-short-path"|"good-long-path"} per the emit schema having no dedicated branch{} key (same convention used for Hazeel Cult per an earlier normalize-q pass); both paths converge back into checkpoint 6 with the water restored either way. Only two real {{Map}} pin coord sets existed in the fetched text: the ardrigal/snake weed herb-collection spots for the bravery potion (idx 38-39). Skipped two off-quest optional collection points visible in the source text but not required by Legends' Quest itself: the vanilla pod (Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze) noted in both Kharazi Jungle and Yommi-tree sections, and the palm-leaf collection for the Karamja Hard Diary -- both flagged inline on the wiki as 'if needed' side-content for other quests/diaries, out of grain scope here. Papyrus quantity for the initial cupboard/table pickup (idx3) is unspecified by the source -- left as "??".

checkpoints.label: Dwarf camp and the witch's house

atoms.label: Talk to King Lathas on the top floor of Ardougne Castle to begin
atoms.detail: He explains the plan to send you through the pass; committing here starts the point-of-no-return sequence once you reach Koftik.

hints.value: 1I am. What's our plan?
1Yes.

atoms.label: Talk to Koftik at the West Ardougne cave entrance
atoms.detail: Bring all remaining supplies now; nothing extra can be fetched once you commit to entering.

hints.value: 1I'll take my chances.

atoms.label: Enter the cave and head south at the first junction
atoms.detail: Zone transition into the dungeon proper.

atoms.label: Get cloth from Koftik and light an arrow with it
atoms.detail: Use the cloth on an arrow, then light it with a tinderbox (or use the arrow on the ground fire).

atoms.label: Shoot the lit arrow at the bridge's guide rope
atoms.detail: Equip a bow first and pick up any dropped items beforehand -- nothing can be recovered once you're across unless you pull the lever to return.

atoms.label: Grab the plank in the room north of the bridge
atoms.detail: Skip if already carrying a plank from earlier.

atoms.label: Use a rope on the rock above the pit to cross it
atoms.detail: Failing the crossing loses the rope.

atoms.label: Cross the tile grid by trial and error
atoms.detail: Keep Hitpoints above 15 while crossing; some tiles collapse and some paths are dead ends.

atoms.label: Pull the lever next to the gate
atoms.detail: Opens the way into the next area; also the point where you could pull it again to retreat across the bridge.

atoms.label: Activate Rapid Heal at the nearby altar
atoms.detail: Optional but recommended before the trap corridor ahead.

atoms.label: Pass west through the zombie-camp corridor
atoms.detail: Attempt to disable or walk past the five sets of wall traps marked along the corridor.

atoms.label: Pick up the plank by the furnace
atoms.detail: Skip if already carrying one.

atoms.label: Take the first light orb via the north path
atoms.detail: Use the plank on the flat rocks to reach it.

atoms.label: Take the second light orb via the north-west path
atoms.detail: Path is guarded by ogres and blessed spiders.

atoms.label: Take the third light orb via the centre-west path
atoms.detail: Use the plank on the flat rocks again to reach it.

atoms.label: Disarm the trap and search the rock for the fourth light orb
atoms.detail: Do not pick up the orb directly on this path -- search the rock beneath it instead.

atoms.label: Fuel the furnace with all four light orbs
atoms.detail: Return east to the zombie camp furnace first.

atoms.label: Turn off Rapid Heal and climb down the well
atoms.detail: Return to the altar before descending.

atoms.label: Search the two stacked crates for food
atoms.detail: Optional: yields 2 salmon and 2 meat pies.

atoms.label: Picklock the south-east slave cage gate
atoms.detail: Opens the route west toward the obstacle maze.

atoms.label: Dig the loose mud with a spade
atoms.detail: Marked as point 2 on the guide map.

atoms.label: Cross the ledge
atoms.detail: Marked as point 3; you may fall and need to retry from the slave cage.

atoms.label: Take the 50-Thieving shortcut, or cross the stone bridge maze without it
atoms.detail: Shortcut is point 5 (avoid the bubbles); the stone bridge maze at point 4 is the non-Thieving alternative.

hints.value: stone bridge maze at point 4 if under 50 Thieving

atoms.label: Squeeze through the pipe
atoms.detail: Marked as point 6 on the guide map.

atoms.label: Search the unicorn cage, then use a railing piece on the boulder above it
atoms.detail: The railing piece can be dropped after this step.

atoms.label: Search the cage again to take the unicorn horn
atoms.detail: The railing piece can be dropped once the horn is retrieved.

atoms.label: Follow the tunnel to the three knights guarding the well
atoms.detail: Zone transition through the cave passage.

atoms.label: Kill the three knights guarding the well
atoms.detail: Safespottable from the hallway to the south; optional dialogue with any of them before the fight yields food and potions.

atoms.detail: Also yields 2 meat pies and a meat pizza; declining Kamen's beer instead costs 75 coins for food, accepting costs 5 damage and -3 Agility.

Open the chest inside the witch's house for loot

Open the chest north of the middle demon
Use a bucket on the brew barrel in the eastern dwarf house

atoms.label: Use the dwarf brew and a tinderbox on the tomb in the south-east corner

Return to Ardougne Castle
Talk to King Lathas to complete the quest

atoms.detail: Not the waterfall cave -- the tomb entrance itself.

atoms.detail: He explains he was cursed after Rennard stole the Staff of Armadyl he was delivering to Entrana; he gives a Ghostly robe (top) and a location hint that reveals which of the three ghost sequences to follow.

atoms.label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 1: the Chaos Temple (hut) altar in level 38 Wilderness, north of the Forgotten Cemetery. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 1: Entrana church -- Morytania legs cannot be used here since they're banned on Entrana. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 1: Wizards' Tower, ground floor. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Viggora to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 1: Rogues' Castle, upper floor, small easternmost room with a bronze sq shield spawn, level 52-56 Wilderness. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Rennard to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 2: the Bandit Camp (Wilderness) near the shops -- lure interrupting bandits into the nearby food store and shut the door if needed. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece

atoms.label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 2: Port Sarim docks at the Lady Lumbridge, second-southmost dock. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 2: Edgeville Monastery, upstairs by the altar (requires Prayer 31). Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Viggora to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece

atoms.label: Talk to Rennard to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 3: the Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert), in the bar on the western side. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 3: the end of the Lava Maze inside the second fenced-in area -- bring a slash weapon or knife to cut through the webs. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
atoms.detail: Sequence 3: west side of Tree Gnome Stronghold, south of the Gnome Ball Field along the fence. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

atoms.label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece

Talk to the crew in the required order
Search the ship for hidden symbols
Arrive on Lunar Isle and brew the waking-sleep potion
Charge the Dramen staff into a Lunar staff
Craft the ceremonial lunar gear and ring

atoms.label: Talk to Lokar Searunner at the westernmost Rellekka docks
atoms.detail: He's found near the closest fairy ring; ask about traveling to Lunar Isle.

atoms.label: Ask Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage
atoms.detail: Request the seal needed to travel to and remain on Lunar Isle.

atoms.label: Return to Lokar Searunner now that you have the seal of passage
atoms.detail: Report back to board the ship.

atoms.label: Board the pirate ship and ask Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle
atoms.detail: Climb the ladders to board, then request passage to Lunar Isle.

atoms.label: Speak to Captain Bentley again
atoms.detail: Continue the conversation about departure.

atoms.label: Climb down the south stairs through the door and talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack
atoms.detail: Meet the ship's navigator below decks.

atoms.label: Climb back up and talk to Captain Bentley again
atoms.detail: Raise the possibility that the navigator is at fault for the delay.

atoms.label: Return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack below decks
atoms.detail: Follow up with the navigator a second time.

atoms.label: Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front (north end) of the ship
atoms.detail: Must be spoken to first in the fixed crew order.

atoms.label: Talk to the Cabin boy one deck up from the captain (south)
atoms.detail: Second crew member in the required order.

atoms.label: Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship
atoms.detail: Third crew member in the order; found belowdecks near the cook.

atoms.label: Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee at the very top-rear of the ship
atoms.detail: Fourth crew member in the order.

atoms.label: Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy' on the deck level, south room
atoms.detail: Fifth and final crew member in the order.

atoms.label: Climb back up and talk to the Cabin boy again
atoms.detail: Requires 2 free inventory spaces; this is where the emerald lens and lantern items for the clue hunt come from.

atoms.label: Prepare an emerald-lens lantern and light it
atoms.detail: Use the emerald lens on your lit bullseye lantern, or make lamp oil and add it to the Cabin boy's spare unlit lantern (or use a Tears of Guthix sapphire lantern) if you didn't bring a lightable one; light it with a tinderbox.

hints.value: If you lose the emerald lens, the Cabin boy will give you another.

atoms.label: Use the lit lantern on the ship's 5 hidden-symbol spots and rub away each symbol
atoms.detail: Search the eastern cannon (same level as the Cabin boy), the wallchart in the southern room down the stairs, the northern chest and the support pillar on the lowest level, and the crate directly east of the cooking range.

atoms.label: Report the findings to Captain Bentley
Climb down the ladders into the Lunar Isle city
atoms.detail: Triggers a short cutscene on arrival.

atoms.label: Head to the south-east of the island and talk to the Oneiromancer
Kill Suqah (safespottable, level 111) until a suqah tooth drops
atoms.detail: Also keep any suqah hides received as drops -- 4 total are needed later in the quest.

atoms.label: Enter the chicken house in the north of the city and talk to Baba Yaga
atoms.detail: Requires 1 free inventory space.

atoms.label: Use an empty vial on a nearby water source outside the chicken house
Add a guam leaf and a marrentill to the vial
atoms.detail: Ironmen can repeat this vial-making loop for Herblore XP if surplus guam/marrentill need using up.

atoms.label: Grind the suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion
Return to the Oneiromancer with the finished potion
Charge the Dramen staff at the Air Altar south of Falador
atoms.detail: Must be done first, in order.

atoms.label: Charge the staff at the Fire Altar (north of Al Kharid, Emir's Arena)
atoms.detail: Second altar, in order.

atoms.label: Charge the staff at the Water Altar in Lumbridge Swamp
atoms.detail: Third altar, in order.

atoms.label: Charge the staff at the Earth Altar north-east of Varrock
atoms.detail: Fourth and final altar; completes the Lunar staff.

atoms.label: Travel back to Lunar Isle and give the Lunar staff to the Oneiromancer
atoms.detail: Bring the seal of passage -- it's required to stay on the isle.

atoms.label: Climb down the ladder to the Lunar Mine in the north-east of the isle
Mine stalagmites for lunar ore (1 now, 3 extra for a later quest)
atoms.detail: Grabbing the extra ore now saves a return trip during The Fremennik Exiles.

atoms.label: Smelt the lunar ore into a lunar bar at a furnace, or superheat it
atoms.detail: The closest furnace and anvil are in Rellekka.

atoms.label: With a hammer, use the lunar bar on an anvil to smith the lunar helm
Return to Lunar Isle
In the north-west of the city, talk to Pauline Polaris and guess her real name
atoms.detail: Requires 1 free inventory space. Chat options appear in a random order; the first guess must be 'Pauline', then pick the option naming 'Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid'.

atoms.label: In the south of the city, talk to Meteora
Kill more Suqah until a special tiara drops
atoms.detail: Also keep up to 4 hides from these Suqah -- at least 4 total are needed for the ceremonial clothes.

atoms.label: Give Meteora the special tiara
South of the bank, talk to Rimae Sirsalis about the ceremonial clothes
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again to have her tan your 4 suqah hides
Craft a Lunar torso, trousers, gloves and boots from the tanned hides
In the centre of the city, talk to Selene about a ring
Dig up the westernmost blue flowers past the two bridges south-west of the city

atoms.label: Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear; she hands it straight back
atoms.detail: Requires 11 free inventory spaces (8 for the lunar gear plus 3 others) or you cannot continue.

hints.value: page states '8 for your lunar gear' but only 6 named pieces (helm/torso/trousers/gloves/boots/ring) appear in the fetched text -- the other 2 are not itemized here

atoms.label: Use the waking-sleep potion on the kindling you were given
Gather combat supplies and wear all 8 pieces of lunar gear
atoms.detail: Keep the seal of passage in your inventory -- do not bank it. 4 free inventory spaces are required.

atoms.label: Enter the building with the ceremonial brazier on the village's west side
atoms.detail: It also has a staircase inside.

atoms.label: Light the ceremonial brazier, then use the soaked kindling on it
Talk to the Ethereal Being to begin the dream trials

hints.value: Logging out mid-dream requires re-visiting the Oneiromancer for a fresh waking-sleep potion and kindling.

atoms.label: Step onto the south-western yellow platform
Talk to Ethereal Fluke to start the dice puzzle
Roll dice to match each called number, 5-6 correct answers needed
atoms.detail: Roll only the dice showing numbers not already covered by a valid combination that sums to the called number.

hints.value: Number-to-dice-combination reference is a table on the cited page, not reproduced here (own-words rule).

atoms.label: After being teleported back, talk to the Ethereal Being
Step onto the south-eastern purple platform
Talk to Ethereal Numerator to start the number-sequence puzzle
Click the numbers that continue each pattern until teleported back

hints.value: Pattern-to-answer reference is a table on the cited page, not reproduced here.

Step onto the north-eastern blue platform
Talk to Ethereal Perceptive and agree to start the logging race

atoms.detail: Pick up any dropped items before handing in the last log, or you'll be teleported away without time to grab them.

Step onto the north-western grey platform
Talk to Ethereal Guide to start the Dream Puffs maze
Cross the chasm on the correct sequence of Dream Puffs stepping stones

Step onto the eastern grey platform
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the hurdle race
Run with the run toggle on and jump each hurdle without failing 3 times

Talk to Ethereal Mimic and agree to play

atoms.label: Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle
Talk to the Oneiromancer with the seal of passage on you to finish the quest
atoms.detail: The seal can be equipped or just carried in the inventory.

hints.value: Knights despawn if a fight drags on too long; logging out/in or teleporting away resumes at the knight that killed you, but leaving through the door resets progress to wave 1.

A flinch-behind-the-training-dummy method (draw the knight to the north-east corner, then west of a dummy, duck between dummies) avoids nearly all retaliation; a dragon dagger special can speed up each flinch kill.

atoms.detail: He gives a small fishing net and asks you to view it in your inventory before catching shrimp at the nearby pond.

atoms.detail: Chop any nearby tree for logs, use the tinderbox on the logs to light a fire, then use the raw shrimp on the fire to cook it.

atoms.detail: He gives a pot of flour and a bucket of water and asks you to make some bread.

atoms.label: Talk to the Quest Guide and open the Quest List
atoms.detail: He asks you to open the Quest List interface.

atoms.label: Talk to the Quest Guide again for a questing overview

atoms.detail: Mine the tin rocks to the west and the copper rocks to the east until you have one of each ore.

atoms.detail: Use one of the ores on the furnace to the south, or simply left-click the furnace, to smelt a bronze bar.

atoms.label: Open the Combat Options interface
atoms.detail: Click the crossed-swords icon to view the different attack styles available with your weapon.
