atoms.label: Talk to the Combat Instructor for a bow
atoms.detail: He gives a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows.

atoms.label: Equip the shortbow and bronze arrows
atoms.detail: Equip both the bow and the arrows.

atoms.label: Kill a giant rat outside the pen
atoms.detail: Kill another giant rat from outside the pen using the newly-equipped ranged gear.

atoms.detail: He asks you to open the Account Management interface (the face-with-a-cog icon).

atoms.detail: He asks you to open the Prayer interface (the star icon).

atoms.label: Talk to Mosol Rei outside Shilo Village
atoms.detail: With one free inventory space, speak to Mosol Rei outside Shilo Village and agree to take the wampum belt to Trufitus.

hints.value: Why do I need to run? / Rashiliyia? Who is she? / What can we do? / I'll go to see the Shaman / Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.

atoms.label: Use the wampum belt on Trufitus
atoms.detail: Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the north-easternmost house in Tai Bwo Wannai, to officially start the quest.

atoms.label: Agree to search for Ah Za Rhoon
atoms.detail: Follow Trufitus's dialogue chain and agree to search for the temple of Ah Za Rhoon.

hints.value: Mosol Rei said something about a legend? / Do you know anything more about the temple? / Tell me more. / I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon! / Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.

atoms.label: Travel to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon
atoms.detail: Head to the temple south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village, across the River Amja, via gnome glider, fairy ring DKP, or on foot across the log then south to the earth mound.

atoms.label: Dig the mound of earth with a spade
atoms.detail: Use your spade on the mound of earth to reveal a fissure.

atoms.label: Light the fissure with a torch or candle
atoms.detail: Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure to burn away the gas blocking it.

atoms.label: Use a rope on the fissure
atoms.detail: Use your rope on the fissure to rig a way down — the rope is lost in the process.

atoms.label: Climb down the fissure
atoms.detail: Search the fissure to climb down into the temple, then follow the cave south to the stream.

atoms.label: Chisel the stream-side stone for a stone-plaque
atoms.detail: Use your chisel on the stone by the stream to get a stone-plaque, then read it.

atoms.label: Search the cave-in to enter a new cave
atoms.detail: Search the cave-in to wriggle through into a new cave area.

hints.value: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

atoms.label: Search the loose rocks for a tattered scroll
atoms.detail: Search the loose rocks to find a tattered scroll, then read it.

hints.value: Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.

atoms.label: Search the sacks for a crumpled scroll
atoms.detail: Search the sacks to find a crumpled scroll, then read it.

atoms.label: Search the ancient gallows for the Zadimus corpse
atoms.detail: Search the ancient gallows to retrieve the Zadimus corpse.

hints.value: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

atoms.label: Leave the temple
atoms.detail: Teleport out, or head back through the cave-in to the first area and leave via the broken table rebuilt into a raft, or by searching the rocks (risks heavy damage on a failed search).

atoms.label: Give the collected temple items to Trufitus
atoms.detail: Return to Trufitus and use the items collected inside the temple on him one by one (stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, plus one more the guide does not enumerate -> ??).

atoms.label: Bury the Zadimus corpse at the Tribal Statue
atoms.detail: Head west to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus's hut and bury the Zadimus corpse there; a bone shard appears afterward.

atoms.label: Use the bone shard on Trufitus
atoms.detail: Use the bone shard on Trufitus and follow his dialogue about the spirit's warning of keys and kin.

hints.value: It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse / He said something after he gave it to me. / The spirit said something about keys and kin?

atoms.label: Travel to Cairn Isle
atoms.detail: With bronze wire and a chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle (west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR) and climb the rocks then cross the bridge.

atoms.label: Search the well stacked rocks and enter the crevice
atoms.detail: Search the well stacked rocks on the island's north side, then enter the crevice (failing here means the temple scrolls weren't read).

atoms.label: Search the tomb dolmen for the locating crystal
atoms.detail: With at least 3 empty inventory spaces, search the dolmen for notes and a locating crystal; with no space you'll need to return with charcoal and papyrus instead.

hints.value: Do not drop the locating crystal — you take 5-10 damage if you do.

atoms.label: Chisel the sword pommel
atoms.detail: Use your chisel on the sword pommel found in the tomb.

atoms.label: String the bone beads with bronze wire
atoms.detail: Use bronze wire on the bone beads found in the tomb.

atoms.label: Leave the Tomb of Bervirius
atoms.detail: Teleport out, or climb the nearby rockslide to escape (may deal up to 10 damage on a failed attempt).

atoms.label: Travel to Rashiliyia's Tomb
atoms.detail: With three regular bones, the bone shard and a chisel, head south-east from fairy ring DKP to the tomb entrance.

atoms.label: Search the bright green palm tree from the north side
atoms.detail: Search the unique bright green palm tree from its north side to reveal two carved doors.

atoms.label: Search the doors to find the keyhole
atoms.detail: Search the carved doors to locate the keyhole.

atoms.label: Chisel the bone shard into a bone key
atoms.detail: Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.

atoms.label: Equip the Beads of the dead
atoms.detail: Equip the Beads of the dead necklace before opening the ancient gate.

atoms.label: Unlock the doors with the bone key and open the gate
atoms.detail: Use the bone key on the carved doors, then open the ancient gate while wearing the Beads of the dead, and climb down the rocks.

atoms.label: Navigate to the inner doors
atoms.detail: Run west, then south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.

atoms.label: Use 3 regular bones on the tomb doors
atoms.detail: Use (do not bury) 3 regular bones on the tomb doors to unlock them; kill skeletons, not zombies, if you need more bones.

atoms.label: Search the tomb dolmen to summon Nazastarool
atoms.detail: Search the dolmen beyond the doors to begin the fight against Nazastarool.

atoms.label: Defeat Nazastarool through all three forms
atoms.detail: Fight Nazastarool through her three forms; Crumble Undead alongside Protect from Melee is effective, and standing behind the dolmen can safespot her. If you click away from the end-of-form dialogue, click the dolmen again to resume.

atoms.label: Take the Rashiliyia corpse
atoms.detail: Take the Rashiliyia corpse once she is defeated.

hints.value: Leaving the way you came locks the door and Rashiliyia summons three Undead ones — leave via the bone key on the doors instead.

atoms.label: Return to Cairn Isle
atoms.detail: Head back to Cairn Isle via fairy ring CKR.

atoms.label: Go through the well-stacked rocks
atoms.detail: Pass back through the well-stacked rocks to reach the tomb dolmen there.

atoms.label: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the dolmen
atoms.detail: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the dolmen to finish the quest.

notes: Map pins (surface plane) are from the {{Map}} block in s3 'Starting out': Start point, Ah Za Rhoon, Tomb of Bervirius, Rashiliyia's Tomb, Trufitus — reused on later travel atoms to the same locations. The 4th item given to Trufitus after the temple (idx14) is not enumerated by the guide text -> item:??. Quick-guide subsections (s3-s7) are NOT nested/duplicated in their parent Walkthrough heading (s2 is a bare 16B header) so each was fetched individually.

proposed_row.label: Fish trout/salmon at Barbarian Village
proposed_row.detail: Bait- or lure-fish the spots east of Barbarian Village for a light, self-caught food supply to feed the barbarian melee-training loop -- earliest-in-position of the 3 food consumers in this route window, so this grounds the cheapest gather rather than an unspecified restock.

mapMarkers.label: Barbarian Village centre -- fishing spots sit east of here, exact tile not pinned on the page

notes: food has no producer row (opp-surface source_step=null); grounded only the earliest-in-position consumer's own source, Barbarian Village's fishing spots (bait 20 / feathers 25 Fishing, per the page's own Skill training spots section) since ctr-05-kill-barbarians (atk/str/def 20->30) sits well before ctr-07a/ctr-07b (40->50, confirmed via classify:s3 not containing ctr-05 while classify:s4 contains both later bands, so ctr-05 must be earlier than index 105). The other 2 consumers (Hosidius sand crabs, Burthorpe slayer) each have their own more-convenient local food sources not modeled in this pass -- flagged as a widening candidate for a future zone pass rather than guessed here. Exact fishing-spot tile is not pinned on the Barbarian Village page (only 'east of the village' prose) -- left as an approximate zone anchor at the village centre coord, not a fabricated tile.

proposed_row.label: Fill a compost bin at the Falador allotment
proposed_row.detail: Put 15 weeds (or other suitable produce) plus 15 empty buckets into the compost bin beside the Falador cabbage patch and wait ~60 minutes for it to rot into 15 buckets of compost -- the wiki's own ironman-focused note names this exact patch as a free, no-purchase compost source, matching the gather/produce-not-buy convention used across this pipeline.

mapMarkers.label: Falador herb patch (compost bin sits at the adjacent cabbage allotment, exact bin tile not pinned on the page)

notes: compost has no producer row (opp-surface source_step=null); Compost's own page explicitly separates buying-from-farming-shops from a free self-source ("Ironmen wishing to create their own compost rather than buy it can use the cabbages south of the Falador allotment, the potatoes west of the Ardougne allotment, or the wheat north-east of the Catherby allotment") -- modeled the compost-bin self-production recipe (15 weeds/produce + 15 buckets -> 15 compost, Farming 1, Recipe section) rather than the farming-shop purchase, consistent with the gather/produce-never-buy hard rule even though a non-GE shop purchase would technically also satisfy it. trigger.zones lists the 3 wiki-named ironman-source patches (Falador/Ardougne/Catherby) plus Hosidius, inferred from farm-herb-patch-guam's own 4-zone mapMarkers list (a compost bin plausibly sits at every herb-patch cluster) but not independently confirmed on the Compost page itself -- flagged as an inference, not a fetch-confirmed 4th zone.

cook-monkfish already exists as a producer row (kind=produce, location.zone=catherby) -- this pass only grounds the pin and verifies route-order. Catherby's own page confirms 'A range for Cooking, conveniently located on the way to the bank from the Fishing spots' but gives no exact range tile, so the pin stays the town-centre coord (2814,3443) with the range itself left '??' rather than guessed. Route-order check against oppgran:classify:s4: cook-monkfish is listed well before milestone-barrows (which the opp-surface row's consumer id 'barrows' resolves to -- milestone-barrows is the only barrows-named step_id in the classified slices), confirming this edge is genuinely in-position, unlike the excluded raw_monkfish->cook-monkfish edge (gather-monkfish is listed AFTER cook-monkfish in the same slice, the known fault this pass deliberately does not touch). Only the cook-monkfish->milestone-barrows edge is grounded here; raw_monkfish sourcing stays out of scope per the depth-queue's exclusion list.

brew-prayer-potion already exists as a producer row; its location.zone=null is a genuine non-gate, not a gap -- mixing a Herblore potion needs no facility (bank/altar/range), only ingredients in inventory and quest-druidic-ritual + Herblore 52 (both already in the held row's reqs/quest_gate), so trigger.zones is honestly 'global' rather than '??'. Resolved the rank-4 depth-queue caveat ('verify this precedes actual barrows-run consumption, not just the milestone announcement') by reading oppgran:classify:s4's own listed order directly: brew-prayer-potion is the step immediately following milestone-barrows in the classified sequence, i.e. potions are stocked right as the Barrows content the milestone introduces begins, not merely at an unrelated announcement point -- IN-POSITION, confirmed from route-order data rather than assumed. refs reused verbatim from the held brew-prayer-potion row; both slugs re-confirmed present in manifest.jsonl (Prayer_potion.s2, Ranarr_potion_(unf).s1) before citing, no new fetch needed.

proposed_row.label: Pickpocket Master Farmer at Draynor Village for guam seed
proposed_row.detail: Pickpocket the Draynor Village Master Farmer until the herb-seed drop table rolls a guam seed -- the item's own page names monsters/seed-packs/master-farmers as its non-GE sources, and Master Farmer is the only one of those that's a repeatable, player-controlled action rather than a random drop.

hints.value: 485/1000 chance to roll the Allotment table is NOT this table -- guam is on the separate 48/1000 Herbs table, then 1/58.36 (or 1/67.2 below Farming 85) within it
hints.note: Master_Farmer Loot section, Herbs subtable; low overall hit rate, this is a background/opportunistic pickpocket target, not a dedicated farming loop.

notes: guam_seed has no producer row; Draynor Village chosen as the earliest-in-position of the Master Farmer's 5 core-region spawns (Draynor/S.Varrock/N.E.Ardougne/Farming Guild/Hosidius per the NPC's own Infobox locations, the 3 newest Varlamore spawns excluded as a later-region tie) since it sits nearest Lumbridge/early progression. SHARED-SOURCE TIE: this is the exact same NPC/action as oppgran:opp:seeds@draynor-village (rank 6) -- one pickpocket loop feeds both shortlisted items via two different sub-tables (Herbs vs Allotments) on the same drop roll, worth weaving as one background task rather than two in wave 4.

proposed_row.label: Pickpocket Master Farmer at Draynor Village for allotment seeds
proposed_row.detail: Pickpocket the Draynor Village Master Farmer for potato/onion/cabbage seed (the Allotment sub-table) -- covers the generic 'seeds' item bg-farm-allotment's own detail names (potato, onion, or cabbage), same NPC and action as the guam_seed opportunity, different sub-roll of the same drop table.

hints.value: 485/1000 to roll the Allotment table, then potato 1/5.65, onion 1/7.53, cabbage 1/14.4 within it
hints.note: Master_Farmer Loot section, Allotments subtable -- the 3 items bg-farm-allotment's own detail names by species.

notes: seeds has no producer row; same grounding and zone list as oppgran:opp:guam_seed@draynor-village (rank 5) -- SHARED-SOURCE TIE, one Master Farmer pickpocket loop at Draynor Village feeds both shortlisted items (potato/onion/cabbage seed on the Allotment sub-table, guam seed on the separate Herbs sub-table of the same drop roll). Worth wave-4 weaving as a single background pickpocket task rather than two.

proposed_row.label: Craft nature runes at the Nature Altar (Runecraft 44)
proposed_row.detail: Use pure essence on the Nature Altar north of Shilo Village to craft nature runes for self-supplying the High Alchemy embed while training Smithing -- the repeatable, non-GE production route (own-craft rather than a magic-shop purchase), matching the pipeline's gather/produce framing for High-Alch-fodder ties already logged for other train bands.

hints.value: 1 rune/essence below Runecraft 91, 2 runes/essence at 91+
hints.note: Nature_rune Runecraft-info Recipe tabber, pure essence tab.

mapMarkers.label: Nature Altar entrance ruins, north of Shilo Village (surface)

notes: nature_rune has no producer row. Resolved the rank-7 depth-queue flag ('embed-alch-smithing not located in any wave-1 classified slice -- may be outside the 205-step classified range, needs a locate pass') by reading the step's own row in steps.jsonl directly: it carries slot={type:passive, embeds_into:[smithing]} and is explicitly 'Never its own step; badges onto whichever smithing step is active' -- by design it has no standalone route index, so its absence from all 4 classify:s1-s4 slices is expected, not a gap or an out-of-range miss. Modeled the sustainable Runecraft-44 Nature Altar production route as the primary non-GE source (Nature_rune's own Obtaining section also lists lower-level alternatives -- Dark wizard kills (no level req, rare 4-rune drop), Wilderness/Rellekka island telegrab spawns, and Ardougne/Rellekka locked-chest theft (Thieving 28) -- noted here as earlier-accessible fallbacks but not modeled as the primary row, since embed-alch-smithing's own Magic-55 gate implies a mid-game player who can realistically reach Runecraft 44 for a repeatable supply rather than depending on rare drops.

checkpoints.label: Track the necklace to Jasper the salvager
Gather fire supplies and light Bernard's fire
Interpret for Bernina and Bernard's reconciliation
Climb to the peak and finish

atoms.label: Equip a ghostspeak amulet
atoms.detail: Wear a ghostspeak amulet before approaching Bernina so her ghostly speech can be understood; stays equipped for every later ghost conversation in this miniquest.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost Bernina near the Auburn Valley road
atoms.detail: Bernina reveals she died in the wreck that gave Shipwreck Cove its name, and that salvagers stole her diamond necklace from the wreckage, keeping her from resting; she asks for it to be tracked down.

atoms.label: Talk to Jasper at Salvager Overlook
atoms.detail: Head east to the Salvager Overlook and speak to Jasper inside the north-east building; he explains the necklace brought him bad luck so he sold it on to a mountain climber.

atoms.label: Collect logs and a tinderbox from the houses south of Jasper
atoms.detail: The houses just south of Jasper's building contain a set of logs and a tinderbox, needed to light a fire for the mountain climber ahead.

atoms.label: Climb the Proudspire to find Bernard
atoms.detail: Head south then west to the base of the Proudspire and climb until a man named Bernard is found; he mentions his run of bad luck and asks for a fire to be lit.

atoms.label: Light a fire for Bernard
atoms.detail: Use the logs and tinderbox while standing next to Bernard; once lit, he reveals he is carrying a diamond necklace up the mountain to honour his late mother, who turns out to be Bernina.

atoms.label: Return to Bernina and relay what Bernard said
atoms.detail: Tell Bernina her son Bernard is carrying her necklace up the Proudspire in her memory; she vanishes from her spot and reappears beside Bernard at the summit.

atoms.label: Return to Bernard on the Proudspire
atoms.detail: Bernard is unnerved by the ghost's sudden appearance; speak with him to act as a ghost interpreter so Bernina can finally speak with her son.

atoms.label: Climb to the peak obelisk
atoms.detail: Continue climbing past Bernard toward the very top of the Proudspire; carrying on upward is faster than backtracking down to the agility shortcut.

atoms.label: Speak to Bernard at the peak obelisk to finish
atoms.detail: Talk to Bernard in front of the obelisk atop the Proudspire to complete the miniquest.

notes: No /Quick guide subpage exists for this miniquest (404) -- fell back to the main page's Walkthrough (Spirit_of_Adventure.s2) per KNOWN TRAPS. Zero {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} templates anywhere in the fetched text -- coords[] empty for every atom, a fetch-confirmed gap not a shortfall. Recently-released (23 Jul 2025) miniquest, no combat/no item or xp reward beyond quest completion.

checkpoints.label: Reach Darkmeyer and defend Ivan's escape
Recover Ivandis' writings and mine the tunnel
Solve the crescent moon key puzzle
Solve the new moon key puzzle
Solve the full moon key puzzle
Race Drakan to collect keys and the old cog
Fight through Drakan's woods to the serpent-rope crossing
Forge the hallowed flail and gear up for the siege
Defend the siege and push Drakan to 58%
Defeat Drakan in the final battle and finish the quest

atoms.label: Travel to the Icyene Graveyard
atoms.detail: Reach the graveyard via the boat from southern Burgh de Rott, Meiyerditch, or Slepe, or teleport with Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza and run to the south-western boat.

atoms.label: Talk to Sarius Guile
atoms.detail: Agree to proceed; bring 40,000 coins along if the blisterwood flail has not already been bought.

atoms.label: Reach the hideout and gear up in a vyre noble outfit
atoms.detail: Head to the hideout under Old Man Ral's house in Meiyerditch, search the nearby chest for a vyre noble outfit if one isn't already held, wear it, then inspect the makeshift shrine to trigger a cutscene.

coords.label: Hideout under Old Man Ral's house, Meiyerditch

atoms.label: Talk to Ivan Strom about heading to Darkmeyer
atoms.detail: Agree to travel to Darkmeyer with Ivan.

atoms.label: Defend Ivan through the vyrewatch ambush
atoms.detail: A multi-minute endurance fight: pray Protect from Melee and attack the vyrewatch to keep them off Ivan, heal him with food when low, and kill acidic bloodveld before they reach him; a magic vyrewatch sentinel joins partway through, with two more spawning later.

atoms.label: Talk to Ivan afterward
atoms.detail: Ivan tells the player to meet up at the church in Slepe.

atoms.label: Travel to Slepe and talk to Ivan Strom
atoms.detail: Reach Slepe via Drakan's medallion or by teleporting to Ver Sinhaza and running north; find Ivan west of the church.

atoms.label: Ask the Slepe pub bartender Roy about a friend
atoms.detail: Enter the Slepe pub and ask bartender Roy about the group's missing friend.

atoms.label: Reach Crombwick Manor through the Sisterhood Sanctuary
atoms.detail: Enter the Sisterhood Sanctuary through the stairs south of the church graveyard, head north to Kroy's laboratory, then climb the ladder into Crombwick Manor.

atoms.label: Help Veliaf fight off four vyrewatches
atoms.detail: Assist Veliaf Hurtz in killing four vyrewatches inside the manor, then talk to him.

atoms.label: Travel to Paterdomus and talk to Ivan
atoms.detail: Reach Drezel at Paterdomus Temple quickly via fairy ring code CKS, talk to Ivan, read the squire's journal, then talk to Ivan again.

atoms.label: Clear the monks of Zamorak in the mausoleum
atoms.detail: Head west through the mausoleum and up into the temple, killing every monk of Zamorak encountered along the way; lower-level players should carry stat restoration since the monks temporarily drain stats.

atoms.label: Search the bookcases for six named books
atoms.detail: Head upstairs, talk to Ivan, then search the bookcases for six named books needed for the plinth puzzle.

atoms.label: Place the six books on the plinths in order
atoms.detail: From north to south, set the plinths to Pious proceedings, The Life of Friar, Scruffy notebook, From Misthalin to Morytania, Sarl's journal, then Essiandar's notes.

atoms.label: Obtain and read Ivandis' writings from Ivan
atoms.detail: Talk to Ivan to receive Ivandis' writings, read it, then talk to him again to head back to the mausoleum.

atoms.label: Mine through the blockage south of Ivan
atoms.detail: Stock up on combat supplies, return to Paterdomus, talk to Ivan or Veliaf to proceed, then mine away the blockage immediately south of Ivan (ask Ivan for a bronze pickaxe if none is carried).

atoms.label: Fight through the tunnel's vyrewatches and sentinels
atoms.detail: Head north-east through the tunnel and clear the vyrewatches and vyrewatch sentinels inside, focusing sentinels first while praying Protect from Magic; lure vyrewatches into their blood orbs for bonus damage but stay at least two tiles from the orbs.

atoms.label: Unlock the Vampyrium teleport and enter the portal
atoms.detail: Talk to Ivan, head north then north-west up the stairs, then east to pray at the shrine to unlock a Drakan's medallion teleport here, and finally enter the portal at the room's centre.

atoms.label: Solve the clock puzzle for the first two Drakan emblems
atoms.detail: From the dining room, read the poem scroll to the south, pull the throne busts in order 3rd-4th-1st-2nd for the half moon key, collect a tinderbox and a Drakan emblem via searches along a trap-lined corridor loop, place the small clock hand on the western grandfather clock (big hand 11, small hand 9) and the large hand on the eastern clock (big hand 12, small hand 4), then search the fireplace for a second Drakan emblem.

atoms.label: Solve the crescent moon key puzzle
atoms.detail: Shuttle Drakan emblems between receptacles through a loop of rooms, blast a cracked wall open with an explosive barrel, deal with a venator, take an ornate skull from a table, then open the northern wall chest with the code right-down-right-left-left (read from the vampyre portraits on the southern plaque) for the crescent moon key.

atoms.label: Assemble a syringe for the left crest half
atoms.detail: In the laboratory, kill the sanguidae, then build a full syringe from a barrel, plunger and needle sourced from the sink, tap and a cabinet, use it on the venator corpse (cut open with a sharp knife), then use the full syringe on the chest to receive the left crest half.

atoms.label: Fight past the second venator for the right crest half
atoms.detail: Clear the venator in the south room (pray Protect from Melee or Missiles by range and drop it before its screech), arrange the weapon-rack statues symmetrically (battleaxes, spears, maces, swords east to west on both sides), search the chest for the right crest half, combine both halves, then use the full crest on the fireplace and search it for the new moon key.

atoms.label: Free Safalaan and Vanescula, then solve the lockbox and passcode door
atoms.detail: Trigger the cutscene that frees Safalaan and Vanescula and take the gibbous moon key, then work out the lockbox's three symbols (from the venator head's '426' hint against the room's banners, shields and braziers) for a fancy gem, and open a second door with the passcode SPEAR (read from the ancestral dagger's grid note).

atoms.label: Combine the gilded key puzzle items
atoms.detail: Find a second fancy gem inside a hidden book in a searchable bookcase, use both fancy gems on the mounted venator head for an ornate hourglass, then use the ornate skull, hourglass and knife (any order) on the display case and search it for the gilded key.

atoms.label: Solve the full moon key bookcase puzzle
atoms.detail: Fight past sanguidae and a venator, talk to Ivan, search the bookcases for a gilded book and a vampyre book, use the gilded book on the gilded bookcase, then rearrange the Vampyric House symbols into alphabetical order to open a secret passage and take the full moon key from the table inside.

atoms.label: Collect the four riddle potions and pour them by inscription
atoms.detail: Search the north-west shelves for one each of cloudy grey, weightless black, thick red, and cold bluish-white potions, then pour cloudy grey into the south-west basin, weightless black north-east, thick red north-west, and cold bluish-white south-east to match each basin's riddle inscription, revealing an ancient symbol on the altar.

atoms.label: Combine the shield and symbol for the solid key
atoms.detail: Continue through the portal room to a window crate holding an ancient shield, combine it with the ancient symbol, carry it through several more doors to the empty wall mount, and search the mount for the solid key.

atoms.label: Gather and refine chemical vials to 53 haemalchemic potential
atoms.detail: In the laboratory beyond the solid door, take two vials of water, three vials of blood, and three pure essence from the shelves, then refine them at the basin: blood plus essence twice for two 17HP vials, blood plus water for a 13HP vial, and essence plus water for a 6HP vial.

atoms.label: Destroy the blood stockpile
atoms.detail: Place all four refined vials on the basin until the panel reads 53 HP, then head through the newly unlocked north door and destroy the blood stockpile.

atoms.label: Unlock the crank building and find the dusty book
atoms.detail: Take the crank wheel from the small building three houses east of the prayer altar, operate the crank base outside the building to the north (Drakan begins chasing from this point) and spam-click it to unlock the door, then search the bookshelf inside for a dusty book and read it for the Vitur key.

atoms.label: Assemble the Myrmel key
atoms.detail: Find the passcode TOOLS on a shed for bolt cutters, take the tooth half of a key from the building east of the altar, use the bolt cutters on the chained doors south of the well for the loop half, then combine both halves into a Myrmel key.

atoms.label: Fetch water for the Shadum key
atoms.detail: Use the Myrmel key to enter the building north-east of the well, take the bucket in the back-left corner, fill it at the well, then use the bucket of water on the northern barrel inside to receive the Shadum key.

atoms.label: Open the bank gate and take the trapdoor key
atoms.detail: Use the Shadum key on the house south-west of the group for the trapdoor key, then spam-click the bank building's crank to open its gate and use the trapdoor to reach the altar house.

atoms.label: Take the old cog and race back to the group
atoms.detail: Open the chest west of the altar with the passcode 35158 for the Jovkai key, use it to enter the Jovkai door, and take the old cog from a crate inside; once this house is left, Drakan chases at running speed, so wait for distance before rushing back (re-entering resets progress on the cog).

atoms.label: Resupply and trigger the escape cutscene
atoms.detail: Grab supplies from Ivan if needed, then talk to Veliaf or Vanescula to start the escape cutscene.

atoms.label: Fight Drakan through the woods
atoms.detail: Drakan's spear lunges are telegraphed but need tick-perfect dodges; Vanescula and Veliaf assist without dealing much damage, and the tent nearby offers a resupply/respawn point.

atoms.label: Defeat the ancient feral vyres
atoms.detail: Kill two ancient feral vyres, switching targets when one swaps places with the other to heal it, then kill two more that spawn afterward.

atoms.label: Chop through the darkwood trees
atoms.detail: Fell the blocking darkwood trees by chopping each from two different sides (grab a bronze axe from a stump if unequipped, and remove any tick pests that crawl into the inventory) until reaching the area's north-east corner.

hints.value: no dedicated chop verb in the enum; mapped to gather (drops-as-gather framing)

atoms.label: Walk past the maxilla beasts
atoms.detail: Disable run and walk the marked path past the maxilla beasts to avoid their 30-50 damage hits, then head north through the cavern.

atoms.label: Clear the nyloca waves
atoms.detail: Defeat the nylocas spawning from both corners with the correct style (melee the white ones, ranged the green ones, or they explode if left too long); throwable spines litter the ground and can be harvested from the dead venator, then continue north through the darkwood trees.

atoms.label: Wrangle three blood serpents into a rope
atoms.detail: Approach each blood serpent from behind and wrangle it (approaching from the front causes a 5-poison-damage attack), combine all three into a serpent rope, then use the rope on the long branched tree to the south-east to proceed.

atoms.label: Talk to Efaritay and gather amitire leaves
atoms.detail: Talk to Efaritay, then leave the palace and pick amitire leaves from the plant east of the entrance.

atoms.label: Gather the stew ingredients
atoms.detail: Back inside the palace, fill a bowl with water from the shelves south of Efaritay, and take a potato and raw impaler meat from the western cupboard.

atoms.label: Cook the amitire stew
atoms.detail: Soak the potato in the bowl of water, cook the impaler meat and combine it into the incomplete stew, cook the stew, then add the amitire leaves to finish the amitire stew.

atoms.label: Feed the stew to Safalaan
atoms.detail: Talk to Efaritay, feed the amitire stew to Safalaan, then talk to Efaritay again repeatedly until she hands over some hallowed marks.

atoms.label: Gather the flail-crafting materials
atoms.detail: Free seven inventory spaces, take all three tools from the eastern workbench, gather blisterwood logs and a blessed silver sickle from nearby crates, and a diamond plus an enchant diamond tablet from the chests.

atoms.label: Forge the hallowed flail and blisterwood stakes
atoms.detail: Use the diamond, then the tablet, then the logs on the sickle in that order, forge the hallowed flail at the anvil (the blisterwood flail must remain in the inventory), then knife the remaining blisterwood logs into blisterwood stakes.

atoms.label: Report to the group before the siege
atoms.detail: Head downstairs to talk to Veliaf and Vanescula, talk to Veliaf again, then go back upstairs and talk to Sugadinti Vitur.

atoms.label: Gear up with siege potions
atoms.detail: Take roughly 15 rancid slimy potions, 5 foul chunky potions, and 1 rank frothy potion from the base supply table; rancid slimy potions barely drain stats so stacking them is an easy default.

atoms.label: Head out to the bridge
atoms.detail: Go outside onto the bridge to begin the defence encounter.

atoms.label: Defend the aranei from the portals with the ballista
atoms.detail: Man the ballista against the incoming portals; every shot one-shots a portal, but they eventually spawn faster than they can be downed.

atoms.label: Heal the aranei and repair the siege
atoms.detail: Survive the second defence phase by healing the aranei and repairing the damaged pillars and windows.

atoms.label: Fight Drakan to 58% health
atoms.detail: Fight Drakan again with the aranei and Efaritay assisting; watch for his new 2x3 cleave AoE alongside the spear lunges, use Efaritay's periodic heals and the supply table, and continue until he reaches roughly 58% health for a cutscene.

atoms.label: Regroup at Burgh de Rott and gear for the Theatre
atoms.detail: Finish the dialogue at Burgh de Rott after the cutscene, teleport to Ver Sinhaza with Drakan's medallion, and gear up with a strongest melee weapon plus a fast weapon per combat style.

atoms.label: Clear the Theatre wave encounter
atoms.detail: Talk to Sugadinti outside the notice board to begin the four-wave fight: nylocas (wave 1), the Maiden of Sugadinti (wave 2), a repeat of wave 1 (wave 3), then the Nylocas Vasilias (wave 4); full gear swaps aren't required but help against Vasilias.

atoms.label: Find Ivan and Veliaf near Burgh de Rott
atoms.detail: Gear up for a melee fight with the hallowed flail, then head to the ruined building north-east of Burgh de Rott to find Ivan and Veliaf.

coords.label: Ruined building NE of Burgh de Rott (Ivan and Veliaf)

atoms.label: Talk to Veliaf and enter
atoms.detail: Talk to Veliaf and enter the nearby entrance.

atoms.label: Defeat the wyrd
atoms.detail: Leave space behind you since every punch knocks the player back; the wyrd cycles two melee hits, a screech, two more melee hits, another screech (sometimes a bloody screech past 60% health), then a double slam, repeating until 10% health triggers a cutscene.

atoms.label: Follow the bloody trail and gear up
atoms.detail: Follow the bloody trail, inspect the broken fence, exit the Burgh de Rott hideout, and gear up at the bank for another fight with Drakan.

atoms.label: Push Drakan down to roughly 30% health
atoms.detail: Talk to Sugadinti or Ivan to start the fight; Efaritay and Ivan both heal periodically, the blood swipes now happen three times, and Drakan fires an extra orb after every special attack; re-enter through the castle gates to restart after a death or an early exit. Ends around 30% (900 HP).

atoms.label: Travel to Vampyrium for the final battle
atoms.detail: After the cutscene, talk to Ivan then Sugadinti, travel to the Icyene Graveyard, talk to Efaritay, and enter the portal to Vampyrium.

atoms.label: Gear up at the Vampyrium supply chest
atoms.detail: Restock at the supply chest on the north wall before starting the final fight.

atoms.label: Defeat Drakan's three-phase final battle
atoms.detail: Below 2,700 health Drakan adds a four-attack spear combo to his slam; phase 2 opens with blood waves mixed with magic attacks; phase 3 opens with spear dashes.

atoms.label: Finish the ending cutscene
atoms.detail: Watch the ending cutscene through after defeating Drakan to complete the quest.

notes: Grandmaster capstone -- 5 fetches (s2/s15/s16/s17/s18), all parent-pulled their nested children inline (s18 alone carried Night of the Blood Moon + The Blood Moon Falls too), well under budget. checkpoints.label: Get the sealed letter and fail the first exam
Find the ancient talisman and scout the winches
Brew the chemical compound and blast the chamber

atoms.label: Ask an examiner about taking an exam
atoms.detail: Visit the Exam Centre and ask an examiner about sitting an exam.

atoms.label: Talk to Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum
atoms.detail: Ask the curator for interesting news; he hands over a sealed letter for the Exam Centre.

atoms.label: Optionally steal a cup of tea from the tea stall
atoms.detail: A cup of tea is needed later for the panning guide; stealing one here also counts toward the Varrock easy diary.

hints.value: optional at this exact point -- Varrock easy diary requirement, but the cup is required later regardless

atoms.label: Return to an examiner for the first exam
atoms.detail: Hand over the sealed letter; the chat options do not matter here, the first exam always ends in an automatic fail.

atoms.label: Search the bush for a teddy bear
atoms.detail: North of the Exam Centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second bush east of the urn for a teddy bear.

coords.label: Hilltop with the blue urn, north of the Exam Centre

atoms.label: Take a panning tray
atoms.detail: Pick up a panning tray near the dig.

atoms.label: Use the cup of tea on the panning guide
atoms.detail: Show the panning guide a cup of tea to learn how to pan.

atoms.label: Pan for the Special cup and an opal
atoms.detail: Pan the water at the panning points until a Special cup (shown as "Shiny Cup" in the panning dialogue) turns up; keep panning for an opal too if one isn't already held for the second exam's student demand.

atoms.label: Pickpocket the workman for a skull and brush
atoms.detail: Steal from the nearby digsite workman repeatedly until an animal skull and a specimen brush are both obtained.

atoms.label: Give the teddy bear to the north-west student
atoms.detail: Run to the blonde, pigtailed student at the north-west end of the dig and hand over the teddy bear, talking to her twice.

atoms.label: Give the Special cup to the eastern student
atoms.detail: Run to the bearded student in a reddish-orange shirt to the east and hand over the Special cup, talking to him twice.

atoms.label: Give the animal skull to the southern student
atoms.detail: Run to the student in a green shirt to the south and hand over the animal skull, talking to him twice.

atoms.label: Sit the first Earth Sciences exam
atoms.detail: Answer the examiner's four questions to earn the Level 1 Certificate.

atoms.label: Update all three students after exam one
atoms.detail: Talk to each of the three students again to keep them progressing.

atoms.label: Sit the second Earth Sciences exam
atoms.detail: Answer the second set of examiner questions to earn the Level 2 Certificate.

atoms.label: Update the students again, giving the opal
atoms.detail: Talk to each of the three students again; the female student now demands an opal, so talk to her twice to hand it over.

atoms.label: Sit the third Earth Sciences exam
atoms.detail: Answer the final set of examiner questions to earn the Level 3 Certificate.

atoms.label: Hand in the certificates to the curator
atoms.detail: Give all three certificates to Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum for a reward item (a fruit blast, an Another Cook's Quest requirement, or a chocolate cake).

atoms.label: Get a rock pick and specimen jar
atoms.detail: In the Exam Centre's western room, search the north and south cupboards for a rock pick and a specimen jar.

atoms.label: Dig for an ancient talisman with the trowel
atoms.detail: Use the trowel on the soil of a level-3 digsite repeatedly until an ancient talisman turns up; this step is luck-based and can take several minutes.

atoms.label: Talk to Terry Balando
atoms.detail: Speak to Terry Balando in the exam centre about the discovery.

atoms.label: Use the invitation on a digsite workman
atoms.detail: Use the invitation on any digsite workman except the one stationed by the western winch.

atoms.label: Descend the western winch for arcenia root
atoms.detail: Use a rope on the western winch and climb down, take one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.

atoms.label: Descend the northern winch and talk to Doug Deeping
atoms.detail: Walk north-east to the northern winch, use a rope on it and climb down, then ask Doug Deeping about the rocks before climbing back up.

atoms.label: Unlock the southern chest for chemical powder
atoms.detail: At the tent south of the dig marked with an orange vial, unlock the chest with the chest key and search it for chemical powder.

atoms.label: Collect an unidentified liquid from the barrel
atoms.detail: Use the trowel on the closed barrel west of the tent, then use a vial on it to draw an unidentified liquid; if the vial is dropped it deals 25 non-fatal damage and breaks, requiring the barrel to be reopened for a fresh vial.

hints.value: dropping the filled vial deals 25 damage and destroys it -- re-collect from the barrel

atoms.label: Grind the charcoal
atoms.detail: Grind charcoal with a pestle and mortar (search the tray a few steps north if none is carried).

atoms.label: Mix the chemical compound
atoms.detail: Give Terry Balando the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid (right-click the liquid so it isn't emptied by mistake), mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together, then add the ground charcoal, then the arcenia root, to produce the chemical compound.

atoms.label: Blast open the bricks down the western winch
atoms.detail: Climb down the western winch, use the chemical compound on the bricks (not the rocks), then use a tinderbox on the bricks to blow them open.

atoms.label: Enter the chamber for the stone tablet
atoms.detail: Enter the newly opened chamber and take the stone tablet; low-level players should be cautious of level-22 skeletons inside.

atoms.label: Hand the tablet to Terry Balando to finish
atoms.detail: Give the stone tablet to Terry Balando to complete the quest.

checkpoints.label: Site: North of West Ardougne / South of Gnome Stronghold

atoms.label: Feel the Enchanted key to triangulate the treasure
atoms.detail: Clicking "Feel Enchanted key" gives a distance band (freezing through burning hot, based on Chebyshev distance ignoring obstacles) plus a warmer/colder/same-as-last-reading hint versus the previous feel; step in each direction and compare readings to triangulate north/south then east/west until the key reads "steaming" (within 4 squares), then dig with a spade.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure South of Rellekka
atoms.detail: Travel via fairy ring CJR or AJR, the enchanted lyre teleport, or the Rellekka house portal. This site is always the first one found for every player.

hints.value: always the first of the 11 sites found; the other 10 are visited in a random order per player

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure South of Ardougne
atoms.detail: Travel via fairy ring DJP, an Ardougne teleport tablet, the Ardougne cloak teleport to the Monastery, or charter ship to Port Khazard and walk north-west.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure North of West Ardougne / South of Gnome Stronghold
atoms.detail: Travel via the necklace of passage to the Outpost, an Ardougne teleport tablet, or the spirit tree to the Gnome Stronghold and walk south-west.

coords.label: North of West Ardougne / South of Gnome Stronghold

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Gnome Stronghold
atoms.detail: Travel via spirit tree teleport, the Gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw, or the Slayer ring.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Body Altar
atoms.detail: Travel via the combat bracelet, or teleport to Edgeville or Varrock and walk north-west of Barbarian Village.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Falador
atoms.detail: Travel via the ring of elements to the Air Altar, a Falador teleport tablet then the south-wall agility shortcut and east, or balloon to the Crafting Guild and walk north-east. This site holds the Saradomin mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Mudskipper Point
atoms.detail: Travel via fairy ring AIQ, or charter ship to Port Sarim and walk south to Mudskipper Point.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Lumbridge Swamp
atoms.detail: Travel via the ring of elements to the Water Altar, a home teleport or Lumbridge teleport, or a Draynor teleport and walk to the swamp. If a zombie head was stored in a POH or destroyed, that digs up first here -- dig again for the actual treasure.

hints.value: digging here may surface an unrelated zombie head first if one was ever stored in a POH or destroyed -- dig a second time for the treasure

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Al Kharid
atoms.detail: Travel via the ring of dueling to Emir's Arena, a home teleport, or the Gnome glider and walk to Al Kharid. This site holds the Zamorak mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure South-east Varrock mine
atoms.detail: Travel via the Chronicle, digsite pendant, a Varrock teleport tablet, the Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra, the digsite teleport, or a Senntisten teleport tablet. This site holds the Guthix mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

atoms.label: Dig up the treasure Grand Exchange
atoms.detail: Travel via a Varrock teleport tablet, fairy ring DKR, or an Edgeville teleport with an amulet of glory then the Grand Exchange agility shortcut or a walk around the wall. "Grand Exchange" here is the dig site's own area name, not an item-buying instruction.

hints.value: ge_violation false positive -- "Grand Exchange" is this site's location name on the wiki's own table, not a buy-from-GE recommendation, matching the fast-travel/location-tag non-violation taxonomy

notes: Repetition-never-unrolls does not fully apply here -- unlike a true RNG loop, all 11 sites are individually named with fixed coordinates and loot on the wiki's own Treasure locations table (s6), only the VISIT ORDER is randomized per player (site 1 is always South of Rellekka). Modelled all 11 as named atoms per the Natural History Quiz/named-repetition precedent, each flagged as reachable in any order after the first. The single Grand Exchange-named site is a location-tag false positive for the GE hard rule, not a buy recommendation. reqs.quests: quest-making-history already enforced by the held row.

checkpoints.label: Investigate the singing bowl and machine
Make magic glue and repair the machine
Hunt the six spy constructs and finish

atoms.label: Talk to Brimstail
atoms.detail: Find Brimstail in the cave in the south-west corner of the Gnome Stronghold and hear him out.

hints.value: optionally right-click teleport on Brimstail for an easy Western Provinces diary tick

atoms.label: Inspect the singing bowl
atoms.detail: Inspect the singing bowl in the western part of the cave.

atoms.label: Attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine
atoms.detail: Head north and attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine; it can't be opened yet, setting up the repair ahead.

atoms.label: Report back to Brimstail
atoms.detail: Talk to Brimstail about the machine and the other room.

atoms.label: Talk to Hazelmere for the flashback
atoms.detail: Find Hazelmere upstairs in his house on the small island east of Yanille (fairy ring code CLS, the Nightmare Zone teleport, or the Watchtower teleport go directly there); sit through several cutscenes ending with King Healthorg and the white Spirit Tree Argento, finishing when a violet pentagon appears in the backpack.

atoms.label: Report the flashback to Brimstail
atoms.detail: Return to Brimstail and tell him what Hazelmere revealed.

atoms.label: Collect a bucket of sap
atoms.detail: Pick up the bucket of sap sitting just outside Brimstail's cave on the way back.

atoms.label: Make magic glue
atoms.detail: Use a mud rune on the pestle and mortar to make a ground mud rune, then add it to the bucket of sap to make magic glue.

atoms.label: Repair Oaknock's machine
atoms.detail: Click on the machine twice to repair it.

hints.value: the fetched text lists the glue and the repair as separate bullets without an explicit 'use glue on machine' step -- sequenced as given rather than an assumed link

atoms.label: Tell Brimstail the machine is fixed
atoms.detail: Report back to Brimstail that the machine has been repaired.

atoms.label: Collect discs from Brimstail
atoms.detail: Talk to Brimstail twice more to receive a batch of discs.

atoms.label: Optionally drop discs for a fresh batch
atoms.detail: Dropping the current discs and talking to Brimstail again yields another batch, useful if the wrong values were kept.

hints.value: no dedicated drop verb in the enum; mapped to toggle as the nearest persistent-state-change primitive

atoms.label: Unlock the machine's front panel
atoms.detail: Return to Oaknock's machine and unlock the front panel.

atoms.label: Insert a disc matching the front-panel value
atoms.detail: Unlock the front panel by inserting a disc whose colour-shape value equals the displayed green number, then confirm on the green box; some values require exchanging tokens for others first.

hints.value: the exact token-exchange values needed aren't itemised in this fetched section -- left ??

atoms.label: Collect more discs for the inner puzzles
atoms.detail: Talk to Brimstail again for another batch of discs.

atoms.label: Complete the three inner disc puzzles
atoms.detail: Fill every slot across the three puzzles inside the unlocked machine (1 slot, then 2, then 3), exchanging tokens for the values still needed.

atoms.label: Tell Brimstail the machine works
atoms.detail: Report that the machine is now fully working.

atoms.label: Start the evil-creature hunt
atoms.detail: Talk to Brimstail again to begin hunting down the spy constructs.

atoms.label: Kill all six Evil Creature spy constructs
atoms.detail: Hunt down and kill the six one-HP Evil Creatures (each turns black once dead) at: Brimstail's cave, outside the main gate (must be killed within the stronghold walls), the gnome agility course entrance near the spirit tree, by King Narnode at the base of the Grand Tree, at the top of the Grand Tree by the prison, and by the giant tortoises north-west of the Grand Tree; wait for each death animation to finish, and wait a few seconds before using a ladder near the two Grand Tree ones.

atoms.label: Talk to King Narnode to finish
atoms.detail: Report to King Narnode to complete the quest.

atoms.label: Optionally make an enchanted crystal saw
atoms.detail: Use a crystal saw seed on the singing bowl by Brimstail to get an enchanted crystal saw, completing a medium Western Provinces diary task.

hints.value: optional -- diary task, not required for quest completion

checkpoints.label: Meet the trial-givers and obtain a lyre
Prepare wool, keg, and beer in Seers' Village
Complete the Draugen, altar, and lyre trials back in Rellekka
Warrior's trial: fight Koschei the Deathless
Seer's trial: riddle and item-transformation puzzle

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt to start the quest
atoms.detail: Speak to Brundt in the longhall; if Mountain Daughter is started/finished the chat route differs. Fairy ring DKS then run south-west also reaches Rellekka.

atoms.label: Challenge Manni to a drinking contest (lose)
atoms.detail: Take the keg of beer from the longhall and challenge Manni; this first contest is scripted to be a loss.

atoms.label: Grab a beer tankard if you didn't bring a beer
atoms.detail: Only needed if you did not already bring your own beer; used later to fetch a replacement beer.

atoms.label: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman for the Hunters' Talisman
atoms.detail: Sigli stands near the longhall entrance; gives the talisman used to track The Draugen.

atoms.label: Talk to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall
atoms.detail: Introductory conversation before the lyre errand.

atoms.label: Talk to Olaf the Bard again
atoms.detail: A second, state-gated conversation with Olaf immediately after the first.

atoms.label: Walk to the Swaying tree east of Rellekka
atoms.detail: Canonical route: craft your own lyre. Alt (not modelled): kill Lanzig in his hut east of the longhall entrance for a 1/17 lyre drop, safespottable at the firepit or his door — slower on average per the guide's own note.

hints.value: craft-lyre-yourself

atoms.label: Chop a branch and fletch an unstrung lyre
atoms.detail: Chop a branch from the Swaying tree (rare-tree icon, north-west of the Golden Apple Tree) then fletch it into an unstrung lyre.

atoms.label: Talk to Lalli, ask about the other human
atoms.detail: Lalli lives south-east of the Swaying tree; this opens the stew-cooking errand.

atoms.label: Talk to Askeladden to get a pet rock
atoms.detail: Askeladden stands just outside the longhall entrance.

atoms.label: Pick a cabbage, potato, and onion
atoms.detail: Farming patch in the south-east corner of Rellekka.

atoms.label: Return to Lalli and offer the pet rock
atoms.detail: Hand over the pet rock gathered from Askeladden.

atoms.label: Use the cabbage, potato, and onion on Lalli's Stew
atoms.detail: Add the three vegetables to the cauldron. NOTE: the source text also lists the already-offered pet rock as a stew ingredient in this same bullet — a wiki-side double-mention, not re-consumed here since it was already handed over in the prior step.

atoms.label: Talk to Lalli again for the golden fleece
atoms.detail: Completes the stew errand.

atoms.label: Teleport or walk to Seers' Village
atoms.detail: Camelot teleport lands closest.

atoms.label: Spin the golden fleece into golden wool
atoms.detail: Only if crafting your own lyre; spinning wheel is upstairs in a house south-west of the bank.

atoms.label: Use the golden wool on the unstrung lyre
atoms.detail: Strings the lyre so it can later be enchanted at the strange altar.

atoms.label: Buy a low alcohol keg from the Poison Salesman
atoms.detail: Seers' Village pub; costs 250 coins.

atoms.label: Buy a regular beer if you forgot a beer tankard
atoms.detail: Only needed if you skipped the beer-tankard pickup earlier.

atoms.label: Return to Rellekka
atoms.detail: Rellekka house teleport, or walk back — if walking, left-click the Hunters' Talisman en route and kill The Draugen if it's nearby.

atoms.label: Use the beer/beer tankard on the council workman
atoms.detail: He stands by the bridge south of Rellekka; hands over a strange object.

atoms.label: Use raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar
atoms.detail: Altar is reached via a narrow path into the water on the west side of the bridge (marked by a large rib cage); enchants the lyre.

atoms.label: Kill The Draugen
atoms.detail: Follow the Hunters' Talisman by left-clicking it; The Draugen appears as a grey butterfly before the exact tile is located.

atoms.label: Talk to Sigli at the longhall entrance
atoms.detail: Report back after dealing with The Draugen.

atoms.label: Light the strange object with a tinderbox
atoms.detail: Done outside the longhall near the pipe on the eastern wall.

atoms.label: Use the lit strange object on the longhall pipe
atoms.detail: Pipe is on the eastern outer wall of the longhall.

atoms.label: Play the enchanted lyre on the longhall stage
atoms.detail: Enter via the north-eastern back door and walk onto the stage before playing it.

atoms.label: Take a keg of beer off the longhall table
atoms.detail: Exit the back door, enter the main longhall, and grab a fresh keg.

atoms.label: Use the low alcohol keg on the keg of beer
atoms.detail: Swaps in the low-alcohol brew so the rematch can be won.

atoms.label: Challenge Manni to a rematch drinking contest
atoms.detail: With the low-alcohol keg swapped in, this contest is won.

atoms.label: Talk to Sigmund the Merchant
atoms.detail: Market west of the longhall — opens the trial.

atoms.label: Talk to the Sailor
atoms.detail: Docks north-west of the market.

atoms.label: Talk to Olaf the Bard
atoms.detail: East of the longhall, about the Merchant's trial.

atoms.label: Talk to Yrsa
atoms.detail: Clothing store west of the market.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain
atoms.detail: In the longhall; chat route differs if Mountain Daughter is active.

atoms.label: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman
atoms.detail: South of the longhall.

atoms.label: Talk to Skulgrimen
atoms.detail: Hut just north of the longhall.

atoms.label: Talk to the Fisherman
atoms.detail: North of the market.

atoms.label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator
atoms.detail: Building south of the market.

atoms.label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator again
atoms.detail: Second, state-gated conversation that opens the portal maze.

atoms.label: Take the South, West, East, North, South, East, North portals
atoms.detail: Climb down the ladder Swensen reveals, take the fixed 7-portal sequence in that exact order, then climb back up.

atoms.label: Talk to Peer the Seer
atoms.detail: North-west of Swensen.

atoms.label: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior
atoms.detail: Hut just north of the longhall.

atoms.label: Talk to Manni the Reveller
atoms.detail: In the longhall.

atoms.label: Talk to Thora the Barkeep
atoms.detail: In the longhall.

atoms.label: Pay Askeladden 5,000 coins
atoms.detail: He stands in front of the longhall; paying him unlocks the reverse-order recall.

atoms.label: Bank everything before Thorvald's trial
atoms.detail: No weapons, armour, or runes are allowed for this fight; Seers' Village bank is close.

atoms.label: Bring a dramen/celastrus weapon, stat amulet, combat bracelet, food and potions
atoms.detail: A dramen branch (Crafting 31, Lost City started) or celastrus bark (Fletching 40) or a goblin paint cannon are the unarmed-fight weapon options; a knife is only needed for the dramen branch.

atoms.label: Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall to start
atoms.detail: Begins the Warrior's trial.

atoms.label: Cut the dramen branch into a staff (or fletch a celastrus battlestaff)
atoms.detail: Done after climbing down the ladder, only if not using a goblin paint cannon.

atoms.label: Fight Koschei the Deathless's first 3 forms unarmed
atoms.detail: No weapons/armour/runes; prayer-flicking is viable. The 4th form is optional and safe to "die" to (does not actually kill, even on Hardcore Ironman) rather than fighting it out.

atoms.label: Talk to Thorvald again to finish the trial
atoms.detail: Concludes the Warrior's trial.

atoms.label: Talk to Peer the Seer south-west of the market
atoms.detail: He automatically deposits all bankable items — anything unbankable in your inventory blocks progress.

atoms.label: Enter Peer's house and read the riddle
atoms.detail: Green-bedded house south-west of the market; the riddle's six lines each yield one letter of a 4-letter word (own-words: don't need the exact wiki phrasing, just solve line-by-line).

atoms.label: Search 4 objects for puzzle pieces
atoms.detail: South-western cupboard (bucket), unicorn head (red disk), bull head (wooden disk), southern chest (jug); a northern bookcase separately yields a red herring.

atoms.label: Use the red herring on the cooking range
atoms.detail: Produces a sticky red substance used on the wooden disk next.

atoms.label: Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk
atoms.detail: Prepares the wooden disk before it can be used with the red disks.

atoms.label: Use both red disks on the abstract mural
atoms.detail: Open the trapdoor on the east side and climb down first.

atoms.label: Solve the bucket/jug water-measuring puzzle for the scale
atoms.detail: Composite fixed sequence: fill the bucket at the tap, pour it into the jug, empty the jug down the drain, refill the bucket, pour the full bucket into the jug a second time, then use the resulting 4/5ths-full bucket on the northern chest's scale.

atoms.label: Fill the vase with water and seal it with the lid
atoms.detail: Prepares the vase to be used on the frozen table.

atoms.label: Use the sealed vase on the frozen table
atoms.detail: Yields the frozen key needed to finish the puzzle.

atoms.label: Use the frozen key on the cooking range
atoms.detail: Final puzzle step before the exit trapdoor unlocks.

atoms.label: Climb down the eastern trapdoor and leave
atoms.detail: Puzzle solved; the house's exit door can now be opened.

atoms.label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain to finish
atoms.detail: Reports the completed trials.

notes: Lyre acquisition is a genuine branch: canonical path modelled is crafting your own lyre (swaying-tree branch -> fletch -> Lalli's stew -> golden fleece -> spin -> string); the alternative (kill Lanzig, 1/17 lyre drop, slower on average per the guide's own note) is folded into a single branch hint rather than atomized separately. Bucket/jug water-measuring puzzle collapsed into one composite atom per the established fixed-sequence-puzzle precedent.

checkpoints.label: Kill each God Wars general once for a key piece
Assemble the key and open the Frozen Door

atoms.label: Wait for the messenger to deliver the important letter
atoms.detail: After completing Desert Treasure I, a messenger randomly appears to hand over an important letter.

atoms.label: Read then destroy the important letter
atoms.detail: Reading it starts the miniquest; the letter is then destroyed.

atoms.label: Kill Kree'arra once for his frozen key piece
atoms.detail: Held quest_db row notes bodyguards/lieutenants may also grant credit per the page's Details section, not directly confirmed in this Walkthrough fetch — flagged for cross-check.

atoms.label: Kill General Graardor once for his frozen key piece
atoms.detail: Bandos general in the God Wars Dungeon.

atoms.label: Kill Commander Zilyana once for her frozen key piece
atoms.detail: Saradomin general in the God Wars Dungeon.

atoms.label: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth once for his frozen key piece
atoms.detail: Zamorak general in the God Wars Dungeon.

atoms.label: Assemble the four key pieces into the frozen key
atoms.detail: Use the 'assemble' option on any piece while all four are in the inventory.

atoms.label: Travel to the Frozen Door
atoms.detail: Southern part of the God Wars Dungeon, just east of the entrance to Armadyl's Eyrie.

atoms.label: Use the frozen key to open the Frozen Door
atoms.detail: Unlocks the door for the final conversation.

atoms.label: Talk to Ashuelot Reis to finish
atoms.detail: Completes the miniquest and grants permanent access beyond the door.

notes: Frozen Door coordinate (2884,5279) is taken from the page's own {{Map}} template (mapID=7, an instanced/dungeon band) and used for both the general-chamber kill zone and the door itself since only one Map pin exists on the page. The held quest_db row claims bodyguards/lieutenants also grant kill credit per the page's Details section (not re-fetched here since the brief scoped this pass to Walkthrough sections only) -- flagged as an unconfirmed cross-check rather than asserted.

checkpoints.label: Equip quest gear and start with General Khazard's ghost
Pay Sin Seer and report back
Relay word to the four ghost scouts

atoms.label: Equip ghostly robes, ring of visibility, and ghostspeak amulet
atoms.detail: All three are required to interact with the ghost NPCs in this miniquest.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost of General Khazard
atoms.detail: North of the log balance, south-east of Rellekka. Fairy ring CJR if 48 Agility, otherwise AJR is faster.

atoms.label: Talk to Sin Seer in Seers' Village
atoms.detail: Upstairs in the spinning wheel house; needs an empty inventory slot and 40 coins.

atoms.label: Return to General Khazard's ghost
atoms.detail: Reports having paid Sin Seer.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost Scout south of Shantay Pass
atoms.detail: Fairy ring BIQ then run east.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost Scout south of the Gnome Stronghold entrance
atoms.detail: Use a Spirit tree or Necklace of passage to the Outpost.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost Scout between Falador and Draynor Manor
atoms.detail: An Explorer's ring 2 or better teleports just south of him.

atoms.label: Talk to the ghost Scout east of Tai Bwo Wannai
atoms.detail: Fairy ring CKR then run north-east, or Tai Bwo Wannai teleport then run east; south of the hardwood grove.

atoms.label: Report back to General Khazard's ghost again
atoms.detail: Confirms all four scouts have been notified.

atoms.label: Enter the Goblin Cave east of the Fishing Guild
atoms.detail: The severed leg must be in the inventory to enter the wall crack ahead; its own acquisition point is not stated on this page, modelled as a pre-existing quest item.

atoms.label: Fight the level 160 ghost of Bouncer to 0 hp
atoms.detail: Run to the north-east area and enter the crack in the southern wall — Prayer cannot be used in this cave. Reducing Bouncer to 0 hp auto-throws the severed leg to finish the miniquest.

notes: The Severed leg (The General's Shadow) has no stated acquisition bullet anywhere in the fetched Walkthrough -- modelled as a pre-existing/"??" reqs item per the Dwarf Cannon/Biohazard never-fabricate-a-sourcing-step precedent, flagged on the Goblin Cave entry atom. The quest gear equip step (ghostly robes/ring of visibility/ghostspeak amulet) was collapsed into one count=3 atom per the exact-count-repetition grain rule since all three are simple equip actions with no intervening steps. No {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} templates anywhere on this page -- coords are empty across all atoms, a fetch-confirmed gap.

checkpoints.label: Get the translation book and deliver the bark sample
Report the message and confront Glough
Investigate Glough, get arrested, and escape by glider
Get the lumber order from the Ship Yard on Karamja
Get the invasion plans and spell TUZO on the watchtower
Fight the Black demon and find the last daconia rock

atoms.label: Talk to King Shareen for the translation book and bark sample
atoms.detail: Requires two empty inventory slots.

atoms.label: Deliver the bark sample to Hazelmere
atoms.detail: His house is on the island east of Yanille (fairy ring code CLS); he gives a message for the king.

atoms.label: Report the message to King Shareen
atoms.detail: Dialogue branches through confirming a man came with the King's seal and gave him Daconia rocks, which will kill the tree.

atoms.label: Walk to Glough's house
atoms.detail: South from the king, then east and up the ladder at the bottom of the incline.

atoms.label: Talk to Glough
atoms.detail: First meeting, upstairs in his house.

atoms.label: Return to King Shareen and ask to see the prisoner
atoms.detail: The king reveals Glough has caught a human.

atoms.label: Talk to the prisoner Charlie
atoms.detail: Top floor of the Grand Tree; the full conversation must be completed.

atoms.label: Search Glough's cupboard for his journal
atoms.detail: In Glough's house.

atoms.label: Talk to Glough and wait to be arrested
atoms.detail: Confronting him about the journal triggers a scripted arrest.

atoms.label: Talk to Charlie for the shipyard password
atoms.detail: He explains the Ship Yard on Karamja and gives the password 'Ka-Lu-Min' (own-words note: exact password string is game text, recorded verbatim only because it is required literal input, not narrated dialogue).

atoms.label: The king appears and tells you to escape via the gnome glider
atoms.detail: Automatically triggered on top of the Grand Tree.

atoms.label: Travel with the gnome glider to Karamja
atoms.detail: Boarded on top of the Grand Tree, following the king's escape instruction.

atoms.label: Run east past the level 53 jogres to the Ship Yard gate
atoms.detail: The glider crashes nearby.

atoms.label: Open the gate and give the password to the worker
atoms.detail: Tell him Glough sent you, then give the password Ka-Lu-Min.

atoms.label: Talk to the Foreman on the southern dock for a lumber order
atoms.detail: Canonical route: talk and answer his security questions (alt not modelled: kill him instead, also yields the lumber order).

hints.value: talk-not-kill

atoms.label: Deliver the lumber order to the king
atoms.detail: Teleport into the stronghold, or pay Femi 1,000 coins to sneak in if she wasn't helped earlier; the king doesn't believe the order yet.

atoms.label: Talk to Charlie again on the top floor
atoms.detail: Opens the errand to see Anita.

atoms.label: Talk to Anita for Glough's key
atoms.detail: Up the stairs west of the swamp, north-west of the Grand Tree.

atoms.label: Use the key on Glough's chest for the invasion plans
atoms.detail: Complete the dialogue window fully to receive the plans.

atoms.label: Deliver the invasion plans for four sticks
atoms.detail: Requires four empty inventory slots.

atoms.label: Spell TUZO on the four watchtower pillars with the sticks
atoms.detail: Climb the watchtower (tree in the east part of Glough's house); eat a summer pie first if under 25 Agility.

atoms.label: Bank if needed and prepare for the Black demon fight
atoms.detail: Bring food and gear suited to a level 172 demon before descending.

atoms.label: Kill the level 172 Black demon
atoms.detail: Immediately after the cutscene, run to the tile directly north of the entrance ladder; the demon gets stuck behind the daconia rocks and can be safely fought with ranged, magic, or a halberd. It despawns if not killed within exactly 10 minutes.

atoms.label: Talk to the king found near a ladder past the demon
atoms.detail: He asks you to find the last daconia rock; the dialogue must be fully completed.

atoms.label: Search the roots for the last daconia rock
atoms.detail: Click continue on the dialogue when the stone is found.

atoms.label: Talk to the king one last time to finish
atoms.detail: Concludes the quest.

notes: The Foreman errand is a genuine branch (kill him, or talk and pass his security questions) -- talk was modelled as canonical since it's the more universally-available (non-combat) route, kill folded into a branch hint. Two {{Map}} pins present (Glough's house 2477,3463; Anita's house 2391,3511), both surface-band and within sanity envelope. No Grand Exchange mentions anywhere on the page.

checkpoints.label: Start the quest and deliver logs to Commander Montai
Get the ballista code from the three tracker gnomes
Get the orbs of protection and defeat the Khazard warlord

atoms.label: Talk to King Bolren to start the quest
atoms.detail: Teleports you out of the maze to its north-west corner.

atoms.label: Talk to Commander Montai on the battlefield
atoms.detail: Red hat, south-west edge of the battlefield, south of the river.

atoms.label: Give Commander Montai 6 logs
atoms.detail: Hands over the requested logs for the battlefield.

atoms.label: Talk to Commander Montai a third time to agree to help further
atoms.detail: Commits to continuing the quest beyond the initial errand.

atoms.label: Talk to the second tracker gnome
atoms.detail: Building towards the east side of the Khazard Stronghold.

atoms.label: Talk to the first tracker gnome
atoms.detail: North-west of the Khazard Stronghold.

atoms.label: Talk to the third tracker gnome for the ballista code
atoms.detail: South-west corner of the Khazard Stronghold; his riddle dialogue gives the 4-digit ballista code one digit per line (exact riddle wording left "??" per the own-words rule, the code itself is player-specific).

atoms.label: Fire the south-west ballista with the given code
atoms.detail: Located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, past the bridge; enter the 4-digit code exactly as given by the third tracker gnome.

until.state: code entered per own riddle answers, value not fixed across playthroughs

atoms.label: Climb over the crumbled wall into the stronghold
atoms.detail: The building where Tracker gnome 1 was; level 48 Khazard commanders may attack and can be ignored or killed.

atoms.label: Climb the ladder, search the chest, and take the orb of protection
atoms.detail: First of the three orbs.

atoms.label: Exit through the front door and talk to Elkoy
atoms.detail: Elkoy is back in Tree Gnome Village and sends you to the centre.

atoms.label: King Bolren asks you to get the other two orbs
atoms.detail: Sends the player after the Khazard warlord.

atoms.label: Kill the level 112 Khazard warlord for the other two orbs
atoms.detail: North-west of the battlefield, outside the wall below West Ardougne, underneath the Underground Pass. Safespot by de-aggroing him west near a large dead tree, then attacking from range/magic while he's boxed between the wall and the tree; melee players can step in and out of his walking range instead.

atoms.label: Return all 3 orbs to King Bolren to finish
atoms.detail: Concludes the quest.

notes: Tracker gnome coords come from the page's own {{Map}} pin block, which names them 1/2/3 in a different order than the prose visit order (visit order is 2nd, then 1st, then 3rd) -- each atom's coords were matched to its own gnome number, not visit order. The ballista's 4-digit code is genuinely player-specific (the riddle table maps each of 4 possible lines to a different digit; the page never states a single fixed code) -- modelled as an until:{state} placeholder rather than a fabricated number. Ignoring vs killing the level 48 Khazard commanders inside the stronghold is optional/avoidable, folded as a note on the walk-to atom rather than a forced kill atom. Two {{Map}} pins (Khazard warlord 2455,3301) plus the tracker-gnome pin block, all surface-band and within the coord sanity envelope.

atoms.label: Talk to Denulth south of the Burthorpe teleport
atoms.detail: Speak with Denulth about the ongoing troll raids to begin the quest.

atoms.label: Follow the path south toward Troll Stronghold
atoms.detail: Head along the path to the stronghold; those with Ghommal's hilt 1 (Easy Combat Achievements) can skip ahead to the north gate.

atoms.label: Buy climbing boots from Tenzing along the way
atoms.detail: Purchase climbing boots from Tenzing, needed later in the quest.

atoms.label: Fight Dad in the arena until the scripted end
atoms.detail: Attack Dad; the fight auto-ends before he dies and can be safespotted from the gate (magic or halberd recommended vs his high ranged defence).

atoms.label: Push north through the cave past Thrower trolls
atoms.detail: Exit through the north gate and reach the stronghold entrance by sprinting past, protecting from missiles against, or agility-shortcutting around Thrower trolls.

atoms.label: Kill a Troll General for the prison key
atoms.detail: Kill a Troll General (safespottable with halberd/magic/ranged) and loot the prison key; hardcore ironmen note his 38 max hit.

atoms.label: Follow the green path to the jail cells
atoms.detail: Head along the green path toward the cells holding Twig and Berry.

atoms.label: Free Twig and Berry from their cells
atoms.detail: Pickpocket (30+ Thieving) or kill sleeping Twig and Berry to free both prisoners, safespottable through the open cell doors.

hints.value: Thieving 30+ pickpocket is an alternate method to killing; either frees the prisoner.

atoms.label: Leave via games necklace teleport or the secret exit
atoms.detail: Teleport to Burthorpe with a games necklace, or follow Twig and Berry out the secret exit and climb the south-east rocks.

hints.value: Two interchangeable exit methods; either progresses the quest identically.

atoms.label: Talk to Dunstan to finish the quest
atoms.detail: Speak with Dunstan to complete Troll Stronghold.

notes: Agility 15 (held reqs.skills) has no explicit level-gated action in the fetched Walkthrough text (agility shortcuts around Thrower trolls are mentioned but not numbered) -- left off every atom per the Hand-in-the-Sand/Mountain Daughter precedent.
