atoms.label: Kill Vanstrom Klause
atoms.detail: Use Protect from Magic. Phase 1: kill the spawned Acidic Bloodveld with ranged before it explodes; avoid standing on the healing blood orb (or lure Vanstrom onto it instead); track his attack count and turn away pre-emptively before 'Stare into darkness' lands, since it gives almost no warning. After he drops to 0hp he self-heals 200hp and stops using those three specials -- turn off protection prayers (they no longer help) but keep buffing prayers like Piety active, and dodge the dark-circle tiles before his lightning strikes (max hit 46; disabling RuneLite's 117 HD plugin can make the warning tiles easier to see). Veliaf allows a re-attempt if you die. Watch the ending cutscene to complete the quest.

atoms.label: Take the dropped key, unlock the door, and take the robes from the coffin

checkpoints.label: Enter the lair via the Haunted Mine cave
Cross the trap gauntlet to Tarn's chamber
Prepare for and defeat Tarn Razorlor

atoms.label: Enter the Haunted Mine cave west of Burgh de Rott
atoms.detail: Climb over the mine cart south of the Zealot and crawl down the cart tunnel to reach Level 1 of the mine.

atoms.label: Head north through the mine to the lair entrance
atoms.detail: Follow the mine path to its northern end and enter Tarn's Lair; a cutscene shows the mutant and its terror-dog statues.

atoms.label: Pass the floor traps at the lair entrance
atoms.detail: Head east past the marked floor traps and any attacking monsters to the end of the entry passage.

atoms.label: Disarm the two wall traps heading north to the bank
atoms.detail: Search the southern wall trap on the west wall, then the northern one on the east wall, to disarm both before the banker's room.

atoms.label: Use the banker in the small room at the hall's end
atoms.detail: The banker charges 100 coins per use and is the last restock or heal point before Tarn's chamber.

atoms.label: Turn off Auto Retaliate before the trap gauntlet
atoms.detail: Disable Auto Retaliate so a disarmed trap or a nearby monster doesn't drag you back into danger while crossing.

atoms.label: Disarm the three floor traps north of the bank
atoms.detail: From the bank go north, west along the U-shaped hall, then north into the square room and search each of its three floor traps to disarm them.

atoms.label: Pass the wall traps in the inverted-T hallway
atoms.detail: Take the north passage of the inverted-T hallway and disarm its wall trap on the west wall, then the one on the east wall.

atoms.label: Disarm the log-swing trap in the first pillar room
atoms.detail: Cross the southern pillars to the west side and search the floor to disable the log-swing trap; it re-arms after any fall, so redisarm it if knocked down.

atoms.label: Cross the second row of pillars north
atoms.detail: Use the second row of pillars from the west to continue north once the log trap is disabled.

atoms.label: Pass the wall traps before the receding-wall room
atoms.detail: Head east along a path with a wall trap on the south wall, then one on the north wall, disarming both.

atoms.label: Time the receding walls to cross the hole room
atoms.detail: Wait for the shooting walls to retract, then run past them to the east passage without being knocked down a level.

atoms.label: Activate Protect from Magic before the final pillar room
atoms.detail: Turn on Protect from Magic to nullify damage from the two level-94 skeleton mages guarding the zigzag pillar crossing.

atoms.label: Cross the zigzag pillars and take the stairs down
atoms.detail: Jump the pillars north-west to south-east while ignoring the skeleton mages, then descend the stairs to the passage leading to Tarn's chamber.

atoms.label: Stock up on prayer potions and food before entering
atoms.detail: Bring at least 2 prayer potions and 15+ pieces of monkfish-or-better food; the salve amulet is not required to start or end the fight.

atoms.label: Turn on Protect from Melee as the fight starts
atoms.detail: After the transformation cutscene ends, activate Protect from Melee against Tarn (level 69) since the terror dogs also only use melee.

atoms.label: Kill Tarn Razorlor through both forms
atoms.detail: Fight only Tarn -- ignore the terror dogs and animated armour -- through his mutant form and his easier ghost form afterward; prayer drains constantly and poison carries over between forms.

atoms.label: Read Tarn's diary to finish
atoms.detail: Find Tarn's diary on the table in the room beyond his chamber and read it to complete the miniquest.

checkpoints.label: Start the quest and gather serum ingredients
Brew Serum 207, cure Razmire, and gather temple materials
Burn a shade and cure both patients

atoms.label: Search the shelf in the ruined south-west house and read the diary
atoms.detail: Enter the ruined house in south-west Mort'ton, search the wall shelf, and read the diary to start the quest and unlock Serum 207.

atoms.label: Search the smashed table for tarromin (if you didn't bring your own)
atoms.detail: If you didn't bring unfinished tarromin potions, pick up empty vials from the north-east house then search the smashed table for two grimy tarromin and a grimy rogue's purse.

atoms.label: Brew two doses of Serum 207
atoms.detail: Add clean tarromin to a vial of water, then add ashes, to make two doses of Serum 207.

atoms.label: Dose Razmire with Serum 207 and agree to help
atoms.detail: Use a Serum 207 on the afflicted Razmire in the general store and pick the dialogue confirming you'll deal with the shadowy creatures; avoid the temple's official world until the repair step so NPC chats aren't interrupted.

hints.value: What are all these shadowy creatures?
Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.

atoms.label: Kill five loar shades for their remains
atoms.detail: Shades killed before talking to Razmire don't count, so kill five afterward and pick up their remains.

atoms.label: Return the loar remains to Razmire
atoms.detail: Hand the remains to Razmire; he may ask for another dose of Serum 207 before accepting them.

atoms.label: Buy an olive oil from Razmire's general store
atoms.detail: Open Razmire's general store stock and buy a bottle of olive oil.

atoms.label: Buy temple-repair materials from the builders' store
atoms.detail: Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks and 25 swamp paste, plus an optional Flamtaer hammer, from Razmire's builders' store.

atoms.label: Dose Ulsquire Shauncy with Serum 207
atoms.detail: Find Ulsquire Shauncy in the house east of the general store, use a Serum 207 on him, then talk to him while carrying the loar remains.

atoms.label: Ask Ulsquire about the remains and the temple
atoms.detail: Talk to Ulsquire again and route the dialogue to ask what he found out about the remains, then about the temple.

hints.value: What did you find out about the remains?
What can you tell me about that temple?

atoms.label: Repair the temple to 100% with at least 20 sanctity
atoms.detail: Head north-east of Mort'ton and repair the temple in the minigame area until it reaches full repair and at least 20 sanctity; the official world is recommended for help from other players.

atoms.label: Light the sacred altar at the temple's centre
atoms.detail: Light the sacred altar yourself if able, or wait for another player with at least level 5 Firemaking to light it.

atoms.label: Pour olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil
atoms.detail: Use the olive oil on the lit altar's flame to produce sacred oil.

atoms.label: Dip Serum 207 in the flame to make Serum 208
atoms.detail: Use a dose of Serum 207 on the flame to permanently upgrade it into Serum 208, the permanent-cure version.

atoms.label: Make a pyre log with the sacred oil
atoms.detail: Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.

atoms.label: Set up and light a stone funeral pyre
atoms.detail: Head to any grouping of four stone funeral pyres west of the general store, use the pyre log then the loar remains on one, and light it for Prayer experience.

atoms.label: Collect the reward from the burned pyre
atoms.detail: Pick up the reward left behind once the funeral pyre burns down.

atoms.label: Cure Razmire with Serum 208
atoms.detail: Use Serum 208 on Razmire to cure him permanently.

atoms.label: Cure Ulsquire and finish the quest
atoms.detail: Use Serum 208 on Ulsquire Shauncy and complete the closing dialogue to finish the quest.

atoms.label: Defeat Essyllt
atoms.detail: Fight Essyllt — Protect from Melee blocks most of his damage, switch to Protect from Range right after his stun attack, and drink a stat-restore potion after his potion attack.

atoms.label: Enter the Temple of Light
atoms.detail: A cutscene automatically brings you into the Temple of Light; if unequipped, teleport out and back in through the same crack you used to enter the dwarf camp.

atoms.label: Defeat the Fragment of Seren
atoms.detail: Fight the Fragment using Magic only (Protect from Range blocks most normal damage) through its four repeating specials: a teleport-in orb (run away after), a split into copies (attack the real one, marked by crystals underneath and a lighter aura), summoned healing orbs (pop them with any fast attack), and a freeze-then-near-max hit (overheal above 100% HP with Saradomin brews/anglerfish beforehand or die in one shot).

atoms.detail: Enter Teumo's basement.

atoms.detail: Talk to Attala in the basement.

atoms.detail: Descend west into the moon puzzle room.

atoms.detail: Use the knife blade on the ancient roots for some root kindling.

atoms.detail: Use the pressure plates to move Prince Itzla and suppress a set of flames; count the lit braziers with Itzla on each plate in turn and add the two totals for the required kindling amount.

atoms.detail: Deposit the tallied amount of root kindling in the moon statue; the total needed does not change until the correct amount is added. Doing this correctly three times completes the puzzle.

atoms.detail: Leave the puzzle through the portal, then follow Prince Itzla as he unlocks the northern doors.

atoms.detail: Inspect the Sun Statue and Moon Statue.

notes: The key found on the large bed (idx6) is never explicitly reused anywhere in the fetched Quick guide text -- left unconsumed rather than guessing its purpose, flagged for consolidator review. The scroll produced by picklocking the blue chest (idx9) and the 'pick up and read the emissary scroll' bullet after the Enforcer fight (idx11) name the same item; the text never states the scroll is dropped mid-fight, so the causal link is inferred, not asserted as wiki fact. The single 'beer' gathered from Teumo's basement cabinet (idx33) is referenced by three separate use points (idx31 sourced upstairs separately, idx36, idx38) -- a genuine quantity gap in the terse source text, flagged on idx38 rather than silently resolved. Lucius and Chimalli (idx49) fight simultaneously in one shared encounter with interdependent tactics -- collapsed into one composite kill atom (count=2) per the Regicide/Kourend tightly-coupled-encounter precedent, rather than split into two boss atoms. The sun-statue word-to-number table (idx61) is fully stated on the page, but the per-attempt altar target is player-specific each time, so only the fixed repeat count (3) is modelled numerically. The moon-room brazier count (idx66) and its resulting kindling total are genuinely player-randomized, left as until:{state:'??'}. Zero {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} templates found anywhere in the fetched text -- coords[] empty on all 78 atoms, a fetch-confirmed gap not a shortfall. This quest's own reqs.quests (quest-the-heart-of-darkness, quest-twilights-promise, quest-children-of-the-sun, quest-perilous-moons) match the held quest_db row; The Heart of Darkness content is out of this task's 2-quest scope and not atomized here.
