hints.value: heal Prince Itzla with bandages from medical boxes during the fight

atoms.label: Talk to Forebearer Janus to start the next trial
atoms.detail: Speak with Forebearer Janus again once the waves are cleared.

atoms.label: Talk to the Prince
atoms.detail: Speak with the Prince at the start of the third trial.

atoms.label: Question each cultist
atoms.detail: Question every member of the cult to work out who mentions Mictl, which is heretical and not part of Emissary beliefs.

atoms.label: Accuse the cultist who mentioned Mictl
atoms.detail: Accuse whichever cultist mentioned Mictl; if none are the traitor, exit and re-enter the floor.

hints.value: traitor identity is randomised per playthrough

atoms.label: Go up the stairs
atoms.detail: Climb the stairs to the final trial's floor.

atoms.label: Fight Prince Itzla
atoms.detail: Fight Prince Itzla, praying melee against his basic attacks. His sword-swipe special disables prayers (re-enable immediately); his AOE special is dodged by running behind him once warned. He is immune to special attacks (unequip a Scythe of Vitur and punch/kick instead).

hints.value: immune to special attacks; unequip Scythe of Vitur and punch/kick if wielding one

atoms.label: Talk to Forebearer Janus
atoms.detail: Speak with Forebearer Janus after defeating the Prince.

atoms.label: Search the chest to the south
atoms.detail: Search the chest south of the arena to obtain a set of Twilight Emissary robes.

atoms.label: Equip the Twilight Emissary robes
atoms.detail: Equip the emissary robes before proceeding.

atoms.label: Have the Prince follow you
atoms.detail: Speak to Prince Itzla to have him follow you, then enter the temple to the east.

atoms.label: Enter the temple
atoms.detail: Enter the temple to the east.

atoms.label: Talk to the Prince after the cutscene
atoms.detail: Speak with Prince Itzla after the temple cutscene.

atoms.label: Talk to Forebearer Fides
atoms.detail: Speak with Forebearer Fides in the temple.

atoms.label: Enter the ruins south of the temple
atoms.detail: Enter the ruins south of the temple and go down the stairs.

atoms.label: Take a pickaxe from the barrel
atoms.detail: Take a pickaxe from the barrel near the Ice Dungeon entrance.

atoms.label: Mine through the rocks
atoms.detail: Mine through the rocks blocking the path.

atoms.label: Run past the Frost Nagua and spikes
atoms.detail: Run past the Frost Nagua and spike traps to reach the first lever.

atoms.label: Pull the first lever
atoms.detail: Pull the first lever.

atoms.label: Climb down and slide to the north-east room
atoms.detail: Climb down the ledge, run past the frost crabs while avoiding traps (each deals 10 Hitpoints of damage), then slide along the icy ledge into the north-east room.

hints.value: traps deal 10 damage each; can be avoided or tanked

atoms.label: Pull the second lever
atoms.detail: Pull the second lever in the north-east room.

atoms.label: Jump the frozen platforms to the west side
atoms.detail: Continue through the cave, jump over the frozen platforms to reach the west side, then climb down another ledge to the north-western room with stone chests.

atoms.label: Pull the third lever
atoms.detail: Pull the third lever in the north-western stone-chest room.

atoms.label: Head to the large gate
atoms.detail: Walk south-west to the large gate.

atoms.label: Pull the fourth lever
atoms.detail: Pull the fourth lever, located on the northern wall next to the gate.

hints.value: a missed lever leaves braziers unlit and the gate closed

atoms.label: Pull the shortcut chain
atoms.detail: Pull the chain before continuing, unlocking future climb up/down shortcut access.

atoms.label: Head through the gate to the statue room
atoms.detail: Walk west through the gate into the statue puzzle area.

atoms.label: Search urns for coloured icons
atoms.detail: Search urns to collect three coloured icons; level-104 Frost Nagua continuously spawn and attack while searching, Protect from Magic negates their regular hits.

hints.value: Frost Nagua spawn continuously; Protect from Magic negates regular attacks

atoms.label: Fix the broken statues
atoms.detail: Fix the broken statues in the western area with the matching coloured icons.

atoms.label: Inspect the corner murals
atoms.detail: Inspect the four markings in the corners of the area to learn the player-specific statue activation order (Zema=1, Oma=2, Yeya=3, Naui=4).

hints.value: no 'inspect' primitive; nearest is toggle
activation order is unique per player

atoms.label: Touch the statues in the derived order
atoms.detail: Touch the four statues in the order determined by the murals to open the frozen door.

atoms.label: Go through the frozen door
atoms.detail: Go through the frozen door, ready to fight the final boss.

atoms.label: Fight Amoxliatl
atoms.detail: Fight Amoxliatl (level 263), praying magic, stepping away from spikes, avoiding ice pools, and re-enabling Protect from Magic whenever it is disabled; melee the healing ice blocks she summons (or ignore them and just mage her at higher level).

hints.value: re-enable Protect from Magic after it's disabled; melee or ignore the healing ice blocks

atoms.label: Head to the Sunrise Palace
atoms.detail: Travel to the Sunrise Palace.

atoms.label: Talk to Servius, Teokan of Ralos
atoms.detail: Speak with Servius, Teokan of Ralos, to finish the quest.

notes: GM-tier 61-atom quest; the Quick guide's stub Walkthrough H2 (17B listed) parent-pulled all 8 nested trial/dungeon subsections inline in ONE get --section 2 (7094B), extending the established parent-pulls-children pattern to this page -- but unlike several prior batches, NO child subsection (s3-s10) is separately manifest-recorded, so every atom cites the coarse .s2 slug (no finer slug exists to prefer). Four genuine player-randomised puzzle states (sw-chest keyword, nw-chest code, statue mural activation order, third-trial traitor identity) modelled as until:{state:??} per the Tree Gnome Village/Movario precedent -- the word-to-direction table (Takam/Makt/Silam/Uitt) and mural name-to-number table (Zema/Oma/Yeya/Naui) are fixed game text (not secret) and were kept in atom detail, only the derived per-player output stays ??. Zero {{Map}}/{{NPC map}} templates found -- coords[] empty across all 61 atoms, a fetch-confirmed gap. Zero Grand Exchange mentions. Dropped the optional 'build the Unbuilt Landing Site in Salvager Overlook' aside and the optional recommended-gear lines (combat gear/potions, empty inventory-slot counts) as non-required player-choice content, per the Murder Mystery optional-aside precedent -- flagged here rather than silently atomized. Second Trial's exact wave count and Third Trial's exact cultist count are not stated on the page -- left as until:{state:??} rather than guessed.

checkpoints.label: Reach the Mage Arena bank and gear up
Claim your god cape and staff

atoms.label: Travel to the Mage Arena bank in level 53 Wilderness
atoms.detail: Reach the bank via the Edgeville/Ardougne levers, Ice Plateau teleport, or Ghorrock teleport; bring something to cut the web outside and keep risk low.

atoms.label: Gear up in low-risk equipment
atoms.detail: Wear minimal-risk items before the fight and reward area, both of which sit in deep Wilderness where other players can attack you.

atoms.label: Talk to Kolodion at the bank to start the fight
atoms.detail: Accepting his challenge teleports you into the arena, which sits in level 54 Wilderness.

hints.value: Can I fight here? -> Yes indeedy. -> Okay, let's fight.

atoms.label: Defeat all five of Kolodion's forms
atoms.detail: Kolodion transforms sequentially (himself, ogre, frost spider, ghost, then a level-112 black demon); every form after the first only deals magic damage, so Protect from Magic tanks the fight.

hints.value: can be safespotted behind a skeleton inside the arena

atoms.label: Step into the north-east Sparkling pool
atoms.detail: Moves you from the fight into the reward area with the god statues.

atoms.label: Pray at the statue matching your chosen god
atoms.detail: Walk north and pray at the statue of Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak; this choice sets which cape and staff you receive next.

hints.value: pick one: Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak

atoms.label: Pick up the matching god cape
atoms.detail: Collect the cape (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak) that matches the statue you just prayed at.

atoms.label: Talk to the Chamber Guardian for the matching god staff
atoms.detail: Head south and speak to the Chamber Guardian, who hands over the staff (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak) matching your earlier choice.

atoms.label: Step into the south Sparkling pool
atoms.detail: Returns you from the reward area toward Kolodion to finish up.

atoms.label: Talk to Kolodion to complete the miniquest
atoms.detail: Reporting back finishes Mage Arena I; the god spellbook prayer still needs roughly 50-100 total casts of the god spell to fully unlock afterward.

notes: God cape/staff are choice-branched (Saradomin/Guthix/Zamorak) so idx5-7 produces are left empty rather than hardcoding one branch; see hints for the choice point. No raw coordinate pins were present in the fetched wikitext (arena layout is template-rendered), so coords stay empty throughout.

checkpoints.label: Receive the enchanted symbol from Kolodion
Gear up, kill, and turn in remains for each follower

atoms.label: Talk to Kolodion at the Mage Arena bank for the enchanted symbol
atoms.detail: Ask him for the next challenge; he hands over the enchanted symbol used to track the three wandering followers.

hints.value: Are there any more challenges available? -> Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!

atoms.label: Use the enchanted symbol to hot-and-cold search for a follower
atoms.detail: Use the symbol at various Wilderness spots to narrow in on where one of the three followers (Porazdir, Justiciar Zachariah, or Derwen) has spawned; the spot is random per player and shifts roughly every 45 minutes of Wilderness time.

atoms.label: Equip the god staff and runes matching the target follower
atoms.detail: Each follower can only be damaged by its own god spell (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak), so bring the matching staff plus enough runes for 50+ casts before engaging.

atoms.label: Use the enchanted symbol at the location to spawn the follower
atoms.detail: Spawns the follower so it can be fought; it hits hard with both magic and melee and despawns if not killed fast enough.

atoms.label: Kill the spawned follower and collect its remains
atoms.detail: Defeat the follower with its matching god spell and pick up the remains it drops; repeat this locate-gear-kill loop across all three named followers.

atoms.label: Hand the follower's remains to Kolodion
atoms.detail: Turn in remains one at a time or save them up to hand in together after killing more than one follower; handing in remains from all three completes the miniquest.

atoms.label: Restock at the bank and switch staff for the next follower
atoms.detail: Refill runes, food, and potions, then swap to the god staff matching whichever follower you target next.

notes: Three named followers (Porazdir, Justiciar Zachariah, Derwen) share one grain per the repetition rule (idx1-6 loop, count=3 on the kill atom) rather than unrolling per name, since each iteration is mechanically identical modulo which god staff is equipped. Section s2 as fetched already contains the s3/s4/s5 subsection text combined (byte sizes match), confirming the nesting gotcha for this page too; s3-s5 slugs are cited per-subsection since that's where each detail actually lives. No raw coordinate pins were present in the fetched wikitext (spawn map is a transcluded template), so coords stay empty throughout.

Nature Spirit — granular walkthrough. Item-sourcing kept non-GE per hard rule: silver bar via Ardougne Silver merchant (NPC shop, not GE, per the quest's own ironman note), sickle mould via Rommik's Crafty Supplies (Rimmington). Exact druid-pouch charge units and quest-complete varbit are unconfirmed ("??") pending a live-client check.

steps.label: Obtain a silver bar
steps.detail: Buy a silver bar from the Silver merchant in Ardougne (an NPC shop, not the Grand Exchange) — the quest's own item note names this as the sanctioned non-GE source.

steps.label: Obtain a sickle mould
steps.detail: Buy a sickle mould from an NPC crafting-supplies shop (e.g. Rommik's Crafty Supplies in Rimmington).

steps.label: Smith the silver sickle
steps.detail: Use the silver bar with the sickle mould at any furnace (Crafting 18, boostable) to smith a silver sickle for 50 Crafting XP.

steps.label: Ask Drezel about Filliman Tarlock
steps.detail: Talk to Drezel in the Paterdomus basement and accept his request to find the druid Filliman Tarlock in Mort Myre Swamp; he hands over three meat pies and three apple pies for the ghost.

hints.note: Well, what is it, I may be able to help? -> Yes -> I'd better get going.

steps.label: Travel to the Nature Grotto
steps.detail: Leave the temple and run south through Mort Myre Swamp to the Nature Grotto north-west of Mort'ton. You must enter the swamp through the gate or Filliman never appears.

steps.label: Meet the ghost Filliman Tarlock
steps.detail: Attempt to enter the grotto to make Filliman appear; wear the ghostspeak amulet and ask how long he's been a ghost. He vanishes if you stop interacting with him, so keep talking.

hints.note: How long have you been a ghost?

steps.label: Find the mirror under the washing bowl
steps.detail: Take the washing bowl off the nearby bench to find a mirror underneath it.

steps.label: Show Filliman the mirror
steps.detail: Use the mirror on Filliman; he realises he's a ghost and asks you to find his journal (if using it does nothing, talk to him again first).

steps.label: Retrieve Filliman's journal
steps.detail: Search (right-click) the grotto tree to find Filliman's journal, then use it on him to return it; he teaches you a druidic spell.

steps.label: Ask Drezel for a blessing
steps.detail: Run back to Drezel and ask him to bless you. (UIM note: if Wolfbane was discarded, take the replacement dagger first, then speak to him.)

steps.label: Cast the druidic spell on a rotting log
steps.detail: Enter the swamp, stand next to a rotting log, and cast the druidic spell Filliman taught you.

steps.label: Pick the mushroom from the log
steps.detail: Quickly pick the mushroom that grows from the log after the spell is cast, then bring it back to Filliman's camp.

steps.label: Solve the three-stone puzzle
steps.detail: Make sure Filliman is standing outside between all three stones. Use the mushroom on the light-brown stone, the used spell card on the grey stone, then stand on the orange stone and tell him you've solved the puzzle.

hints.note: I think I've solved the puzzle!

steps.label: Give the nature spirit your sickle
steps.detail: Enter the hole under the tree, search the grotto in the middle of the cave, then give the nature spirit your silver sickle by talking to him; he blesses it and hands you a druid pouch.

steps.label: Fill the druid pouch with swamp plants
steps.detail: Leave the grotto and stand next to rotting logs, bushes, or branches in the swamp. Use the silver sickle (b)'s Bloom ability (costs prayer points) to harvest fungi/saplings/pears and fill the druid pouch.

steps.label: Kill three Ghasts
steps.detail: Use your filled druid pouch on a Ghast to make it attackable, then kill three of them (level 30 each).

steps.label: Complete the grotto restoration
steps.detail: Return to the nature spirit via the grotto in the cave; he redecorates the grotto and the quest completes. If aiming for the Morytania Diary, pray at the altar here first.

checkpoints.label: The Nature Spirit: bless the sickle
Killing the Ghasts: finish the quest

notes: Lost City — granular walkthrough. Bronze axe and dramen branch counts are RNG/recommendation-driven and left "??"/loose per the wiki's own guidance (40% drop, recommend 3 branches). Chronicle-from-Diango note kept optional/non-required (reward-shop purchase, not the Grand Exchange, and not needed to progress).

steps.label: Ask the Warrior about Zanaris
steps.detail: Speak to the Warrior camped north-west of Lumbridge Swamp and ask what he's guarding and who Zanaris is.

hints.note: What are you camped here for? -> Who's Zanaris? -> If it's hidden how are you planning to find it? -> Looks like you don't know either.

steps.label: Chop (don't chop down) the nearby tree
steps.detail: Go to the tree closest to the Warrior's encampment and right-click it, choosing the 'chop' option rather than 'chop down'. This makes Shamus appear.

steps.label: Speak to Shamus
steps.detail: Talk to Shamus about how the camp fits in a shed.

hints.note: How does it fit in a shed then?

steps.label: Bank weapons and armour before Entrana
steps.detail: Deposit all weapons and armour at a bank (jewellery such as a ring of dueling, amulet of glory, or combat bracelet is allowed) — Entrana's monks confiscate anything else. Optionally buy a chronicle from Diango and charge it with teleport cards if you lack a teleport to Entrana (not required, just convenient for repeat trips).

steps.label: Travel to the Port Sarim docks
steps.detail: Head to the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn.

steps.label: Sail to Entrana
steps.detail: Talk to a Monk of Entrana at the docks to travel to the island.

steps.label: Reach the cave on Entrana
steps.detail: Cross the north-east bridge, go west to find the Cave monk, then go down the ladder. Do not craft a battlestaff or bow before entering the cave, or the monks will knock you out and send you back to Port Sarim.

steps.label: Farm zombies for a bronze axe
steps.detail: Kill zombies in the cave until one drops a bronze axe (roughly 40% drop chance per kill, so exact kill count is "??"). Two level-92 Greater Demons occupy the room before the Dramen tree — be careful.

steps.label: Reach the Dramen tree
steps.detail: Go south-east past the Greater Demons and attempt to chop the Dramen tree. Caution: the nearby magical door teleports you into level-32 Wilderness.

steps.label: Defeat the Dramen Tree Spirit
steps.detail: Chopping the tree summons the Dramen Tree Spirit; kill it (there's a safespot behind the southern fungus formation). Do not use the mushroom near the demons as a safespot — even after killing the spirit once, it respawns the next time you try to chop.

steps.label: Chop dramen branches
steps.detail: Chop the now-unguarded Dramen tree with the bronze axe. Cutting at least three branches is recommended — spares are useful later for the Freeing Sir Amik Varze RFD subquest and for smuggling into Thorvald's trial in the Fremennik Trials — but don't make them into staves yet.

steps.label: Carve a dramen staff
steps.detail: Use a knife on a dramen branch to make a dramen staff.

steps.label: Return to the Lumbridge Swamp tool shed
steps.detail: Teleport out of the cave, then travel to the tool shed in the centre of Lumbridge Swamp.

steps.label: Enter Zanaris
steps.detail: Wield the dramen staff and enter the tool shed — it opens onto Zanaris and completes the quest.

checkpoints.label: Cave trial: bronze axe and the Dramen Tree Spirit
Craft the dramen staff and enter Zanaris

notes: Tale of the Righteous — granular walkthrough. FLAG for Lane 5: the coarse row's id 'quest-tale-of-arrav' does not match its own cited quest — 'Tale of Arrav' has no wiki page (wikicli confirms 'page you specified doesn't exist'), while the row's refs[] correctly cite 'Tale of the Righteous' (Shayzien/Mount Quidamortem investigation quest), which is what was atomized here per the brief's own instruction to trust refs[]. No item gather/produce chain needed — the quest carries no purchasable/craftable quest items beyond a rope and generic combat gear the player already owns.

steps.label: Go to Phileas Rimor's house
steps.detail: Head to the house west of the Cloak and Stagger tavern in Shayzien (from Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west; fairy ring code DJR also reaches Shayzien).

steps.label: Agree to help Phileas Rimor
steps.detail: Speak to Phileas Rimor and agree to help with his investigation.

hints.note: Do you need help with anything? -> Yes.

steps.label: Ready a ranged, melee, and magic loadout
steps.detail: Make sure you're carrying a ranged weapon, a melee weapon (a pickaxe counts), and runes for a magic attack — needed for the Tower of Magic puzzle ahead. Own combat gear, not a quest-specific item to source.

steps.label: Travel to the Arceuus Library
steps.detail: Travel to the Arceuus Library via fairy ring code CIS or the Lovakengj Minecart Network.

steps.label: Ask Archeio for the Historical Archive
steps.detail: Speak to Archeio, who teleports you to the Library Historical Archive.

steps.label: Ask Pagida about King Shayzien VII
steps.detail: Speak to Pagida, ask about King Shayzien VII, and agree to be teleported into the Tower of Magic prison.

hints.note: I have a question about King Shayzien VII. -> Yes please.

steps.label: Push the device and attack with magic
steps.detail: Push the strange device all the way west, then attack it with magic from the north side.

steps.label: Attack the device with melee
steps.detail: From the south side, attack the device using melee. Make sure NPC attack options aren't set to hidden or the option won't appear.

steps.label: Push the device east and attack with ranged
steps.detail: Push the device all the way east, then from the south side attack it using ranged.

steps.label: Investigate the skeleton
steps.detail: Investigate the skeleton in the northern cell.

steps.label: Report back to Phileas Rimor
steps.detail: Return to the quest start and talk to Phileas Rimor again (Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west).

steps.label: Head to the War Tent
steps.detail: Go north-west to the War Tent in the south-west corner of the Shayzien Encampment and climb upstairs.

steps.label: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien upstairs in the War Tent.

steps.label: Travel to Mount Quidamortem's summit
steps.detail: Travel to the summit of Mount Quidamortem via the Lovakengj Minecart Network, Xeric's Talisman (Xeric's Honour, if unlocked), or fairy ring code BLS (if unlocked). Optionally speak to the Mountain Guide here to unlock quick travel for later trips.

steps.label: Speak to Historian Duffy
steps.detail: Speak to Historian Duffy, found near the water symbol on the minimap.

steps.label: Enter the mountain crevice
steps.detail: Use a rope on the crevice on the western side of the mountain and enter it, then go around to the south — not through the middle (near the exclamation-mark symbol on the minimap).

steps.label: Mine the boulder
steps.detail: Mine the boulder blocking the passage.

steps.label: Push the boulder aside
steps.detail: Push the mined boulder out of the way.

steps.label: Defeat the Corrupt Lizardman
steps.detail: Attempt to pass the magic gate; a Corrupt Lizardman blocks it — kill it.

steps.label: Inspect the Unstable Altar
steps.detail: Pass through the magic gate and inspect the Unstable Altar.

steps.label: Hop worlds to leave the cave
steps.detail: Once the dialogue finishes, hop worlds to quickly leave the cave.

steps.label: Speak to Duffy again
steps.detail: Speak to Historian Duffy again on the mountain.

steps.label: Return to the unstable altar
steps.detail: Go back into the cave to the unstable altar.

steps.label: Speak to both Duffy and Gnosi
steps.detail: Speak to Duffy, then to Gnosi, near the unstable altar — make sure to talk to BOTH of them.

steps.label: Report to Lord Shiro Shayzien
steps.detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien back at the War Tent (fairy ring code DJR or the Lovakengj Minecart Network), or speak to the Mountain Guide if quick travel was unlocked earlier.

steps.label: Check Phileas's empty house
steps.detail: Return to Phileas's house and walk inside to trigger dialogue — he won't physically be there.

steps.label: Finish the investigation
steps.detail: Return to Lord Shiro Shayzien once more to complete the quest.

checkpoints.label: Report back at the War Tent

notes: Monkey Madness I — granular walkthrough. Gold bar and ball of wool are modeled as full own-gather/own-produce chains (mine gold ore -> smelt; shear wool -> spin) per the hard rule, since the quick guide is silent on sourcing them and neither is quest-bound; exact rock/pen location relative to the quest's own travel path is left "??" (generic material, any source works). Freeing King Awowogei RFD-subquest side content (extra talismans/greegrees/bones) mentioned throughout the source walkthrough is deliberately out of scope — not required to complete Monkey Madness I itself.

steps.label: Accept King Narnode's request
steps.detail: Speak to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree and agree to investigate the missing 10th squad. Keep an inventory slot free or the gnome royal seal drops on the ground.

hints.note: start: ask about the missing 10th squad

steps.label: Glide to Gandius
steps.detail: Climb up the tree at the Grand Tree and take the gnome glider to Gandius.

steps.label: Get monkey bones if needed
steps.detail: If you don't already have monkey bones, kill a monkey nearby for some (if Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is already started, only a monkey corpse drops, which also works).

steps.label: Enter the Shipyard gate
steps.detail: Enter the Shipyard gate to the north, carrying the Royal Seal.

steps.label: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock
steps.detail: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the building south of the Shipyard gate.

steps.label: Report back to King Narnode
steps.detail: Return to King Narnode and speak to him. Keep 1 free inventory slot, or Narnode's orders drop to the floor.

steps.label: Talk through every option with Daero
steps.detail: Talk to Daero in the bar on the first floor (east side) of the Grand Tree, working through every dialogue option in turn, to be teleported to a new location.

steps.label: Talk to Daero inside the hangar
steps.detail: Talk (not "travel") to Daero again, now inside the hangar.

steps.label: Solve the hangar sliding puzzle
steps.detail: Click the panel in the south-eastern hangar and solve the sliding puzzle, or alternatively pay Glough back at the Stronghold to solve it for you.

steps.label: Fly to Crash Island
steps.detail: Watch the cutscene, then talk to Daero, then to Waydar, to fly to Crash Island.

hints.note: Yes

steps.label: Speak to Lumdo
steps.detail: Talk to Lumdo on Crash Island.

steps.label: Have Waydar convince Lumdo
steps.detail: Talk (not "travel") to Waydar twice so he convinces Lumdo to follow orders.

hints.note: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island.

steps.label: Sail to Ape Atoll
steps.detail: Talk to Lumdo again to travel west to Ape Atoll.

steps.label: Enter the valley and get arrested
steps.detail: Follow the red path into the valley on Ape Atoll. You'll be shot and arrested by the guards.

steps.label: Pick the cell lock and escape
steps.detail: Watch the guards' patrol pattern, pick the lock on your cell door with a lockpick, and escape. Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards, even while inside the cell.

steps.label: Talk to Garkor
steps.detail: Follow the green path and talk to Garkor, completing the full dialogue (skipping it means Zooknock won't give the m'speak amulet later).

steps.label: Find the monkey dentures
steps.detail: Follow the blue path to the U-shaped building and enter through the southern door, staying on the dark-brown floor to avoid alerting guards. Search the stacked crates on the light-brown floor for Monkey dentures.

steps.label: Fall into the cave below
steps.detail: Heal up first (fall damage applies), then search the south-eastern crate to fall into a cave below.

steps.label: Find the M'amulet mould
steps.detail: Search the north-western crates in the cave for a M'amulet mould, then you may teleport away safely.

steps.label: Mine a gold ore
steps.detail: Mine a gold ore (Mining 40, pickaxe) at a gold rock. Exact nearest rock to the quest's travel path is unconfirmed this pass ("??") — any gold rock works, this is a generic material, not a quest-location-specific one.

steps.label: Smelt the gold bar
steps.detail: Smelt the gold ore into a gold bar at any furnace (Smithing 40, boostable), or cast Superheat Item (Magic 43) to skip the furnace trip.

steps.label: Shear a sheep for wool
steps.detail: Shear a sheep with a pair of shears to collect wool — any sheep pen near your bank works (e.g. Lumbridge or Falador).

steps.label: Spin the wool into a ball
steps.detail: Spin the wool into a ball of wool on a spinning wheel (Crafting 1).

steps.label: Descend into the Ape Atoll Dungeon
steps.detail: Resupply at a bank (good food, prayer/antipoison/stamina potions), return to Ape Atoll via Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo, follow the yellow path west, and climb down the ladder into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

steps.label: Fight through to Zooknock
steps.detail: Run through the dungeon to Zooknock, keeping Protect from Melee active against the level-98 Monkey Zombies and level-142 Skeletons, eating and drinking potions as needed.

steps.label: Speak to Zooknock
steps.detail: Talk to Zooknock, the exiled monkey blacksmith.

steps.label: Have Zooknock forge the enchanted bar
steps.detail: Use your Monkey dentures, M'amulet mould, and gold bar on Zooknock, then talk to him to receive the Enchanted bar and get your mould back. Do not give him the mould a second time once you already have the bar, or he'll keep it.

steps.label: Reach the temple with the wall of flames
steps.detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo). Follow the red path, get arrested and escape again, then follow the pink path to the temple. Bearded guards can't be walked through — enter the trapdoor, then navigate via the ladder to avoid the gorillas.

steps.label: Forge the M'speak amulet
steps.detail: With the M'amulet mould in your inventory, use the Enchanted bar with the wall of flames, then string the result with your ball of wool to create the M'speak amulet.

steps.label: Head to the Monkey child's house
steps.detail: Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the Monkey child's house. Watch for the Monkey's Aunt — it's only safe in the garden while she's away.

steps.label: Convince the monkey child
steps.detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to the monkey child, then talk to him twice more to trigger "Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!"

hints.note: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle! -> How many bananas did Aunty want?

steps.label: Pick 5 bananas
steps.detail: Pick 5 bananas from the trees in the garden.

steps.label: Deliver the bananas
steps.detail: Give the bananas to the monkey child, leave the garden, wait for the aunt to pass through, then talk to him again to receive a Monkey talisman.

steps.label: Return to Zooknock for the greegree
steps.detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo), resupply at a bank, and follow the yellow path down into the Ape Atoll Dungeon again.

steps.label: Trade for a greegree
steps.detail: Give Zooknock a Monkey talisman and Monkey bones from a regular monkey (not another type) to receive a Greegree. Be careful not to accidentally bury the bones, and don't leave the Zooknock dialogue early or you'll have to restart the cutscene.

steps.label: Prepare at the Ardougne Zoo
steps.detail: Head to the Ardougne Zoo, equip the Karamjan monkey greegree, and talk to the Monkey minder (click through any first-time dialogue).

steps.label: Bag a monkey
steps.detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to a nearby monkey so it jumps into your bag. Remove the greegree and speak to the minder again.

steps.label: Walk back to Ape Atoll on foot
steps.detail: Travel by foot (walk or run) back to the Grand Tree — do not use any teleportation method — then return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.

steps.label: Reach King Awowogei
steps.detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree — Ape Atoll is no longer hostile while wearing it. Follow the red path through the gates, talk to Garkor, then the nearby Elder Guard, then head to the west coast, climb the hill, cross the bridge, and talk to Kruk.

steps.label: Speak with King Awowogei
steps.detail: Talk to Awowogei twice, then talk to the Elder Guard again to be let out.

steps.label: Receive the 10th squad sigil
steps.detail: Talk to Garkor and watch the cutscene, then talk to him again to receive the 10th squad sigil.

steps.label: Prepare for the Jungle Demon
steps.detail: Prepare combat equipment for the final fight — good food, prayer potions, and high-healing food are strongly recommended.

steps.label: Defeat the Jungle Demon
steps.detail: Equip the 10th squad sigil, then fight the Jungle Demon. Use Protect from Magic and stay out of melee range to minimise damage.

steps.label: Report victory to King Narnode
steps.detail: Return to the Grand Tree and talk to King Narnode Shareen to complete the quest.

checkpoints.label: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle

steps.label: Talk to the Cook (start Cook's Assistant)
steps.detail: The Cook is in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen, panicking over the Duke's birthday cake. Agree to fetch a bucket of milk, an egg, and a pot of flour for him.

steps.label: Grab an empty bucket in the castle cellar
steps.detail: An empty bucket sits in the Lumbridge Castle cellar (basement); pick it up before heading out to the cow field.

steps.label: Milk a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): use the bucket on a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field, just south of the castle.

steps.label: Pick up an egg at the chicken coop
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): an egg spawns at the chicken coop north-west of the cow field; pick one up.

steps.label: Grab an empty pot from the Cook
steps.detail: A spare empty pot sits by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.

steps.label: Pick grain from the wheat field by Mill Lane Mill
steps.detail: Grain grows in the wheat field just outside Mill Lane Mill, next to the cow pens.

steps.label: Mill the grain into a pot of flour
steps.detail: Climb to the top floor of Mill Lane Mill, use the grain on the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb back down and take the flour from the flour bin using the empty pot.

steps.label: Deliver the milk, egg, and flour to the Cook
steps.detail: Bring the bucket of milk, egg, and pot of flour to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen and hand them over to finish the quest.

checkpoints.label: Gather the three ingredients (milk, egg, flour)

notes: GE-violation FIX applied: the wiki's own Walkthrough lists 'Buy from the Grand Exchange' as the first ingredient-sourcing option ahead of 'Create them yourself' -- modeled the gather/produce path for all three ingredients (milk from a dairy cow, egg from the coop, flour milled from wheat-field grain) per the hard rule, dropping the GE-buy sentence entirely. Coordinates for the cow field, chicken coop, and wheat field come from the Quick guide's own inline map markers; the mill building's own tile is inferred from the first (unlabeled) marker in that same cluster.

steps.label: Talk to Kaqemeex (start Druidic Ritual)
steps.detail: Kaqemeex stands in the stone circle north of Taverley; agree to help the druids reclaim the ritual site.

mapMarkers.label: Kaqemeex, stone circle N of Taverley

steps.label: Talk to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop
steps.detail: Sanfew is upstairs in Taverley's Herb shop; he explains the meat-enchanting ritual and asks for four raw meats.

steps.label: Kill a bear for raw bear meat
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'these meats can all be bought on the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a bear near the building just west of Ice Mountain.

steps.label: Kill a chicken for raw chicken
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a chicken at the farm just south-east of Falador.

steps.label: Kill a cow for raw beef
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): the same farm south-east of Falador also has a cow.

steps.label: Kill a giant rat for raw rat meat
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill the giant rat near the graveyard just north of the church below Port Sarim.

steps.label: Go to the Cauldron in Taverley Dungeon
steps.detail: Enter Taverley Dungeon and head to the Cauldron room.

steps.label: Enchant the four meats on the Cauldron
steps.detail: Use each of the four raw meats (bear, rat, beef, chicken) on the Cauldron one at a time to enchant them. The Quick guide doesn't name the resulting item(s) distinctly from the raw meats -- treated as a 1:1 transform per meat, flagged "??" on exact post-enchant item naming.

steps.label: Return the enchanted meats to Sanfew
steps.detail: Bring the four enchanted meats back to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop.

steps.label: Return to Kaqemeex to finish the quest
steps.detail: Talk to Kaqemeex at the stone circle north of Taverley to complete Druidic Ritual and unlock Herblore training.

mapMarkers.label: Kaqemeex, stone circle N of Taverley

notes: GE-violation FIX applied: the wiki's own 'Acquiring the meat' section says all four meats 'can all be bought on the Grand Exchange' as its first sentence -- modeled the gather/kill path instead per the hard rule, using the section's own non-Lands-End alternative spawns (bear west of Ice Mountain, chicken+cow at the farm SE of Falador, giant rat near the graveyard N of the church below Port Sarim) since the Lands End option is gated behind X Marks the Spot, an unlisted requirement for this quest. The Quick guide's Walkthrough never names a distinct enchanted-meat item -- flagged "??" rather than invented; modeled as a straight 4:4 transform on the Cauldron.

steps.label: Talk to King Roald (start Priest in Peril)
steps.detail: King Roald is in Varrock Palace; ask about a quest and he sends you to check on the missing priest Drezel.

steps.label: Go to the temple east of Varrock, by the river
steps.detail: Bring a ranged or melee weapon -- magic attacks and the Dwarf multicannon will not damage the Temple Guardian ahead.

steps.label: Fight past the Temple Guardian
steps.detail: Click the large door, climb down the trapdoor to the north, then kill the Temple Guardian blocking the way.

hints.value: east-wall-middle-section
hints.note: Get it stuck in the middle section against the east wall, then stand one tile north on the east wall to safespot.

steps.label: Report back to King Roald
steps.detail: Go back to Varrock Palace and speak to King Roald again before returning to the temple.

steps.label: Gather 25 unnoted essence
steps.detail: Collect 25 unnoted pure or rune essence, plus a bucket, a weapon, and 1 free inventory slot. The Quick guide doesn't cite a specific essence-mine route here -- flagged "??". Low-level players may need two trips; the Monk of Zamorak ahead can be safespotted over the pews with ranged or magic.

steps.label: Climb to Drezel's cell and talk to him
steps.detail: Enter the temple again, go up the stairs then the ladder to the 2nd floor, and talk to Drezel through the cell bars.

steps.label: Kill the Monk of Zamorak for a golden key
steps.detail: Kill the level 30 Monk of Zamorak on the 1st floor of the temple to obtain a golden key.

steps.label: Study the monuments for the one that takes the golden key
steps.detail: Go back to the trapdoor where the Temple Guardian was fought, climb down, go through the first door, and check the monuments until finding the one the golden key fits.

hints.note: Which monument is the correct one isn't specified in the Quick guide -- check each until it fits.

steps.label: Use the golden key on the monument
steps.detail: Use the golden key on the correct monument to open it. The Quick guide doesn't explicitly narrate where the Iron key (used later on Drezel's cell door) comes from -- modeled as the contents of this monument since it's the only sourced key between here and the cell door; flagged for confirmation.

steps.label: Fill the bucket at the well among the monuments
steps.detail: Use the bucket on the well in the middle of the monument room. The Quick guide calls the result a 'blessed bucket of water' with no separate blessing step shown -- flagged "??" on the exact trigger, modeled as produced directly by filling the bucket here.

steps.label: Unlock Drezel's cell and pour the water on the coffin
steps.detail: Go back up to the top floor where Drezel is held. Use the Iron key on the cell door, talk to Drezel, then use the blessed bucket of water on the coffin in his cell.

steps.label: Talk to Drezel again to start The River Salve
steps.detail: Speak to Drezel once more at his cell to move into the final segment.

steps.label: Go through the monument room's eastern door and talk to Drezel
steps.detail: Go back down the trapdoor, through the monument room, and through the eastern door; Drezel is waiting there.

steps.label: Gather 50 unnoted essence for Drezel
steps.detail: Collect 50 unnoted pure or rune essence to hand over; without essence pouches this takes a few trips.

steps.label: Give Drezel the 50 essence to finish the quest
steps.detail: Hand the 50 unnoted essence to Drezel to complete Priest in Peril and unlock Morytania.

checkpoints.label: Priest in Peril: start -> Temple Guardian
The vampyre (essence, golden key, iron key, coffin)

notes: 0 GE-violation flags -- no Grand Exchange language anywhere in the fetched Quick guide sections. Two honest "??" gaps left rather than fabricated: (1) the Iron key's exact source isn't narrated by the Quick guide text, modeled as the contents of the golden-key monument since that's the only sourced key in the sequence; (2) the 'blessed' transformation of the bucket of water has no separate blessing step in the fetched text, modeled as produced directly by the well-fill action. Essence-gathering location (mine/route) is not specified by this quest's own walkthrough -- left as a generic gather atom rather than asserting a specific route from memory.

steps.label: Talk to Asgarnia Smith at Bedabin Camp (start Desert Treasure)
steps.detail: Asgarnia Smith stands by the magic carpet at Bedabin Camp; bring at least one free inventory slot and agree to help him.

steps.label: Gather the starting materials Eblis needs
steps.detail: Assemble 650 coins, ashes, a blood rune, bones, 6 molten glass, 12 magic logs, charcoal, and 6 steel bars via non-GE routes: bones from any kill, molten glass crafted from bucket-of-sand + soda-ash in a furnace, steel bars smithed from iron ore + coal, ashes from burning any logs. Blood rune sourcing (Runecrafting at the Blood Altar, or a monster drop) and magic-log sourcing (Woodcutting 75 on magic trees) and charcoal sourcing are not detailed in this quest's own Quick guide -- flagged "??", genuine gaps for Lane 5 rather than a GE substitution.

steps.label: Get the book translated at the Digsite Exam Centre
steps.detail: Go to the Digsite Exam Centre and talk to Terry Balando about the Desert Treasure quest, then talk to him again for a translation.

steps.label: Show the translated book to Asgarnia Smith
steps.detail: Return to Asgarnia Smith in the desert; tell him not to read the book, then talk to him again to have him help you.

steps.label: Buy a drink at the Bandit Camp bar and ask about the diamonds
steps.detail: Run south to the Bandit Camp and buy a drink in the pub for 650 coins (remove any Saradomin/Zamorak items first so the bandits don't attack). Talk to the bartender again and ask about the four diamonds.

steps.label: Talk to Eblis about the four diamonds
steps.detail: Find Eblis in or just outside the small rectangular building east of the bar; ask about the four diamonds of Azzanadra and agree to fetch them.

steps.label: Deliver the gathered supplies to Eblis
steps.detail: Use each required item (ashes, blood rune, bones, molten glass, magic logs, charcoal, steel bars) on Eblis, then talk to him again. Items can remain noted for this delivery.

steps.label: Follow Eblis to the mirrors and begin the diamond hunt
steps.detail: Go south-east to the mirrors and talk to Eblis there. The four diamonds (Smoke, Shadow, Ice, Blood) can be collected in any order; watch for a level 95 stranger who may randomly ambush you with a poisoned dragon dagger while carrying a diamond -- bank or place diamonds in the pyramid to avoid it.

steps.label: Equip a facemask or gas mask
steps.detail: Equip a facemask, gas mask, or Slayer helmet before entering the Smoke Dungeon.

steps.label: Light the four torches and grab the warm key
steps.detail: Enter the Smoke Dungeon (west of Pollnivneach, east of the mirrors). Light all four standing torches, one per corner, and open the centre chest for the warm key before any torch burns out. Starting NE then SE, NW, SW with 100% run avoids needing stamina potions.

steps.label: Unlock the gate and kill Fareed for the Smoke diamond
steps.detail: Use the warm key to open the gate east, then kill Fareed. Ice gloves are needed to wield melee gear (ranged works unarmoured but ash-es arrows), and only water spells damage him with Magic.

hints.value: protect-from-melee+water-spells-or-ranged
hints.note: Protect from Melee strongly advised; attack with a water spell or any ranged ammo.

steps.label: Talk to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls
steps.detail: Rasolo is outside his house south of Baxtorian Falls; ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

steps.label: Gather 20+ lockpicks and antipoison
steps.detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own coin-exchange shortcut (flagged GE-violation): pickpocket bandits in the Bandit Camp vicinity for lockpicks and antipoison instead of exchanging noted coins with Tiles' general store.

steps.label: Pick the secure chest and give the gilded cross to Rasolo
steps.detail: In the southernmost Bandit Camp tent, pick all 3 locks on the secure chest consecutively (can take many tries, faster at higher Thieving) to get the gilded cross. Bring it back to Rasolo, who swaps it for a visibility ring even with a full inventory.

steps.label: Equip the visibility ring and climb down
steps.detail: Equip the visibility ring, then climb down the ladder east of Rasolo in the fenced area.

steps.label: Kill Damis (both forms) for the Shadow diamond
steps.detail: Run through the dungeon and kill Damis in both of his forms, then pick up the shadow diamond. His second form drains Prayer rapidly.

hints.value: stack-npcs-behind
hints.note: Safespot by hitting a bat or rat and stacking NPCs behind you; don't run too far out of his range or he resets.

steps.label: Gather sweet food and spiked boots
steps.detail: Bring any sweet food from the Troll child's list, plus fire-spell runes. Get spiked boots from Dunstan by giving him a pair of climbing boots and an iron bar.

steps.label: Give the troll child sweet food and enter the ice gate
steps.detail: North-west of Trollheim, use the sweet food on the troll child, talk to it, then enter the ice gate.

steps.label: Kill 5 ice trolls
steps.detail: Kill 5 ice trolls guarding the gate; you won't need to re-kill them if you teleport out and return.

steps.label: Follow the path and kill Kamil
steps.detail: Enter the cave, follow the path, then fight Kamil. Only fire spells damage him with Magic (Iban Blast, Flames of Zamorak, and the trident's built-in spell do not work); your stats are constantly drained during the fight.

hints.value: protect-from-magic-then-melee
hints.note: Approach with Protect from Magic to force him to teleport into range, then switch to Protect from Melee.

steps.label: Wear spiked boots, cross the ice ledge, and free the frozen trolls
steps.detail: Continue west along the long icy path. Wear spiked boots to climb the ice ledge, follow the new path, go through the gate, then use a fire spell on each troll frozen in ice. Talk to them for the Ice diamond.

steps.label: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub
steps.detail: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub about the special diamond; ask how to kill Dessous.

steps.label: Gather a silver bar, spice, and garlic powder
steps.detail: Smelt a silver bar (silver ore in a furnace). Garlic can be searched from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house in Draynor; grind it with a pestle and mortar for garlic powder.

steps.label: Get a silver pot made and enchanted
steps.detail: Travel to the Draynor Sewer and give Ruantun the silver bar for a silver pot. Take the pot to the High Priest in the Entrana church (Entrana bans combat equipment) and he enchants it.

steps.label: Talk to Malak again
steps.detail: Return to Malak in the Canifis pub. He deals 5 damage during this conversation but cannot kill you.

steps.label: Add spice and garlic powder to the pot of blood
steps.detail: Add the spice and garlic powder to the pot Malak gives you to create a pot of blood. Prepare combat gear and prayer/healing supplies before the boss fight ahead.

steps.label: Pour the blood on the tomb and kill Dessous
steps.detail: Go to the Morytania Graveyard north of Castle Drakan, pour the pot of blood on the tomb, and defeat Dessous. He has 99 Defence and strong slash resistance -- range or mage him, alternating Protect from Melee/Missiles each tick to avoid damage.

steps.label: Return to Malak and claim the Blood diamond
steps.detail: Go back to Malak in the Canifis pub and claim the blood diamond. You keep the blessed pot even after leaving the fight (a new pot of blood is only needed if you leave mid-fight).

steps.label: Place a diamond in each of the pyramid's obelisks
steps.detail: Go south-east of Eblis and place the smoke, shadow, ice, and blood diamonds in the pyramid's obelisks.

steps.label: Enter the pyramid and run each floor without stopping
steps.detail: Enter the pyramid from the top and run through each floor without stopping -- traps may still trigger and can send you back to the start regardless. Mummies and Scarabs can hit over 20.

steps.label: Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest
steps.detail: Talk to Azzanadra at the end of the pyramid to complete Desert Treasure and unlock the Ancient Magicks spellbook. Praying at his altar twice afterward unlocks a hard Desert-area task.

checkpoints.label: Starting out (Bedabin Camp -> Digsite -> Bandit Camp -> Eblis)

notes: GE-violation FIX applied to one spot: the Shadow diamond section's own text offers exchanging noted coins with Tiles' general store for lockpicks (5gp each) as its primary route -- modeled the pickpocket-bandits alternative it also names instead, per the hard rule. Several starting-material and supply items (blood rune, magic logs 12x, charcoal, ashes count, bones count, antipoison, spice) have no sourcing method stated anywhere in the fetched Quick-guide sections -- left "??" rather than invented; flagged as genuine supply-chain gaps for Lane 5, not GE substitutions (the source text simply lists them as required items, it never says 'buy'). Dig-spot/monument-style exact tiles are not given by this quest's Quick guide at all (prose directions only, e.g. 'east of the mirrors', 'north-west of Trollheim') -- no coordinate markers were available to cite, unlike Cook's Assistant/Druidic Ritual. Phase-split into the quest's own 6 walkthrough sections (Starting out + 4 diamonds + Ancient Pyramid) per the design doc's Multiquest lever, matching the source's own structure 1:1.

The Feud -- granular walkthrough. No real GE-violations found (all 'buy' mentions are NPC shop purchases -- disguise parts, beers, camels, sauce -- never the Grand Exchange). Two genuine sourcing gaps left "??" because the wiki walkthrough is silent on them: the oak blackjack (feud-15) and the mayor's-house keys (feud-21) both appear mid-sequence with no stated acquisition, flagged for Lane 5 rather than invented.

steps.label: Talk to Ali Morrisane about his stock problems
steps.detail: Talk to Ali Morrisane next to the Silk Stall in northern Al Kharid; ask why he's still selling from a stall to trigger the quest start.

hints.note: start: ask about his stock problems

steps.label: Obtain a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard
steps.detail: Buy a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard (NPC clothing stock in Al Kharid, not the Grand Exchange).

steps.label: Combine the headpiece and beard into a desert disguise
steps.detail: Use the kharidian headpiece on the fake beard to combine them into a desert disguise for the Pollnivneach infiltration later.

steps.label: Travel to Pollnivneach
steps.detail: Head south to Pollnivneach to begin the local investigation.

steps.label: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman
steps.detail: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman at the Pollnivneach bar (NPC purchase).

steps.label: Ply Drunken Ali with 3 beers
steps.detail: Use one beer on Drunken Ali at the bar, talk through the full dialogue, then repeat with the second and third beers -- do not skip any dialogue between beers.

steps.label: Question the bandits and the Menaphite Thugs
steps.detail: Talk to the bandits by the general store, then head west of the bar and question the Menaphite Thugs.

steps.label: Travel to the camel store
steps.detail: Head to the camel store just north-west of the bar.

steps.label: Buy 2 camels from Ali the Camel Man
steps.detail: Talk to Ali the Camel Man and buy 2 camels for 500 coins (NPC purchase); keep 2 free inventory slots first.

hints.note: haggle to 500 gold for the pair

steps.label: Deliver camel receipts
steps.detail: Talk to a Menaphite and a bandit, handing each of them a camel receipt.

steps.label: Join Ali the Operator's gang
steps.detail: Go to the large purple tent south-west of the bar and ask Ali the Operator to join his gang.

steps.label: Demonstrate a pickpocket attempt
steps.detail: Attempt to pickpocket a villager once (as a demonstration), then return to Ali the Operator for advice.

steps.label: Pay the street urchin for a tip
steps.detail: Talk to the street urchin near the centre town well and pay him 10 coins for a tip on which villager to target.

steps.label: Pickpocket the marked villager
steps.detail: Pickpocket the villager with an arrow marker over their head (the urchin's tip-off), then report back to Ali the Operator.

steps.label: Obtain an oak blackjack
steps.detail: Obtain an oak blackjack before continuing -- the walkthrough does not state an explicit source here ("??"); it is most likely supplied on joining Ali the Operator's gang, otherwise buy one from a Pollnivneach blackjack seller.

steps.label: Equip the oak blackjack
steps.detail: Equip the oak blackjack before approaching a villager.

steps.label: Blackjack and pickpocket a villager
steps.detail: Lure a villager into a secluded area, knock them out with the equipped oak blackjack, then pickpocket them while they're unconscious.

steps.label: Report success, move to the jewels task
steps.detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to move on to the jewel-theft task.

steps.label: Equip the desert disguise and gloves
steps.detail: Put on the desert disguise (made earlier) and a pair of gloves before infiltrating the mayor's house.

steps.label: Hide behind the cactus near the mayor's house
steps.detail: Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house, the large house to the east by the fountain.

steps.label: Obtain the mayor's house keys
steps.detail: Obtain the keys to the mayor's house -- the walkthrough does not state exactly how they're acquired here ("??"); they appear to be picked up automatically during the hide-behind-the-cactus sequence.

steps.label: Enter the house and find the hidden dial
steps.detail: Use the keys on the door, go up the stairs in the north-eastern corner, then search the landscape picture near the bed to reveal a hidden dial.

steps.label: Crack the dial and take the jewels
steps.detail: Hit the button on the dial to reset it, then click 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 in that exact clockwise order to open the safe and take the jewels.

steps.label: Hand over the jewels
steps.detail: Give the recovered jewels to Ali the Operator.

steps.label: Chase down the traitor lead
steps.detail: Talk to Ali the Operator, then a Menaphite Thug, then Ali the Operator again, then Ali the Barman about "Traitorous Ali" -- a fixed dialogue chase with no branching outcome.

steps.label: Buy special kebab sauce
steps.detail: Buy special sauce from the kebab seller north-west of the well in the middle of town (NPC purchase).

steps.label: Sabotage the trough behind the camel shop
steps.detail: Use the special sauce on the trough behind the camel shop.

steps.label: Collect Ugthanki dung
steps.detail: Use a bucket on the dung behind the camel shop once it has turned brown; scoop 3 extra buckets of dung if also planning My Arm's Big Adventure later.

steps.label: Get a snake charm and basket
steps.detail: Use a coin on the snake charmer's money pot south of the bar, with 2 free inventory slots, to receive a snake charm and a snake basket.

hints.note: ask for a go with the snake charm

steps.label: Capture a desert snake
steps.detail: Use the snake charm repeatedly on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent until it goes into the snake basket.

steps.label: Travel to Ali the Hag
steps.detail: Head to Ali the Hag, north-west of the kebab seller.

steps.label: Trade the snake and dung for hag's poison
steps.detail: Talk to Ali the Hag twice, handing over the filled snake basket and the Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison.

steps.label: Poison the beer table
steps.detail: Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.

steps.label: Report the traitor
steps.detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to report what was found.

steps.label: Prepare for battle and confront the Menaphite Leader
steps.detail: Gear up for combat, then talk to the Menaphite Leader just outside the tent.

steps.label: Kill the Tough Guy for a willow blackjack
steps.detail: Kill the level-75 Tough Guy from a safe-spot behind the bush; he drops a willow blackjack.

steps.label: Find and question the Bandit Leader
steps.detail: Talk to a villager, then find and talk to the Bandit Leader, who wanders near the northern magic carpet station.

steps.label: Kill the bandit champion for an adamant scimitar
steps.detail: Kill the level-70 bandit champion from a safe-spot behind the chair in the house to the east, while holding the willow blackjack; he drops an adamant scimitar.

steps.label: Report to Ali the Mayor
steps.detail: Talk to a villager, then talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in the village centre.

steps.label: Return to Ali Morrisane to finish the quest
steps.detail: Return to Ali Morrisane, who you started the quest with, to complete The Feud.

notes: Fairytale I - Growing Pains -- granular walkthrough. No real GE-violation: the only 'GE' mention in the source is the Grand Exchange spirit tree used as a fast-travel hop to the Gnome Stronghold (ft1-05), matching the established fast-travel/non-violation taxonomy, not an item-sourcing shortcut. The dramen/Lunar staff's own acquisition (ft1-11) sits outside this quest's walkthrough entirely and is left "??". The 3 random collection items (ft1-19) are inherently randomised per playthrough per the source's own text.

steps.label: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener
steps.detail: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village to start the quest.

hints.note: start: ask about the failing farm patches

steps.label: Obtain secateurs and a spade if missing
steps.detail: If you don't already have secateurs or a spade, buy them from Sarah in the building next to the Draynor cabbage patch (NPC purchase).

steps.label: Confirm membership with Elstan
steps.detail: Run north-west and talk to Elstan at the allotment/flower/herb patch; confirm he's a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners.

steps.label: Confirm membership with Frizzy Skernip
steps.detail: Run south and talk to Frizzy Skernip; confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

steps.label: Travel to the Gnome Stronghold
steps.detail: Take the spirit tree network (the Grand Exchange spirit tree is the fastest hop) to the Gnome Stronghold, then run east.

steps.label: Confirm membership with Bolongo
steps.detail: Talk to Bolongo and confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

steps.label: Confirm membership with Prissy Scilla
steps.detail: Run south-west to the tree patch and talk to Prissy Scilla; confirm her membership.

steps.label: Travel to Falador Park
steps.detail: Teleport to Falador (Ring of wealth's Falador option lands directly in the park) and run to the tree patch.

steps.label: Confirm membership with Heskel
steps.detail: Talk to Heskel at the Falador Park tree patch; confirm his membership -- this completes the 5-gardener tally.

steps.label: Report back to Martin
steps.detail: Return to the Draynor Village market and talk to Martin again to move the quest forward.

steps.label: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff
steps.detail: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff -- required to enter Zanaris; source of the staff itself is outside this quest's own walkthrough ("??" if not already owned from Lost City).

steps.label: Travel to Zanaris
steps.detail: Enter the small shack south of Lumbridge Castle in Lumbridge Swamp with the staff equipped to teleport to Zanaris; if the quest spade still needs collecting, enter once without the staff equipped first to grab it.

steps.label: Ask the Fairy Godfather about the Fairy Queen
steps.detail: Run to the throne room and talk to the Fairy Godfather; ask where the Fairy Queen is.

steps.label: Get the symptoms list from Fairy Nuff
steps.detail: Run north of the bank and talk to Fairy Nuff to receive the Fairy Queen's symptoms list.

steps.label: Consult Zandar Horfyre
steps.detail: Speak to Zandar Horfyre on the top floor of the Dark Wizards' Tower, just north of the Makeover Mage.

steps.label: Fill a druid pouch (recommended)
steps.detail: Fill a druid pouch before collecting the 3 random items -- it protects any of them that ghasts could otherwise turn to rotten food. Recommended, not strictly required.

steps.label: Dig up a Draynor skull if needed
steps.detail: If you don't already have a Draynor skull, travel to Draynor Manor and use a spade on the grave north of the building, within the fence, to dig one up.

steps.label: Trade the skull for the collection list
steps.detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, the necromancer north-west of Port Sarim's rune shop; give him the Draynor skull to receive the list of 3 required items. Buy secateurs/spade from the nearby farm shop if still missing.

steps.label: Collect the 3 randomly-assigned items
steps.detail: Collect the 3 randomly-picked items per your quest journal's list -- the exact items vary per playthrough ("??"); carry the filled druid pouch while gathering any that ghasts could rot.

steps.label: Travel to the Nature Grotto
steps.detail: Travel to the Nature Grotto in Mort Myre Swamp via the Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, go west, then follow the winding path north over the bridge.

steps.label: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet
steps.detail: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet before entering the grotto so the Nature Spirit can be understood.

steps.label: Trade the items for the Magic secateurs
steps.detail: Talk to the Nature Spirit inside the grotto and hand over the 3 collected items to receive the Magic secateurs.

steps.label: Bring food and armour for the Tanglefoot fight
steps.detail: Bring food and armour before returning to Zanaris to face the Tanglefoot.

steps.label: Return to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs
steps.detail: Travel to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs in your inventory.

steps.label: Squeeze through the gap by the Cosmic Altar
steps.detail: Run south of the wheat fields to the Cosmic Altar and squeeze through the gap in the western wall.

steps.label: Equip the Magic secateurs
steps.detail: Equip the Magic secateurs before entering the tunnel.

steps.label: Defeat the Tanglefoot
steps.detail: Run to the end of the tunnel and defeat Tanglefoot; toggle Protect from Melee if the level allows, or lure it around the mushrooms to the east to flinch it.

steps.label: Pick up the Queen's secateurs
steps.detail: Pick up the Queen's secateurs dropped by Tanglefoot.

steps.label: Finish the quest with the Fairy Godfather
steps.detail: Talk to the Fairy Godfather to complete Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

notes: Bone Voyage -- granular walkthrough. No Grand Exchange mentions anywhere in the source; no GE-violation. Two supply items (2x vodka bottles, bv-15) have no sourcing method stated in this quest's own walkthrough and are left "??" (flagged for Lane 5); the Marrentill potion (unf) chain (bv-16..18) is modelled from first principles since the wiki assumes the player simply 'brings' it.

steps.label: Talk to Curator Haig Halen
steps.detail: Speak to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum and agree to help finish the barge.

hints.note: start: offer to help finish the barge

steps.label: Travel to the canal barge
steps.detail: Go to the canal barge north of the Digsite.

steps.label: Talk to the barge foreman
steps.detail: Talk to the barge foreman at the canal barge.

steps.label: Get the sawmill proposal
steps.detail: Talk to the sawmill operator in the Lumber Yard, explaining you're there on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

steps.label: Deliver the sawmill proposal
steps.detail: Bring the sawmill proposal to the sawmill operator in the Woodcutting Guild; if entry requirements aren't met, simply try opening the guild's eastern gate to satisfy this step.

steps.label: Deliver the signed agreement
steps.detail: Bring the sawmill agreement back to the Lumber Yard's sawmill operator.

steps.label: Report back to the barge foreman
steps.detail: Talk to the barge foreman again.

steps.label: Board the barge
steps.detail: Right-click the Embark option on the barge guard to board the barge.

steps.label: Talk to the Lead Navigator
steps.detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator aboard the barge.

steps.label: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn
steps.detail: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim.

steps.label: Ask Jack Seagull about cursed voyages
steps.detail: Talk to Jack Seagull in the Rusty Anchor Inn about cursed voyages.

steps.label: Re-board the barge
steps.detail: Return to the northern part of the Digsite and board the boat again through the barge guard.

steps.label: Talk to the Lead Navigator again
steps.detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator once more.

steps.label: Get the Bone charm from the Odd Old Man
steps.detail: Deboard, walk west then north then east to the limestone mine, and speak to the Odd Old Man about lucky charms and the cursed voyage; he gives a Bone charm.

steps.label: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka
steps.detail: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka -- the walkthrough does not state a sourcing method here ("??"); no Grand Exchange purchase is used regardless.

steps.label: Gather a marrentill herb
steps.detail: Gather a marrentill herb (Herblore farming patch or a common secondary monster drop).

steps.label: Fill a vial with water
steps.detail: Fill an empty vial with water from any water source.

steps.label: Make a Marrentill potion (unf)
steps.detail: Use the marrentill herb on the vial of water to produce a Marrentill potion (unf).

steps.label: Bring the vodka and potion to the Apothecary
steps.detail: Bring the 2 vodka bottles and the Marrentill potion (unf) to the Apothecary in Varrock; select 'Talk about something else' then 'Talk about Bone Voyage'.

steps.label: Receive the potion of sealegs
steps.detail: Speak to the Apothecary again, selecting the same chat options as before, to receive the potion of sealegs.

steps.label: Deliver the potion of sealegs
steps.detail: Return to the Lead Navigator and give him the potion of sealegs.

steps.label: Hand over the bone charm and depart
steps.detail: Speak to the Junior Navigator, give him the bone charm, and confirm you're ready to go.

steps.label: Steer the barge to Fossil Island
steps.detail: Click the arrow opposite whichever way the top arrow tilts to correct course, and keep the sails as large as possible in a straight line for steadier travel, until the progress bar fills and you arrive at Fossil Island.

notes: Swan Song -- granular walkthrough. No Grand Exchange mentions anywhere in the source; no GE-violation. The bones-vs-big-bones drop-table trap (swan-06/swan-15) is called out explicitly per the source's own note (early Sea Troll kills drop usable bones, later kills drop big bones that don't count). Bone seeds' exact quantity (swan-29) is left unspecified/null ("??" equivalent) since the source never states a count.

steps.label: Talk to Herman Caranos
steps.detail: Talk to Herman Caranos at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, north of fairy ring code AKQ; the offered cutscene is optional.

hints.note: start: agree to fight the sea trolls

steps.label: Gather blood, mist, and lava runes
steps.detail: Gather 5 blood runes, 10 mist runes, and 10 lava runes before visiting the Wise Old Man.

steps.label: Talk to the Wise Old Man
steps.detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village, handing over the gathered runes.

steps.label: Bring combat supplies for the Sea Trolls
steps.detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, and prayer potions to fight the Sea Trolls guarding the colony.

steps.label: Return to the Colony with the Wise Old Man
steps.detail: Return to the Fishing Colony and talk to the Wise Old Man.

steps.label: Fight through the Sea Trolls into the Colony
steps.detail: Kill the level-79 Sea Trolls blocking the entrance and collect 7 of their bones if needed for later; note that after 1-3 kills the trolls switch to dropping only big bones, which don't count toward that requirement.

steps.label: Talk to Herman in the east building
steps.detail: Talk to Herman inside the east building -- click inside the building itself, not directly on Herman, or your character will run back outside.

steps.label: Gather repair materials
steps.detail: Bring logs, a tinderbox (or get one from Franklin), 5 iron bars, a hammer (or get one from Franklin), a small fishing net (or get one from Arnold), and level-boosting items if below Fishing 62 or Smithing 45.

steps.label: Talk to Franklin Caranos
steps.detail: Talk to Franklin Caranos near the colony entrance to begin repairs.

steps.label: Light the firebox
steps.detail: Use a log on the firebox -- not the furnace -- and light it, inside the building marked with the furnace symbol; Franklin supplies a tinderbox if asked again.

steps.label: Press iron sheets
steps.detail: Use each of the 5 iron bars on the Metal Press to produce iron sheets.

steps.label: Repair the western perimeter wall
steps.detail: Use the iron sheets to repair the western colony perimeter's broken walls; Franklin supplies a hammer if asked.

steps.label: Talk to Arnold Lydspor
steps.detail: Talk to Arnold Lydspor in the bank; he supplies a small fishing net if you don't already have one.

steps.label: Fish 5 fresh monkfish
steps.detail: Fish 5 fresh monkfish at the spot to the north-west, catching a few extra in case some burn while cooking.

steps.label: Optionally fight spawning Sea Trolls
steps.detail: Optionally kill Sea Trolls as they spawn nearby while fishing; after 1-3 kills they only drop big bones, which no longer count toward the earlier bones requirement.

steps.label: Cook the monkfish
steps.detail: Cook the monkfish in the kitchen south of the fishing spot; note that Arnold's bank cannot be used to access cooking gauntlets here.

steps.label: Deliver the cooked monkfish to Arnold
steps.detail: Talk to Arnold and hand over the cooked monkfish.

steps.label: Report back to Franklin
steps.detail: Talk to Franklin again.

steps.label: Report to the Wise Old Man and Herman
steps.detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman in the far eastern building.

steps.label: Gather bones, an airtight pot, and a brown apron
steps.detail: Gather 7 bones (from the earlier Sea Troll kills), an airtight pot OR a pot with a pot lid, and a brown apron (or ask Malignius for one); if not banking afterward also bring food, armour, a weapon, and prayer potions.

steps.label: Travel to the Wizards' Guild basement
steps.detail: Travel to the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille; the Nightmare Zone minigame teleport is needed to leave the colony first.

steps.label: Talk to Wizard Frumscone
steps.detail: Talk to Wizard Frumscone and agree to help the necromancer.

steps.label: Portal to the Dark Wizards' Tower
steps.detail: Use the southern portal on the guild's 2nd floor to teleport to the Dark Wizards' Tower, near Malignius Mortifer.

steps.label: Get a brown apron from Malignius Mortifer
steps.detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, south of Falador, about saving the fishing colony; receive a brown apron for Crafting Guild entry.

steps.label: Talk to the Master Crafter
steps.detail: Talk to the Master Crafter with dreadlocks on the east side of the Crafting Guild.

steps.label: Make a pot and pot lid
steps.detail: If carrying soft clay, use it on the potter's wheel then the potter's oven to produce a pot and pot lid; if carrying a pickaxe instead, mine clay first then follow the same steps.

steps.label: Assemble the airtight pot
steps.detail: Combine the pot and pot lid into an airtight pot.

steps.label: Remove Saradomin-affiliated gear
steps.detail: Remove any Saradomin-affiliated gear before continuing -- Malignius refuses to hand over bone seeds while it's worn or held, and dropping gear here isn't advisable since you'll be teleported away shortly.

steps.label: Collect bone seeds and teleport back
steps.detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer to receive the bone seeds and teleport back to the Fishing Colony.

steps.label: Bring supplies for the Final Battle
steps.detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, prayer potions, and the bone seeds to the final fight.

steps.label: Begin the fight with Herman
steps.detail: Talk to Herman to begin the final battle.

steps.label: Defeat the Sea Troll Queen
steps.detail: Fight the Sea Troll Queen; use Protect from Magic while in melee range, and Ranged or Melee to deal damage.

steps.label: Finish the quest with Herman
steps.detail: Talk to Herman to complete Swan Song.

steps.label: Optionally cook a diary monkfish
steps.detail: Optionally catch and cook another monkfish afterward -- satisfies a hard Western Provinces Achievement Diary task.
